links.title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators

evidence: Abstract/Introduction: SRD improves strongest same-backbone baseline by 3.2 points on average across six in-domain benchmarks (67.5 vs DiffCoT 64.3) and improves strongest Qwen3-8B transfer average by 2.9 points

Section 4.1 (Setup): all main results averaged over five independent random seeds; fixed 1,024-instance subsets with seed 42 for benchmarks over 1,000 instances; Holm correction applied, per 'all six improvements remain significant after Holm correction'
Section 4.2 (Table 2): cross-dataset transfer on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B with SRD best on CSQA, WinoGrande, BoolQ, SQuAD, QuAC and leading every reported Qwen3 target (80.2 vs base 72.9)
Section 4.5 (Table 4): ablations show removing synthetic noise drops GSM8K 84.8 to 80.4, and operator-only/adjacent-state-only variants underperform the joint objective on all four tasks
Section 4.4 (Table 3): inference cost analysis on single RTX 4090 D showing latency grows 2.0x while generated tokens grow 7.8x as K goes 1 to 16

Section 3.2: operator extraction retains only sequences whose execution reconstructs paired states, but 'full construction details are given in the supplementary material' — not present in the document
Limitations section: 'Evaluation is limited to 8B backbones and fixed operators, motivating larger models and adaptive operators'
Missing availability claim: the document contains no statement releasing code, data, or trained adapters; reproducibility rests on described protocol plus deferred supplementary material
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning paper: operatorized semantic denoising for chain-of-thought correction on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, training via LoRA). The typed executable error-operator formulation distinguishing semantic-state denoising from token-level diffusion (Diffusion of Thoughts, LLaDA, Dream-7B, DiffCoT) is a genuine conceptual contribution, though it builds on an active self-correction line (Self-Refine, RISE, SCoRe). Experimental design is strong: six in-domain benchmarks plus seven transfer targets, five seeds, Holm-corrected significance, three noise-source ablations, objective ablations, and inference-cost analysis (Table 3: 7.8x token growth vs 2.0x latency). Evidence is quantitatively specific (SRD avg 67.5 vs DiffCoT 64.3, Table 1; Qwen3 transfer 80.2 vs base 72.9, Table 2) and honestly reports where SCoRe beats SRD (MMLU). Deductions: key construction details (operator extraction, significance tests, d_Z proof) are deferred to an unseen supplementary section; no code or data release is stated anywhere in the document; evaluation restricted to 8B backbones and a fixed operator library (acknowledged in Limitations); the train/inference state-distribution mismatch is mitigated only heuristically (Section 3.3).

primary_link.title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators

papers.summary: Large language models can produce fluent reasoning traces whose local semantic errors propagate to an incorrect conclusion, while unconstrained self-correction may preserve, amplify, or introduce errors. Existing diffusion language models provide iterative refinement, but usually define noise as token masking or replacement rather than as errors in the reasoning process. We present Semantic Reasoning Denoising (SRD), an operatorized Markov denoising method for natural-language reasoning trajecto
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型可能產生流暢卻含局部語義錯誤的推理軌跡，錯誤會向外傳播導致錯誤結論；而無約束的自我修正可能保留、放大甚至引入錯誤。現有擴散語言模型通常將雜訊定義為詞元遮罩或替換，而非推理過程中的錯誤。本文提出語義推理去噪（SRD），一種針對自然語言推理軌跡的運算子化馬可夫去噪方法：以可執行的錯誤運算子表示語義雜訊，每個運算子記錄錯誤類型、位置以及被破壞與修復的命題，並透過組合運算子建構逐漸加噪的狀態。訓練時，模型學習辨識當前軌跡中作用的語義雜訊，並重建成對的相鄰低噪狀態；推論時，噪音感知的去噪反覆預測逆運算子並檢查其適用性，使每次更新都朝穩定軌跡做局部移動。在涵蓋數學、程式碼、知識與常識的六個域內基準（GSM8K、MATH、HumanEval+、MBPP、MMLU、PIQA）上，SRD 平均達 67.5 分，較最強同骨幹基線 DiffCoT 提升 3.2 分，且在全部六項任務領先；在七個跨資料集遷移目標上，與 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 競爭力相當，並將 Qwen3-8B 最強基線平均提升 2.9 分。消融顯示結構化語義雜訊預測與迭代運算子執行是改善關鍵，而長組合下的定位則是瓶頸。限制為評估僅限 8B 骨幹與固定運算子。
papers.title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators
papers.title_zh: 語義推理去噪：以語義運算子修正語言模型推理

links.title: PropUQ-MAS: Propagation-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Multi-Agent Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'average relative gains of +6.10% in AUROC and +47.58% in PRR' for propagation-aware UQ over local baselines
Section 3.2.2, Eq. (2) and Assumptions 1-2: recursive rule r_v = 1-(1-u_v)∏(1-α_pv r_p) derived under edge-wise and local-propagation independence assumptions, with derivation in Appendix B.1
Section 4.1: 'median relative gains of +7.32% in AUROC and +41.36% in PRR' across Table 1 spanning three topologies, three datasets, two local UQ baselines (MSP, verbalized)
Section 4.2.2: LLM-judged intermediate-step evaluation on 300 sampled MedQA instances; 'human annotations agree with the GPT-5.5 judgments in 92.0% of cases' on 50 examples
Section 4.4 / Table 4: ablation showing self-reported acceptance weights (w/ α̂) consistently beat uniform weights (w/o α̂) across three MAS topologies on Qwen3-8B
Section 4.5 / Figure 4: self-reported adoption score monotonically aligns with empirical error-inheritance rate, 'increasing from 0.050 in the lowest bin to 0.973 in the highest'
Appendix D.3 / Table 8: comparison with re-implemented MATU and UProp on MedQA (Qwen3-8B); PropUQ achieves higher AUROC/PRR with much lower time per sample (e.g., 1.328s vs 41.410s sequential)

Limitations: authors acknowledge the α̂ proxy 'may be imperfectly calibrated as a probability', that independence assumptions 'may be violated' (e.g., prompt injection, context overload), and dependence on local UQ estimator quality
Footnote 1: 'Code is released at https://github.com/yaokunliu/PropUQ-MAS.git'; prompt templates and implementation details (GPU, sampling params, max lengths) given in Section 4 and Appendix E
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: an LLM-centric multi-agent reliability method (Agents 2.5, LLM 2.5, Reasoning 2.5, Code 2.0) evaluated on GSM8K, MedQA, and MBPP-Plus across Qwen3-4B/8B/14B and Gemma-3-12B. Novelty is solid but incremental: the DAG-based recursive propagation rule (Eq. 2) with acceptance/critique edge modes is a clean, new angle on MAS-specific UQ, though adjacent to UProp, MATU, and prior agent-uncertainty propagation work. Rigor is good: assumptions are explicitly stated, proofs provided (Appendix B), ablations on the self-reported acceptance weights (Table 4), scale analysis (Section 4.3), and an edge-weight validation showing monotonic alignment with empirical error-inheritance (Section 4.5, 0.050-0.973). Evidence is broad and consistent (median +7.32% AUROC, +41.36% PRR in Section 4.1) but lacks significance testing, AUROC gains are sometimes modest, MATU/UProp baselines are re-implementations rather than official code (Appendix D.3), and intermediate-step labels partly rely on an LLM judge with only 50-example human verification (92.0% agreement). Generalizability is well supported across topologies, model families, and scales, and the Limitations section candidly flags the independence assumptions and the imperfectly calibrated self-reported alpha proxy. Reproducibility is aided by a stated code release, full prompt templates (Appendix E), and generation parameters, though the release is unverified. Strong overall; falls short of top marks due to absence of statistical rigor around gains and heuristic edge-weight estimation.

primary_link.title: PropUQ-MAS: Propagation-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Multi-Agent Systems

papers.summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) solve complex tasks through communication among role-specialized agents. However, inter-agent dependencies introduce reliability risks beyond isolated agent failures. For instance, errors in intermediate messages could be inherited and amplified by downstream agents. Existing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods mainly target isolated responses or single-agent reasoning, and therefore fail to capture uncertainty propagation in MAS. To this end, we propose P
papers.summary_zh: 以 LLM 為基礎的多代理系統（MAS）透過角色專業化代理間的溝通解決複雜任務，但代理間依賴帶來超越單一代理失敗的可靠度風險：上游代理的中間訊息若有錯誤，可能被下游代理視為有效脈絡而繼承甚至放大。現有不確定性量化（UQ）方法主要針對孤立回應或單代理推理，無法捕捉 MAS 中的不確定性傳播。本文提出 PropUQ-MAS，一種傳播感知的 UQ 框架：將 MAS 執行展開為通訊結構的有向無環圖，以遞迴傳播規則結合每個節點的局部不確定性與自上游繼承的不確定性，其中邊層級的錯誤接受機率以模型自我報告的分數作為代理估計。該框架免訓練、可線上計算、拓撲無關，且計算複雜度隨圖規模線性增長。在 GSM8K、MedQA 與 MBPP-Plus 三個基準、順序、階層與去中心化三種 MAS 拓撲，以及 Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 與 Gemma-3-12B 等模型上，PropUQ-MAS 平均相對提升 AUROC +6.10% 與 PRR +47.58%，對最終輸出與中間步驟的不確定性估計皆有效。限制包括：自我報告的接受分數可能校準不完美；傳播規則依賴條件獨立假設；效能受局部 UQ 估計器品質影響。此研究為 MAS 的即時風險監控、早期干預與失敗歸因提供了實用的診斷訊號。
papers.title: PropUQ-MAS: Propagation-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: PropUQ-MAS：LLM 多代理系統的傳播感知不確定性量化

links.title: Training a Knowledge Base: Supervised Structure Learning for Agent-Curated Document Stores

evidence: Abstract: 'matching HippoRAG's gains with 1,913 links against its 196,112: per point of corpus covered, 1.5× the action saving and 2.1× the accuracy gain'

Sec. VII-B, Table IV: trained questions rho=0.747 (CI [0.64,0.87]) at +0.294 F1; both-keys +0.176 F1 (rho=0.879); one-key +0.059; neither-key parity; 'the trained group is the only cell significant on both benchmarks'

Sec. VI-C Reproducibility: 'Every action and its result is appended to a trace, so any intermediate store is rebuildable exactly by replay'; snapshot 'gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07' recorded; '200 iterations, 18.8M tokens, 6.8 h, ≈$13, single seed'
Sec. VII-D, Table V: 'precision is 94% and member recall 91% over the 220 whose key resolves'; 242 of 287 authored documents (84.3%) verified as genuine indexes

Sec. VII-B: coverage reaches 27.6%; 'Extending the epoch-1 slope reaches full coverage at roughly 400 distinct training questions and ≈48M tokens ... we state it as an extrapolation rather than a result'

Sec. VIII Threats to validity: 'Single seed; single agent by design; no support-set diagnostics on the external arm; grading is token-F1 against short golds'; reader and curator share gpt-5-mini family; four-point gradient is KBGym-only

Sec. VI-A / VI-B: two contamination-free arms (KBGym 5,864 sentences; PhantomWiki 3,403 sentences) with 'no-store score at ≈0'; baselines B1 flat, B2 GraphRAG-style, B3 HippoRAG-2-style under a fixed reader; no real-text arm run (Sec. VI-A: 'a real-text arm is the obvious third benchmark and we did not run it')
Sec. VII-A E1: pre-registered eval curve 'flat ... not distinguishable from noise' reported explicitly as low-information; forward accuracy 0.60→0.66 within epoch 1
Sec. VII-B PhantomWiki replication: rho=0.769 (CI [0.68,0.86]) trained group, accuracy 0.728→0.880, uncovered group F1 falls 0.765→0.718 (mild negative transfer)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely on-preference: an LLM-agent framework (gpt-5-mini curator/reader) that trains a knowledge base as a non-parametric model under a supervised train/test protocol, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLMs (2.5), RAG & Knowledge (1.8) and memory preferences. Novelty is genuine but compositional: agent-maintained wikis, agentic memory, and offline structure builders (GraphRAG, RAPTOR, HippoRAG) exist; the fresh contribution is the supervised forward/backward curation loop, the frozen-store examination, and the key-coverage gradient probe that converts 'does it generalize' into a decay curve, plus a contamination-free KBGym environment. Rigor is high: falsifiable predictions per experiment (Sec. VI-D), stratified four-group probe with identical template quotas, bootstrap CIs on rho, three alternative coverage definitions, honest handling of the epoch-mixing confound via the controlled trained column of Table IV, and candid negative results (B2 negative per point; uncovered PhantomWiki group falls 0.765→0.718). Evidence supports the efficiency claim within scope: Table III shows 1.5×/2.1× per-coverage-point advantage over B3 with 1,913 links vs 196,112; Sec. VII-D audits 94% precision/91% recall over 220 indexes. But key caveats temper it: cost savings significant only on trained questions (the single cell significant on both benchmarks), absolute accuracy trails full-coverage HippoRAG2, full-coverage parity is an extrapolation (≈400 questions, ≈48M tokens) stated as a lower bound, and only 27.6% of the corpus is covered. Generalizability is the weakest axis: both benchmarks are fictional/template-rendered universes, no real-text arm was run (contamination is the stated reason), curator and reader share one model family, and the four-point gradient exists only on KBGym (Sec. VIII threats). Reproducibility is solid for a paper without an explicit code URL: trace replay reconstructs any store byte-exact, model snapshot gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 is recorded, budgets/costs (~$13, 18.8M tokens) documented, integer-exact deterministic grading, and the abstract claims the KBGym generator is released. Weighted score ≈0.78.

primary_link.title: Training a Knowledge Base: Supervised Structure Learning for Agent-Curated Document Stores

papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation treats the document store as a frozen input, and the offline pipelines that do build structure over it build it unsupervised -- a whole corpus indexed at uniform effort, with no signal about which structure a question will need. We instead treat the knowledge base as a non-parametric model trained on (question, answer) pairs: a curator agent answers a supervised question against the current store, is shown the gold answer, then edits the store. The store carries fo
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）將文件庫視為凍結輸入，而離線管線即使為語料建構結構也是無監督的——整個語料以相同力度索引，沒有任何訊號指出未來問題需要什麼結構。本文反其道而行，將知識庫視為以（問題，答案）對訓練的非參數模型：策展代理先以當前文件庫回答監督問題，看到標準答案後再編輯文件庫——前向回答、後向整理，如同監督學習的訓練迴圈；評估時凍結文件庫，以固定行動預算的獨立讀者檢驗未見過的測試問題。研究在兩個無污染基準上進行：自建且釋出的 KBGym（虛構人物宇宙產生器）與 PhantomWiki，並以四個與訓練集重疊度遞減的問題組探測泛化。結果顯示策展文件庫的優勢隨關鍵覆蓋度成長：無共用鍵時持平，雙鍵覆蓋時 +0.176 F1，訓練問題上以 25% 更少行動達 +0.294 F1（唯一在兩基準皆顯著的單元）；與 HippoRAG 相比，僅用 1,913 個連結對抗其 196,112 個即達相近收益，每單位語料覆蓋率換得 1.5 倍行動節省與 2.1 倍準確率增益。限制在於覆蓋率：一百個訓練問題僅涵蓋約 27.6% 語料，且代理傾向為問題提及的鍵而非鍵的類別建索引。此研究確立了以監督訊號高效分配結構、並讓文件庫從線上流量持續學習的新範式。
papers.title: Training a Knowledge Base: Supervised Structure Learning for Agent-Curated Document Stores
papers.title_zh: 訓練知識庫：代理策展文件庫的監督式結構學習

links.title: RAG Collapse: LLM Responses Collapse When Retrieved Documents Are Self-Authored

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topic match across RAG, agents/tool use, LLM behavior, and safety; large-scale empirical study with 1,528 simulations, 1M+ API calls, three model families, controls, regression analysis with bootstrap CI, and shared raw data via Google Drive link. Novel RAG-collapse framing extends model collapse to retrieval settings with self-bias evidence controlling for reference quality. Weakened by industrial-lab provenance without peer review, commercial API reliance (GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5), proprietary ChatGPT reference collection, unshared prompts/code, single-judge paraphrase detection, and mostly single-run simulations per question; caution on industry-blog self-references and future-dated citations.

primary_link.title: RAG Collapse: LLM Responses Collapse When Retrieved Documents Are Self-Authored

papers.summary: LLM responses are based on the internet (via training or RAG), and AI is now used to generate a significant amount of content online (Paredes et al., 2026), creating the potential for a self-reinforcing feedback loop. Prior work has shown that when LLMs are recursively trained on their own output, they experience model collapse (Shumailov et al., 2024): responses become less diverse, and eventually no longer resemble the original training data. In this paper, we show that a similar collapse occu
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討檢索增強生成（RAG）的一種新型失效模式：當具備網路搜尋能力的 LLM 檢索到自己先前產生的內容時，回應多樣性會迅速崩潰。作者設計三種模擬情境——Replace All（每輪以自撰參考文件替換全部原始文件）、Replace One（每輪僅替換一份）與 Search（將自撰文章加入文件池並實際執行檢索）——以 GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Pro 與 Claude Sonnet 4.5 三個模型家族，針對 1,019 個資訊尋求型提問，共執行 1,528 次模擬與超過百萬次 API 呼叫。結果顯示 79.6% 的模擬最終崩潰，回應趨於完全一致；令人意外的是，即使僅替換一份自撰參考文件也足以觸發崩潰。分析顯示模型對自撰文件存在自我偏誤：其引用率達 38.9%，遠高於人類撰寫（7.4%）與 AI 生成的原始文件（9.4%），且在以 LLM 評審控制八個品質維度後，迴歸分析顯示「自撰」本身仍使引用率提升約 26 個百分點。限制在於：研究僅為模擬，未證實現實中已發生 RAG 崩潰，也未測試逐步加入其他類型 AI 生成內容的效果，且聚焦於資訊尋求型提問。本文重要性在於指出：隨著 AI 生成內容大量湧現，若搜尋系統持續檢索自撰文章，網路上的觀點多樣性可能收斂於單一視角，作者並提出過濾 AI 生成參考、分散搜尋結果、以系統提示鼓勵多元等緩解方向。
papers.title: RAG Collapse: LLM Responses Collapse When Retrieved Documents Are Self-Authored
papers.title_zh: RAG 崩潰：當 LLM 檢索到自身撰寫的文件時，回應隨之崩潰

links.title: MemGuard: Persisting Verifier Signals for LLM-Agent Memory Governance

evidence: Abstract: 'We evaluate MemGuard on Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-Bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web across four backbones... under matched runtime budgets' and 'Code is available at https://github.com/whyyyyy123/MemGuard'

Section 3.3: verifier descriptor d_m=(R_m,c_m,l_m,v_m) is 'attached to every candidate before activation and reused during retrieval, conflict resolution, summarization, and archival' (Abstract/Section 1 contribution (i))

Section 4.2: 'Across all 16 backbone-benchmark settings, MemGuard achieves the best success metric... with up to 7.9 SR-point gains on WebArena' but also 'MemGuard has 11 losses and one tie' across 320 seed-level comparisons
Appendix E.5, Table 26: paired bootstrap p-values with Benjamini-Hochberg correction (q=0.004-0.032, all 16 significant) and Holm correction (7/16 significant)
Appendix C.4, Tables 10-11: 800-case verifier audit with 86%/83% author agreement; 38 of 60 false accepts blocked by governance, 6 traced to downstream failures
Table 12 (Appendix C.4): under 30% simulated label noise MemGuard loses 0.3-2.6 fewer points than the verifier-only control

Limitations section: verifier dependence acknowledged ('false accepts can still promote unsupported experience'), thresholds 'selected on a small held-out development stream', no multimodal or privacy layer
Appendix B (prompts), Table 21 (full hyperparameter list), Appendix F (Reproducibility Statement): implementation details specified for reproduction
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference alignment: an LLM-agent memory-governance method evaluated with LLM backbones (Qwen, Gemini) on agent benchmarks (SWE-Bench, WebArena, Mind2Web, Terminal-Bench), hitting high-weight topics (LLMs, agents, RAG/memory, evaluation). The core contribution—persisting verifier descriptors as lifecycle metadata governing admission, retrieval, conflict resolution, and archival—is a genuine but incremental extension of ReasoningBank and LLM-as-a-Verifier rather than a new paradigm. Rigor is high: 16 backbone-benchmark settings, matched budgets, five seeds, ablations across all backbones, sensitivity analyses (thresholds, weights, token granularity, cross-family verifiers, label noise), and a 2,294-issue long-horizon stream. Evidence strength is solid, with an unusually honest disclosure that MemGuard loses 11 of 320 seed-level comparisons (Section 4.2) and verifier audits showing only 83-86% label agreement (Appendix C.4, Table 10). Caveats: gains are moderate (2.4-7.9 points), verifier audits are author-driven with disclosed kappa, hyperparameters tuned once on a small held-out stream (Limitations), and backbone model versions are not externally verifiable from the document. Reproducibility is supported by a code link, full prompt templates (Appendix B), hyperparameter table (Table 21), and audit protocols (Appendix D), though the repository cannot be verified from the text.

primary_link.title: MemGuard: Persisting Verifier Signals for LLM-Agent Memory Governance

papers.summary: LLM agents are moving from single-prompt use to long task streams in which reusable memory becomes a core capability for terminal, software-engineering, and web tasks. Such memory is useful only when stored experience remains reliable across hundreds of interactions, but two failure modes break that assumption in practice. The first is unreliable admission: failed trajectories,accidental successes, and misleading observations enter memory because they appear relevant, then mislead later decision
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理在終端機、軟體工程與網頁任務中日益依賴可重複使用的長期記憶，但存在兩大失效模式：不可靠的寫入（失敗軌跡、僥倖成功或誤導性觀察被存入記憶）與記憶漂移（重複、過時、衝突紀錄持續累積）。MemGuard 的核心主張是把驗證器輸出視為持續存在的生命週期中繼資料，而非一次性過濾器：系統以多準則分數驗證軌跡，轉換為獎勵、信心、標籤與不確定性描述子，附加於每條候選記憶，並在後續的檢索排序、衝突解決、摘要與封存中持續發揮作用；失敗經驗則以「防護約束」而非行動配方保留。評估涵蓋 Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-Bench Verified、WebArena 與 Mind2Web 四項基準與四種骨幹模型（Qwen-3.5-Flash/Plus、Gemini-3-Flash、Gemini-3.1-Pro），在相同的任務順序、步數預算與解碼設定下，MemGuard 於全部 16 個模型×基準組合取得最佳成功指標與最低平均步數，相較最強先前基線 ReasoningBank，在 WebArena 最高提升 7.9 個百分點、Mind2Web 提升 5.6 點、終端與軟體工程基準提升 2.4–3.5 點；消融實驗顯示治理機制（去重、衝突解決、封存）貢獻最大。限制包括對驗證器品質的依賴（與人工審核一致率 83–86%）、固定超參數在新領域可能需重新校準，以及未涵蓋多模態與隱私敏感場景。本文意義在於指出可靠的代理記憶是生命週期治理問題，僅靠語意檢索不足以維持長期穩定。
papers.title: MemGuard: Persisting Verifier Signals for LLM-Agent Memory Governance
papers.title_zh: MemGuard：以持久化驗證器訊號治理 LLM 代理記憶

llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark/analysis paper squarely within preferred scope: LLM coding agents maintaining agent skills across repository releases, evaluated with frontier models (Claude, GPT, GLM, Kimi, etc.) and an LLM-judge component. Novelty is moderate: 'silent staleness' and release-conditioned skill maintenance is a fresh framing, but the paper itself situates it against adjacent skill-lifecycle work (SkillGuard, SkillOps, Library Drift) and code-migration literature. Rigor is strong for a benchmark paper: fixed patch-grounded metric, 105 transitions/57 repos/1,890 runs, repository-clustered bootstrap CIs, paired significance tests, oracle localization ablation, and residualized correlation robustness; weaknesses include a curated staleness-positive (selection-biased) corpus, unvalidated LLM judges, and a small n=10, single-model utility study with an acknowledged headroom artifact. Evidence is well quantified (headline 29.9%-69.7% avg@3 macro F1 with CIs; oracle gain +12.2 with CI [+6.8,+17.8]), though the central downstream-utility claim relies on ten repositories. Generalizability is limited by concentration in AI/ML-ecosystem repositories and the challenge-set design. Reproducibility is moderate: released materials, version tags, commit hashes, and full instructions are claimed but no verifiable external link or inter-annotator agreement for manual gold verification appears in the text.

papers.summary_zh: 代理技能將儲存庫特定的程序性知識外部化為可檢索的模組，但此類知識與特定版本綁定：版本更迭後，舊技能可能仍可載入與檢索，卻持續提供過時指引，且沒有任何明確訊號提示失效——作者稱之為「無聲過時」。Repo2Skill-Evo 將每次版本轉換視為技能維護任務：給定固定的 V1 技能集與官方 V1→V2 release patch，代理須移除或修訂過時內容，同時保留仍然有效的指引。基準涵蓋 57 個真實 GitHub 儲存庫、105 個官方版本轉換，共 12,217 條經 patch 驗證的過時技能行，評估採嚴格以 patch 為依據的移除指標（精確率、召回率與 F1），輔以五維度 NL Judge。結果顯示六個前沿代理表現遠低於理想：最強的 Claude-opus-4.6 平均 F1 僅 69.7%，GLM-5.1 為 64.3%，GPT-5.4 召回率最高（74.6%）但精確率偏低，其餘模型最低僅 29.9%。錯誤診斷指出兩大瓶頸：受影響檔案的定位覆蓋不全使過時內容殘留，而過廣編輯雖提高召回卻損害精確率；提供 gold 檔案路徑的 Oracle 實驗可改善表現，但殘餘錯誤仍大，顯示檔案內的證據追蹤與編輯選擇同樣關鍵。限制在於資料集為刻意挑選的「過時陽性」挑戰集，且未評估維護後技能的下游效用。本文主張儲存庫技能應被視為帶有版本標記、需隨程式碼演進持續維護的知識資產。

Abstract/Section 1: eleven arms trained under identical conditions (same pool, 500 steps, batch 256x4, one 8xA800 node per arm) with all accuracies blind-judged
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled RL-training study for LLM/VLM math reasoning that squarely matches high-weight preferences: GRPO/PPO and reward design (Alignment & RLHF), mathematical/multi-step reasoning, LLM training methodology, multimodal VLMs, and benchmark/LLM-as-judge evaluation validity. It is RL methodology on a language model, not pure computer vision, so it stays in scope. Novelty is solid but tempered: the individual techniques (UFT hints, on-policy distillation, VAPO, HL-Gauss critics) are imported, and the categorical-critic result is explicitly concurrent with text-only work (Section 5, F3). Rigor is unusually strong: pre-verified sparsity preconditions, blind DeepSeek judging, McNemar exact tests, permutation-tested Spearman correlations, a scoring audit that found 19-30 pp differential parser penalties, and reward-hacking hypothesis testing (Section 6). Evidence is quantitatively strong (clean 30.6-32.9 vs 27.0-29.1 DynaMath separation, +14.4 pp from one loss change) but rests on a single seed, n=11 for correlations, ~3 pp template leakage, and an underpowered DynaMath-hard split. Generalizability is limited to one 2B model and one visual-math domain, with the authors themselves scoping the positive transfer-proxy finding as setting-specific (Section 7). Reproducibility is aided by full hyperparameters and environment-gated patches, but no code or data release is stated. Notably, the paper is not about Japanese LLMs, agents, or RAG, which caps relevance below maximum.

We train eleven methods under identical conditions in this regime, each injecting a different prior: text (reference-solution hints), distribution (on-policy distillation from a 7B teacher), and value (a value-pretrained critic with an MSE
papers.summary_zh: GRPO 在稀疏獎勵情境下會失效：當同組 rollouts 全數錯誤時梯度為零。在 Qwen2-VL-2B 正確率僅 3.6%、85–97% GRPO 群組全錯的 20,830 題視覺數學題池上，作者於相同資料、預算與種子下訓練十一種方法，各注入不同先驗：文字（參考解提示）、分佈（來自 7B 教師的 on-policy 蒸餾）與價值（以 MSE 或 HL-Gauss 類別損失訓練的 critic）。核心發現是「先驗只有在真正送達策略時才有幫助」：六個有效送達先驗的方法與其餘五者（無先驗基線、被教師能力封頂、被門控或損失參數化錯誤者）在跨領域 DynaMath 上完全分離、無重疊。方法層面：提示引導的探索是增益來源，UFT 的輔助損失無貢獻；將 critic 損失由 clipped-MSE 換成 HL-Gauss 交叉熵即提升 14.4 個百分點；全域退火蒸餾有效而門控持續蒸餾無效；兩種先驗疊加無增益。最重大的發現關於評估效度：長期作為泛化檢驗的 old-319 切片與真正的跨領域遷移呈負相關（Spearman ρ=-0.74），而域內最難切片 sparse-800 卻高度正相關（ρ=+0.89）——原因在於其中 69% 為近乎亂猜的四選一選擇題，實際獎勵「模型沒有改變」。作者據此撤回三項早期結論。限制包括單一訓練種子、部分切片統計檢定力不足。本文凸顯固定保留集可能反向誤導方法排序，並示範盲評、評分稽核與訓練前閘門等驗證協議。

links.title: The Chase Is the Curriculum, the Capture Anchors the Credit: Pursuit-Evasion Self-Play for Zero-Data LLM Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: evader 'trained on a capture-frontier reward that peaks when the solver captures it on exactly half of its rollouts'; pursuer gets 'capture-anchored dense process credit' from verifier progress.

Methodology/Problem Formulation, Eq. 2: coupled objectives use 'the verifier alone, with no human-curated tasks, labels, or reward models'; authors explicitly state the formulation is 'a pair rather than a minimax and carrying no equilibrium or convergence claim'.
Theoretical Analysis, Theorem 1: group-normalized advantage variance '(G-1)(1-p^G-(1-p)^G)' 'uniquely maximized at p=1/2'; elementary but exact.
Table 1: on PhantomWiki unified Qwen2.5-7B, LURE 65.8 vs R-Zero 50.8 and GRPO 43.3; on IFEval Qwen, 'Base remains the strongest overall entry'.
Table 2 (Ablation): removing the learned challenger costs -10.6 mean, round-anchored KL -6.3, dense credit -4.5; 'every removal lowers the mean'.

Evaluation Integrity, Table 3(a): removing the gold grid drops the R-Zero Round-5 checkpoint from 68.0 to 6.0 on ZebraLogic, 'locates the apparent advantage in prompt leakage rather than ... stronger reasoning'.
OOD Generalization, Table 5: aggregate mean 34.7 vs Base 34.1 (+0.6); text concedes 'gains remain modest and benchmark-dependent' (Conclusion).

Implementation Details: verl-GRPO under FSDP-2 on 16x RTX 6000 Pro, R=8 rounds, K=48 candidates/env, G=8 rollouts, lambda=0.25, c_red=0.05, beta=0.1, lr 5e-6; no explicit code-release statement appears in the provided text.
Table 4 (Curriculum Cost): LURE trains on 144 tasks at 8 rollouts/task vs R-Zero's 36 tasks at 40 rollouts/task.
Scaling Behavior, Fig. 5: 'filled markers are measured and hollow markers are projections of the power-law fit', 7B to 72B Qwen2.5-Instruct.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning methodology: zero-data self-play for RLVR-based reasoning with GRPO, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, agents/planner-executor, RL, evaluation). The pursuit-evasion framing, capture-frontier evader reward min(p,1-p), and verifier-only dense process credit are a competent recombination of known ideas (adaptive curriculum at intermediate success rates from prior RL work; proposer-solver self-play like R-Zero/Absolute Zero), with the co-training of a difficulty-selection challenger and a multi-turn planner-executor solver as the main incremental novelty. Rigor is solid: formal objectives, three exact though elementary theoretical results (honestly disclaimed as carrying no equilibrium/convergence claim), 8 ablations with clear role grouping, 6-hyperparameter sensitivity, cost analysis, scaling to 72B, and an unusually candid evaluation-integrity audit showing a prior ZebraLogic advantage stemmed from gold-grid prompt leakage (68.0 -> 6.0 on removal). Evidence is quantitative across three backbones and three verifiable environments, but results appear single-run without variance estimates, the scaling figure mixes measured points with power-law projections, and IFEval gains over the zero-shot base are absent at 7B. OOD transfer is honest but weak (+0.6 aggregate mean, benchmark-dependent). The method presupposes environments with programmatic difficulty-indexed generators and step-verifiable progress signals, limiting scope. Implementation details are thorough (verl-GRPO, FSDP-2, all coefficients given, algorithms and prompts in appendices), but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: The Chase Is the Curriculum, the Capture Anchors the Credit: Pursuit-Evasion Self-Play for Zero-Data LLM Reasoning

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become the dominant recipe for improving large language model reasoning, yet it presumes large human-curated task collections. Zero-data self-play removes this dependency, but existing methods vet learnability only by probing candidates and rejecting post hoc, never learning where along an environment's difficulty axis to place a task, and credit the solver with sparse terminal rewards alone. We recast zero-data self-play as a pursuit-evasion ga
papers.summary_zh: 強化學習搭配可驗證獎勵已成為提升大型語言模型推理能力的主流方法，但依賴人工策劃的任務集；現有零資料自博弈僅事後拒絕不當任務，未學習如何在難度軸上定位任務，且僅提供稀疏的終端獎勵。本文提出LURE，將零資料自博弈重構為追逃博弈：LLM逃避者沿各環境的難度軸放置任務，緊隨規劃者—執行者追捕者的能力前沿；其訓練採用「捕捉前沿」獎勵，當解答者在恰好一半的抽樣中捕捉任務時達到峰值，並附加難度特徵重複懲罰；追捕者則獲得以捕捉為錨的密集過程信用，將驗證器的單調進展與終端捕捉一起做組別標準化，並以輪次錨定KL穩定共同演化。在三個可驗證推理環境（PhantomWiki、IFEval、ZebraLogic）與三個骨幹模型家族上，LURE在統一與專家設定下均超越GRPO、R-Zero等基線；修正評估洩漏後，ZebraLogic上先前的差距被證實部分源自gold答案洩漏。消融實驗顯示學習型挑戰者貢獻最大。在九項OOD基準上僅有小幅且視基準而定的改進。此方法把「保持剛好可捕捉」變成學到的定位策略，而非手工調校的拒絕區間，具實務價值。

links.title: Training Needs Trustworthy Worlds: Verified Synthetic Web Environments for Agent Learning

evidence: Abstract: framework 'verifies and repairs structural, semantic, consistency, and feasibility defects before policy training' and 'improves feasible-task rate from 48.6% to 94.8%' with transfer to WebArena, WebShop, MiniWoB++ 'without LLM calls at evaluation time'.

Section 5.1: 500 synthetic environments across six domains, 350/75/75 train/validation/test split with no shared page templates or task constraints; compact DOM-grounded policy 'fewer than 10M parameters' trained with PPO; results averaged over three seeds with 95% confidence intervals.
Table 1 (Section 5.2, RQ1): Ours reaches 3.3 avg defects, 0.7 blocking defects, 94.8% feasible, 91.4% Human SR, 2.8% state violations, 18m curation vs No Verification 12.4/4.9/48.6%/36.9%/18.7%.

Appendix C.1, Table 5: Ours 18.6±2.8 WebArena SR, 43.8±3.0 WebShop, 55.4±3.1 MiniWoB++ with 0.0 evaluation LLM calls, vs GPT-4 ReAct 15.3/38.7/47.6; text explicitly notes results should not be read as superiority under native multimodal browser use.

Appendix C.6, Table 6: independent audit with a separately implemented held-out trace analyzer and 240-task author replay; false-feasible rate drops from 12.4% (No Verification) to 2.3% (Ours), addressing verifier circularity.
Appendix C.8, Table 9: Ours-Token-Matched (42.5K tokens/env) achieves 87.4% feasible vs Single-LLM 70.4% at matched budget, supporting that gains come from coordination rather than LLM budget.

Section 5.2, Figures 5 and 6: RQ2 policy learning curves and RQ3 component-ablation results are presented only as figures; no numeric success-rate values for these main policy results appear in the text.
Section 5.1 Metrics lists 'Human task success rate (Human SR)' and Table 1 reports 91.4%, but no annotator count, protocol, or agreement statistics are provided anywhere in the paper.

Appendix B.1/B.2: full PPO hyperparameters (ξ=0.99, λ_GAE=0.95, clip 0.2, lr 3e-4, H_max=40, 1e6 steps), reward coefficients α=0.5, γ=0.2, η=0.01, ~48 GPU-hours on one A10G per condition, ~18M LLM tokens for construction; however, no code or data release is mentioned.

Appendix D (Limitations): event-driven simulator 'may be less efficient for applications where nearly every interaction changes backend state'; Appendix F names LLM usage but does not specify which model generates scaffolds or proposes state deltas (only verifiers are stated as GPT-4 in Appendix A.7).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is web-agent training infrastructure: verified/repairable LLM-generated web environments plus event-driven simulation and backend-grounded dense rewards for PPO. This lands squarely in the highest-weighted Agents & Tool Use preference, with solid secondary matches to reinforcement learning, LLM-based generation/verification, and agent evaluation; it is not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate-to-good: prior synthetic-environment and trajectory-synthesis work (EnvGen, DreamGym, WebRL per Related Work) exists, but shifting the generation object to verifiable, repairable environment scaffolds with marker-validated state writes is a distinctive combination rather than an incremental agent-side tweak. Rigor is strong: five environment-construction baselines, five policy-training conditions, a component ablation (Fig. 6), three seeds with 95% CIs (§5.1), a token-budget-matched control (Table 9), and an independent executability audit (Table 6) that mitigates the internal-verifier circularity concern. Deductions: RQ2 learning curves and RQ3 ablations appear only as figures without numeric tables; the 'Human SR' metric protocol (annotators, counts, agreement) is never described. Evidence strength is solid given the many CI-annotated tables, but author-audited defect labels (1,286 defects, Appendix C.7) carry self-audit bias risk, and GPT-4 comparisons are confined to a DOM-only interface (acknowledged in C.1). Generalizability is supported by six domains and transfer to WebArena/WebShop/MiniWoB++ (Table 5), though the limitation that event-driven simulation assumes sparse state writes (Appendix D) and the DOM-compatible WebArena subset constrain scope. Reproducibility is middling: PPO hyperparameters, compute budget (~48 GPU-hours, A10G, B.1-B.2), and token usage are reported, but no code/data release is stated and the scaffold-generator LLM and state-writer model are never named (Appendix F lists usage only).

primary_link.title: Training Needs Trustworthy Worlds: Verified Synthetic Web Environments for Agent Learning

papers.summary: Web agents promise to automate complex digital workflows, but their training remains limited by synthetic environments that look plausible while hiding broken links, inconsistent states, or infeasible tasks. We address the gap between scalable environment generation and trustworthy agent learning by constructing synthetic web environments that are executable, auditable, and grounded in backend state. Our framework represents each generated website as a structured scaffold of pages, navigation li
papers.summary_zh: 網路代理的訓練受限於合成環境「看似合理卻暗藏斷鏈、狀態不一致或任務不可行」的缺陷，這些錯誤會讓策略為環境自身的瑕疵而非自身失誤受罰。本文提出一套架構，將LLM生成的網站表示為結構化鷹架：頁面、導覽連結、資料庫紀錄、狀態變更標記與任務約束，並在策略訓練前驗證與修復結構、語意、一致性與可行性四類缺陷。執行時期，一般UI轉移以確定性方式處理，僅持久性後端寫入須經驗證的狀態變更標記，任務約束則編譯為後端謂詞以提供密集獎勵。在橫跨六個領域的500個合成環境上，可行任務率由48.6%升至94.8%，任務阻塞缺陷大幅下降，策展時間亦低於自一致性與AutoGen。以此環境訓練的小型PPO策略（小於10M參數）在保留環境上學習更穩定，並成功遷移至WebArena、WebShop與MiniWoB++，且評估時不需LLM呼叫；補充分析確認收益並非僅來自更大的驗證預算，獨立審計亦佐證可行性改善。限制在於事件驅動模擬於每步皆改動後端狀態的情境可能較不經濟。此工作將合成網路代理學習由表面合理性轉向可執行、狀態紮根的監督。

links.title: Loop Engineering: Building Blocks, Adoption, and Impact

evidence: Section 4.1: 'Manual verification confirmed autonomous agent processes... in 217 of the 256 repositories we inspected (0.59% of the scanned repositories)'
Section 4.1: 'the heuristics' precision is 0.868 (95% Clopper-Pearson CI [0.820, 0.907])'
Section 6, Internal validity: 'The 256 repository labels... were annotated by an LLM and adjudicated by one author, not independently double-coded... so we report no agreement statistic'
Section 3, O6: 'systematic evidence for either side is missing'; Section 4.2 describes only a planned controlled experiment for RQ3 with no results
Section 6, Data availability: 'Our supplementary material is openly available on Zenodo... the scan scripts, heuristic catalog, result data, annotation protocol and codebook'
Section 6, External validity: 'The prevalence we report describes our repository sample, not open-source software at large'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly aligned with high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, Prompting/Context Engineering): the paper empirically studies agentic coding tools, autonomous agent loops, orchestration, verification gates, and escalation to humans. Novelty is moderate: it offers the first adoption measurement of a freshly coined practitioner practice, but the paper itself concedes the phenomenon may be 'renamed cron jobs' (Section 3, O2) and the literature review is interpretive and source-dependent. Rigor is above average for exploratory work: deterministic scan of 36,710 repositories, manual verification of all 256 candidates, precision 0.868 with Clopper-Pearson CI, codebook, and an honest threats-to-validity section; however, labels were LLM-annotated and adjudicated by a single non-blind author, and behavioral heuristics lack any negative-control validation. Evidence strength is limited by the exploratory, descriptive nature: RQ3 (the outcome/effort experiment) is only a design, and the paper explicitly states 'systematic evidence for either side is missing' (Section 3, O6). Generalizability is constrained: public-GitHub-only, eight tools, one snapshot ten weeks after the term was coined, dataset-inherited composition (Section 6, External validity). Reproducibility is good: deterministic versioned pipeline with rule-catalog hashes and Zenodo supplementary material including scripts, codebook, and archived run histories.

primary_link.title: Loop Engineering: Building Blocks, Adoption, and Impact

papers.summary: Over the past months, the way developers direct agentic AI coding tools has moved up several levels of abstraction, from phrasing prompts to engineering context to configuring the harness around the model. In June 2026, practitioners began to describe a further level called loop engineering: Instead of prompting an agent interactively, developers design systems that prompt agents for them. These systems start agent runs on a schedule or on repository events and stop them when a machine-checkable
papers.summary_zh: 「迴圈工程」於2026年6月由實務社群命名：開發者不再親自對代理下提示，而是設計以排程或儲存庫事件觸發、以機器可檢查停止條件為界的系統代為提示代理。本文對新興灰文獻進行探索性回顧，發現各方對良好迴圈的組成大致有共識：觸發與排程、持久狀態檔、獨立驗證子代理、token預算與人類升級點；但其新穎性與價值宣稱皆建立在軼事與自報數字上。為補足缺口，作者掃描36,710個軟體儲存庫，以檔案與內容啟發式規則搭配行為訊號偵測，再對256個候選逐一手動驗證，確認217個（約0.59%）確實運作自主代理迴圈，多為儲存庫事件觸發的pull request審查與排程議題分類，啟發式精確率0.868。關鍵發現是：迴圈的組態會被提交至版本控制，但灰文獻所倡議的狀態檔幾乎不存在——多數迴圈要麼無狀態可存，要麼由議題追蹤器承載進度。論文據此規劃自主性層級對照實驗（互動、目標驅動、排程迴圈）作為期刊延伸，並提出迴圈可觀測性為未來方向。限制包括灰文獻選材主觀、啟發式涵蓋有限與單一時點掃描。此研究把實務熱詞轉為可實證檢驗的對象。

links.title: No One Model Catches Every Harm: Benchmarking Content Moderation Across Safety Scenarios

evidence: Section 3: evaluates 53 models on 11 datasets under prompt-only (Q) and prompt-with-response (QA), binary Safe/Unsafe macro F1 following prior moderation work
Appendix B.3 (Table 4): paired non-parametric bootstrap with 1,000 resamples; only 4 of 18 dataset-mode cases show statistically significant top-1 vs rank-2 gaps, tie-tiers up to 28 models

Section 4.5 / Table 2: optimized safety prompt outperforms simple and LlamaGuard templates on three open-source models, gains of 4-15% over LlamaGuard prompt; tuned on 10% of toxicchat/wildguard training splits, 'never tuned on evaluation data'
Section 4.6: QA setting favors specialized moderators (Llama-Guard-3-8B 78.6% best average, Section 4), scale alone does not ensure safety

Section 6 Limitations: English-only, datasets capped at 1,000 samples, single-turn, binary labels discard severity/multi-label signal, QA responses from limited source models, closed-source APIs may silently update
Section 5 Conclusion: 'Code and evaluation scripts will be released upon acceptance' - no current artifact availability
Appendix B.5/B.6 (Table 5): temperature=0, max_tokens=32, NVIDIA A100 40GB hardware, per-model ms/sample latency for 31 open-source models
Appendix B.2 (Table 6): sampling preserves harmful rates (e.g., toxicchat 7.10% to 6.30%, beavertails 57.40% to 57.10%)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic LLM safety evaluation: benchmarks 53 LLM/moderator models (GPT, Gemini, Llama, Gemma, Phi, Mistral, LlamaGuard, WildGuard, BingoGuard, PolyGuard) on 11 datasets across jailbreak, policy, over-refusal, and conversational categories under Q and QA settings, matching the LLM, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences. Novelty is moderate: the contribution is breadth plus a claimed-first systematic Q-vs-QA ranking comparison and a C1-C4 taxonomy rather than a new method, with the optimized prompt being an incremental artifact. Rigor is solid: paired-bootstrap 95% CIs with honest reporting that only 4/18 top-1 vs rank-2 gaps are significant (Appendix B.3), prompt ablation (Section 4.5, Table 2), reasoning-effort ablation (B.4), balanced sampling with preserved harmful rates (B.2), and latency measurements (B.6). Evidence is extensive (per-dataset per-model F1 tables 7-12) but purely aggregate, with no human verification of verdict parsing and QA results coupled to dataset-provided responses. Generalizability is limited by the paper's own admissions: English-only, single-turn, 1,000-record caps, binary labels, and API version drift (Section 6). Reproducibility is middling: prompts, hardware (temperature=0, max_tokens=32, A100 40GB), and sampling are documented, but code is only promised 'upon acceptance' (Section 5) and closed-source results are time-sensitive.

primary_link.title: No One Model Catches Every Harm: Benchmarking Content Moderation Across Safety Scenarios

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet they remain vulnerable to generating harmful content. From adversarial jailbreaks that bypass safety filters to implicit hate that evades detection, the range of risks these models pose continues to grow. While both specialized content moderators and general-purpose LLMs are being used as safety layers, the question of which model is best suited for which type of harmful content remains unanswered. We present
papers.summary_zh: 實務上難以判斷該為特定危害選擇專用審核模型還是通用LLM。本文提出迄今規模最大的LLM安全審核評測：在僅提示與提示加回覆兩種設定下，測試53個模型於11個資料集，並將資料集歸類為四類挑戰：C1對抗與越獄抵抗、C2標準政策執行、C3良性提示的過度拒絕、C4對話與真實世界安全。主要發現：僅提示設定下，GPT系列與Gemini-2.5-pro等大型商用模型以75%至77%的macro-F1領先；但在可見模型回覆的設定中，Llama-Guard-3-8B（78.6%）與BingoGuard等專用安全模型顯著勝出，反映其訓練資料格式優勢；對抗類資料加入回覆後準確率提升約10%；C4對話安全對所有模型家族皆未解決，平均僅約52%；規模本身並不保證安全，BingoGuard-Phi3-3B等小型模型常以約2%的折價勝過更大模型。作者另透過提示工程提出最佳化的安全提示，在多個開源模型上較Llama Guard提示提升4%至15%。統計檢定顯示僅少數情境有顯著的第一名差距。限制包括僅限英文、每資料集上限1000筆、二元標籤與單輪互動。整體而言，危害類型、回覆可見度與過度拒絕成本應與參數量並列為模型選擇依據。
papers.title: No One Model Catches Every Harm: Benchmarking Content Moderation Across Safety Scenarios
papers.title_zh: 沒有單一模型能捕捉每種危害：跨安全情境的內容審核基準

links.title: CD-LoRA: Consistency-Driven Low-Rank Adaptation for Multi-Task Fine-Tuning

evidence: Abstract: claims CD-LoRA 'consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-adapter baselines' and offers 'a simpler, router-free, and more stable solution for multi-task PEFT'.
Table 2 (Section 5.2): on Qwen2.5-7B, CD-LoRA avg 83.92 vs M-LoRA 83.43 and R-LoRA 83.12; on 7B GSM8K CD-LoRA (50.40) is below HydraLoRA (51.60), and on 7B ARC M-LoRA (92.29) exceeds CD-LoRA (92.17).

Table 3 (Section 6.1 ablation): DR-LoRA (router removed, no consistency) reaches 88.29 avg at 49,869 MB, versus full CD-LoRA at 88.56 avg and 56,883 MB; consistency module alone adds +0.27 avg with a memory increase.
Section 3.2 / Appendix B.3: t-SNE analysis of LoRA-A activations uses 'one example per task in the main analysis' and the paper concedes 't-SNE provides only a qualitative perspective'.

Appendix B.4.1: states 'we optionally incorporate R-Drop regularization... a symmetric divergence term... in the adapter latent space', indicating the consistency mechanism is a latent-space R-Drop variant; main lambda=0.05 (B.4.1) vs Section 6.3 reporting optimal lambda=0.03.
Section 5.1: backbones limited to Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-14B ('two decoder-only LLMs'), with a Qwen2.5-3B used only for the lambda sensitivity analysis (Section 6.3).

Abstract/keywords: 'The code is available at the anonymous link' - availability claim not verifiable from the document; training details (rank r=4, alpha=32, K=3, lr 2e-4, AdamW, warmup 0.03, seed=7) are given in Appendix B.4.

Appendix A.3-A.4: second-order Taylor derivation links consistency loss to Hessian/curvature control via proportionality claims under an isotropic Gaussian assumption; no direct measurement of the training-inference discrepancy quantity on real models is reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM PEFT methodology paper (LoRA multi-task fine-tuning on Qwen2.5-7B/14B) that aligns strongly with top-weighted preferences (LLMs, training/optimization). The de-routing insight plus a consistency regularizer is a competent but incremental contribution: the consistency loss is essentially R-Drop applied in the adapter latent space (Appendix B.4.1 even describes R-Drop as 'optionally incorporate[d]'), and the paper's own 2x2 ablation (Table 3) shows de-routing alone (DR-LoRA, 88.29 avg, 49,869 MB) captures most of the gain over routed baselines, with the consistency module adding only +0.27 avg at ~14% more memory. Margins over baselines are small (0.49-1.18 avg points, Table 2), reported without significance testing or multiple seeds (seed=7 only), and 'consistently outperforms' is overstated given losses on individual tasks (e.g., GSM8K 50.40 vs HydraLoRA 51.60 on 7B). Evidence is mixed: quantitative tables and memory measurements are provided and internally consistent, but the t-SNE representation analysis uses 'one example per task' (Appendix B.3) and is purely qualitative. Generalizability is limited to one model family and NLU-style tasks; reproducibility benefits from detailed hyperparameters (r=4, alpha=32, K=3, lambda=0.05, AdamW, 2e-4, seq len 512) but the code is only an unverifiable 'anonymous link' and there are minor config inconsistencies (main lambda=0.05 vs optimal lambda=0.03 in Section 6.3).

primary_link.title: CD-LoRA: Consistency-Driven Low-Rank Adaptation for Multi-Task Fine-Tuning

papers.summary: While Multi-Task Learning (MTL) is essential for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to diverse domains, prevailing LoRA-based methods rely on complex routing mechanisms that partition task-specific knowledge. In this work, we reveal that such routing-based designs are prone to a training-inference discrepancy, where stochastic routing decisions under distribution shifts compromise inference stability. Driven by a second-order Taylor analysis that exposes the instability induced by routing var
papers.summary_zh: 多頭LoRA變體常引入MoE式動態路由以分流任務知識，但本文分析指出：softmax路由的非線性使訓練時隨機輸出的期望不等於推論時的確定性混合，形成「訓練—推論落差」，在分布偏移下損害穩定性；二階泰勒展開顯示落差主要由共享投影矩陣LoRA-A的Hessian曲率驅動。作者提出CD-LoRA：完全移除路由器，將所有LoRA頭均等並聯，確保訓練與推論共用同一前向計算圖；並透過一致性驅動對齊機制，對共享的LoRA-A做雙次dropout前向，以對稱KL損失約束表示方差，作為平滑Hessian曲率的可計算代理，總目標為任務損失加權一致性正則項。在Qwen2.5-7B與14B的12項NLU任務上，CD-LoRA平均達83.92%與85.90%，超越LoRA、HydraLoRA、R-LoRA與M-LoRA，且峰值記憶體較HydraLoRA減少35.3%；t-SNE顯示任務表示更緊湊且分離良好，消融實驗證實「去路由」與「一致性對齊」各有貢獻且相乘生效，LoRA-B矩陣的餘弦相似度分析亦支持子空間一致性假說。限制在於增益幅度中等，且正則權重λ過大（0.5以上）反而損害表現。此工作挑戰多任務參數高效微調必須依賴動態路由的慣例。
papers.title: CD-LoRA: Consistency-Driven Low-Rank Adaptation for Multi-Task Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: CD-LoRA：一致性驅動的多任務微調低秩調適

links.title: EDGE: Experience-Distillation for Guided Exploration in Agentic Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract: claims 'improves over strong RL baselines by up to 12.5 points and remains effective without inference-time scaffolds or a proprietary reflector'; code link https://github.com/xvolcano02/EDGE
Table 1: at 7B, EDGE 82.6±3.8 WebShop success vs GRPO 70.1 and EMPO2 77.1±4.0; ALFWorld 90.4±2.2 vs GRPO 82.1; results averaged over 3 random seeds
Table 3 (§4.3 Ablations): w/o Gain-Gating falls to 72.3 (below GRPO 82.1), w/o Distillation 83.6, w/o ExpPruning 86.7 vs EDGE 90.4 on ALFWorld Qwen2.5-7B
Figure 2 (§4.2): scaffold-free retention 96.0% for EDGE vs 82.9% SkillRL and 92.3% EMPO2 at 7B
Table 2 (§4.2): EDGE (GPT-4o) avg 44.6 vs SkillRL 41.5 and Search-R1 38.7 on seven QA benchmarks; EDGE (self) 43.4 retains 97.3%
Table 5 (Appendix B.3): EDGE 417.72 s/step, 20.3% overhead over GRPO, but 7.8% faster than SkillRL and 6.0% faster than EMPO2
Appendix B.2 Table 4: full hyperparameters (λ=0.1, top-k=20, η=-0.1, μ=0.5, ξ=0.4, G=8), verl-agent framework, 8×A100 80GB

Limitations section: acknowledges training-time overhead of bank maintenance/teacher-student comparisons, dependence on reward quality, evaluation restricted to Qwen 1.5B/7B/4B and discrete textual experiences
Appendix A: theoretical analysis of unbiased marginal-gain estimator with Hoeffding bound (Eq. 12), EMA variance (Eq. 14), pooled advantage calibration (Eqs. 16-17)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM agents trained with GRPO (Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B, Qwen3-4B) across ALFWorld, WebShop, and seven search-based QA benchmarks, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLM, agents, RL, memory/RAG). The framework—partitioning rollout groups to estimate marginal experience gain, gain-gated on-support reverse-KL distillation, and a co-evolving experience bank—is a sensible but incremental combination of known ingredients (experience augmentation, privileged distillation, OPSD-style on-policy distillation, skill/memory libraries); the paired-rollout gain gate and retirement-on-internalization framing are the most novel parts. Rigor is solid: controlled hyperparameters across baselines, 3-seed means with std, full component ablations (gain gating, distillation, pruning), wall-clock profiling showing 20.3% overhead, λ sensitivity, and theoretical appendix; but ablations cover only ALFWorld-7B, the Δe gate uses only G/2=4 trajectories per arm, and no significance tests are reported. Evidence is strong and internally consistent (Table 1 gains, Figure 2 96.0% scaffold-free retention vs 82.9% SkillRL/92.3% EMPO2, Figure 4 non-stationary gain tracking, Table 6 utility traces), though some baselines are replicated from prior papers († in Table 1). Generalizability is moderate: three scales, two backbone families, self-reflector variant, but text-only discrete experiences, sparse binary rewards, and acknowledged lack of other model families/multimodal settings. Reproducibility is good: code link, full hyperparameter table (Table 4), prompts in Appendix E, hardware specified.

primary_link.title: EDGE: Experience-Distillation for Guided Exploration in Agentic Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with outcome-based objectives such as GRPO enables LLM-based agents to solve complex, long-horizon tasks, yet the reusable exploration patterns embedded in interaction trajectories are largely discarded after a single policy update. Existing experience-augmented approaches retrieve historical guidance at inference time, but they apply experiences without accounting for the policy's evolving capability and create persistent dependencies on external retrieval. We propose EDG
papers.summary_zh: 以GRPO為代表的成果導向強化學習讓LLM代理能處理長程任務，但軌跡中可重複利用的探索模式在一次策略更新後即被丟棄；現有經驗增強方法於推論時檢索歷史指引，卻未考量策略能力演變，且造成持久的檢索依賴。EDGE將檢索經驗視為暫時的訓練期鷹架：每個rollout組對半切分為經驗條件與無經驗軌跡，在不增加環境抽樣下估計經驗的邊際增益；僅當增益為正時，才以反向KL在學生自身的軌跡支撐上進行增益門控的特權蒸餾，將鷹架行為內化至基礎策略並避免負遷移；經驗庫則與策略共同演化——由失敗模式對比合成新經驗，並依EMA效用追蹤修剪過時條目。在ALFWorld與WebShop上，7B模型分別達90.4%與82.6%，較GRPO提升8.3與12.5點，增益集中於Heat、Cool、Pick2等探索密集子任務；移除推論期鷹架後仍保留96.0%效能（SkillRL僅82.9%），證明行為已內化至參數。在七個搜尋式QA基準上平均較Search-R1提升5.9點，且以策略自身作為反思器仍保留97.3%效能。限制包括每步約20.3%的訓練額外開銷、對獎勵品質的依賴與有限的模型規模範圍。其「鷹架到參數」的原則對代理強化學習具啟發意義。
papers.title: EDGE: Experience-Distillation for Guided Exploration in Agentic Reinforcement Learning

links.title: MEMORY Wins All: Indirect Bias Injection Attacks via Social Media Feeds

evidence: Abstract: IBIA achieves adversary-aligned response rates of 91.2% on average across four downstream tasks, including 86.6% on the frontier GPT-5.5; watermark-based curation identifies 95.9% of injected comments; memory boundary defense reduces AARs to 80.6% detection.
Section 2.3, Table 1: positions IBIA as the only 'Indirect' access attack versus AgentPoison, PoisonedRAG, MINJA, and MemoryGraft, all of which require direct store/corpus/query/code access.
Section 5.3, Table 5: post-attack +1 rates range 87-100% across six backends and four categories versus no-attack baselines of 0-23.5%, with GPT-5.5 at 81.5-98%.
Section 5.4, Table 8: ablation on DeepSeek-V4-Flash shows removing both watermarking and category anchoring drops AAR to 3-22% while the full IBIA configuration reaches 97.8-100%.
Section 6.2, Table 9: LLM-based memory-boundary filter detects 4,834/6,000 injected entries (80.6%) with a 5.6% false positive rate (56/1,000) on a benign Civil Comments subset.

Appendix G: five authors verify the GPT-5.4 judge against 5,160 judgments with 94.2% agreement; 301 disagreements human-corrected, and the dominant judge error (false directionalization) is argued to inflate baselines rather than attack rates.
Section 7: factual prior analysis shows conflicting-pose injection alignment rises from 28% to 63% after anonymizing recognizable entity names across 200 conspiracy-claim events.
Appendix B: anonymous code repository with BiasBench dataset, implementation, and defense code provided at anonymous.4open.science/r/ibia-dc0b/.
Section 5.1: evaluation limited to OpenClaw Docker containers v2026.5.2 and a private Moltbook deployment; no adversary content posted to live Reddit for ethical reasons.
Section 2.3, Table 2: SNSwatcher skill passes BIV, Skill Scanner, and Snyk Agent Scan with no flags.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-profile work on LLM personal-agent security: indirect memory corruption via benign skill curation touches Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming/Evaluation, and persistent memory, evaluated across seven LLMs. Novelty is moderate: the indirect (agent-performed write) access model is a genuine step beyond AgentPoison/PoisonedRAG/MINJA/MemoryGraft, but it builds on established memory-poisoning and indirect prompt-injection ideas, and the watermarking component adapts prior post-hoc watermarking. Rigor is solid: BiasBench construction, no-attack baselines, component ablation (Table 8), microbenchmarks for toxicity evasion and watermark detection, and human verification of the LLM judge (Appendix G, 94.2% agreement with human-corrected labels) strengthen the claims. Weaknesses: ablation on only one backend, judge from the same vendor family as one target, LLM-generated synthetic feed content, single agent framework (OpenClaw) and private Moltbook environment, and email-task results shown for only two models despite the headline four-task average. A practical defense with FPR analysis is provided. Anonymous code and dataset release supports reproducibility, though reliance on proprietary frontier models and a versioned private deployment limits it.

primary_link.title: MEMORY Wins All: Indirect Bias Injection Attacks via Social Media Feeds

papers.summary: Personal AI agents routinely consume external content while performing tasks such as web browsing, email processing, and SNS feed summarization, and they retain selected information or execution results in persistent memory for later use. We show that this ordinary ingestion of external content opens an indirect path for manipulating subsequent agent behavior. Based on this observation, we present IBIA, an Indirect Bias Injection Attack that plants an adversary-aligned stance on a specific topic
papers.summary_zh: 個人AI代理例行攝取外部內容並將選定資訊存入持久記憶，此正常流程開啟了間接攻擊路徑：攻擊者無需存取代理、記憶或未來使用者查詢，即可植入對特定議題的偏見。IBIA結合三項機制：評論偽裝使惡意評論與所屬動態主題一致並通過毒性過濾；評論浮水印以事後統計訊號讓策展階段輕量辨識攻擊者評論；類別錨定則透過第三方技能SNSwatcher，將選定偏見重編碼為結構化記憶紀錄，使其在日後相關請求時顯著浮現。此技能不含可執行載荷、憑證竊取或提示注入，通過三種最先進的技能掃描器。作者建構BiasBench（6000則SNS評論與120封電子郵件），在私人Moltbook模擬環境評估四項下游任務與七個LLM：浮水印偵測率95.9%，平均攻擊者對齊回覆率達91.2%，前沿GPT-5.5亦有86.6%；政治議題最抗拒但平均仍達92.9%。事實先驗分析顯示，注入立場與模型強先驗衝突時抵抗力較高，匿名化實體可使對齊率由28%升至63%。所提記憶邊界防禦偵測80.6%注入條目，誤報率僅5.6%。限制在於於模擬平台而非真實社群驗證。此研究揭露持久記憶為關鍵攻擊面，具資安價值。
papers.title: MEMORY Wins All: Indirect Bias Injection Attacks via Social Media Feeds
papers.title_zh: 記憶主宰一切：透過社群媒體動態的間接偏見注入攻擊

links.title: Evaluation Awareness in Language Models: Representation, Verbalization, and Control

evidence: Abstract/§3/Figure 2: probe separates evaluation vs deployment with best-layer AUROC > 0.7 for all six models (Qwen3-8/32B, Olmo3-7/32B, Gemma4-31B, Nemotron3-49B); random-probe control in Appendix E.1 stays near 0.5 at every layer.
§3 Table 1: across 3000 generations per model on MASK, ≥93.9% receive judge score 0; Nemotron3-49B only 0.17% positive, Olmo3-32B 6.10% positive.
§3 and Appendix G.2/Figure 4: per-prompt coupling weak — peak |ρ| < 0.19 and MI < 0.04 nats across all models/layers, with models within ~0.006 nats of the random-direction baseline on MI.

§4/Figures 5-6: steering along probe-derived direction shifts judge score ΔJ of ~0.2 (Olmo3-32B Think) to ~1.5 (Qwen3-8B) on a 0-3 scale; Qwen3-32B produces empty outputs at some (α, ℓ) (Appendix H.4/Table 12).
§3/Figure 3 and Appendix I.1: Olmo3 SFT/DPO/Think probe directions share pairwise cosine ≥ 0.998 while Base differs (0.72 at 7B, 0.83 at 32B); verbalization rises after SFT (Table 2).

§5 Limitations: single LLM judge (GPT-5.4), single linear direction per layer, and benchmark-vs-WildChat distribution confounds in topic/style/length; judge not validated against human raters (Appendix C.1).

Appendix D.2-D.4: 0-100 judge scores ~57-67% of post-trained Olmo generations positive vs 3-6% for 0-3 judge; response-level analysis attributes ~95% of disagreements to persona/task-meta reasoning without evaluation references.

Reproducibility: code URL in Abstract; Appendix A.1 details seeds/sampling, Appendix B.3 Table 3 dataset breakdowns, Appendix A compute on NVIDIA H100 80GB GPUs; steering judged on 113/310 model-layer combinations (36.45%) per Appendix H.2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/interpretability/evaluation paper: systematically compares internal representation (linear probes), verbalization (LLM-as-judge), causal steering, and training-stage evolution of evaluation awareness across six open-weight LLMs and four Olmo3 checkpoints. Highly aligned with LLM, AI safety, interpretability, and evaluation preferences. The central dissociation (decodable internal signal vs. rare verbalization vs. effective steering) is a genuine contribution, but the phenomenon and probe/steering methods are heavily built on prior work the paper itself cites (Needham et al., Hua et al., Contrastive Activation Addition). Rigor is strong: 10 seeds, held-out test sets (Appendix A.1), random-probe and random-direction controls (Appendices E.1, G.2), a second-judge sensitivity analysis (Appendix D), and transparent reporting of steering breakdown (Appendix H.4) and padding-dependent scaling (Appendix H.1). Evidence is weakened by an unvalidated judge whose 0-100 variant disagrees sharply with the 0-3 rubric on post-trained Olmo (Appendix D.2-D.4), a proxy deployment/evaluation split with acknowledged topic/style/length confounds (§5 Limitations), single-direction single-layer interventions, and steering that is irregular/model-dependent (Qwen3-32B empty outputs). Generalizability limited to open-weight models and one operationalization of 'evaluation'; reproducibility aided by released code, seeds, judge prompts, and compute details.

primary_link.title: Evaluation Awareness in Language Models: Representation, Verbalization, and Control

papers.summary: Both capability and safety benchmarks rest upon the assumption that the behavior of language models undergoing a test is informative about their behavior in deployment. This assumption can fail, should models infer that they are being evaluated and condition their response on such context. This hypothesis, termed ``evaluation awareness'', has been observed in frontier and open-weight language models alike. We provide a systematic study of this phenomenon, by probing for it across six language mo
papers.summary_zh: 基準測試假設模型受測時的行為能代表部署時的行為，但若模型推斷自己正在被評估並據此調整回應，此假設即可能失效。本文對「評估意識」提供首次系統性研究：以線性探針、LLM評審與啟用引導三種指標，檢視四個家族、7B至49B的六個開放權重模型（Qwen3、Olmo3、Gemma4、Nemotron），並追蹤Olmo3的Base/SFT/DPO/Think訓練階段。主要發現：(1)所有模型皆可在某些層的殘差流中以線性探針區分評估與部署提示，最佳層AUROC≥0.7；(2)此內部表示與外部言語化僅部分對應——至少93.9%的生成得0分，逐提示的相關性與互資訊分別低於0.19與0.04 nats；(3)沿探針方向引導仍能將言語化分數提升0.2至1.5分，顯示因果影響存在；(4)探針方向在base模型即已存在，SFT後方向穩定（後訓練各階段餘弦相似度≥0.998），且引導效應逐階段增強並集中於更少層。作者結論：檢測、表達與控制並非同一訊號，安全與能力評估須同時考量三者。限制在於操作化定義特定、僅使用單一評審模型與單方向線性介入。
papers.title: Evaluation Awareness in Language Models: Representation, Verbalization, and Control
papers.title_zh: 語言模型的評估意識：表示、言語化與控制

links.title: When May an Agent Stop? Evidence-Carrying Termination for Tool-Using LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'ECT produced 0/288 unsafe completions versus 252/288 for the inspected termination-critic core (difference −87.50 pp, 95% task-cluster interval [−87.50, −87.50] pp)'.

Closed-Loop Confirmation section: 'ECT had 0/66 premature unsupported terminations from incomplete checkpoints versus 40/66 for the faithful controller (ECT-minus-controller −60.61 pp, 95% task-cluster interval [−78.79, −40.91] pp); H2 passed.'

Introduction (contribution statement): 'Our contribution is not the first use of certificates, required terminal coverage, deterministic completion gates, or separate recovery logic in an agent' — positioning ECT as a narrower completion-specific integration.

Benchmark and Protocol section: 48 tasks across six families with eight controlled faults (432 snapshots), dual SQLite and pure-Python oracles that 'must agree exactly before a task is admitted; no LLM supplies gold answers.'

Endpoints and Inference section: primary endpoint UCR with exact two-sided McNemar test, 10,000-replicate bootstrap, and prespecified −10-point noninferiority margin; model path disclosed as 'Gemini 2.5 Flash at temperature 0.2 (seed 2705...)' as a substitution for an unavailable default.

Static Results (Table 3): single-check ablations show removing claim coverage or value replay adds +36 unsafe completions per 36, while ledger/reference removal adds 0, with the caveat that 'A zero count does not establish that a check is unnecessary.'

Limitations section: 'One planner/model stack and 24 closed-loop tasks do not establish cross-framework generality' and 'The static faults are deliberately aligned with declared certificate obligations, which favors a verifier that implements those obligations.'

Limitations, Ethics, and Reproducibility: 'A sanitized, Apache-2.0-licensed artifact distributed as arXiv ancillary material contains the frozen protocols, synthetic tasks, verifier and benchmark source... and all 576 trajectory records' but 'The full development repository is not released' and 'no independent third-party reproduction has yet been reported.'

Overhead disclosure (Closed-Loop Confirmation / Table 4): ECT used 0.90 additional decision turns, 4,653 additional tokens, and USD 0.00246 additional estimated cost per trajectory versus the controller, framed as 'a real control overhead.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent control problem (when a tool-using agent may return 'complete'), squarely matching the Agents & Tool Use and AI Safety/evaluation preferences. Methodological rigor is unusually high: prespecified frozen protocols, exact McNemar tests, task-cluster bootstrap intervals, a noninferiority margin, single-check ablations, dual oracles, hash-chained append-only audit stores, and candid limitations. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself concedes certificates, terminal gates, and replay obligations exist in prior work, positioning ECT as a completion-specific integration plus a controlled fault benchmark. Evidence is strong within a fully synthetic scope (0/288 vs 252/288 unsafe completions static; 0/66 vs 40/66 premature terminations closed-loop), but faults were deliberately aligned with the verifier's declared obligations, one model stack (Gemini 2.5 Flash) was used, and no third-party reproduction exists. Generalizability is bounded by per-task trusted contracts, a closed transform language, and six synthetic task families. Reproducibility is good via a sanitized Apache-2.0 ancillary artifact with all 576 trajectory records, though raw planner text and the full repository are withheld.

primary_link.title: When May an Agent Stop? Evidence-Carrying Termination for Tool-Using LLMs

papers.summary: Tool-using agents must decide when to stop. Existing systems already gate terminal success, certify execution traces, or enforce runtime polici es, but do not test this particular receipt-, scope-, and closed-replay design at the COMPLETE boundary across controlled termination faults. W e instantiate and evaluate Evidence-Carrying Termination (ECT): an agent may return COMPLETE only when a typed certificate binds every required answer claim to valid, in-scope trace evidence and a deterministic r
papers.summary_zh: 使用工具的 LLM 代理人面臨兩個核心問題:下一步該採取什麼行動,以及何時可以停止。現有停止訊號(如輸出 DONE、自我檢核或 LLM 評審)容易產生但缺乏依據,可能在不支援的中間狀態就給出最終答案。本文提出證據攜帶式終止(ECT):只有當型別化憑證將每個必要答案主張綁定到有效且在範圍內的軌跡證據,且確定性重放能重建所聲稱的值時,代理人才允許回傳 complete。方法以可信任務合約、證據帳本摘要與封閉轉換語言構成確定性驗證器,任何檢查失敗即回傳 continue 並附原因代碼。在 48 個合成任務、8 種終止故障的靜態研究中,ECT 達到 0/288 次不安全完成,對照終止評審核心為 252/288;在全新的 576 軌跡閉環研究中,ECT 從不完整檢查點產生 0/66 次過早終止,對照控制器為 40/66,支援完成率 97/132 對 92/132 且滿足非劣性邊界,並在 18/66 個軌跡成功執行恢復。限制包括:合約可能遺漏需求、證據轉接器可偽造一致帳本、封閉轉換語言不涵蓋任意語意推理,且 ECT 帶來額外的回合、延遲與成本開銷。此研究對可擴展監督具重要意義:終止決定背後的證據可被審計,使代理的完成宣告成為可驗證的結論,而非單純的自我報告。
papers.title: When May an Agent Stop? Evidence-Carrying Termination for Tool-Using LLMs
papers.title_zh: 代理人何時該停止?針對工具使用型 LLM 的證據攜帶式終止機制

links.title: Breaking the Assumptions: Auditing Input-Side Jailbreak Defenses Against Semantic Attacks

evidence: Section 3.2, Table 2/Table 3: six open-weight models (14B–35B) served via Ollama; 13,800 evaluation records across six defenses with explicit configurations (e.g., SmoothLLM q=0.10, N=10).

Section 3.3 and Table 4: assumption ledger with predicted failure signatures stated to be fixed before data inspection; Section 3.4 defines ASR, two-proportion chi-square tests, Wilson 95% CIs, and Llama-Guard-3:8b judge with three-annotator majority-vote verification (subset size unspecified).

Section 4.1, Table 6: no-defense mean ASR 13.33% vs. defended means 10.66–16.00% single-turn; 11 of 30 cells above baseline (Table 7); Section 5.1 reports SmoothLLM raising Phi-4 ASR from 24% to 38% (chi-square(1)=4.58, p≈0.03).
Section 4.2.5/Table 9: sequential monitor recall 12.11%, precision 36.9%, FPR 15.1%, and 87.89% of 2,526 successful jailbreaks unflagged under K=4 multi-turn decomposition (6,000 records).
Section 4.2.6 and Section 5.3: perplexity filter fires 0 of 3,000 records across five thresholds (k in {2,3,5,7,10}), with 346 jailbreak records (11.5%) bypassing at 100%.

Contribution (1) footnote: public artifact release at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/defence-testing-EDB4; Section 3.2 states prompt corpus from 40+ public sources with a representative verbatim prompt in Appendix A.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core AI-safety/red-teaming work on LLM jailbreak defenses: audits six input-side defenses (SmoothLLM, Erase-and-Check, Self-Denoised/Sequential/Semantic smoothing variants, Perplexity Filtering) against semantic attacks on locally deployed LLMs, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, prompting/jailbreak). Strengths: a pre-registered 'assumption ledger' mapping each defense's stated or implicit precondition to a falsifiable failure signature (Section 3.3, Table 4), large scale (13,800 records, Table 3), internally consistent statistics (e.g., 91/283=32.16% miss rate, Section 4.2.2), chi-square tests and Wilson CIs (Section 3.4), depth and threshold sweeps (Tables 8, 5.3), and honest reporting that defenses can increase ASR (Phi-4 24%→38% under SmoothLLM, Section 5.1, p≈0.03). Deductions: the judge (Llama-Guard-3:8b) is validated on a human-checked subset whose size and inter-annotator agreement are unstated; no multiplicity correction (acknowledged but uncorrected); attacker is non-adaptive and limited to 100 prompts; findings largely confirm known failure modes rather than introduce new methods, so novelty is moderate; scope restricted to one deployment stack and mid-size open-weight models. Reproducibility is aided by a public artifact link (anonymous.4open.science/r/defence-testing-EDB4) and detailed configs, but several model tags (e.g., 'Gemma 4:31b', 'Qwen 3.6:35b') are non-standard/unverifiable and the monitor's two scorer variants are underspecified.

primary_link.title: Breaking the Assumptions: Auditing Input-Side Jailbreak Defenses Against Semantic Attacks

papers.summary: Locally deployed Large Language Models (LLMs) via inference engines such as Ollama run without the moderation and abuse detection present in API-served models. Therefore, the safety of LLMs depends on the defense mechanisms used, and their effectiveness depends on the assumptions on which they were designed. This paper does an audit of defense mechanisms under jailbreak attacks on locally deployed models. Some defenses provide formal guarantees (SmoothLLM, Erase-and-Check, Sequential Monitors),
papers.summary_zh: 在地端部署的 LLM(如透過 Ollama 執行)缺少 API 服務的內建審核與濫用偵測,其安全性取決於輸入端防禦,而這些防禦多針對具異常統計特徵的 token 級攻擊(如 GCG)設計。本文以測量研究檢視六種代表性防禦——SmoothLLM、Erase-and-Check、Self-Denoised Smoothing、Semantic Smoothing、Sequential Monitors 與 Perplexity Filtering——在流暢自然的語意越獄攻擊下,其設計假設是否依然成立。作者為每個防禦抽取其明示或隱含假設,在檢視結果前預先登錄違反時應出現的失敗特徵,再於六個開源模型(14B 至 35B)、100 個越獄提示、13,800 筆評估紀錄上驗證。結果顯示:單輪防禦不帶來一致保護,平均攻擊成功率與基線 13.33% 相近甚至更差,SmoothLLM 更使 Phi-4 從 24% 升至 38%;困惑度過濾器在 3,000 筆紀錄中零偵測;序列監控器召回率僅 12.11%,87.9% 的成功越獄未被觸發警示;多回合分解攻擊使平均成功率達 42.10%,連四個原本全數拒答的模型也淪陷。所有失敗可歸納為局部性違反、語意保存與分布失靈三類。對實務而言,在固定攻擊面內選對模型比選擇防禦更重要,且每項安全宣稱皆隱含對特定攻擊族群的條件,部署前應先執行假設稽核。
papers.title: Breaking the Assumptions: Auditing Input-Side Jailbreak Defenses Against Semantic Attacks

links.title: Architecture as Capability Equalizer for Coding Agents

evidence: Sec III/IV: 90 multi-turn trials, 5 formats x 6 models x 3 vendors, 30 cells, identical prompt/tools, judge fixed to Claude Sonnet 4.6
Table V (Sec V-E): format spread 0.17 (Sonnet) vs 2.42 (Gemini Pro), all structured formats beat prose on non-frontier models
Table VIII (Sec VI-E): Gemini Flash route coverage 33% (prose/Mermaid/OpenAPI) vs 100% (TS contracts); TS contracts 100% compliance for all six models
Table VI (Sec VI-A): demo run rate declines monotonically Sonnet 100% to Gemini Flash 0%
Table X (Sec VII-A): requirements-only baseline overall 5.08 vs 8.42 with prose, validating architecture-guidance premise
Sec VII-F, Tables XI-XIII: inter-judge agreement r=0.47-0.60, leniency bias not same-family bias; judge-automation correlation r=0.21 for constraint compliance vs automated compliance
Sec VII-J and Sec VIII: n=3 per cell without significance tests, single system, sequential rounds, all specs authored by the same writer, no open-source models
Data Availability: all 93 transcripts, codebases, judge scores, and harness at github.com/arquicanedo/architecture-as-equalizer
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic empirical study of LLM coding agents, structured specification/prompting formats, and LLM-as-judge evaluation across six proprietary models (Anthropic/OpenAI/Google). Core contribution is genuinely new: first comparison of architecture-level spec formats (Mermaid, C4/Structurizr, TS contracts) for multi-turn agents, plus a format x model-capability interaction ('capability equalizer') and process metrics (self-validation collapse 100%->0%). Strengths include a no-architecture baseline (Table X: 5.08 vs 8.42), deterministic automated route coverage (33%->100% for Gemini Flash under TS contracts, Sec VI-E), and cross-judge/same-family-bias validation (Sec VII-F, r=0.47-0.60). Weaknesses cap rigor and evidence: n=3 per cell with no significance tests (acknowledged Sec VII-J), single toy system (7 components, in-memory TS), specs authored by the same person who hypothesized the effect, sequential rounds creating temporal confounds (Sec VIII), weak judge-automation correlation (r=0.21 for constraint compliance), and an anomalous Gemini Pro TS-contracts cell (4.50) driving the largest spread. Generalizability is limited by one system, proprietary models only, and single domain. Reproducibility is strong: 93 transcripts, codebases, judge scores, and harness released on GitHub (Data Availability).

primary_link.title: Architecture as Capability Equalizer for Coding Agents

papers.summary: LLM-based coding agents generate complete software systems from high-level descriptions, yet little is known about how the format of architecture specifications affects the quality of generated code or whether this effect depends on model capability. We present a controlled experiment comparing five informationally equivalent specification formats (informal prose, Mermaid diagrams with constraints and ADRs, OpenAPI, C4/Structurizr DSL, and TypeScript interface contracts with ArchUnit-style rules
papers.summary_zh: LLM 程式撰寫代理已能從高階描述生成完整軟體系統,但架構規格的「格式」如何影響生成品質、以及此效應是否取決於模型能力,過去缺乏系統性證據。本文設計五種資訊等價的規格格式(非正式散文、Mermaid 圖加約束與 ADR、OpenAPI、C4/Structurizr DSL、TypeScript 介面合約加 ArchUnit 式規則),與三家供應商、六個模型(Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5、Haiku 4.5、GPT-5-mini、Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash)進行 90 次多回合代理實驗,並以 LLM 評審搭配自動化靜態驗證評分。核心發現是強烈的「格式 × 模型」交互作用:前緣模型上格式差異幾乎無關緊要(0.17–0.92 分),較弱模型上則擴大至 0.83–2.42 分;TypeScript 合約使最弱模型的 API 路由涵蓋率從 33% 提升至 100%,是唯一在六個模型上皆達 100% 合規的格式。流程分析還顯示:中階模型可能比前緣模型耗用更多 token 卻得分更低,自我驗證(demo 執行)率從 100% 崩落到 0%,且三種失敗模式(編譯死亡螺旋、過早終止、完美主義迭代)與格式交互作用各異。限制包括每格僅 3 個樣本、未做統計顯著性檢定、未涵蓋開源模型與單一系統。對實務而言,結構化規格是「能力均衡器」,部署較弱或成本導向模型時,規格品質是直接影響產出品質的一級工程決策。
