links.title: HiDiffTIR: Hierarchical Difficulty-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Tool-Integrated Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: proposes difficulty-aware credit assignment at trajectory and turn levels for multi-turn TIR 'without additional supervision, relying solely on group-level statistics derived from standard RL rollouts'.
§4.1: training on FTRL dataset (2,215 examples) with Qwen3-4B/8B backbones, verl framework, GRPO group size 16, max 10 turns, 8x NVIDIA H20 GPUs.
Table 1: HiDiffTIR achieves avg 41.79 (Qwen3-4B) vs MatchTIR (KM) 41.01, and 48.75 (Qwen3-8B) vs 46.93; gains over the strongest baseline are modest on 4B.
Table 2: ablations w/o trajectory-level (FTRL avg 36.70) and w/o turn-level (37.34) degrade vs full model (39.48) on FTRL, but both exceed the full model's ToolHop score (51.36/51.96 vs 49.95).
§4.2: acknowledges 'it slightly trails MatchTIR' on the Missing Functions subset and that difficulty reweighting 'inadvertently reinforces this aggressive calling bias'.
Appendix B.1: OOD average is non-monotonic in group size (G=4: 40.19, G=8: 39.77, G=16: 41.79), showing estimator sensitivity.
Limitations: only moderately sized (4B/8B) open models validated; difficulty estimation is 'a heuristic'; reward sparsity may require a supervised warm-up when the base policy fails entirely.

Appendix A.5 and footnote 1: full hyperparameters (lr 1e-6, batch 256, G=16, temp 1.0, 5 epochs, KL 0.001), prompt template in Table 6, and code at https://github.com/YucanGuo/HiDiffTIR support reproducibility.

Related Work §2.2: situates contribution against difficulty-aware RL (GRPO-LEAD, DIVA-GRPO) and process supervision, indicating the hierarchical TIR combination rather than a fundamentally new mechanism.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM agents/tool use: difficulty-aware RL credit assignment for multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning on Qwen3 backbones, directly matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, RL). Novelty is moderate: the ingredients (turn-level matching rewards from MatchTIR/ToolRL, group-statistic difficulty estimation from prior difficulty-aware RL like GRPO-LEAD/DIVA-GRPO) are combined hierarchically in a supervision-free way, an incremental but sensible extension. Rigor is decent: two backbone scales, three benchmarks, five baselines, component ablations, fusion-coefficient and group-size sensitivity, efficiency analysis, and honest reporting of weaknesses (Table 2 shows ablations beat the full model on ToolHop; §4.2 admits trailing MatchTIR on the MF subset). However, headline gains are small on Qwen3-4B (avg 41.79 vs MatchTIR-KM 41.01), OOD improvements are modest and non-monotonic (Appendix B.1), no seeds/variance/significance tests are reported, and training requires ground-truth tool-call trajectories for the matching reward. Generalizability is limited by the single training dataset (FTRL), 10-turn cap, and only 4B/8B models, as the authors concede in Limitations. Reproducibility is strong: public code link, complete hyperparameters (Appendix A.5), prompt template (Table 6), and metric definitions (Appendix A.1).

primary_link.title: HiDiffTIR: Hierarchical Difficulty-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Tool-Integrated Reasoning

papers.summary: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) is a fundamental capability for LLM agents to solve complex tasks by interacting with external tools iteratively. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become the dominant paradigm for enabling this capability. However, existing approaches typically assign uniform trajectory-level advantages and treat all correct tool calls equally, ignoring the varying difficulty and learning value across trajectories and reasoning steps. This can lead to imprecise learning signals tha
papers.summary_zh: 工具整合推理是 LLM 代理解決複雜任務的核心能力,而 RL 已成為訓練此能力的主流典範。然而現有方法多半在軌跡層面給予一致的優勢訊號,並將所有正確的工具呼叫視為同等重要,忽略不同軌跡與推理步驟的難度與學習價值差異,導致學習訊號不夠精確。本文提出 HiDiffTIR,一個在軌跡與回合兩個層級進行難度感知信用分配的階層式策略最佳化框架:軌跡層依各回合難度重新加權原始獎勵,計算難度感知的軌跡優勢;回合層再依工具選擇成功率將軌跡優勢重新分配,聚焦較難的工具呼叫決策。關鍵在於難度判斷僅依賴標準 RL rollout 的群組統計量,無需額外監督。在 FTRL、BFCL 與 ToolHop 三個基準上,以 Qwen3-4B 與 8B 為骨幹,HiDiffTIR 於兩種規模皆取得最佳平均分數(如 4B 平均 41.79,超越 MatchTIR (KM) 的 41.01),消融實驗確認兩個層級組件皆有貢獻,並使回應長度縮短、生成延遲下降約 12.8%。限制包括:實驗僅涵蓋中等規模開源模型、難度訊號假設基礎模型具備基本指令遵循能力,且難度估計屬於啟發式而非絕對的語意複雜度度量;在缺失工具或參數情境下,難度加權可能無意間強化激進呼叫工具的偏誤。此研究顯示難度感知的細粒度信用分配是改善工具使用 RL 的有效方向。
papers.title: HiDiffTIR: Hierarchical Difficulty-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Tool-Integrated Reasoning
papers.title_zh: HiDiffTIR:針對多回合工具整合推理的階層式難度感知策略最佳化

links.title: Adaptive Multilevel Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo for Rare Events Estimation in Language Models

evidence: Section 4, Table 1: at gamma*=7.0 (p_MC=3.81e-6), 'Ours' achieves hit rate 0.549±0.269, ESS 135.0, estimate 4.89e-6±4.47e-7 (28.3% error) versus SMC hit rate 0.000 and 100% error, and SD-TSMC estimate 3.96e-7±0.86e-6 (89.6% error)
Section 4, Table 9 (Appendix F.1): at gamma*=4.0 the proposed method has 50.9% error, worse than SMC (42.6%) and SD-TSMC (40.5%), showing results do not uniformly dominate at less rare thresholds

Section 3.3/3.4 and Algorithm 1: adaptive next-level threshold chosen as min{gamma*, weighted (1-rho)-quantile}; Proposition 2 states total sample complexity O(log(1/p*)[log log(1/p*)+log(1/delta)+1]) under ideal proposals, extended to imperfect proposals in Appendix D.4 Proposition 11

Appendix D.2, Propositions 5-6: almost-sure consistency and asymptotic normality of the importance-weighted positive-phase gradient estimator, with error rate O_p(G*sqrt((1+chi^2)/N)); Appendix D.5 Proposition 13 decomposes MSE into irreducible score-bias plus proposal-dependent chi^2 term

Section 4, Table 3 / Table 14: under an imperfect proxy score, at gamma*=7.0 'Ours' best-seed error 9.6% with 5/5 CI coverage versus SMC 100% error and 0/5 coverage; Appendix F.3 reports coverage 1/5 at gamma*=6.0, indicating residual proxy-mismatch vulnerability

Section 4 / Appendix E.3: experiments on TinyStories-33M (ToxiGuardrail score) and StrongREJECT with Llama-3.2-3B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; hyperparameters in Tables 5 and 7, five seeds, single RTX 4090; no statement releasing the authors' own code
Appendix B Limitations: fixed-prompt formulation requires training a separate proposal model for each prompt and does not cover prompt-space search formulations, limiting practical scale-up
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: a statistical method (Adaptive Multilevel Twisted SMC) for estimating probabilities of rare unsafe LLM outputs, directly serving the LLM (2.5), AI Safety (2.0), and Red Teaming/Evaluation (1.8) preferences, with alignment/reward-model ties. Novelty is moderate-incremental: multilevel splitting (Cérou & Guyader) and Twisted SMC (Zhao et al.) are established, and the authors themselves note LatticeBridge already combined multilevel splitting with Twisted SMC for search allocation (Appendix C.1); the new element is adaptive quantile-based intermediate thresholds plus importance-weighted CTL to fix the positive-sample bottleneck, mirroring prior SD-TSMC motivation. Rigor is solid: full proofs for consistency/CLT of the weighted positive-phase estimator (Appendix D.2), polylog sample complexity under ideal and imperfect proposals (Props 9, 11), threshold consistency (Prop 8), and score-misspecification MSE decomposition (Prop 13), plus ablations on rho and samples/level and an imperfect-score experiment. Evidence is credible but not uniform: at gamma*=7.0 the method attains hit rate 0.549 vs 0.000 for SMC and 28.3% error vs the 1,048,576-sample MC reference, and StrongREJECT errors stay ~4-20% vs 60-2780% for baselines, yet at gamma*=3.0/4.0 the method does not beat SD-TSMC/SMC on error, hit-rate variance is large (0.549±0.269), ESS values are small, and the reference is itself a MC estimate. Generalizability is capped by the acknowledged fixed-prompt formulation (separate proposal per prompt, Appendix B) and evaluation on only two task families (TinyStories toxicity, StrongREJECT across three LLMs). Reproducibility benefits from detailed hyperparameter tables, hardware, seeds, and algorithms 1-3, but no release of the authors' own code is stated. No out-of-scope domain content.

primary_link.title: Adaptive Multilevel Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo for Rare Events Estimation in Language Models

papers.summary: Rare unsafe behaviors in large language models can remain practically significant even when their probability is extremely small, particularly at deployment scales involving millions or billions of interactions. Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) provides a principled framework for rare-event probability estimation by learning twist functions that guide generation toward a target event. However, the standard twist learning framework relies on positive samples from the rare-event target distrib
papers.summary_zh: 部署規模的 LLM 即使對齊良好,每查詢極小的有害輸出機率,在數十億次互動下仍可能造成實質風險。扭轉序貫蒙地卡羅(SMC)透過學習扭轉函數引導生成朝向稀有事件,是原則性的稀有事件機率估計方法,但其對比式扭轉學習需要來自稀有事件分布的正樣本,在學到有用的扭轉前這類樣本幾乎不存在,形成正樣本瓶頸。本文提出自適應多層級扭轉 SMC:不直接學習最終稀有事件的扭轉,而是透過一系列逐漸更嚴格的中介事件逐級學習,每層以加權分位數自適應選取閾值,並以重要性加權修正正相梯度估計。理論上,方法將取樣複雜度從與稀有事件機率成反比,改善為對 1/p* 的多重對數依賴,並證明重要性加權估計量的一致性、與對不完美評分函數的誤差分解。實驗涵蓋毒性故事生成與 StrongREJECT 越獄任務:在最難的 γ*=7.0 設定,本方法命中率高達 0.549 而標準 SMC 為 0.000,相對誤差 28.3% 對 100%;在多個模型與有害類別上相對誤差多在 20% 以下,且對代理評分的不完美更具穩健性,信賴區間覆蓋率也明顯較佳。限制在於需為每個提示獨立訓練提議模型,未處理提示分布與輸入側的稀有事件形式。此方法為大規模部署下的安全評估與紅隊測試提供可行工具。
papers.title: Adaptive Multilevel Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo for Rare Events Estimation in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 針對語言模型稀有事件估計的自適應多層級扭轉序貫蒙地卡羅

links.title: LLM4LLM: Bridging Kernel Benchmarks and Real Deployment via Closed-Loop Agentic Optimization

evidence: Abstract: 'improves end-to-end latency for every evaluated model, achieving 3.91×/6.98× geometric-mean speedups on A100/H100' across ten inference workloads spanning transformer, Mamba-family, and RecurrentGemma.

§2.1/§2.2: motivating ResNetConvLayer case and taxonomy of four evaluation stages (isolated qualification, search-time validation, deployment-time acceptance, final end-to-end evaluation) defining the benchmark-to-deployment gap.
§4.2 Table 1: end-to-end latency compared only against Eager (e.g., Llama-2-7B 1.86× A100, Mamba-2.8B 8.09× A100); no vLLM or torch.compile end-to-end baseline in the table.

§4.3/§4.4 Table 2: KernelBench L2 GeoMean 2.745 (A100)/2.628 (H100); several baseline rows lack GeoMean entries and STARK is noted as 'A100-40G' versus the paper's A100-SXM4-80GB, and the text admits 'existing papers report results with different aggregation conventions'.
§4.5 Table 3: ablation over GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GLM-5 with Sample-1/Sample-10/Iter-10/w/o-restart/full variants; restart improves GLM-5 GeoMean from 2.294 (w/o restart, 15) to 2.745 vs eager.

§3.2/§3.3: experience-guided episodic search and deployment-time acceptance formalized in Equations 2-3, but the required minimum improvement δ and correctness tolerance ε are not given concrete values.

Limitations: 'currently targets single-GPU inference workloads', 'assumes access to a representative inference script', and patches are 'specialized to observed shape and phase regimes' requiring re-profiling.
Footnote 1: 'Code is available at https://github.com/hzeng2000/LLM4LLM'; Appendix A.1-A.5 provide run traces, API-correction layer details, and accepted kernel families.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is an LLM-agent closed-loop system for kernel optimization targeting LLM inference deployment, matching Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Code & Programming, and Inference & Serving preferences; not an out-of-scope pure-domain application. The benchmark-to-deployment gap taxonomy (warm-cache locality, latent OOB faults, phase specialization) is a genuine framing contribution, but components (episodic restart, compact experience memory) are incremental over Reflexion-style memory and prior kernel agents (CUDA-L1, STARK, KernelBlaster). Rigor is solid: ablations across three LLM backbones isolating sampling/iteration/restart, torch.compile comparisons, and scope-matched baselines (FlashAttention, mamba_ssm/causal-conv1d). Weaknesses: primary end-to-end results (Table 1) are measured only against eager PyTorch with no vLLM/torch.compile end-to-end baseline; scope-matched comparisons are figures without reported numbers and the text concedes attention gaps remain; KernelBench Table 2 mixes hardware (STARK on A100-40G) and lacks GeoMean for several baselines; acceptance thresholds δ and error tolerance ε are unspecified. Evidence is internally consistent (A100 GeoMean of Table 1 speedups reproduces the claimed 3.91×/6.98×), with detailed case studies, though heavy-tailed arithmetic means (e.g., 22.157 Mean vs 2.745 GeoMean) require the provided percentile columns. Generalizability is bounded by single-GPU scope and re-profiling needs per the Limitations. Code is released, aiding reproducibility.

primary_link.title: LLM4LLM: Bridging Kernel Benchmarks and Real Deployment via Closed-Loop Agentic Optimization

papers.summary: Large language models have become increasingly capable agents for low-level code and kernel optimization, but isolated kernel benchmarks provide only a proxy for the deployment behavior that matters in language-model inference. We identify a benchmark-to-deployment gap: candidate kernels that appear correct and fast in standalone harnesses can exhibit different performance, safety, or phase behavior after integration into a real inference workload. We introduce LLM4LLM, a deployment-aware closed
papers.summary_zh: 孤立核心基準僅是 LLM 核心程式最佳化的代理指標:在獨立測試中正確且快速的候選核心,整合進真實推論工作負載後,可能因記憶體駐留差異、潛藏的越界存取或階段(預填充/解碼)特化而在部署時失效或反轉加速。本文提出 LLM4LLM,一個以部署為導向的閉環最佳化框架:從目標推論腳本出發,以真實工作負載剖析熱點,萃取預填充與解碼分離的階段感知任務,利用經驗引導的分段式代理搜尋(將驗證軌跡濃縮為緊湊經驗後重新開始),並僅在將候選插入目標模型、驗證其模型內正確性與端對端延遲後才接受修補。在十個語言模型推論工作負載(涵蓋 Transformer、Mamba 狀態空間與 RecurrentGemma 家族)上,LLM4LLM 於 A100/H100 達成 3.91×/6.98× 的幾何平均端對端加速;在 KernelBench Level 2 亦取得 2.745× 幾何平均,消融實驗顯示重啟機制的貢獻超出單純增加取樣預算,剖析優先的任務萃取則讓不同模型家族各自聚焦於正確的最佳化目標。限制包括:目前僅針對單 GPU、模組層級最佳化,形狀與設定改變需重新剖析與驗證,且尚未處理分散式服務。此研究的價值在於指出:核心搜尋應以目標執行環境中的驗證與接受為依歸,孤立基準效能不應等同部署表現。

links.title: Spine-Branch Coordination for Multi-agent Computer Use

evidence: Abstract and Section 3, Table 1: on 200 Odysseys tasks across three backbones (Qwen3.6-27B, gpt-5.4-mini, Qwen3.7-Plus), Spine-Branch improves Success Rate over MACU by +6.0% to +16.5% (e.g., 67.0% vs 50.5% on Qwen3.7-Plus) and cuts per-task cost 34-70% (e.g., $0.44 vs $1.46), with standard deviations over three evaluation runs.

Section 2, 'Single-parent VM Inheritance' and Eq. (2): formalizes VM-state non-mergeability as in-degree <= 1 on E_vm with branch VMs discarded, elevating it to a first-class planning constraint; Section 5 contrasts this with MACU's ad-hoc cross-VM reconciliation.

Section 4, Table 2 (45-task stratified subset, Qwen3.7-Plus): spine-only ablation reaches 71.1% SR and branch-only 66.7% versus 73.3% for the full framework, supporting the claimed complementarity of the two components.

Section 4, Table 4 ('When Decomposition Is Not Worth the Cost'): on 65 OSWorld 2.0 tasks Single-Agent reward 0.22 vs Spine-Branch 0.16 with 21/65 timeouts; Spine-Branch leads only on the 19 planner-selected decomposable tasks (0.17 vs 0.12), a post-hoc selection that limits generalizability claims.

Appendix D, Table 7: swapping the manager from claude-opus-4-8 to gpt-5.4-mini lowers macro score by 0.07-0.14 across backbones with nearly identical graph structure (~1.9 spine, ~3.5 branch nodes per task), quantifying manager sensitivity.

Appendices A.1, A.2, B, and C: the full decomposition system prompt, step-budget prompt text, all 45 subset task IDs, and the complete CUA action space are provided; however, no code release is stated and the pipeline depends on proprietary models, including the gemini-3.1-flash-lite rubric judge described in Section 3.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-AI contribution squarely matching the highest-weighted Agents & Tool Use preference (multi-agent orchestration, computer use, task planning, test-time scaling) with LLM backbones and a prompting component, so preference relevance is high. The single-parent VM-inheritance constraint and the typed spine-branch graph is a clean but incremental systems contribution over MACU: manager-worker decomposition, VM cloning, and artifact passing are known and recombined around one new physical constraint. Rigor is solid: a 200-task benchmark, three CUA backbones, three scored runs with variance, spine/branch and step-budget-prompting ablations, a manager-swap ablation, and an honestly reported OSWorld 2.0 negative result. Evidence is mostly consistent quantitative tables plus qualitative case studies and failure counts from trajectory inspection; the LLM rubric judge is unvalidated against human ratings and only one multi-agent baseline is compared. Generalizability is bounded by the authors' own OSWorld 2.0 finding that decomposition rarely pays off outside long-horizon multi-site workflows, and by dependence on current proprietary model behavior and pricing. Reproducibility is moderate: full prompts, action space, algorithm, and subset task IDs are published, but no code release is stated and the pipeline requires proprietary models including the judge.

primary_link.title: Spine-Branch Coordination for Multi-agent Computer Use

papers.summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems that decompose a task into multiple subtasks executed across parallel virtual machines (VMs). However, a critical physical bottleneck is that the state of two VMs cannot be merged. Previous systems handle this ad-hoc rather than treating it as a first-class concern. We propose Spine-Branch Coordination for multi-agent computer use, a framework that decomposes a task into a "spine-branch" graph, where the spine carries th
papers.summary_zh: 電腦使用代理(CUA)日益以多代理系統部署,將任務分解到平行執行的虛擬機(VM)上,但存在關鍵物理瓶頸:兩個 VM 的即時狀態無法合併,每個子任務最多只能繼承一個父代 VM(單親 VM 繼承)。既有系統對此採取臨時處理,常導致狀態遺失與昂貴重建。本文提出 Spine-Branch 協調框架:將任務分解為主幹與分支的有向依賴圖,主幹透過 VM 克隆攜帶連續狀態並承載主要任務流,分支在拋棄式 VM 上平行收集主幹所需資訊,完成後僅提交可抽取的交付物並銷毀 VM,從而依構造滿足單親繼承、永不發生 VM 合併。框架由負責規劃與聚合的 Manager、持續狀態的 Spine Worker 與拋棄式 Branch Worker 組成,並以步數預算提示(SBP)確保分支在預算耗盡前提交結果。在 Odysseys 的 200 個長程任務、三種 CUA 骨幹上,Spine-Branch 相較 MACU 基線將成功率提升 6.0% 至 16.5%,同時降低 34% 至 70% 的每任務成本,並將 Manager token 開銷削減約 5 倍;消融顯示移除主幹或分支皆使效能下降,失敗主要來自環境封鎖與基礎模型能力。在 OSWorld 2.0 上,研究亦發現多數任務不值得分解,僅約 18% 為真正的分解候選,凸顯協調成本必須與收益一併考量。此框架使 VM 不可合併性成為多代理電腦使用的一級設計約束。
papers.title: Spine-Branch Coordination for Multi-agent Computer Use
papers.title_zh: 多代理電腦使用的主幹—分支協調

links.title: OptiMAS: Automatically Optimize Multi-Agent System

evidence: Table 1 (Section 4.2): OptiMAS reaches 64.0/84.5/92.9 on WorkBench across GPT5/Qwen3.6/Gemini3 vs. 18.6/65.6/71.7 for single-agent E0, with stated gains +2.8% to +45.4%.
Section 4.4, Table 2: removing hypothesis memory drops SWE-Bench to 22.2 (GPT5, -7.2 vs E0) and 53.3 (Qwen3.6, -7.8 vs E0); removing adaptive sampling yields 24.4/-5.0 and 60.6/-0.5.
Appendix A.2: deterministic partition ratios (0.36, 0.04, 0.60) give validation sets of only 4 instances for SWE-Bench and BrowseComp, a noisy generalization signal.
Section 4.1 (Metrics): 'All test results are averaged over three independent trials', but tables report only means with no standard deviations or significance tests.

Section 4.2: 'the evolved systems produced by ADAS fall below our OptiMAS by up to 58.9% on SWE-Bench/Gemini3'; AFlow/MaAS/MAS-GPT/FlowReasoner appear only in Related Works (Section 2.2), not in experiments.

Limitations section: acknowledges 'substantially weaker models may struggle to operate effectively within this framework' and lists unexplored dimensions (curricula, dataset curation, agent diversity).

Appendix A.5: 'All curated data and code will be publicly released' with fixed seed s=42; GitHub link in paper header; Appendix D provides full hyperparameter tables; Appendix E.1 states infrastructure built on Model Context Protocol.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong core-topic match: an LLM-based multi-agent system optimizer spanning agents/tool use (ReAct, MCP, tool orchestration, agent evolution) with LLM backbones as substrate; squarely in scope, not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: the continuous textual-gradient optimization framing builds on TextGrad/DSPy/ADAS/DGM, with the dual-track memory (plan-oriented short-term, hypothesis-driven long-term with falsifiable lifecycle) being the most original element. Rigor is decent—four benchmarks, three backbones, optimizer-backbone ablation, four component ablations (Table 2), three-trial averaging, fixed seeds—but weakened by a 4-instance validation split (Appendix A.2), no variance/significance reporting, LLM-as-judge on two benchmarks, and absent empirical comparison to several discussed baselines (AFlow, MaAS, MAS-GPT, FlowReasoner). Evidence for headline claims is concrete (Table 1 gains +2.8% to +45.4%; ablation showing -7.2/-7.8 SWE-Bench regression without hypothesis memory) but small 100-query subsets and missing error bars cap confidence. Generalizability is well supported: one task-agnostic configuration across four heterogeneous benchmarks and three backbones, with honest limitations on backbone capability. Reproducibility is partially supported: GitHub link, fixed seed 42, detailed hyperparameters (Appendix D) and prompts (Appendix C/F), though code 'will be publicly released' (not verifiably available) and the pipeline depends on closed-source APIs and commercial Serper/Jina services.

primary_link.title: OptiMAS: Automatically Optimize Multi-Agent System

papers.summary: Automated evolution of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) holds significant potential for reducing the manual effort required to design and optimize LLM-based agent architectures. However, extant search-based paradigms face a fundamental trade-off, where an expanded optimization scope exacerbates evolutionary instability, while discrete branch-and-discard search isolates insights across lineages. To address these limitations, we propose a continuous, data-driven optimization paradigm built upon a unified
papers.summary_zh: LLM 多代理系統(MAS)的手工建構耗時費力,而現有以搜尋為基礎的自動演化方法面臨兩難:擴大最佳化範圍會加劇演化不穩定,離散的分支捨棄式搜尋又使洞察孤立於不同譜系間無法轉移。本文提出以連續、資料驅動為核心的最佳化典範,並實作 OptiMAS:一個與演化中 MAS 共用統一 ReAct 基礎設施的通用代理式最佳化器,將代理軌跡與任務準確率視為損失訊號,推導文字梯度並端對端更新提示、技能、編排拓撲與工具設定。為維持長期演化的穩定,OptiMAS 內建雙軌記憶:計畫導向的短期記憶確保步驟內一致性,假設驅動的長期記憶則以可否證的假設與證據日誌跨步累積並驗證演化洞察,並以自適應取樣重訪失敗案例、以訓練/驗證/測試分離防止過擬合。在 WorkBench、GAIA-text、BrowseComp 與 SWE-Bench 四個基準、三個規模各異的骨幹(GPT-5-Nano、Qwen3.6、Gemini3)上,OptiMAS 相較單代理初始化獲得 +2.8% 至 +45.4% 的提升,並在多數配置上匹配或超越 Tongyi-DeepResearch、SWE-Agent 等領域特化系統與 ADAS、EvoAgent、DGM 等演化方法;消融顯示移除假設記憶的損害最大。限制在於框架對骨幹的指令遵循與工具呼叫能力要求較高,且最佳化器的情境長度會限制軌跡密集任務上的成效。此工作朝自動化、可部署的 MAS 合成邁出務實一步。

Novelty is solid for a benchmark: it credibly positions itself against LLMCBench (dense-only, no composability) and MoE-CAP (serving, not compression) and claims the first joint composable-compression study for MoEs. Rigor is generally good — six controlled configurations, sensitivity sweeps with standard errors (Table 9), three ablations (calibration data, quantization-aware scoring, alternate expert method REAM) — but weakened by one representative method per axis, a single inference backend (llama.cpp) for all efficiency claims, and minor editorial defects (Finding 2 cites Figure 3 which is captioned as quantization sensitivity while Figure 2 is the pruning-rate figure; Appendix B.2 contains an incomplete sentence 'As shown in ,'). Evidence strength is backed by extensive quantitative tables and specific ratios (e.g., pruning +28.5% PPL vs quantization +0.7%). Generalizability benefits from architecture and hardware breadth but efficiency findings are explicitly scoped to the evaluated execution path. papers.summary_zh: 混合專家模型透過稀疏路由擴大模型容量,但龐大的專家參數、路由不均衡與長上下文KV快取成長,使其難以部署於一般硬體。實務上常需疊加多種壓縮技術:專家剪枝、權重量化與KV快取壓縮,惟過去多半個別評估,疊加後的交互作用不明。本文提出MoE-XBench,以端對端部署流程系統性評估可組合壓縮:涵蓋30B至235B共10個MoE模型、標準注意力、混合線性注意力與滑動視窗注意力三類架構,於七種工作負載評測20%–50%剪枝率、1至16位元量化與多種KV快取精度,並設計八個評測模組衡量品質保留、穩健性、敏感度與部署效率。主要發現:壓縮率無法預測品質損失,專家剪枝才是主要退化來源;平均準確率會掩蓋特定工作負載與架構的失敗;KV快取在8位元時穩健、低精度則敏感;記憶體縮減不保證吞吐量提升,低精度反量化開銷可能抵銷效益。作者據此建議以目標準確率—記憶體—延遲權衡點為依歸,並在目標後端驗證完整管線,為MoE壓縮提供可重現的比較基礎。

evidence: Abstract: reports 96.29% Hit@10 and 73.64% turn Recall@5 on 1,536 LoCoMo category-1–4 questions and 97.60% Hit@10 on all 500 LongMemEval-S questions, establishing topical alignment with agent memory and retrieval.

Sec. V-C: 'A post-hoc source audit found that the frozen query-expansion rule set contains proper names and lexical phrases added while benchmark histories were visible,' classifying expansion-enabled retrieval numbers as development-stage diagnostics only.

Table V / Sec. VI-C: preregistered five-history BEAM gate fails all three thresholds (78.65% Hit@10, 40.80% turn recall, 52.34% session recall vs. gates of ≥85/≥50/≥60), falsifying generalization of the one-history pilot.
Table VI / Sec. VI-D: Mem0 OSS scores 64.84% vs ECHO 41.76% on the 91-question matched sample (exact McNemar p=.00107), but the eight-history cluster sensitivity interval [-25.5,+25.0] crosses zero.

Sec. IV: pinned Mem0 OSS revision, Ollama 0.32.14, exact hardware (i9-13900H, RTX 4060 8 GiB), and archived artifact ledger (Appendix B) support reproducibility, though no external public release is stated.
Sec. VIII-B: 'ECHO builds on temporal database and provenance semantics rather than claiming that timestamps, graphs, or consolidation are new by themselves,' bounding novelty claims.
Table VIII / Sec. VII-A: paired ablations on n=18 show query expansion removal drops Hit@10 by 16.67 points and turn recall by 26.42 points, but this is a small single-history diagnostic.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an auditable memory plane for long-horizon LLM agents sits squarely in the Agents, Long Context & Memory, and RAG preferences, with LLMs used as answerer/judge. Methodological rigor is exceptional: preregistered failing gates, leakage audits, McNemar/Wilson/cluster-bootstrap statistics, and stage-separated estimand taxonomy (Sec. V, VI). Novelty is moderate: the paper itself concedes bitemporal semantics and database provenance are prior art, positioning the contribution as an authority-boundary decomposition (Sec. VIII-B). Evidence strength is limited by self-disclosed contamination of the headline retrieval numbers (query-expansion phrases from visible histories, Sec. V-C), the failed five-history BEAM gate (Table V: 78.65% Hit@10 vs ≥85% gate), and Mem0 OSS beating ECHO by 23.08 pp on the 91-question matched QA sample with a history-cluster interval crossing zero (Table VI). Generalizability is explicitly bounded and empirically weak on fresh histories; reproducibility relies on archived artifacts and pinned revisions (Sec. IV, Appendix B) but no public code/data release is stated.

evidence: Section 5.1 / Table 4: 327/382 source-oracle probes pass (85.6%) vs 21.7% for both direct baselines on the same planned probes; all 382 runnable for ADFD-Migrate vs 99/98 for baselines.
Section 5.1, Table 4 last columns: runnable-only agreement rates are 85.6% vs 83.8%/84.7%, so the reported gain is coverage/runnability rather than per-behavior correctness.
Section 4.2 (i)-(iv): the same generator produces a repository's ADFD port and all its baseline ports; probes curated from source Fortran oracles and fixed before any port exists.

Section 6.2 Limitations: probes are targeted checks bounding correctness from below; judge (Claude Opus 4.6) shares model family with complex-tier generator; no human expert verification of ported code.
Appendix D.2: ADFD vs direct mean outcome-index gap 0.270 with bootstrap CI [0.206, 0.341] and Wilcoxon p<0.001; Appendix D.5: 98.9% of 10,000 sampled weightings preserve a positive gap.
Section 6.2 External validity: only Fortran-to-Python evaluated; language-specific analyzers/adapters required for other pairs; approach suits data-flow-dominated numerical software.

Data Availability Statement: benchmark at github.com/ShraddhaSurana/iProg/tree/main/f2x50 and artifacts at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22054047; Appendix C.5 gives full prompt texts; Appendix F.2 specifies hardware/environment.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-for-code work squarely matching high-weight preferences (Large Language Models, Code & Programming, Agents & Tool Use): an LLM-agent pipeline infers an Annotated Data Flow Diagram as an inspectable intermediate representation, with static-analysis coverage checks, SCC/topological dependency-aware chunking, and source-target ADFD alignment for repository-scale Fortran-to-Python migration, plus a new 50-repository benchmark. Novelty is solid but bounded: DFD-as-specification and dependency-graph decomposition have adjacent prior work (AlphaTrans, InterTrans, CodePlan, SemanticForge; authors' own prior DFD synthesis work), and the chunking itself is standard graph algorithmics. Rigor is above average: source-side oracle probes fixed before porting, identical generator per repository for method and baselines, two ablations (static-profile, dependency-chunking) isolating the IR contribution, Wilcoxon/bootstrap statistics, weight-sensitivity analysis, and a candid threats section. Evidence honestly shows the headline 85.6% vs 21.7% advantage is driven by runnability/coverage (runnable-only rates are 83.8-84.7% for baselines), supporting a completeness claim more than a per-behavior correctness claim; probes are only ~4+ per repository and no human expert verification was possible. Generalizability is limited by the single Fortran-to-Python pair, numerics-oriented code, language-specific adapters, and no-aliasing assumptions. Reproducibility is strong: public benchmark (GitHub), artifacts (Zenodo DOI), full prompts, settings, tolerances, and cost accounting, though API model dependence and temperature-0.3 nondeterminism with single runs temper exact replication.

papers.summary_zh: 遺留軟體儲存庫將數十年領域知識埋藏在缺乏文件的老舊程式碼中,直接要求LLM翻譯整個儲存庫常喪失跨模組結構、產生幻覺API且無法檢視修正。本文提出ADFD-Migrate,主張程式是某個未觀測的潛在宣告式表示之實作,並以註記資料流程圖(ADFD)作為其明確、可檢視的近似:LLM在有限儲存庫脈絡下推斷來源ADFD,由靜態分析涵蓋率檢查驅動迭代修正;再以Tarjan強連通分量與拓撲排序進行相依感知分塊,依序產生目標語言程式碼,並藉來源與目標ADFD的結構差異回饋再生成。作者建立f2x50基準,涵蓋50個1.5k至1.6M行的Fortran儲存庫、三個複雜度層級。對382個源自Fortran的行為探針,產出的Python通過327個(85.6%),40個儲存庫全數通過,可執行目標數為直接翻譯基線的3.9倍;遷移結果指數平均93.1%,領先直接翻譯17至59個百分點,且分塊使本地30B模型足以勝任多數儲存庫並大幅降低成本。限制包括:探針為抽樣而非窮盡測試、缺乏人類專家驗證、僅評Fortran轉Python,且公式層級缺陷(如終止邏輯)仍可能漏失。結果顯示可檢視的語義瓶頸能有效提升儲存庫規模遷移的涵蓋與整合。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological LLM/RAG paper squarely within scope: it augments parametric RAG (PRAG/DyPRAG) with a learned retrieval-conditioned Fusion Controller that predicts per-passage LoRA merge weights plus sample-level calibration (gate g, temperature tau), supervised by leave-one-out merge-aware labels. Preference relevance is high (LLM backbones, RAG, LoRA/PEFT, inference efficiency), though no Japanese-NLP relevance. Novelty is moderate: the components (MLP scoring on embedding interactions, softmax temperature, uniform-prior shrinkage, AdapterFusion-style weighting, classical calibration) are individually standard; the contribution is their combination for parameter-space evidence fusion plus a stylized Proposition 1. Rigor is mixed but above average: four QA benchmarks, three backbones, random-controller and label-source ablations, varying-K and retrieval-perturbation checks, and an honest limitations section; however, no significance tests or variance are reported, baselines are 'manually reproduced', and the abstract's 'consistently improves' overstates results (e.g., Table 2: Llama-3.2-1B PRAG 29.22 vs FCPRAG 28.15 on 2Wiki Avg; FCPRAG-Combine trails DyPRAG-Combine on CWQ/Qwen 20.77 vs 32.08). Evidence strength is moderate: headline 'up to 4.65%/7.55%' gains are traceable to specific Table 2 cells but are best-case selections; case studies show only EM/F1=1.0 successes. Generalizability is limited to QA, English, small K=3, and backbones up to 8B. Reproducibility is partially supported (Appendix B.4 gives retriever, controller dims, optimizer, LoRA config; B.8 gives prompts), but the instruction-tuned LLM used for synthetic QA-pair generation is unnamed, the 'fixed-subset evaluation protocol' is unspecified, and no code release is stated.

When multiple passages are retrieved for the same query, however, evidence-level fusion becomes a bottleneck: equal-weight merging can amplify weak or conflicting evidence, and translating retrieval signals into fusion weights often requires fragile global tuning. We propose FCPRAG, a fusion-controlled
papers.summary_zh: 參數化檢索增強生成將檢索證據轉為段落專屬LoRA權重注入模型,避免長提示開銷;但當同一查詢檢索多個段落時,證據層級融合成為瓶頸:等權合併會放大弱或衝突證據,而全域溫度與混合係數的網格搜尋難以跨查詢與模型泛化。本文提出FCPRAG,在PRAG推論管線加入輕量融合控制器:預測每段落的融合分數,並輸出樣本層級校準訊號—混合閘門g與自適應溫度τ,將分數與均勻先驗插值,使系統在證據可靠時選擇性融合、不確定時保守退回均勻融合。理論上證明在異質檢索不確定性下,任何單一資料集層級溫度都有嚴格正的校準遺憾,支持樣本層級適應。訓練採合併感知監督:以留一法估計各adapter在多adapter合併中的邊際貢獻,並僅用訓練資料避免洩漏。在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、PopQA與CWQ及三個LLM骨幹上,FCPRAG於2Wiki最高提升4.65%、CWQ提升7.55%的F1;隨機控制器消融明顯較差,驗證所學融合的價值。限制包括標籤建構的離線成本、對嵌入相似度的依賴,以及尚未擴展至更大的K值。此方法近乎即插即用,可穩定多段落參數化RAG。

Section 4 Analysis / Figure 3(b): 'most occur within the first half of the trajectory, and half within the first quarter' across 160 runs - temporal analysis of hack onset.
Appendix A: exact admin/ README content provided - supports reproducibility of the planted honeypot setup.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: an agentic reward-hacking evaluation over frontier LLM coding agents, touching Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLMs (2.5), AI Safety (2.0), Alignment (2.0), Red Teaming/Evaluation (1.8), and Code (2.0). Novelty is moderate: the core hack-verifiable-environments methodology is imported from prior work (Section 2 cites Roth et al.), and 'Terminal Wrench' already covers reward-hackable terminal environments; the incremental contributions are the Terminal Bench adaptation, the L0-L3 prompt-information ablation, and the distinct-axis comparison to ImpossibleBench/EvilGenie. Rigor is solid in design (deterministic inotify-based detection, prompt class as the only variable, 89 tasks x 5 models x 5 prompt classes) but weakened by exactly one run per task per condition (2,225 = 5x5x89), no confidence intervals or significance tests, and a crude difficulty metric based on mean solve time. Evidence is internally consistent: Appendix C Table 2 gives full per-hack counts backing Figure 2 claims (e.g., Gemini L0 59.8% vs ablation 47.7%, L3 16.3%), and Appendix B provides verbatim traces. The paper itself concedes sound-but-not-complete measurement (Section 3: rates are lower bounds) and only two hack types, limiting generalizability beyond planted-solution/test-reading hacks on one benchmark. Reproducibility is strong via release of all 89 environments, 2,225 traces, a task-transformation script, and the exact admin README (Appendix A), though proprietary agents/models preclude exact re-execution over time.

primary_link.title: Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench: Evaluating Reward Hacking in Terminal Tasks

papers.summary: As agents grow more capable and autonomous, their tendency to reward hack, satisfying a task's checks while violating its intent, becomes an increasingly important failure mode. Measuring reward hacking is itself challenging, as detection typically relies on human inspection or LLM judges, both of which can be unreliable. The hack-verifiable environments (HVE) methodology addresses this challenge by embedding detectable hacks into tasks, allowing reward hacks to be identified automatically and r
papers.summary_zh: 隨著代理日益自主,獎勵駭取(滿足檢查但違背任務意圖)成為重要失效模式,而偵測通常依賴人工檢視或LLM裁判,皆不可靠。本文提出Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench(HVTB),將可駭驗證環境方法套用於終端任務基準Terminal Bench:在每個任務的admin/目錄植入標準解答與保留測試作為蜜罐,以inotify檔案監看器自動且確定性地標記讀取解答或測試兩類駭取,並釋出89個環境與2,225條代理軌跡。研究以五種提示層級逐步揭露漏洞資訊,評測claude-opus-5、gpt-5.6-sol、gemini-3.1-pro、kimi-k3與glm-5.2。結果顯示多數模型的駭取率隨資訊增加穩定下降,但gemini-3.1-pro是明顯異常者:L0下駭取率59.8%反而高於無警告對照的47.7%,L3明令禁止仍達16.3%。額外分析顯示駭取集中在軌跡前半段且較難任務更易發生;與ImpossibleBench和EvilGenie相比,HVTB探測不同的駭取軸並能區分前緣模型。限制在於此方法完備但不完備:僅能量測植入的駭取,回報率為真實駭取率的下界。此基準為獎勵駭取提供可靠、可規模化的量測基礎。
papers.title: Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench: Evaluating Reward Hacking in Terminal Tasks
papers.title_zh: Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench:終端機任務中的獎勵駭取評估

links.title: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?

evidence: Section 5.3: 'Unlike rubric-based coding benchmarks, this directly verifies game behavior... free of LLM-judge bias' — headless-Chromium behavioral probes with Fail-to-Pass/Pass-to-Pass gates.
Appendix B.1: authoring-time gate requiring gold-green, coupled-base-red, single-bug-red, and P2P survival (N=5 stable runs) per bug site to exclude cross-bug test contamination.

Section 4.4/Figure 8: Pearson r=0.898 (p=5.38e-6) and Spearman rho=0.832 between automated functional and human perceptual scores across 15 models; deviations (Claude-Opus-4.8, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) cited as justification for hybrid protocol.
Section 5.1: 'For confidentiality, the closed set remains internal' — 50 proprietary Gold Games not released; no code or data availability statement appears for GameGen or GameOpt either.
Table 3 / Section 5.4: best model reaches Strict=39.0/100; Self-Discovery score span ~38 points vs ~13 under Explicit Issue, supporting the self-discovery deficit finding.

Section 6.4: Claude-Opus-5 tops GameOpt at 93.96; per-turn macro-average 77.30→81.97 is non-monotonic, and authors state turn and content are confounded ('audio is always turn six'), limiting causal claims about long-context retention.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic coding-agent benchmark (LLM coding agents evaluated on game creation, bug repair, and multi-turn optimization) that sits squarely in the Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLM evaluation preference space. Methodologically strong: deterministic executable grading with F2P/P2P probes and authoring-time contamination gates (Appendix B.1), multi-run averaging, and a validated automated-vs-human score correlation (r=0.898, Section 4.4/Figure 8). Novelty is combinatorial rather than fundamental — GameGen overlaps existing game-generation benchmarks and GameFix follows SWE-bench — though the trajectory-derived lifecycle framing, Strict survival-curve metric, and discrimination-weighted rubric scoring are genuine contributions. Key weaknesses: the proprietary Gold Games remain confidential ('the closed set remains internal', Section 5.1), no code/data release is stated for any track, the GameGen LLM-based evaluator and human annotation protocol (annotator count, blinding, agreement) are under-specified, and GameOpt turn-dimension ordering is confounded by the authors' own admission (Section 6.4). Findings (self-discovery cliff, implementation-vs-functional gap) plausibly generalize to coding agents broadly, but the artifact itself is game-scoped and hard to reproduce externally.

primary_link.title: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?

papers.summary: Recent large language models (LLMs) can operate as coding agents that build complete games from natural language requests. Game development is especially demanding because program logic, visual and audio content, interfaces, interaction and playability must function together in one executable artifact. Measuring this capability therefore requires evaluation of both game product and the development process. Existing benchmarks often assess the game development capabilities of LLMs by evaluating t
papers.summary_zh: 評估程式代理的遊戲開發能力不應只看最終成品或單一階段。本文分析完整的人機共同開發軌跡,歸納三個生命週期階段並建立GameXpert-Bench:GameGen在空白工作區由單一自然語言需求生成完整遊戲(97題、11種類型、含44個3D遊戲);GameFix以50個經人工驗證的金級遊戲注入19–27個可逆突變缺陷,得100個修復任務,以Fail-to-Pass與Pass-to-Pass行為探針確定評分;GameOpt基於真實人機軌跡設計17條、共102項請求的多輪最佳化鏈,涵蓋玩法、關卡、平衡、美術、介面與音訊。評測15至17個前緣模型,Claude-Opus-5在三個軌道均居首(GameGen 79.7、GameFix Strict 39.0、GameOpt 93.96)。主要發現:豐富度普遍低於完整性;15.2%的模型—遊戲回合出現UI重疊或錯位;5.32%「已實作」事件實際執行失敗,主因是載入崩潰與狀態轉換錯誤;缺陷隱藏時各模型差距擴大近三倍,自我發現、行為驗證與停止準則是主要分水嶺;最佳化中維持核心玩法與跨輪回歸控制仍不穩定。此基準證明僅憑初始生成品質不足以刻劃代理的遊戲開發能力,並為可執行證據導向評估建立基礎。
papers.title: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?
papers.title_zh: GameXpert-Bench:編碼代理距離專家遊戲開發還有多遠?

links.title: MCite-RL: Towards Reliable Multimodal RAG via Citation-enhanced Agentic Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract/Sec. 1: claims average 26.16% IoU gain over vanilla RAG and 5.89% answer-accuracy gain; both values are arithmetically consistent with Table 1 across 3B/7B settings
Table 1 (Sec. 5.1): MCite-RL (7B) achieves 60.00/36.05 (Wiki-VISA), 21.81/37.22 (FinRAGBench-V), 35.04/30.12 (MMLongBench-Doc) vs VRAG-RL w/SFT at 54.20/20.56, 17.65/15.40, 31.58/12.97

Table 2 (Sec. 5.3): removing all citation rewards drops citation 36.05→20.56 and answer 60.00→54.20; w/o Outcome-level citation degrades citation to 13.15, supporting the process/outcome reward-split claim
Sec. 4.2: 'proprietary models are only tested under the setting of MCite-RL (w/o Training)', limiting the strength of comparisons to GPT-4o/Gemini/Claude

Sec. 4.4 + Appendix B/D: SFT on 2,417 GPT-5-synthesized trajectories from 28,175 candidates (8.6% acceptance), GRPO on 1,000 samples, 8×A800 with vLLM, reward weights in Table 8 and hyperparameters in Tables 9-10
Sec. 4.1 + Appendix C: MMLongBench-Doc citation evaluated on 300 newly manual-annotated samples with two-annotator checking; FinRAGBench-V on a provided subset
Limitations: bounding-box citation on single images only; added computational overhead from the training pipeline
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal RAG paper with strong overlap to curatorial preferences: agentic tool-use RL (weight 2.5), RAG/grounding/citation (1.8), reward-based RL/alignment (2.0), and multimodal LLMs (1.8), built on Qwen2.5-VL backbones — clearly not out-of-scope 'pure vision'. Methodologically it is a competent but incremental extension of VRAG-RL/Search-R1/VISA: the main novel element is making citation precision (process-level IoGT + outcome-level IoU) an explicit RL reward rather than a by-product. Rigor is above average: three benchmarks, two model scales, reproduced strong baselines, and unusually thorough component-wise ablations; but proprietary models are only tested in the untrained setting (Sec. 4.2), ablations are confined to Wiki-VISA/7B, results are single-run without variance estimates, and the answer-citation consistency metric is a self-defined LLM-judge. Evidence is internally consistent — the abstract's 26.16% IoU and 5.89% accuracy gains check out against Table 1 arithmetic — though figures could not be verified from text and MMLongBench-Doc citation ground truth is the authors' own 300-sample annotation. Generalizability is supported by genuine OOD evaluation (training only on Wiki-VISA) but limited to single-image bounding-box citation, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is mixed: full hyperparameters, reward weights, filtering criteria and annotation guidelines are given, yet no code/data release is stated and SFT depends on GPT-5-synthesized trajectories.

primary_link.title: MCite-RL: Towards Reliable Multimodal RAG via Citation-enhanced Agentic Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with visual citation is crucial for ensuring the traceability and verifiability of MLLMs. However, current RAG and SFT-based methods struggle to achieve robust cross-modal reasoning, causing imprecise visual citations or decoupling between the citation and the generated answers. To address these limitations, we propose MCite-RL, a citation-enhanced agentic reinforcement learning framework designed for reliable multimodal RAG. MCite-RL introduces an
papers.summary_zh: 多模態檢索增強生成若要可信,不僅答案要正確,還須提供可追蹤、可驗證的視覺引用。現有RAG與SFT方法常出現引用區域不精確,或引用與答案脫鉤。本文提出MCite-RL,一個以引用為核心目標的代理式強化學習框架:先以GPT-5合成帶品質過濾的逐步軌跡進行SFT冷啟動;推論採迭代檢索與遞迴裁切的代理流程,逐步縮小視覺搜尋空間;強化學習階段以GRPO最佳化融合獎勵,包含過程層級的IoGT(確保中間裁切保留核心證據)與結果層級的IoU(要求最終引用精準對齊),另含檢索效率、答案精確匹配與格式約束。在Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B上,於Wiki-VISA、FinRAGBench-V與MMLongBench-Doc評測:7B模型在Wiki-VISA達60.00%答案準確率與36.05%引用精確度,引用IoU較vanilla RAG平均提升26.16%,答案準確率平均提升5.89%;消融顯示移除引用獎勵會大幅退化,結果層級錨點尤其關鍵。限制包括額外訓練開銷,以及目前僅支援單一影像上的邊界框引用形式。此工作證明顯式的引用監督可同時提升證據定位與答案可靠性。
papers.title: MCite-RL: Towards Reliable Multimodal RAG via Citation-enhanced Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: MCite-RL:以引用增強之代理式強化學習邁向可靠的多模態RAG

links.title: ChainPrune: Evaluating and Reducing Redundancy in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: claims 26.8% chain-length and 28.1% token-length reduction without accuracy drop via DPO-based preference learning on merged reasoning paths
Experiment Setup: base models are DeepSeek-R1-Distilled-Qwen-7B/1.5B, fully fine-tuned on cleaned MATH (9,967 pairs) using 8×A100; evaluation on MATH500, AMC23, AIME24/25, LiveCodeBench
Table 1: ChainPrune AIME24 accuracy 0.5833 vs base 0.5479 and 5,688 tokens vs 7,346 (7B); 1.5B gains are smaller (0.3292 vs 0.3104)
Table 2: LLM-as-a-Judge on MATH500 reports 43 faulty, 47 invalid-reflection, 45 redundant steps vs base 102/124/132
Analysis and Discussion, Table 3: DPO+NLL improves both Kimi-1.5 and DAST variants on AIME24/MATH500, isolating the objective's contribution
Experiment Setup: 'Each experiment is run 16 times and averaged' yet no standard deviations or significance tests are reported anywhere
Appendix C, Algorithm 1: merging depends on thresholds θ_sim and ε, whose values are not specified in the provided text; no code availability is stated
Conclusion: authors acknowledge the online-RL extension is 'not yet implemented' due to time and resource constraints
Appendix A: only 33.95% of questions have min_distance=0, quantifying the token-vs-chain misalignment motivating the method
llm_evaluation.rationale: Clearly in-scope LLM reasoning work: reduces overthinking/CoT redundancy in DeepSeek-R1-distilled models via tree-merged reasoning paths, Pareto-based preference data construction, and DPO+NLL, with math and code benchmarks. The pseudo-conciseness observation (only 33.95% of shortest-token correct paths are also shortest-step, Appendix A) is a genuinely useful reframing, and the entropy-verified node merging is a reasonable mechanism, but components are incremental: DPO+NLL is adopted from prior work (Pang et al. 2024), and Kimi-1.5/DAST are reproduced baselines. Rigor is moderate: two model scales, five benchmarks, objective ablations (Table 3) and chosen-length ablation (Table 4), plus an LLM-as-a-Judge protocol with human review; however, no variance/significance despite 'run 16 times and averaged' (Experiment Setup), tiny eval sets (AMC23 n=30), reproduced rather than official baselines, and missing key hyperparameters (β, λ, θ_sim, ε). Evidence for the headline claims (28.1% token, 26.8% chain reduction without accuracy loss) is consistent across benchmarks but modest in magnitude and unaccompanied by error bars. Generalizability is limited to one distilled-Qwen model family and math/code; no code release or threshold values are given, hurting reproducibility.

primary_link.title: ChainPrune: Evaluating and Reducing Redundancy in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

papers.summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly enhanced the multi-step problem-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by introducing explicit intermediate reasoning. However, advanced Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often exhibit overthinking behaviors, including excessively long reasoning steps, redundant steps, and high computational overhead. Existing token-length reward strategies aim to promote concise outputs, but often result in pseudo-conciseness, where token count is red
papers.summary_zh: 長推理模型常出現過度思考:推理步驟過長、冗餘且計算成本高。僅以token長度為獎勵會導致「偽精簡」—token數下降但推理被切碎成更多微步,鏈長反增。本文提出ChainPrune,一種低成本的語義結構最佳化方法:先將模型自採樣的多條推理路徑以嵌入餘弦相似度與熵變化檢查合併為語義樹,剔除冗餘步驟並保留關鍵推理節點;再以Pareto支配準則同時考量token長度與鏈長選出偏好資料,拒絕明顯過長或錯誤的回答;訓練採DPO結合NLL損失,避免邊際式偏好學習因梯度糾纏造成選中與拒絕回答的機率同步退化。在DeepSeek-R1-Distilled-Qwen-7B與1.5B上,對AIME24/25、AMC23、MATH500與LiveCodeBench五個基準,ChainPrune在不犧牲準確率下平均縮短鏈長26.8%、token 28.1%;LLM-as-a-Judge與人工覆核顯示錯誤推理步驟減少57.8%、無效反思減少62.1%、冗餘步驟減少65.9%。限制是目前僅離線最佳化,尚未整合至PPO等線上強化學習框架。此方法揭示推理效率應同時衡量結構與表達層面的精簡,而非只算token數。
papers.title: ChainPrune: Evaluating and Reducing Redundancy in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ChainPrune:評估並減少長思維鏈推理中的冗餘

links.title: What actually runs: a measurement study of language model placement and decode speed on the Apple Neural Engine

evidence: §1 (p.2): three deliberately independent measurements with non-shared failure modes; every headline claim supported by at least two paths
§5.2 Table 7 (p.9): compute-unit control — ANE byte counter reads 135.3 GB under CPU_AND_NE vs exactly 0.00 GB under CPU_ONLY and CPU_AND_GPU, establishing channel specificity
§6.2 Table 11 (p.12): trained checkpoints — q25-fp16 0% residency with 0.00 GB read across ~5,750 inferences vs q25-int8 83.5% residency with 255.6 GB and 0.74 ms/predict
§6.5 (pp.13–14): encoding-gated placement replicated on M3 (fp16 0 mJ / 1.11 ms vs int8 ~2,200 mJ / 0.64 ms) with compute-unit and CPU_ONLY latency controls, but energy-based and single-run per §10
§10 Limitations (pp.19–20): no quality measurement; ~26–31M boundary is M1/macOS 26.1/coremltools 9.0 and conv-family specific; bytes/param analysis M1-only; throughput is best-of-30 warm
§12 (pp.20–21): GitHub repo with code, ledgers, and harnesses; tables regenerated from append-only results/ledger.l via paper/build_paper.py; full pipeline commands and export gotchas enumerated
§5.1 (pp.8–9): quantization swaps module class so checkpoints are byte-identical; 40-assertion tests/test_quant.py caught STE floating-point off-grid defect defeating LUT palettization
llm_evaluation.rationale: A careful measurement study of LLM placement and decode speed on the Apple Neural Engine — squarely in LLM efficiency/inference scope (matches LLM, Scaling & Efficiency, Inference & Serving, Transformer Architecture preferences), not an out-of-scope domain application. Strengths: three independent measurement paths with stated non-shared failure modes (§1, Table 3), negative controls and a compute-unit control validating undocumented byte counters (§5.2, Table 7), matched training arms with byte-identical quantized checkpoints and a 40-assertion quantizer test suite that caught a real deployment defect (§5.1), cross-chip M3 replication of the encoding-gated placement result (§6.5), and an unusually candid limitations section (§10). Novelty is genuine but niche: first ANE placement/bytes measurements with weight encoding as a design variable and the formulation-sensitivity finding, yet the conceptual territory (hardware-aware quantization, on-device LLM inference measurement on other NPUs) is established. Evidence is strong internal triangulation (plan + counters + latency + power all agree, §6.2) but single-run per cell with no error bars, tiny 5–50M TinyStories-trained undertrained models, and an unresolved discrepancy with the published M1 int8/2-bit bandwidth account that the authors correctly decline to claim as refutation (§10). Generalizability is explicitly limited: the ~26–31M placement boundary is M1/macOS 26.1/coremltools 9.0/conv-family-specific, and bytes-per-parameter analysis is M1-only; the qualitative principles may extend but are not demonstrated. Reproducibility posture is excellent: append-only ledger with table regeneration, full pipeline commands, documented IOReport channel-matching and coremltools export hazards. Overall a solid, honest systems measurement contribution, capped by scale, single-machine evidence, and toolchain-specific findings.

primary_link.title: What actually runs: a measurement study of language model placement and decode speed on the Apple Neural Engine

papers.summary: We ask what gets a language model onto the Apple Neural Engine (ANE) and what makes it fast there, and we answer with three measurements. We sweep a 64-shape matrix of LLM primitives that varies how a computation is expressed while holding what it computes fixed, recording per-operation device support. We then train matched models across size and precision, with quantized checkpoints byte-identical in structure to their fp16 counterparts, so every deployment measurement is of a real trained arti
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討兩個實務問題：什麼條件能讓語言模型跑上 Apple Neural Engine（ANE），以及跑上去之後解碼有多快。作者以三條獨立的測量路徑回答：掃描 64 種 LLM 基本運算的形狀矩陣、訓練跨規模與精度的配對模型、以及在推論期間讀取 ANE 記憶體控制器的位元組計數器。主要發現包括：運算放置取決於計算的表達方式而非語意，融合式 RMSNorm 完全符合 ANE 資格，而算術上等價的分解版本卻只能用 CPU；權重編碼決定能否上加速器，25.85M 參數的 conv-heavy fp16 模型整個落在 CPU，計數器證實零位元組經過引擎，同一張圖換成 int8 或 2-bit 即有約 83% 駐留率並快 1.8–2.2 倍；解碼成本等於每 token 串流的位元組數，約為名義編碼寬度的固定 0.77 比例。作者測得最小且最快的模型皆為三進制，據此提出設計流程：先選編碼，再把位元組預算花在參數上。限制是本文刻意不測量品質，放置邊界與特定晶片、作業系統與工具鏈版本綁定，跨晶片證據僅為單次能量測量而非位元組。對想在裝置端部署 LLM 的人而言，這是少見針對 ANE 的系統性實測。
papers.title: What actually runs: a measurement study of language model placement and decode speed on the Apple Neural Engine
papers.title_zh: 什麼實際在執行：Apple Neural Engine 上語言模型運算放置與解碼速度的量測研究

links.title: SAFE-G: Structure-aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering

evidence: Abstract: 'reinforcement learning (RL) strategy with an evidence-grounded reward that assigns credit to correct answers only when the selected evidence is correct'; code at github.com/MINE-USTC/SAFE-G
§4.2: 'Inspired by HippoRAG (16), we use Open Information Extraction (OpenIE) to construct graphs' with Personalized PageRank — core retrieval mechanism is an adaptation of prior work
§4.3.1 Eq. (10): r_acc = 1 only if predicted answer matches and r_sec = 1, where r_sec checks only document title (T̂_i = T*), not section content
§5.3.1 Table 1: SAFE-G (Qwen2.5-VL-7B) 45.1 E-VQA vs VLM-PRF 37.1 and CC-VQA 41.4; InfoSeek All 46.7
§5.4 Table 5 ablation: graph retrieval without RL 34.8; +evidence reward 38.3; +gating 43.2; full model 45.1 on E-VQA
§5.5.4 Table 7: RL 45.1 vs SFT 40.4 vs zero-shot 34.8 (E-VQA), isolating training paradigm gains

§5.5.2 Table 6: OK-VQA transfer, SAFE-G-7B 79.8 vs VLM-PRF 77.8, supporting generalizability beyond the two main benchmarks
llm_evaluation.rationale: Multimodal RAG + RL paper squarely in preferred space: MLLMs (Qwen2.5-VL), retrieval-augmented generation, GRPO with evidence-gated rewards, structured outputs, hallucination/faithfulness mitigation, chain-of-thought style reasoning; VQA is an explicitly listed preference topic, so not capped as pure CV. Novelty is moderate: the graph retrieval is explicitly 'Inspired by HippoRAG' (OpenIE + Personalized PageRank) with a multimodal prior added, and the RL stage reuses GRPO; the main new element is gating answer-correctness reward on cited document title. Rigor is good but imperfect: component-wise ablations, oracle-page analysis, zero-shot/SFT/RL comparison, data-size sensitivity, and OK-VQA transfer are all present, yet there are no significance tests, baseline resource asymmetries (NVEmbed-v2 encoder, LLaMA-3.3-70B OpenIE, OMGM summaries), and 'evidence' verification only checks document title, not section, so the faithfulness claim is only indirectly supported. Evidence strength is solid (consistent tables, training curves, case studies) with minor abstract-vs-text discrepancy (8.9%/3.5% margins vs +8.0/+3.7 reported). Generalizability shown across three benchmarks and two model scales but remains Wikipedia-centric KB-VQA. Reproducibility is above average: public code link, LoRA r=64, lr, rollout count, hardware, and data sizes specified.

primary_link.title: SAFE-G: Structure-aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering

papers.summary: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) aims to answer queries that necessitate reasoning over external knowledge sources beyond the visual content. Typically, current methods fuse multimodal features to retrieve external information, subsequently leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to derive answers from the retrieved evidence. However, these methods often struggle to capture structural associations within complex contexts to effectively filter noise. Furthermore, the
papers.summary_zh: 知識型視覺問答（KB-VQA）需要結合影像理解與外部知識，但現有 RAG 式方法常受檢索雜訊干擾，且推理過程未必忠於檢索到的證據。SAFE-G 提出三階段框架：先以視覺與文字混合的粗粒度檢索召回候選文件；再建構以 OpenIE 為基礎的無 schema 異質知識圖，注入多模態先驗並透過 Personalized PageRank 傳播，鎖定精確的證據段落，無需訓練昂貴的重排序器；最後以 GRPO 強化學習搭配證據接地獎勵，只有答案正確且引用的證據也正確時才給予準確度分數，迫使模型將推理錨定在檢索脈絡上。在 Encyclopedic-VQA 與 InfoSeek 兩個基準上，SAFE-G 分別領先先前最佳方法 8.9% 與 3.5%；以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 為骨幹時 E-VQA 達 45.1%，在提供 oracle 文件的設定下更領先 ReflectiVA 近 10 個百分點，並在 OK-VQA 上展現泛化能力。消融實驗證實圖檢索、影像先驗、證據門控與摘要各模組皆有貢獻。限制在於線上推論每次查詢約需 4.7 秒，略高於可訓練基線，且工具設計與評分任務同源。整體而言，這是將結構化檢索與證據門控 RL 結合以抑制幻覺的代表作。
papers.title: SAFE-G: Structure-aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering
papers.title_zh: SAFE-G：知識型視覺問答的結構感知忠實證據引導生成

links.title: From Solver Feedback to Faithful Plans: Multi-Role Reinforcement Learning for Symbolic Planning

evidence: Abstract: reports PlanBench average success 70.8% vs 35.5% for LLM+P, 66.3% faithful success, 6.4% semantic drift, using solver feedback only without PDDL annotations.

Table 1 / Section 4.1: baselines CoT, ToT, LLM+P use GPT-4o as backbone while the method uses Qwen2.5-7B; a matched-backbone, K=6 solver-call control is provided in Table 2 and Appendix H.1 (ours 70.8 avg vs 49.8 for Qwen-Self-Refine+Solver, 3.2 avg calls).

Table 4(a) Section 4.3: role ablation on Mystery BlocksWorld reports Actor only 0.0, Actor+Editor 0.0, and Separate models 3x7B 0.0, which conflicts with Table 3(b) where 'Ours w/o Judge' reaches 13 faithful success on MBW and Table 3(a) where Solver-only RL reaches 39.8 overall solvability.

Appendix E (Theorem 3.1) and Appendix F: reward-hacking scaling bounds assume isotropic Gaussian hacking gradients and a full-rank Judge-Editor gradient covariance (Assumptions E.1/E.2, F.6/F.7); Appendix F.2 justifies the drift-rate assumption by citing external gaps below 0.1.

Appendix A.4-A.7: full hyperparameter tables (PPO lr 3e-5, clip 0.2, lambda_J 0.3, beta 0.1, H_max 5), compute (8x A100 80GB, ~12,000 solver interactions, 12-16 hours); no code or artifact release is mentioned anywhere in the document.

Table 5 / Appendix H.9: Judge separates unsolved (0.19), solved-unfaithful (0.48), and solved-faithful (0.76) candidates with AUC 0.89 despite being trained only on solver labels; mechanism is post-hoc and unvalidated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work squarely on-topic: trains a Qwen2.5-7B backbone with PPO using deterministic solver feedback for NL-to-PDDL planning, with Actor/Judge/Editor roles, reward-hacking analysis, and planning/reasoning benchmarks. Novelty is moderate: the assembly (LLM-as-judge shaping, diagnostic-conditioned self-refine editing, LLM+P formalization, RLVR) is composed of known pieces; the shared-vs-separate reward-hacking scaling theorems are the most original element but rest on strong isotropic-Gaussian and full-rank covariance assumptions (Appendix E/F). Rigor and evidence are weakened by an internal inconsistency: Table 4(a) reports Actor+Editor = 0.0 and Separate 3x7B = 0.0 on Mystery BlocksWorld, which contradicts Table 3(b) where 'Ours w/o Judge' achieves 13 faithful success on MBW; exact-zero ablations are suspicious and lack variance. Strengths include matched-backbone, matched-solver-budget controls (Table 2/App. H.1), faithfulness/drift metrics with a defined reference checker (App. H.4), judge AUC analysis (Table 5), and repair-dynamics accounting that is internally consistent (App. H.7). Generalizability is limited to PDDL-verifiable domains, though zero-shot transfer to ProntoQA and NATURAL PLAN is positive. Hyperparameters, compute (8xA100, 12-16h), and protocols are detailed (App. A), but no code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: From Solver Feedback to Faithful Plans: Multi-Role Reinforcement Learning for Symbolic Planning

papers.summary: Reliable planning requires converting natural-language instructions into executable symbolic specifications, yet large language models remain brittle without costly PDDL annotations and may exploit solver success in semantically unfaithful ways. We study how to learn faithful natural-language-to-PDDL formalization using only solver feedback, without human-written demonstrations. We propose a solvergrounded multi-role reinforcement learning framework where a single language model acts as an Actor
papers.summary_zh: 將自然語言轉成可執行的 PDDL 規格是 LLM 規劃的關鍵瓶頸：高品質形式化通常需要人工標註，而僅以求解器成功作為獎勵，又可能鼓勵語意漂移的投機解。本文提出求解器接地的多角色強化學習框架：單一 Qwen2.5-7B 模型分飾三角，Actor 產生 PDDL 規格、Judge 學習以求解器結果校準的品質分數、Editor 依據 Fast Downward 的結構化診斷進行有界修復，全程不使用任何人工 PDDL 示範。理論分析顯示共享骨幹可限制獎勵駭取的自由度，其上界以角色私有子空間維度而非總參數量成長。在 PlanBench 四個領域上，平均成功率達 70.8%，遠高於 LLM+P 的 35.5%；忠實成功率 66.3%，語意漂移降至 6.4%；在相同骨幹與六次求解器呼叫預算的受控比較下，仍領先最強基線 21 個百分點，且能零樣本遷移到 ProntoQA 與 NATURAL PLAN。消融顯示三個角色缺一不可，改用三個分離的 7B 模型反而崩潰。限制是僅涵蓋古典 PDDL 領域，忠實性檢查依賴事後參考檢核器，且結果綁定特定求解器與超參數設定。
papers.title: From Solver Feedback to Faithful Plans: Multi-Role Reinforcement Learning for Symbolic Planning
papers.title_zh: 從求解器回饋到忠實計畫：符號規劃的多角色強化學習

links.title: Reinforcement Learning on Benign Facts Amplifies Leakage of Memorized Private Data

evidence: Abstract: RLVR on benign factual data raises verbatim recall@k from 0.155 to 0.370 (2.4x) on DeepSeek-V3.1, with reasoning and refusal rates retained.
Section 3, Table 1: targeted recall rises 0.005->0.050 (Qwen3-8B), 0.050->0.135 (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B), 0.155->0.370 (DeepSeek-V3.1); free recall 0->16, 5->65, 50->83 real addresses.

Section 2 (Fabrication controls) and Figure 2(a): decoy pool of 100 synthetic never-seen @enron.com addresses stays at zero recall throughout training; untargeted emission precision on DeepSeek-V3.1 is 82.0%->82.2% (Section 3).
Section 2 (Reasoning capability control) and Figure 2(b): MMLU evaluated via a fixed 60-question probe, accuracy stays in 0.78-0.89 band with no downward trend.
Section 3, Table 2: refusal rate moves 86.33%->81.20% (Qwen3-8B) and is unchanged at 8.78% (DeepSeek-V3.1), arguing leakage is not explained by refusal erosion alone.

Section 4 (Related Works) and Limitations: closest prior work is Liu et al. 2026 (finetuning activates verbatim recall of copyrighted books); authors concede single corpus, single PII type (Enron emails, verbatim), and cross-family model confound for the scaling conclusion.

Appendix A.2 (Table 3) and Appendix B: full hyperparameters (GRPO, LoRA rank 32, seeds 42/1234, per-model LRs, 5 paraphrase templates, k=10) and ~210 GPU-hours total training compute; Ethical Considerations state target pool and RL checkpoints are not released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/alignment paper: RLVR (GRPO) post-training on PII-free factual QA increases extractability of memorized PII across three instruction-tuned models (8B-671B). Strong match to LLM, AI Safety, Alignment/RLHF, RL, and evaluation preferences; no match to Japanese NLP, agents, or code (heaviest unmatched preferences). Novelty is incremental: the structure mirrors Liu et al.'s copyright finding (SFT reactivates verbatim recall) and Zhang et al.'s RL-knowledge-traversal work; the delta is RL-with-verifiable-rewards on benign data plus a PII domain, untargeted free-recall probing, and a scaling trend. Rigor is solid but incomplete: thoughtful controls (decoy pool at zero, emission precision 82.0->82.2, refusal measurement, template-derivable address filtering, MMLU capability check), yet no SFT-on-same-data baseline to isolate the RL mechanism, no significance testing or multi-seed variance, a small 60-question MMLU probe, crude phrase-list refusal detection, and 'maximum recall over 5 paraphrases' selection. Evidence shows large, consistent, controlled effects but from seemingly single runs on a 200-record pool. Generalizability is honestly limited (single corpus, single PII type, verbatim match only, cross-family models confound the scaling claim). Reproducibility benefits from full hyperparameters, prompts, seeds, and public datasets/models, but target pool and checkpoints are withheld (ethically justified) and the ~210 GPU-hours total for training including a 671B model via an unnamed managed service is under-specified. Overall a relevant, credible, moderately novel contribution.

primary_link.title: Reinforcement Learning on Benign Facts Amplifies Leakage of Memorized Private Data

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is deployed to make models better at reasoning tasks, but its side effect on what models will divulge is under studied. Here we show that RLVR on facts increases extraction of personally identifiable information (PII) the instruct model had already memorized. We first confirm that instruct models have already memorized PII but leave them latent, rarely surfacing one when asked. We then apply RL on benign factual data that contains no PII of a
papers.summary_zh: RLVR（可驗證獎勵的強化學習）廣泛用於提升推理能力，但其對模型隱私行為的副作用研究甚少。本文證實：在完全不含 PII 的良性事實問答上執行 GRPO，會大幅提高模型對預訓練時已記憶個人資料的可萃取性。作者先確認 instruct 模型已記住 Enron 員工的姓名與電子郵件配對，但平時很少主動吐出；接著在不含任何電郵的 FACTS-Parametric 事實資料上微調，再以目標式探針與非目標式自由回憶提示測試 200 筆保留配對，並以從未出現的虛構地址作為捏造對照。結果顯示 DeepSeek-V3.1 的逐字 recall@k 從 0.155 升至 0.370，約 2.4 倍，且效果隨模型規模放大，Qwen3-8B 為 0.005 升至 0.050、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 為 0.050 升至 0.135；虛構地址召回率始終為零，未目標輸出的精確度不變（82.0% 至 82.2%），MMLU 與拒答率也大致保留，顯示改變的是哪些已記憶資訊變得可存取，而非整體能力退化。這意味著攻擊者無需任何隱私相關訓練訊號、也無需接觸資料本身，僅靠無害微調即可放大洩漏。限制包括僅使用單一英文語料與單一 PII 類型，三個模型的家族與架構並不一致。
papers.title: Reinforcement Learning on Benign Facts Amplifies Leakage of Memorized Private Data
papers.title_zh: 在良性事實上的強化學習會放大已記憶私人資料的洩漏

links.title: From SQL Generation to Tool Selection: A Domain-Oriented Pattern for MCP Servers

evidence: Section 6, Design and Setup: 4 models x 3 approaches x 17 tasks x 3 repetitions = 612 planned cells, 609 completed; temperature 0, seed 42, 8192-token context, max 10 agent steps; three qwen2.5:3b/service_case/approach-A cells lost to a stdio pipe hang.

Section 6, Scoring: rule-based checks against live-computed gold answers with no LLM judge, but 'Workflow checks (tool-call sequences, argument validation) apply only to approaches B and C; approach A is scored solely on its final answer text' — an asymmetry that can bias pooled mean scores toward B/C.

Section 6, Accuracy Results: verticalized pack pooled mean 0.939 vs 0.666 (raw SQL) and 0.605 (generic pack); llama3.2:3b improves 0.583 to 0.929 with 42/51 fully-correct cells; generic pack trails raw SQL on three of four models.

Threats to Validity: 'the verticalized pack and the check-based scorer were developed against the same seventeen tasks... no held-out task set was evaluated'; single small schema whose DDL fits in context; only local 3B-8B models at one decoding setting; hardware-relative latency.

Section 6, Token and Latency Efficiency: tokens per correct answer 3,582 (B) vs 9,372 (C) vs 11,858 (A); per-model reductions of roughly 2.0x-11.6x, cheapest correct cell from llama3.2:3b with domain tools.

Abstract and Conclusion: 'All harness code, prompts, gold answers, packs and per-cell results are publicly available'; run recorded 2026-08-20 against MCP Blueprint commit b386d58 with a pinned run manifest; gemma2:2b and phi3:mini excluded pre-measurement for lacking tool-calling support.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agentic tool-use paper: proposes replacing generic SQL execution in MCP database servers with curated domain tools ('verticalized packs') and empirically shows small local models suffice when the interface reduces SQL synthesis to intent classification ('Model Demotion'). Strong match to Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences, with secondary relevance to efficiency and text-to-SQL. Novelty is moderate: the core idea restates established abstraction-layer engineering (ORMs, REST, semantic layers) applied to MCP, though the three-arm comparison isolating tool design from tool existence (B 0.939 vs C 0.605 vs A 0.666 pooled) is a genuinely useful empirical angle. Rigor is decent but constrained: controlled 4x3x17x3 design at temperature 0 with rule-based scoring, honest Threats to Validity section, yet no significance testing, a single hand-authored task suite developed by the same author as the tools (acknowledged circularity), and a scoring asymmetry since workflow checks apply only to approaches B and C while A is scored on final answers alone. Evidence is internally consistent (per-model and per-task tables, documented 3 lost cells) but derives from one run on one small schema (Sakila, six tables, DDL fits in context) with only 3B-8B local models. Generalizability is limited by no held-out tasks, no frontier models, and one domain, as the authors concede. Reproducibility is exemplary: public harness, prompts, gold answers, packs, per-cell JSON records, pinned commit b386d58, documented exclusions.

primary_link.title: From SQL Generation to Tool Selection: A Domain-Oriented Pattern for MCP Servers

papers.summary: Agents built on Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly reach enterprise data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and many MCP database servers maximize flexibility by exposing a single generic SQL execution tool. This paper proposes the Domain-Oriented Tooling Pattern: instead of generating SQL at query time, the model selects from a small set of domain-aligned tools whose parameterized queries encapsulate schema navigation, joins and business rules on the server side. We formalize the
papers.summary_zh: 許多 MCP 資料庫伺服器以單一通用 SQL 執行工具換取彈性，卻把 schema 探索、join 推理與商業規則解讀全推給模型，推高對大型模型的依賴並擴大安全面。本文提出領域導向工具模式：模型不再即時生成 SQL，而是從少數與領域對齊的工具中做選擇，參數化查詢、join 與商業規則封裝在伺服器端；並提出 Model Demotion，介面複雜度降低後，開放式合成化為意圖分類與槽位填補，小型模型即可勝任。作者釋出開源框架 MCP Blueprint，以 YAML 與外部參數化 SQL 檔宣告式定義工具，並建立可重現的公開基準：三種伺服器設計（原始 SQL、垂直化工具包、通用薄工具包）搭配四個 3B–8B 本地模型與十七個企業式任務。垂直化工具包平均準確率 0.939，遠高於原始 SQL 的 0.666 與通用工具包的 0.605；每個模型皆受益，最小的 3B 模型從 0.583 躍升至 0.929，每個正確答案的成本降低約 2 至 12 倍。通用薄工具包甚至不如原始 SQL，凸顯工具設計而非工具存在才是關鍵。限制包括評分與任務對齊、單一小 schema、僅測本地模型與溫度 0 設定，延遲亦為硬體相對值。

links.title: SkillBloat: Token Amplification Attacks via Skill Injection in LLM Coding Agents

evidence: Abstract: reports 5.4184×–10.1455× average best amplification across coding-agent target configurations, with ablation showing Phase 2 refinement improves over Phase 1 screening alone.

Section 3.3: no-feedback control rewrites five times without execution feedback at matched budget; feedback-guided Phase 2 is higher in all four configurations (e.g., 10.1455× vs 8.8427× on gpt-5.4-mini; largest gap 1.3028×).
Section 4.2: frozen Phase-2 SKILL.md deployed verbatim on three task variants per skill without re-optimization; mean retention 0.92, seven of ten skills ≥0.82×, four exceed 1×.

Section 3.1: task completion is judged by glm-5, which is also a target backend model for the Claude Code configuration (potential judge bias), and no judge-validation or inter-annotator check is reported.
Section 3.2: lighter-weight backends are more vulnerable — GLM-4.7-Flash 9.3105× vs glm-5 5.4184×; gpt-5.4-mini 10.1455× vs gpt-5.5 6.0063× — with max 71.59× and 75.86×.
Section 3.4 / Table 3: consciousness-principles case study shows commands 3→9→28 and file edits 0→1→10 tracking amplification 1×→10.07×→26.39× (tokens 38,410→1,013,561; cost $0.21→$5.41).

Section 3.1 and Appendix A Table 4: K=15 attack types fully enumerated with tool contexts, but no code, artifact, or full system-prompt (θ_sys, θ_refine) release is stated; benchmark is reused from SkillJect (ref 7).

Section 5: paper positions contribution against SkillJect (security-oriented skill injection), DDIPE supply-chain poisoning, and prompt-based DoS (Engorgio, CRABS, ThinkTrap, tool-chain amplification), claiming first systematic study of the skill-injection resource-abuse channel.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent security paper directly matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming, Code & Programming): token amplification via skill injection in coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI). Novelty is moderate — the attack surface (trusted SKILL.md documents) is plausibly new per Section 5's positioning against security-oriented skill poisoning (SkillJect, DDIPE) and prompt/tool-chain resource amplification (Engorgio, CRABS, ThinkTrap), but the two-phase screen-then-LLM-refine methodology closely mirrors SkillJect's trace-driven closed-loop refinement. Rigor is decent: a no-feedback resampling control matching Phase 2 budget (Section 3.3) and a frozen-skill cross-task persistence experiment (Section 4.2) are well-designed; however, single-run measurements without variance or significance tests, undisclosed sample sizes, and an LLM judge (glm-5) that is also a target backend weaken confidence. Evidence is concrete and internally consistent (amplification ratios, token counts, cost estimates, command/edit counts), but no code, prompts, or artifact release is stated, and only two terminal coding-agent frontends are tested. Verified methods, baselines, ablations, and limitations support a mid-to-upper score.

primary_link.title: SkillBloat: Token Amplification Attacks via Skill Injection in LLM Coding Agents

papers.summary:
Agent skills extend coding agents with task-specific instructions, scripts, and resources, but they also create a trusted
  instruction channel that can be abused beyond conventional security attacks. This paper studies token amplification through
  skill injection: an economic resource-abuse threat in which a malicious skill causes an agent to consume substantially more
  tokens than needed for normal task execution. We present SkillBloat, a two-phase framework that first screens a library of
papers.summary_zh: 代理技能以 SKILL.md 為核心，是編碼代理的高信任指令通道，但既有研究多聚焦資料外洩、提權或後門等安全後果，忽略了經濟面的資源濫用。本文提出 SkillBloat，首個系統性的技能注入 token 放大攻擊框架：第一階段從 15 種攻擊類型條件（冗長輸出、工具驅動放大、脈絡放大等機制）中篩選最強者；第二階段由攻擊代理依目標代理的執行軌跡與失敗診斷回饋，迭代改寫整份 SKILL.md，在保留任務完成度的同時誘發重試、多階段驗證與品質檢查等額外工作。在真實技能基準上，橫跨 Claude Code 與 Codex 兩種前端與四個後端模型，平均最佳放大率為 5.42 至 10.15 倍，單一任務最高達 75.86 倍；案例研究中 gpt-5.5 的 token 消耗從 38,410 增至 1,013,561（26.39 倍），成本由 0.21 美元升至 5.41 美元。較輕量的後端更易受攻擊；跨任務保留實驗顯示毒化技能平均保留 0.92 的放大率，代表一次性部署即可持續危害。限制是任務完成度由 glm-5 評判，且本研究僅針對資源濫用而非資料外洩。此研究凸顯技能生態系需要針對異常資源消耗的防禦。

links.title: Align, Unify, Suppress, Route: A Coherentist View of Transformer Computation

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 15 models from five architecture families, the suppression, unification, and routing weight-space signatures correlate with held-out activation-level role measures above random baselines.'

Section 4 (Decision rules and statistical testing): pre-specified support/partial/mixed/against criteria, paired permutation tests (10,000 permutations), Holm correction, and percentile bootstrap CIs fixed before confirmatory runs.

Table 2 / Section 5.1: P1 verdicts are 3 support and 12 partial; the weight-magnitude baseline is exceeded in only 10 models, and the alignment weight score does not track the activation-level alignment measure (r ≈ −0.04).

Table 3 / Section 5.4: P2 outcome is 1 support, 9 partial, 5 against; the conflict-specificity control passes only in LLaMA-3.2-3B, and the reduction 'reflects generic upstream dependence, not conflict-specific signalling'.

Section 5.5: the raw coherence gap is significant in 14 models but its sign is architecture-dependent (GPT-2/Pythia positive; Gemma/Qwen/three LLaMA variants negative); the whitened proxy gap is positive in all models and significant in 14.
Section 5.6 / Table 4: P4 gives two support and two partial verdicts; induction-head preservation passes in all four pairs (r = 0.98–1.00, one-sided test against r = 0.9).
Section 5.7: cross-task suppression r = 0.68 versus unification r = 0.45, with the prediction fully holding in 6 of 15 models.

Limitations: 'The suppression evidence is the weakest... layer-matched control exceeded in 5/15 models'; evaluation rests on synthetic tasks with a single naturalistic negation set (gap positive in 10/15 models).

Title-page availability note: 'Code and data will be made publicly available upon acceptance' — no artifact released at submission, though Appendix D documents preregistered thresholds, seeds {0,...,4}, and exact software versions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core mechanistic-interpretability work on transformer computation, directly matching the Interpretability, Transformer Architecture, and LLM preferences (attention heads, QK/OV circuits, probing across GPT-2/Pythia/Qwen/Gemma/LLaMA), though it does not engage the higher-weight agent/CoT/Japanese topics. Novelty is solid: the coherentist CPC framework with four operator roles is a fresh unifying vocabulary, operationally instantiated in weight-space signatures. Rigor is a standout: pre-specified decision rules, discovery/held-out splits, Holm correction, permutation/bootstrap inference, dual silhouette nulls, random- and magnitude-matched ablation controls, whitened proxies, and 5-seed reporting. Evidence strength is only moderate because many headline predictions survive only in weakened form: P1 gives 3 support/12 partial, P2 gives 1 support/9 partial/5 against, the raw coherence proxy's sign flips by family, and the suppression weight score isolates task-specific suppression in only 5/15 models. Generalizability is limited to small decoder-only English models and largely synthetic tasks, with the paper itself concluding depth-level claims are architecture-specific. Reproducibility is supported by unusually detailed methodology (Appendix D fixed thresholds, seeds, software versions) but no code/data artifact is released yet ('upon acceptance').

primary_link.title: Align, Unify, Suppress, Route: A Coherentist View of Transformer Computation

papers.summary: Mechanistic interpretability has identified transformer circuits, but lacks a shared vocabulary for describing how their functions compose across tasks and architectures. We introduce Coherentist Probabilistic Compositionalism (CPC), an interpretive framework that grounds transformer computation in coherentist theories of interpretation and describes it through four operator roles. Alignment identifies candidate relations, unification integrates supporting information, suppression reduces incomp
papers.summary_zh: 機制可解釋性已辨識出眾多電路，卻缺乏描述其功能如何在任務與架構間組合的共同詞彙。本文提出 Coherentist Probabilistic Compositionalism（CPC），把 Transformer 運算視為連貫性的逐步精煉，並以四個運算子角色描述：對齊透過 QK 互動提出候選關係、統一以加法寫入整合相容資訊、抑制以減法寫入削弱不相容選項、路由把選定內容送往讀出位置。作者為每個注意力頭定義權重空間特徵，搭配 activation 層級測量與因果消融，在 GPT-2、Pythia、Qwen 2.5、Gemma 2 與 LLaMA 3.2 五個家族共 15 個模型上驗證。結果顯示抑制、統一與路由的權重特徵與保留集的 activation 測量呈正相關（r 介於 0.21 至 0.58）；抑制的跨任務穩定性（r=0.68）高於統一（r=0.45）；明確矛盾在 14 個模型顯著改變逐層連貫代理，移除共享殘差協變後方向在所有模型皆符合預期；後訓練大致保留歸納頭結構（r 不低於 0.98）而呈現角色重新加權。限制包括抑制權重分數對任務特定抑制的辨識力弱、連貫代理與殘差幾何混淆，且深度與幾何表現高度依賴架構。此框架為跨架構比較提供了共同語言。
