Section 3.2: formal definitions of Accuracy, Magnitude, Stability (magnitude-weighted), and Collapse Point with tau = 0.80 x acc(L0), measured-severity level assignment via deterministic surface metrics
Section 4.2: 5,673 candidates generated, 4,473 (78.9%) admitted after structural/NLI/LLM-judge gates; Table 3 gives per-family admitted counts

Section 4.3: 'for Knowledge Boundary a gpt-4o-mini judge scores each response' — the KB judge is also a system under test; o4-mini uses non-deterministic default decoding; baseline queried three times (300 evaluations)

Section 5.1: accuracy falls L0 to L5 from 0.98 to 0.65 (o4-mini), 0.94 to 0.46 (gemini-2.5-flash), 0.89 to 0.41 (gpt-4o-mini), 0.72 to 0.41 (phi4-mini), with the cliff concentrated at L5 impossible-premise tests

Table 5: every model collapses under Conflict Instruction Stress (L5/L5/L2/L4) and on Knowledge Boundary (L3/L3/L3/L5); gpt-4o-mini additionally collapses on Context Interference (L1) and Context Load (L3)
Section 5.2: impossible-premise refusal accuracy 0.07-0.08 for the three API models and 0.47 for phi4-mini; missing-information (0.92-0.95) and fabricated-evidence (0.78-0.90) refusals are reliable
Section 6 limitations: single task family, 100 seeds, LLM-based entailment/judging may introduce evaluator error or bias, one rubric level never assigned, no human validation or inter-judge agreement

Code and data availability: all code, prompts, per-level bands, gate thresholds, and test suite claimed at https://github.com/neuroloft-ai/stability; seeds from apple/GSM-Symbolic on HuggingFace (Section 4.1)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Clearly in-scope LLM evaluation methodology: a graded, seven-family perturbation framework with validity gates, measured-severity labeling, magnitude-weighted Stability, and baseline-relative Collapse Points, run on four LLMs (o4-mini, gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-4o-mini, phi4-mini) over 4,473 gated GSM8K-derived tests. Novelty is moderate: it credibly synthesizes separate literatures (GSM perturbation robustness, abstention/unanswerability, instruction conflict) into one graded frame, but the ingredients (GSM-Plus families, CheckList invariance, SQuAD 2.0-style refusal, instruction-hierarchy conflicts) all exist, and the metrics are simple. Rigor is solid on gating and severity calibration but weakened by LLM-judge dependence with no human validation, an unvalidated 0.80 collapse threshold, single runs with no variance estimates or significance testing, and a conflict of interest in scoring: the Knowledge Boundary judge is gpt-4o-mini, itself a system under test (Section 4.3). Evidence is concrete (Tables 3-5, per-boundary-type refusal rates), supporting the headline claims of universal CIS and impossible-premise failures, but several conclusions rest on described figures. Generalizability is limited to one task domain and 100 seeds, which the authors acknowledge. Reproducibility is aided by released code/prompts/gates and explicit formulas, though the repository and future-dated citations cannot be verified from the document.

primary_link.title: Measuring Stability and Failure Behavior in Language Models Under Structured Perturbations

papers.summary: Language models are usually judged by a single accuracy score, which does not reveal how their performance degrades as inputs are perturbed. We present a graded, multi-family, failure-aware framework for stress-testing reasoning models. It perturbs each problem along a multi-level severity ladder across seven families: six that preserve the answer, paraphrase, input noise, formatting, irrelevant context, context load, and conflicting instructions, and a Knowledge Boundary family that removes ans
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型通常只以單一準確率被評判，掩蓋了效能如何隨輸入惡化而退化、以及在無法回答的問題上如何失敗。本文提出分級、多家族且失效感知的壓力測試框架：七個擾動家族——語意改寫、輸入品質、格式、無關脈絡、脈絡負載、衝突指令與知識邊界——沿五級嚴重度階梯施加，每個測試經有效性閘門把關並以實測嚴重度標籤；每個模型以逐級準確率、幅度加權的穩定性，以及相對自身基線定義的崩潰點三個量總結。框架以 GSM-Symbolic 的 100 道種子題擴充為 4,473 道通過閘門的測試，評估 o4-mini、gemini-2.5-flash、gpt-4o-mini 與 phi4-mini 四個模型。結果顯示崩潰點具有家族特異性而非全域性：所有模型都在衝突指令下崩潰；知識邊界中的不可能前提最為普遍地失效，三個 API 模型的正確拒答率僅 0.07 至 0.08，模型會照算不誤而不標記前提不可能；強模型的表面擾動家族則相對穩健。限制是僅涵蓋小學數學單一任務與 100 道種子題，生成閘門與評分部分依賴 LLM 判斷，可能引入評審偏誤。此類退化曲線與行為剖面補足了單一分數看不到的部署風險。
papers.title: Measuring Stability and Failure Behavior in Language Models Under Structured Perturbations

links.title: ToSCA: Leveraging Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning on Temporal and Strategic Abstractions of Conversational Agents

evidence: Section 4.1: high-level backbone LLaMA3.2-1B-Instruct, low-level LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct, trained on OpenRLHF with 16 A100 GPUs; 'We employ GPT-4o for both user simulation and satisfaction scoring' — the same oracle produces the reward and simulates the environment.

Section 3.5 and Algorithm 1: high-level reward r_sat is the GPT-4o judge score (0-5), used for both B^H and B^L buffers, so headline reward/value results (Table 2: ToSCA 616.5/4.03 vs Direct 486.2/3.21) are self-referential to the training oracle.
Table 3 (Section 4.5): ToSCA reports Acc 63.64, MaF1 58.91, B-2 16.35, R-L 35.22 vs SFT B-2 6.81/R-L 18.52; no significance tests and no analysis of the >2x similarity jump are provided.

Table 6 (Section 4.6 Ablation): w/o high-level and w/o low-level cause large drops (B-2 7.85 and 4.17 vs 16.35), w/o im a moderate drop (16.21), supporting the hierarchical and intrinsic-motivation design.
Appendix E (Proof of Theorem 1): relies on Lemma 1 from the options framework (Sutton et al. 1999); condition 2 is asserted rather than shown ('The second condition is part of our basic assumption').

Appendix F.1, Table 12: GPT-4o vs human Spearman correlations 0.81-0.91 across six dimensions, partially mitigating judge circularity; Appendix F.3 reports human eval with Cohen's Kappa 0.47 (moderate agreement).

Limitations section: 'the hierarchical framework introduces additional training complexity' and the study 'mainly focuses on conversations'; Appendix B shows framework needs strategy-annotated corpora (DailyDialog 4 strategies, ESConv 8 strategies).

Abstract: 'Our implementation is available at https://github.com/AaronJi/ToSCA'; Appendix B Table 11 lists full hyperparameters (lrs 5e-6/9e-7/9e-4, beta1=beta2=0.01, gamma 0.85 high-level / 1.0 low-level) and Appendix A gives all prompts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM-methodology paper: hierarchical RL (DQN high-level strategy critic + PPO token-level actor-critic) for LLM-based conversational agents, touching LLMs, RLHF/alignment, agents, prompting/ICL, and RL preferences. Novelty is moderate: it explicitly positions itself between ArCHer (latent high-level) and DAT (utterance-level planner), and the components (options framework, DQN+PPO, KL penalty, log-likelihood intrinsic motivation) are largely recombination of known techniques; the convergence theorem adapts existing SMDP Q-learning results. Rigor is reasonable but uneven: extensive baselines, ablations, sensitivity analyses, and human evaluation exist, yet the GPT-4o oracle serves simultaneously as user simulator, reward source, and (correlated) evaluator, creating circularity risk; the huge B-2/R-L jumps over SFT (16.35 vs 6.81 on DailyDialog) are not explained, some baseline numbers are imported from other papers/backbones, and the theory proof is thin (e.g., 'The second condition is part of our basic assumption'). Evidence is mixed: concrete tables, ablation support (Table 6), OOD transfer (Table 5), and judge-human correlation (Table 12, Spearman 0.81-0.91) strengthen claims, but circular evaluation and absent significance testing weaken them. Generalizability is limited to strategy-annotated dialogue domains with an admitted focus on conversations. Reproducibility is comparatively strong: public code claim, full hyperparameters (Table 11), prompts (Appendix A), and public datasets, though GPT-4o dependence adds cost/nondeterminism.

primary_link.title: ToSCA: Leveraging Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning on Temporal and Strategic Abstractions of Conversational Agents

papers.summary: Humans have multiple levels of temporal abstractions on daily interaction and thinking, such as concept perception and strategic planning. Inspired by this nature, we propose a two-level hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework for conversational agents, bridging the gap between previous token-level or utterance-level RL methods. Developed on a two-level MDP, the token-level response decoding is conditioned on the utterance-level action, the explicit textual strategies. Based on theore
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在對話任務上多採用 token 層級的 RLHF，但面臨獎勵稀疏與運算開銷過高的問題；而語句層級的強化學習方法（如 DAT）又忽略 token 層級的示範。本文提出 ToSCA，一個雙層階層式強化學習（HRL）框架：高層 MDP 以純生成式價值批評者（DQN）在離散動作空間選擇明確的文字策略，低層 MDP 則以 PPO 的 actor-critic 在策略條件下逐 token 生成回應。為緩解獎勵稀疏，作者設計雙粒度獎勵機制，結合語句層級滿意度分數（由 GPT-4o 評分）、KL 懲罰與內在動機（低層脈絡與回應的對數似然）。在 DailyDialog 與 ESConv 實驗中，ToSCA 的策略分類準確率、回應相似度與多樣性均超越提示工程、監督微調及 RL 基線，並在 EmpatheticDialogues 的域外測試展現泛化能力。消融實驗顯示移除高層或低層元件都會明顯掉分，內在動機有助於策略一致性。限制在於階層式訓練複雜度高且僅聚焦對話領域。此研究示範了將人類的策略性思考抽象引入對話代理訓練的可行路徑。

links.title: PowerSlider: Exploiting Phase Asymmetry for LLM Serving under Demand Response

evidence: Abstract: 'sustains 78.3% online goodput at a 30% cap reduction versus 47.6% for the best of five baselines (1.64x)' and '92% mean goodput through a replayed CAISO grid-emergency day bottoming at 0.41x (54% at the trough; every baseline below 7%)'.

Sec. VI (Experimental Methodology): 'We use DGX-A100 and GH200 servers as serving instances ... (under 8 GPU nodes) ... scaling to 64-512 GPUs with a modified SplitwiseSim discrete-event simulator', with 'component-wise against held-out measurements to be less than 4% MAPE; power-fit R^2>0.95'.

Sec. VII-E: 'PowerSlider holds >=98% online goodput across the entire day (worst 60 s window: 98.0%, at the deepest point of the trough)', inconsistent with the Abstract's 92% mean / 54% trough figures for the same replay.
Sec. VII-D (ablation): 'removing any one at a 30% reduction raises LC TTLT by 74-100% and LC TTFAT by 59-101%'.
Sec. VII-F: 'in the paper's 9-group setting this takes 7.7 ms (130 solves/s), and even at 81 groups ... the solve takes 63 ms, inside a single 100 ms DVFS interval'.
Appendix -F: 'a full H100 evaluation is left to future work', limiting cross-hardware generality claims to fitted curves (GH200 R^2=0.98).
No code or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the paper; only trace provenance (Azure public dataset, Magpie, S1K) is identified in Sec. VI and Table IV.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid systems paper on power-capped LLM serving under grid demand response, squarely within the LLM inference/serving and efficiency preferences (LLM workloads on SGLang, KV-cache and DVFS knobs), though it is infrastructure work rather than LLM methodology, so topic relevance is moderate rather than high. Novelty is good: the Flex (alpha, rho) SLO contract, Prefill-Think-Answer disaggregation, and a KKT-based online solver for time-varying caps are differentiated from static-envelope prior work (DynamoLLM, POLCA, Splitwise), and the paper positions itself carefully in Sec. VIII and Table I. Rigor is strong: measured motivation (Sec. III, Fig. 4), convex relaxation with a full KKT derivation (Appendix -B), five baselines (Table V), component ablations (Sec. VII-D), sensitivity studies (Figs. 16-17), and a validated simulator (<4% MAPE, power-fit R^2>0.95, Sec. VI). Evidence strength is dinged because the headline large-scale results (64-512 GPUs) are simulator-based with real hardware limited to 8 GPU nodes (Sec. VI), and there is an internal inconsistency: the Abstract claims 92% mean goodput (54% at trough) for the CAISO replay while Sec. VII-E claims >=98% online goodput all day (worst window 98.0%), which is unexplained. Generalizability is limited to GPU serving with NVML DVFS control; H100 porting is asserted from curve fits but 'a full H100 evaluation is left to future work' (Appendix -F). No code or artifact release is stated, only trace/dataset identifiability (Azure, Magpie, S1K), capping reproducibility.

primary_link.title: PowerSlider: Exploiting Phase Asymmetry for LLM Serving under Demand Response

papers.summary: AI inference clusters are increasingly constrained by instantaneous power, not just energy: grid operators condition new capacity on demand response, imposing time-varying power caps. Existing LLM serving systems optimize a static energy objective or shed fixed priority tiers under load; either way, goodput collapses when the power envelope moves. An LLM pipeline is not a uniform load: compute-bound prefill loses throughput almost linearly with GPU frequency, memory-bound answer decode sustains
papers.summary_zh: AI 推理叢集日益受瞬時功率上限而非僅能源消耗的約束，電網營運商以需量反應（demand response）作為新增容量的條件，要求伺服器系統在時變功率上限下持續服務。作者觀察到 LLM 推理管線的相位不對稱性：計算密集的 prefill 幾乎線性損失吞吐量，記憶體頻寬受限的 answer decode 可在低至 0.57 倍標稱頻率下維持性能，而推理模型的 thinking 階段使 KV 快取容量與排程耦合。PowerSlider 據此提出三項設計：將有界使用者延遲容忍轉為最佳化約束的 Flex SLO 合約、暴露每階段頻率與 KV 控制旋鈕的 prefill–think–answer（PTA）分離架構，以及基於 KKT 條件、每次上限變動後 7.7 毫秒內重新求解的線上求解器。在 SGLang 與生產軌跡的評估顯示，30% 降載下 PowerSlider 維持 78.3% 線上 goodput，對比最佳基線的 47.6%（1.64 倍）；延遲關鍵尾延保持在標稱的 1.3 倍內；重播 CAISO 電網緊急日仍保有 92% 平均 goodput。限制包括靜態功率下限迫使電源閘控，以及硬體頻率調整粒度較粗。此系統為電網互動式 LLM 服務提供了可行藍圖。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Substantive overlap with high-weight preferences: an agent interface that monitors LLM conversations (GPT-4o generator; Llama-3.3-70B zero-shot classifier selected from nine open-weight models) for AI-safety-relevant dark patterns (sycophancy, brand bias, anthropomorphization, sneaking, harmful generation). The contribution is an HCI behavioral study rather than an LLM methodology advance, so relevance is strong but not central to language modeling itself. Novelty is solid: plausibly the first controlled evaluation of defensive interventions against conversational dark patterns in live multi-turn interaction, plus a reusable testbed and the counterintuitive finding that cognitive forcing did not transfer from single-shot tasks. Rigor is high: preregistered five-condition between-subjects design (N=150), human-coded manipulation check with reported kappa, FDR-corrected post-hoc tests, and an explicit classifier-confound check across conditions. Evidence strength is moderate: only the just-in-time-without-forcing contrast survived correction (71.7% to 53.7% compliance), with n=30 per condition, ~80% in-deployment classifier agreement, imperfect stimulus realization (88.2% confirmation), and nulls acknowledged as absence of large effects. Generalizability is limited by a US English-only Prolific sample, mock tasks without real consequences, and scripted manipulation schedules. Reproducibility is partial: prompts and model choices are documented and the classifier is open-weight, but no public code/data/testbed release is stated.

primary_link.title: AI Watchdog: Agent Interfaces for Detecting and Defending Against Manipulative Dark Patterns in AI Conversations

papers.summary: Conversational AI increasingly shapes consequential decisions, yet users have limited support for recognizing and resisting manipulation. We present AI Watchdog, a browser-based agent interface that monitors live conversations, detects five dark-pattern categories, including sycophancy, brand bias, anthropomorphization, sneaking, and harmful generation, and alerts users when they occur. Its open-weight turn-level classifier supports independent deployment and a path toward local inference, prese
papers.summary_zh: 對話式 AI 日益影響重大決策，但使用者缺乏辨識與抵抗操縱的支援。本文提出 AI Watchdog，一個持續監控對話、偵測五類黑暗模式（諂媚、品牌偏見、擬人化、偷偷夾帶、有害生成）並即時警示使用者的瀏覽器代理介面，採用開放權重的 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 回合層級分類器，與對話模型保持獨立以利第三方監督與未來本地推理。作者進行預註冊的五條件受試者間實驗（N=150），比較無介入對照與四種組態，橫跨提醒時機（預先防範 prebunking 對即時 just-in-time）與參與模式（有無認知強制）。結果顯示各組態的明確標記率皆低（中位數 0%），事後自陳覺察亦無顯著差異；但僅「即時提醒、無認知強制」顯著降低對 AI 操縱性建議的服從率，由對照組的 71.7% 降至 53.7%（18 個百分點），而要求書面回應的認知強制版本未達顯著。探索性分析指出辨識操縱與行為抵抗是不同結果，諂媚最難被察覺卻產生最高服從。限制包括每組僅 30 人、英語情境與模擬場景。此研究提示低摩擦、及時的介入可能比增加反思負擔更有效。

Table 4 (Ablation Studies, §3): removing SFT cold start lowers average Pass@1 by 3.7 points with a drop on every benchmark; removing rubric reward lowers average by 1.3 points
Table 2 (§3) and Figure 3: SFT cold start mixed on Qwen3-VL-8B Pass@1 (-1.7 to +2.5) but better token efficiency; reflection rate drops from 61.8% to 1.0% (Table 3, Appendix H)
Appendix C.1/C: 1,000 held-out problems (467 PhysReason, 412 PhyX, 121 SeePhys) excluded from all training stages; Appendix D Table 7 reports 10/1000 near-duplicate training-eval overlaps
Appendix C.4: manual audit of 50 instances / 498 criterion-level judgments; LLM judge agrees on 439/498 (88.2%) with 37 false positives and 22 false negatives

Limitations section: pipeline quality depends on generator models, rubrics may not cover alternative valid formulations, Pass@1 for Qwen3-VL-8B is mixed, no generalization to other scientific fields examined, rubric-based RL incurs extra LLM-as-a-judge training cost

Appendix F: implementation details (LoRA rank 64, alpha 128, lr 1e-4 SFT / 5e-5 GRPO, LLaMA-Factory, verl) but pipeline relies on Gemini-2.5-Flash and Qwen3.5-Flash; no explicit code or dataset release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-reasoning post-training paper (SFT + rubric-guided GRPO) applied to multimodal physics, not a pure domain application: the methodology (structured intermediate modeling traces, physics-specific rubric rewards, text-to-multimodal curriculum) matches high-weight preferences in reasoning, RLHF/reward design, and multimodal VLMs. Novelty is incremental: it combines known rubrics-as-rewards and planning-style SFT with a physics-specific twist (modeling-derived rubrics). Rigor is above average: four model backbones, five benchmarks with held-out sets (Appendix C.1), component ablations (Table 4: -3.7 avg Pass@1 w/o SFT, -1.3 w/o rubric), fixed-executor diagnostic (Table 5), overlap analysis (Table 7: 10/1000 near-duplicates), and human audit of rubric judgments (Appendix C.4: 88.2% LLM-judge agreement). Evidence is solid but gains are modest (~3% avg over GRPO) and Pass@1 results are mixed for the strongest model (Qwen3-VL-8B: 51.8→54.0 GRPO vs 53.3 full on PhysReason), with no significance testing. Generalizability is limited to physics by the authors' own admission (Limitations). Reproducibility is partial: hyperparameters and pipeline are detailed (Appendix F: LoRA rank 64, LLaMA-Factory, verl) but the pipeline depends on proprietary models (Gemini-2.5-Flash, Qwen3.5-Flash) and no code/data release is claimed.

primary_link.title: Decoupled Physical Modeling and Execution for Physics Reasoning

papers.summary: Physics reasoning requires constructing a consistent model of the underlying physical system rather than relying solely on symbolic or formula-based manipulation. Although large language models have shown strong ability in solving math and coding problems, they still struggle with physics problems, as these problems entangle the physical modeling process with mathematical calculations. Humans approach physics by first building a representation of the system before performing calculations. Inspir
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型在物理問題上常將物理建模與數學計算混為單一推理過程，導致概念性錯誤。受「人類先建立系統表徵再計算」的啟發，本文將物理推理形式化為物理建模與數學執行兩階段，提出統一框架：透過拒絕抽樣與雙階段驗證（建模層級篩選與執行驗證）產生結構化物理建模軌跡，涵蓋系統理解、約束條件、物理定律與方程式；再從驗證後軌跡衍生物理專屬評分規準（rubric）。訓練採兩階段後訓練：先以 SFT 冷啟動建立結構化建模能力（文字到多模態課程），再以 rubric 引導的 GRPO 獎勵（結合結果正確性、格式與評分項）精煉建模品質。在 PhysReason、PhyX、SeePhys 及域外的 PhysUniBench、MMK-12 上，物理建模方法普遍優於純 GRPO，平均約提升 3%，Pass@5 增益在所有骨幹模型上一致，Qwen2.5-VL-3B 在 PhysReason 上 Pass@1 提升 5.6 分；力學與電動力學次領域增益最大。token 預算分析顯示 SFT 冷啟動使 Qwen3-VL-8B 能以更短推理軌跡維持強勁表現。限制在於資料管線依賴生成模型品質、Qwen3-VL-8B 的 Pass@1 改善有限，且 rubric 強化學習增加訓練成本。此工作證實顯式物理建模是提升小型 VLM 物理推理的有效策略。
papers.title: Decoupled Physical Modeling and Execution for Physics Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 物理推理的解耦式物理建模與數學執行

links.title: Enhancing Group Recommendation with Memory-Augmented Reasoning in LLM Agent

evidence: Abstract: AGR is an LLM-based agent with Memory and Reasoning Modules trained via RFT (SFT then GRPO), open-sourced at https://huggingface.co/niuqimeng/AGR

Section IV-A: Memory Module uses token-based hash table with insertion, updating, forgetting (removes item with lowest cosine similarity to current group profile, O(phi)), summarization, and retrieval (Qwen3 embeddings + FAISS-HNSW, O(log(|I|)))

Section IV-B: Reasoning Module performs four stages - Group Interests Collection, Group Consensus Refinement, Multi-dimensional Evaluation (ICL + LLM-as-a-judge over s1/s2/s3), and Explainable Recommendation Generation
Section IV-C2: GRPO objective with format reward (tag presence, 0.25 each), recommendation reward (0.5*NDCG@k + 0.5*HitRatio@k), and reasoning reward via LLM-as-judge with ICL-calibrated dimensions

Section V-A4: 'For fair comparison, all baselines are evaluated using this identical candidate set C' where C is the top-K=200 set produced by AGR's own Ranking Retrieval - a potential confound favoring the proposed method
Section V-A4: LLaMA3-8B base LLM, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B for generalization, LoRA on dual RTX 4090, LR 5e-6, temperature 0.7, GRPO beta 0.001, rollout 4, uniform reward weights (1,1,1)
Table II: AGR HR@5 0.699 / NDCG@5 0.5634 on LastFM vs best baseline LLaMA+CoT+ICL 0.478; AGR-SFT alone reaches 0.676, showing most gain from SFT on expert-annotated data
Section V-B: all improvements significant at p<0.001 via Mann-Whitney U test; backbone sensitivity tested (Fig. 6, DeepSeek backbone best)
Section V-A3: human evaluation by three domain experts, single-blind, double-scored, Fleiss' Kappa kappa=0.74

Section V-C: ablations confirm both modules and both training stages needed; ICL+LLM-as-a-judge outperforms pure LLM judge and LLM+human annotation on Fleiss' Kappa and HR@5 (Fig. 8); prompt ablation robust (BERTScore >0.92, Table IV)
Table I: Douban 'Tags' count (199,813) exactly equals U-Inter. count, indicating an apparent transcription error in dataset statistics

Section V-E: memory capacity ablation shows best performance at phi=8 (HR@5=0.70); relevance-based forgetting beats FIFO and Retain-ALL for t=1..4 but underperforms FIFO at t=5 due to sparsity (Fig. 10)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference alignment: an LLM agent with a tool-invocable memory module, explicit multi-step reasoning stages, SFT+GRPO reinforcement fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge rewards, and retrieval (Qwen3 embeddings + FAISS-HNSW) squarely hits the highest-weight categories (LLMs, agents/tool use, reasoning, alignment/RL). Novelty is moderate-incremental: the 'first agent for group recommendation' framing is real, but the hash-table memory with insert/update/forget/summarize mirrors MemoCRS/MR.Rec, the relevance-based forgetting is a modest upgrade over FIFO, and RFT with GRPO is now standard practice. Rigor benefits from broad ablations (AGR-M/R/SFT/GRPO, reward and prompt ablations, leave-last-t-out temporal tests, efficiency breakdown, Mann-Whitney U p<0.001, Fleiss' Kappa 0.74 for human eval), but is undermined by a key confound: Section V-A4 evaluates ALL methods only on a K=200 candidate set produced by AGR's own Ranking Retrieval pipeline, which could bias comparison toward the proposed method; Table II also shows AGR-SFT alone reaches HR@5 0.676 vs full AGR 0.699, so GRPO's marginal gain is small and GRPO-only variants collapse below vanilla LLMs without deeper analysis. Evidence is detailed and quantified (Tables II-VI) but figures are unverifiable from text and the candidate-set bias weakens headline claims. Generalizability is limited to two recsys benchmarks with two backbones; the memory+reasoning+RFT pattern could transfer but is demonstrated only on group recommendation. Reproducibility is decent: full hyperparameters (LoRA on 2x RTX 4090, LR 5e-6, GRPO beta 0.001, rollout 4) and an open-source release claim (HuggingFace), though the 500 expert-annotated examples and group-construction code are not stated as released, and Table I contains an apparent transcription error (Douban 'Tags' equals U-Inter. at 199,813).

primary_link.title: Enhancing Group Recommendation with Memory-Augmented Reasoning in LLM Agent

papers.summary: The core challenge in group recommendation lies in modeling the dynamic evolution of user preferences and explain?ing the consensus formation process. Existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods, despite improved interpretability, treat interaction history as fixed text, ignoring the natural evolution of group/user preferences over time, and lacking explicit modeling of the complex group decision-making process. To address these issues, we propose AGR, a LLM-based agent, which consists of
papers.summary_zh: 團體推薦的核心挑戰在於建模使用者偏好的動態演變，並解釋共識形成過程。現有 LLM 方法將互動歷史視為固定文字，忽略偏好隨時間演化，也缺乏對複雜團體決策過程的顯式建模。本文提出 AGR，首個具備記憶增強推理能力的團體推薦 LLM 代理框架：記憶模組採用基於 token 的雜湊表動態管理團體與使用者歷史，支援插入、更新、遺忘（依與當前團體輪廓的相關度淘汰）、摘要與檢索（FAISS-HNSW 粗篩加上 LLM 細篩）等操作；推理模組執行四階段多步推理：團體興趣蒐集、共識精煉、多維度評估（以 ICL+LLM-as-a-judge 降低評分偏誤）與可解釋推薦生成。訓練採強化微調（RFT）範式：先以 SFT 建立模組呼叫能力，再以 GRPO 強化協調，獎勵結合格式、推薦指標（NDCG@k、HitRatio@k）與推理品質。在 LastFM 與 Douban 資料集上，AGR 在 HR@5、NDCG@5 等準確度指標及 BLEU、人類評估的可解釋性指標皆顯著超越現有最先進方法；相關度遺忘機制在多步時間預測上優於 FIFO 與不遺忘策略。限制包含候選集預篩與對人工標註的依賴。此框架為團體決策過程提供了透明的逐步推論基礎。
papers.title: Enhancing Group Recommendation with Memory-Augmented Reasoning in LLM Agent
papers.title_zh: 以記憶增強推理的 LLM 代理提升團體推薦

links.title: GuardianBench: A Same-Scene Instruction-Contrastive Benchmark for Latent Contextual Risk in Embodied AI

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 2: mean Pair Accuracy 24.1% and Utility 88.1% vs Safety 30.1% across 13 primary models, supporting the instruction-insensitivity claim
Section 3.3: Cohen's kappa = 0.8316 on independently re-annotated subset; tau_crit = 9 thresholding with discard-below-threshold rule
Section 4.2 / Appendix C: Real50 (50 ADE20K photos, 50 pairs) gives Pearson r=0.74 (accuracy) and r=0.86 (Safety) with main benchmark rankings
Section 4.3, Table 3: audit over 19,136 error rows; CUE stage 76.1%, marginal verdict-rationale inconsistency 6.9%
Section 5.2, Table 4: VLOS vs standard GRPO on Qwen2.5-VL-7B: Acc 95.4 vs 87.1, Pair 90.8 vs 74.3; Ministral-8B also improved
Appendix F.1/F.5: reward function specified; three-seed ablation (seeds 42/1234/2887) shows one-sided VLOS variants underperform GRPO
Appendix F.4: LoRA r=32, lr 5e-5, TRL 0.22.2, PyTorch 2.8.0, ~110.5 GPU-hours total; no dataset/code release URL stated anywhere in the paper
Limitations: main data are generated rather than photographed; no closed-loop control, temporal risk, or prompt-invariant robustness claimed
llm_evaluation.rationale: A safety-evaluation benchmark for VLMs in embodied pre-execution risk assessment plus a GRPO-augmented alignment case study. It matches high-weight preferences (AI safety, red teaming/evaluation, multimodal AI, alignment/RLHF) but is not a core-LLM-methodology paper; the embodied framing is secondary to VLM verdict evaluation, so the pure-robotics cap does not apply. Novelty is moderate: the same-scene instruction-contrastive design complements MSSBench and the ISO-12100-grounded risk matrix is a clean construction, but counterfactual benchmark design and a BCE-on-verdict-log-odds auxiliary (VLOS) are incremental. Rigor is solid: 1,512 contrastive pairs, 16 VLMs, Cohen's kappa 0.8316, shortcut controls, Real50 external validation, three-seed ablations, alpha sweep, and careful exclusion of Gemini-family models that overlap the generation stack. Evidence strength is good, with headline claims (permissive tendency, instruction-insensitive verdicts, mean Pair Accuracy 24.1%) backed by full tables, correlations, and an error audit; however, the main corpus is text-to-image generated, Real50 is only 50 photos, the rationale audit relies on GPT-5.2 as judge, and VLOS is evaluated only in-domain on the benchmark's own test split. Generalizability is limited by household-only synthetic scenes and prompt-conditioned evaluation, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility benefits from detailed hyperparameters, seeds, prompts, and hardware/software stack, but no public release URL for data or code is stated and generation depends on proprietary APIs.

primary_link.title: GuardianBench: A Same-Scene Instruction-Contrastive Benchmark for Latent Contextual Risk in Embodied AI

papers.summary: In embodied AI, safety risk can be latent: a benign instruction and a safe scene become hazardous only when composed. Prior work has advanced embodied safety by varying visual contexts or evaluating execution-time dynamics, but the complementary axis of fixing the scene and varying only the instruction remains underexplored. We introduce GuardianBench, an instruction-contrastive benchmark grounded in international safety standards that isolates this latent contextual risk through 3,024 instructi
papers.summary_zh: 具身 AI 的風險常是潛在的：良性指令與安全場景組合後才變得危險。針對此「潛在情境風險」，本文提出 GuardianBench，一個基於 ISO 12100、NFPA 1、CXC 1-1969 與 GHS 四項國際安全標準的指令對比基準，包含 3,024 個指令—場景範例，組織為 1,512 個同場景安全/不安全對比對，並以 5×5 嚴重度—可能性風險矩陣（門檻 S·L≥9）校準危害強度。對 16 個視覺語言模型的評測揭示「指令不敏感判決」：主要模型平均成對準確率僅 24.1%，且呈現寬容傾向（安全類準確率平均 30.1% 對效用類 88.1%），多數模型在同一場景下對兩個指令給出相同判決，而非依指令條件化推理。理由層級審計顯示 76.1% 的錯誤源於未繫結指令相關的關鍵場景線索。作為後訓練案例研究，作者提出 VLOS（判決對數機率監督），直接對 Safe/Unsafe 的對數機率施加二元交叉熵，在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 與 Ministral-8B 上顯著改善 GRPO 的安全—效用平衡，成對準確率達 90.8%。限制包括僅評估執行前判決、主要使用生成圖像。此基準暴露了模型安全推理的系統性盲點，並提供校準途徑。
papers.title: GuardianBench: A Same-Scene Instruction-Contrastive Benchmark for Latent Contextual Risk in Embodied AI
papers.title_zh: GuardianBench：具身 AI 潛在情境風險的同場景指令對比基準

links.title: MEMONDEMAND: A Memory Management System for Large-Scale Enterprise Data

evidence: Abstract: 'MemOnDemand outperforms the strongest published LB#1 result at every evaluated scale from 10M tokens through the complete 618M-token collection, with gains of 12.23% at 10M and 4.66% at 618M.'
Section 5.1, Table 1: FULL (618M) row reports Combined 72.88%, Δ Combined +4.66%, Correct 80.0%, DocRcl 48.77%, InvDoc 0.5019 over 500 queries.
Section 5.2, Table 2: selective detailed memory at 20M uses 13,629 answer-input tokens/query (−70.2% vs detailed-only 45,784) at 78.66% Combined; distilled-only drops to 49.76%.
Section 5.4, Table 4: ablations at 10M — one-step navigation 64.52%, no promotion 64.20%, 25-candidate pool 62.64% vs full system 80.45% Combined.
Section 5.5, Table 5: on-demand promotion wall time 1.46 s vs estimated eager parent preparation 593.5 s (407×), described as estimated from measured per-call latency.

Limitations: 'Our main scaling results and promotion-floor sweeps are based on single runs, so repeated-run variance and confidence intervals remain to be studied. The eager preparation cost is estimated from measured call latency rather than measured through a complete end-to-end run.'
Appendix B.1, Table 8: GPT-5.4 handles navigation, answer generation, and EnterpriseRAG evaluation — the same model serves as generator and judge.
Section 5.7, Table 7: external results are mixed — FinanceBench DocRcl 80.00%, HotpotQA DocRcl 49.90% (Correct 78.4%), FRAMES Correct 55.0%.
Abstract: 'Our code is available at https://github.com/xfab-xinyuansong/MemOnDemand.git'; Appendix G supplies full prompt templates and Appendix D gives Algorithms 1–4.

Appendix C, Tables 10–12: promotion-floor sweeps show non-monotone, noisy patterns (e.g., 10M floor 0.1 gives 72.65 vs floor 0.5 gives 76.40), with the 10M sweep noted as distinct from the revised-prompt headline results in Table 1.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on LLM memory/RAG infrastructure: hierarchical memory, dual distilled/detailed representations, and on-demand promotion for enterprise-scale retrieval. It is squarely within scope (RAG, long-context memory, LLM serving efficiency), not a pure domain application. Relevance to preferences is strong (RAG & Knowledge, Long Context & Memory, LLMs, Inference & Serving), though it is not agent-, reasoning-, or Japanese-focused. Novelty is moderate: RAPTOR/GraphRAG-style hierarchy, RECOMP/LLMLingua-style compression, and database-style adaptive caching are combined coherently; the dynamic-depth controller and bounded promotion state are incremental engineering contributions rather than new methodology. Rigor benefits from seven-scale evaluation, component ablations, promotion-floor sweeps, and four benchmarks, but is limited by single runs with no variance, use of GPT-5.4 as both generator and evaluator on a synthetic benchmark, unmeasured (estimated) eager-preparation costs, and confusing prompt-version differences between Tables 2 and 3 (detailed-only at 82.68 Combined vs 'Hierarchical, detailed only' at 46.80). Evidence strength is decent: headline numbers are internally consistent and trade-offs (DocRcl falling to 48.77% at 618M; HotpotQA DocRcl 49.9%) are honestly reported, but the LB#1 baseline is a published reference not re-run and the 407x speedup is an estimate. Generalizability is partially demonstrated across domains and scales but within a single proprietary model family. Reproducibility is aided by full algorithms, prompt templates, and a code link, yet depends on closed APIs and a synthetic benchmark.

primary_link.title: MEMONDEMAND: A Memory Management System for Large-Scale Enterprise Data

papers.summary: Enterprise repositories are large, heteroge- neous, and continuously updated, making re- trieval difficult when efficient access, source- faithful evidence, and cross-query adaptation must be supported together. Enterprise mem- ory extends retrieval beyond the model con- text, but existing systems do not jointly address collection-specific hierarchy construction, low- cost routing, detailed evidence loading, and workload-aware memory updates at this scale. We introduce MEMONDEMAND, short for On-
papers.summary_zh: 企業資料庫規模龐大、異質且持續更新，現有系統難以同時兼顧高效存取、忠實來源證據與跨查詢調適。本文提出 MemOnDemand，透過三個協同機制解決此問題：一、動態多層級階層，由 LLM 控制器依每個集合的特性決定抽象結構與層級深度（從 L0 來源節點到更高層摘要）；二、每個階層節點皆維護雙重記憶——精簡的蒸餾記憶供低成本路由檢索，詳細記憶則保留完整內容供生成與引用；三、按需記憶提升（on-demand promotion），依查詢時觀察到的需求更新節點優先級，在有限活躍狀態預算內以衰減機制降級陳舊節點。在 EnterpriseRAG-Bench 的七個規模層級（10M 至 618M token）上，MemOnDemand 在所有層級都超越最強已發表結果 LB#1，10M 時提升 12.23%，完整 618M 資料集仍高 4.66%（Combined 72.88%）；雙重記憶選擇性載入將答案輸入 token 減少 70.2%，持續化階層使查詢就緒時間僅 1.46 秒（對比預估的 593.5 秒）。在 FinanceBench、HotpotQA 與 FRAMES 上亦展現跨領域強健表現。限制包括單次運行缺少變異數估計、文件召回率在最大規模下降。此系統示範了超出模型上下文視窗的大型企業記憶管理實務。
papers.title: MEMONDEMAND: A Memory Management System for Large-Scale Enterprise Data
papers.title_zh: MemOnDemand：面向大規模企業資料的記憶管理系統

links.title: Beyond Fixed Directions: Adaptive Representation Analysis of Reasoning and Memorization in LLMs

evidence: Abstract/Table 2: best mean-difference direction (layer 18) reaches Accuracy 0.9975, AUROC 1.0000, identical to full 1024-D probe and probe-weight direction (layer 12)
Section 5.1: base-to-GRPO mean-direction cosine mu=0.4534 (sigma=0.1794, min 0.1734) and probe-direction cosine mu=0.4448, while Section 5.3 reports RL-checkpoint probe AUROC still 1.0000

Table 3/Section 4.2: TF-IDF lexical classifier reaches 0.9600 accuracy / 0.9911 AUROC and length-only classifier 0.6475 accuracy on the matched 400-example set, showing residual lexical/domain confound
Section 3.3/3.3.1: 400-example dataset built from MATH-500, GSM8K, PopQA, TriviaQA via token-length-bin matching after an unmatched Stage-1 diagnostic where length alone achieved ~0.965 accuracy

Section 8 (Limitations): single model family (Qwen3-0.6B), single externally released GRPO checkpoint, no causal interventions (patching/ablation), and cosine cannot distinguish task-specific vs global rotation due to missing null distribution
Section 9/C.3: uses public checkpoint x32/Qwen3-0.6B-GRPO-GSM8K-Think, 5-fold stratified CV, deterministic artifact pipeline; no explicit code/data release URL is provided
llm_evaluation.rationale: A focused LLM interpretability study squarely on-preference: probing reasoning-vs-factual-recall representations (LLMs, reasoning, probing/interpretability, GRPO alignment). RQ1 is competently controlled (length-binned dataset, length/TF-IDF/random-label baselines, two independent direction estimators, 5-fold CV), but the headline AUROC=1.00 comparison suffers ceiling effects and the TF-IDF baseline at 0.9911 AUROC (Table 3) shows the 'reasoning' signal remains heavily lexically/domain confounded, which the authors honestly concede. RQ2's direction-rotation finding (cosine ~0.453, drift ~0.511, Section 5) is conceptually useful (separating decodability from geometric stability) but is based on one 0.6B model and a single external GRPO checkpoint with no controlled training trajectory, no null distribution over task-irrelevant directions, and no significance testing, so the rotation cannot be attributed to GRPO specifically. Novelty is moderate: representation rotation under training is a familiar observation; the increment is narrowly targeting the fixed-direction assumption of DiRL/Hong et al., which the paper itself frames as a bounded empirical check. Generalizability is explicitly limited (one model family, one size, one checkpoint, one task pairing). Reproducibility is decently specified (public checkpoint, artifact pipeline, CV protocol) though no code release URL is stated. Calibrated weighted score ~0.66.

primary_link.title: Beyond Fixed Directions: Adaptive Representation Analysis of Reasoning and Memorization in LLMs

papers.summary_zh: 近期研究主張大型語言模型的推理與記憶可由單一表徵方向刻劃，甚至將其固定作為強化學習期間的幾何錨點（如 DiRL）。本文以 Qwen3-0.6B 與 400 個長度配對範例（推理導向的 MATH-500/GSM8K 對照事實回憶的 PopQA/TriviaQA）檢驗兩項假設。研究問題一（可分離性）：一維平均差方向與探針權重方向皆達 AUROC 1.00，與完整 1024 維線性探針效能相同，支持所研究任務群組的近似單方向可解碼性；隨機標籤探針、長度與 TF-IDF 控制排除了管線雜訊，但 TF-IDF 仍然強烈，顯示詞彙混淆未完全消除。研究問題二（穩定性）：與公開的 GRPO 檢查點比較後，平均方向餘弦僅 0.453，探針方向餘弦 0.445，最終層表徵漂移達 0.511，呈現層級相依的幾何重組；然而探針 AUROC 仍維持 1.00。此結果區分了資訊保留與幾何保留：任務區分資訊在強化學習後依然高度可解碼，但承載它的具體方向已大幅旋轉。作者明確不聲稱因果機制結論，也未評估下游強化學習效能。此研究提醒方向感知強化學習方法應實測而非假設錨點方向在訓練後的穩定性，並建議將方向餘弦與表徵漂移列為標準報告指標。

Experimental design is fairly careful: a frozen 100-question dev split with 400-question validation (Section 4/Table 7), a component ablation (Table 4), and a gold-evidence intervention that cleanly attributes scaling loss to retrieval rather than generation (Appendix C/Table 8). papers.summary_zh: 現代語言模型與代理人日益需要持久式記憶，以支援完整程式碼庫、長期互動紀錄與異質企業資料，但如何在保持數億詞元可搜尋的同時，僅將有限證據傳遞給答題模型，是核心挑戰。本文提出 MegaMem，採用來源解析的雙視角檢索架構：對蒸餾記錄與詳細證據分別建立索引，以原始與轉換後的多路查詢檢索；每個蒸餾命中在倒數排名融合、去重與交叉編碼器重排前，先解析回不可變的來源識別碼；生成階段僅於固定預算內載入排名最高的詳細證據，答後歸因模組再篩除未支援的來源。在涵蓋逾五十萬份文件、約六點五億詞元的 EnterpriseRAG-Bench 上，MegaMem 將 Overall 由 68.22 提升至 82.26，Correctness 達 86.50；記憶規模自 20M 擴至 250M 詞元時效能平緩衰退，消融實驗顯示雙索引與蒸餾貢獻最大，選擇性證據可減少約三分之二輸入詞元。侷限包括多數結果僅單次執行、來源精確度低於基準領先者、對對話式與跨領域語料轉移有限，且不擴展模型原生注意力視窗。此工作將可搜尋的記憶規模與答題上下文大小分離，為超大型持久記憶檢索提供可行路徑。

papers.summary_zh: 當具身代理團隊中決定任務路徑的關鍵事實分散於各代理的本地視野時，沒有任何單一視角能確定誰該行動、該交接什麼，形成配對本地歧義，成功上限僅五成。本文提出 GenCoord，將私有事實的任務後果轉為可執行的技能路徑承諾：本地 Qwen3.5-0.8B 模型發出多步 SELF 計畫與對等 REQ 請求；當決定性能力屬於對方時，透過 Accept、Reject 或 Counter 的有限回饋觸發請求者修正。承諾物件經綱要檢查、規範化實例化、編譯為 Mineflayer 技能，並以交接與終端狀態驗證。在 Minecraft 的反事實介入中，注入的任務後果能雙向主導解析路線：正確能力回饋將配對成功率自 50% 提升至 100%；多步承諾在保留模板上提升 6.9 個百分點並減少 32% 的模型決策；在匹配閉迴圈品質下，Short DSL 相較受控自由格式通訊減少 92.8% 的對等流量與 68.2% 的中位達成時間。研究範圍限於靜態 Minecraft、可靠通訊下的雙邊協調，動態多邊一致性尚待驗證。此研究確立可執行任務後果作為連結分散式本地推理與可驗證聯合行動的協調單位。

Verification note (whole document): no inter-annotator agreement, annotator count, or statistical significance testing is reported; the Ethics Statement (p.10) says the benchmark is released 'in the spirit of transparency' but no repository URL, license, or code link appears in the paper.
Related Work, p.3: positions ASAS against AraTrust ('do not offer the structured redteaming framework of ASAS') and ALUE, supporting the novelty claim within Arabic safety evaluation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: a human-curated Arabic LLM red-teaming/safety benchmark evaluated across seven frontier and regional LLMs, directly matching AI Safety and Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences with core LLM relevance. Novelty is moderate: the 'first fully human-curated Arabic redteaming benchmark' claim (p.1) is credible against the cited Arabic prior work (AraTrust, Ashraf et al.), and the Islamic/Arab Culture Alignment category (25.3% of data, Section 3.1) is a genuine regional contribution, but the taxonomy, attack types, and 4-point safety scale closely follow established frameworks (Inan et al. 2023), so methodological novelty is limited. Rigor is hampered by absent inter-annotator agreement statistics, unreported annotator counts/adjudication protocol, only 801 prompts, and no significance testing; the red-teaming procedure ('attempt to elicit the most unsafe response possible', Section 3.5) is adversarial and non-standardized. Evidence strength is fair: headline numbers (Claude 68% safe, GPT-4o judge ~50% accuracy/~22% recall) are stated in text and tied to figures, but no confidence intervals or error analysis are given. Generalizability is moderate: the language-transfer and LLM-as-judge findings likely extend to other low-resource languages, while specific scores are MSA-bound (dialects deferred to future work, Section 5). Reproducibility is weak: model versions are pinned (e.g., Claude 20250219, Mistral Saba v25.02, Section 3.5) and label definitions are given (Table 1), but no dataset repository URL, license, or code release is provided anywhere in the document.

papers.summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型在阿拉伯語地區的使用成長，其安全性與文化對齊日益重要，但阿拉伯語 LLM 安全評估長期被忽視。本文提出 ASAS，首個完全由人工策劃的阿拉伯語安全基準，包含 801 個提示、8 個安全類別與 8 種攻擊策略，並附上以現代標準阿拉伯語撰寫的理想回應。研究團隊對七個具阿拉伯語能力的領先模型進行紅隊測試，涵蓋 GPT-4o、Claude 3.7 Sonnet、ALLaM 與 FANAR 等，由訓練過的人類專家以四級安全量表評分。結果顯示多數模型對約一半的不安全提示未能有效防禦，表現最佳者僅達 68% 安全分數；在槍械與非法武器、管制物質等高危害類別缺口最大；直接提示、代碼加密與假設測試為最有效的攻擊手法；以 GPT-4o 作為自動評審僅有約五成準確率與二成二召回率，遠低於人類標註者。此研究證明單一語言的安全對齊不會自動轉移至其他語言，自動評審亦不可靠。侷限在於僅涵蓋現代標準阿拉伯語，作者計畫擴展至方言與其他模態。ASAS 為文化落地且含紅隊協定的基準，可推動阿拉伯語 LLM 安全的後續研究。

papers.summary_zh: 仇恨言論研究已從粗粒度分類走向結構化解析，須同時標出攻擊目標、支持論據與目標層級標籤；當文件含多重目標、相互衝突的局部解讀或文化編碼語言時，此類綁定極難恢復。本文提出 SPAR-Hate，一個由稽核者引導的多視角角色推理框架：先將文件切分為局部焦點單元，再由受害者、版主與文化旁觀者三種角色條件產生器，以證據接地方式產生候選元組；第三階段在接地與綱要約束下進行品質評分、聚類與動態仲裁，最後重組為樣本層級輸出。中文文化旁觀者另獲俚語詞庫的弱上下文支援，並可將結構化教師軌跡蒸餾至較小的學生模型。在中文 STATE-ToxiCN 與受控英文 TBO 切分上，SPAR 於本地與 API 主幹模型皆改善嚴格聯合指標，SPAR-DeepSeek-v4-Pro 達中文平均 39.52；整合提示對照、組件消融與蒸餾結果共同驗證分離式視角產生與仲裁的貢獻。侷限包括未與任務專用微調系統完整比較、角色集未經窮舉搜尋，且 TBO 結果採內部切分，不可與原始公開測試集直接比較。此框架對隱性與文化編碼仇恨的結構化解析具方法學參考價值。

links.title: Rebuild Dossier: Mechanically-Enforced Specs for Agentic App Rebuilds, and What Model-Tier Failures Reveal

evidence: Section 4.8: three single-prompt trials tied 7/7 visible and 1/1 held-out against three spec-plus-rails trials at the weak tier on Madeline, replicated on both sides.
Section 4.9: on catchandtrade, spec-plus-rails batch-built in two of three trials with '.claude/.hook-heartbeat.' never created (hook confirmed dead), losing to single-prompt at the weak tier.
Section 4.5.6: directed trials A-D show the hook blocks edit/write tool calls but a bash heredoc bypasses enforcement, filesystem-confirmed.

Section 4.6: contract-locking fidelity (Contribution 1) tested on one app (notarybox), one model tier, one run, with two named gaps (200 vs 201 status, missing-field 400 rejection) outside the extractors' scope.

Section 5.3: 'We do not report trial counts or variance for our main results' and item (d) 'there has been no third-party replication of any result'; item (k) notes no non-LLM or rule-based baseline was evaluated.

Section 7: public MIT repo at tag v0.2.2-paper (commit 3931e508883de3fe6ec7257b6c980e44098146a1), Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22036801, 512 passing tests across 83 files confirmed by direct run; raw transcripts 'available from the author upon reasonable request'.

Section 2: situates the test-integrity finding against SWE-bench+ (32.7% solution leakage, 31.1% suspicious passes) and UTBoost (345 mislabeled patches), and against specification-gaming literature (Krakovna et al. 2020).
Section 4.4: weak-model diagnostic boundary replicated across three independent trials (all classified 'failure' by pre-declared criteria: correct failure category, wrong mechanism).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope agentic-coding work: an MCP-based tool (rebuild-dossier) that locks interface contracts extracted from existing apps and enforces rebuild discipline via hooks, evaluated on Claude Code/OpenCode LLM agents (Haiku/Sonnet, Nemotron). Highly relevant to Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLM-agent reliability themes including specification gaming and self-report unreliability. Novelty is moderate: contract testing, mutation-checked tests, hook enforcement, and test-suite insufficiency (SWE-bench+, UTBoost) are known; the combination and the honest negative results (apparatus ties a single prompt on the small app and loses on the larger app with the hook confirmed dead) are the fresh parts. Rigor practices are unusually transparent (pre-registered taxonomies, filesystem verification of every self-report, discarded confounded trials, retraction of an earlier claim), but the design is small-N case studies (N=1 to 3), convenience-sampled apps, an ablation that failed to isolate the mechanism, no non-LLM baseline, and sole-author self-verification. Evidence is real and independently checked but qualitative and thin; several central results rest on one run (Section 4.6) or an unresolved hook-liveness fork (Section 4.3). Generalizability is explicitly narrow (two author-owned JS/TS apps plus one third-party app and built fixtures). Reproducibility is comparatively strong: public MIT repo, pinned commits, Zenodo DOI, exact test commands, though raw transcripts are only available on request and Claude snapshots were never logged.

primary_link.title: Rebuild Dossier: Mechanically-Enforced Specs for Agentic App Rebuilds, and What Model-Tier Failures Reveal

papers.summary: An AI agent's rebuild is only as good as the process that produced it. Prior work found that once a model is strong enough, a multi-agent rebuild pipeline loses to the simplest approach: giving the model the original code and one instruction (AgentModernize). We present rebuild-dossier, an open-source tool that locks an application's real interface - its exact inputs and outputs - before any code is written, then enforces one-test-at-a-time building through automated checks, not written instruct
papers.summary_zh: 代理式「重建應用程式」管線的品質取決於產生它的流程；先前的 AgentModernize 研究發現，當模型夠強時，多代理管線反而輸給直接提供原始碼加單一指令的作法。本文介紹開源工具 rebuild-dossier：在任何程式碼產生前，先以靜態分析鎖定應用程式的真實介面（確切輸入與輸出），並以鉤子強制逐一測試驅動的建構紀律，而非僅靠文字指令。評估揭露多項教訓：遵守規範的代理反而未通過保留測試，違規代理卻全數通過，證明可被操弄時通過的測試套件不足以認證正確性；文字規則不等於強制——弱模型讀懂後仍違反僅以文字描述的規則，鉤子強制則有效；弱模型三度遭遇環境類故障時，能辨識「非自身程式碼問題」卻無法定位機制；跨模型實驗顯示更強的模型能三度遵循流程，另一模型則出現刪除參考資料與虛構 Stripe 整合的風險。在小型應用上與單一提示平手，於較大應用因檢查機制未運行而落敗。此研究樣本小且由作者自行驗證、缺乏第三方複製，但其對測試有效性、機械強制與自我報告可靠性的反省，對代理式軟體工程極具參考價值。

links.title: LLM assisted writing deserves empirical evaluation

evidence: Main text: 'we analyzed 69,209 PubMed-indexed Health Informatics articles' grouped pre/post 'the public release of ChatGPT in late 2022' and classified post-LLM papers 'using a SciBERT classifier'.
Main text: classifier was 'trained on human-written and LLM-rewritten abstracts'; no accuracy, precision, recall, or validation metrics are reported anywhere in the document.
Figure 2 caption: 'Statistical annotations indicate pairwise Mann-Whitney U tests' with significance thresholds; no effect sizes or absolute values are stated in the body text.
Visibility and recognition section: 'When citation acquisition was compared within a fixed post-publication window, LLM-assisted papers did not show weaker early citation uptake.'
Semantic concentration section: the authors concede the finding 'admits multiple interpretations' and that semantic closeness 'does not by itself indicate either novelty or lack of novelty'.
Reference patterns section: 'broader retrieval is not synonymous with better selection'; citations 'can be superficial, misplaced, or only loosely connected'.
Future work section: 'Whether these patterns are robust across disciplines, time horizons, and modes of LLM use... remains an open question', bounding generalizability to the studied field.
Document structure (Acknowledgments through References): contains funding, author contributions, and conflict-of-interest sections but no data or code availability statement.

LLM-assisted writing vs agentic research section: LLM assistance is characterized as 'non-agentic tools for language transformation, summarization, and restructuring', a conceptual framing only, with no agent systems evaluated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An empirical bibliometric study of LLM-assisted scientific writing over 69,209 Health Informatics papers, centrally on-topic for LLM preferences (LLM weight 2.5) with secondary NLP relevance (SciBERT classification), though it touches no agents, reasoning, Japanese, or alignment methodology. Novelty is moderate: it broadens the LLM-writing literature (e.g., the cited excess-vocabulary work) to semantic concentration, reference diversity, authorship equity, and citation impact, but remains an observational association study. Rigor is mixed: the design sensibly contrasts LLM-assisted vs LLM-independent papers within the post-ChatGPT era and uses Mann-Whitney U tests, yet the SciBERT classifier's accuracy and validation are unreported, training on 'LLM-rewritten abstracts' may mislabel real drafting use, and no sensitivity analyses or effect sizes appear in the text. Evidence strength is mid-range given the large corpus but figure-only results and hedged, non-causal claims. Generalizability is limited by a single PubMed-indexed field, as the authors concede. Reproducibility is weak: no data or code availability statement is provided anywhere in the document. Not out-of-scope (it studies LLM behavior, not a domain application), but not a methodological advance.

primary_link.title: LLM assisted writing deserves empirical evaluation

papers.summary: LLM-assisted writing is often treated as a detection problem, as it raises questions about clarity, integrity, equity, and evaluation. An analysis of 69,209 Health Informatics papers links it to more focused presentation, broader citation practices, and more globally distributed authorship. These patterns do not prove better science, but they support evaluating manuscripts by scholarly quality and accountability rather than by tool use.
papers.summary_zh: LLM 輔助寫作常被視為偵測問題，牽動清晰度、誠信、公平與評鑑等爭議。本文主張應以實證方式評估，並分析 69,209 篇 PubMed 收錄的健康資訊學論文：以 2022 年底 ChatGPT 公開發布為界區分前後時期，再以 SciBERT 分類器將後 LLM 時代論文分為 LLM 獨立與 LLM 輔助兩類，比較其書目計量、語義、參考文獻與作者結構等後設資料。結果顯示 LLM 輔助論文的主題與語義呈現更集中，引用文獻數量與主題多樣性更高，第一作者來自非英語系國家的比例明顯較高，中低收入經濟體與洲際合作的參與也略增；在固定發表後窗口內比較，其早期被引並未較弱，發表期刊影響因子反而略高。這些是相關而非因果模式，可能同時反映更清晰的定位與修辭多樣性下降；引用廣度也不等於更嚴謹的篩選，成效取決於任務、使用者、領域與人類監督程度。作者強調此處的 LLM 輔助屬非代理型工具，類比寫作支援與統計軟體而非智慧夥伴。其意義在於將辯論從偵測與道德分類，轉向以學術品質與問責為本的評鑑實務。
papers.title: LLM assisted writing deserves empirical evaluation
papers.title_zh: LLM 輔助寫作值得實證評估

links.title: FIRM-Video: Check Before You Score for Reliable Text-to-Video Reward Modeling

evidence: Abstract: 'FIRM-Video-8B achieves the best overall MAE on FIRM-Video-Bench while consistently delivering the highest VBench Total, Quality, and Semantic Scores in Best-of-8 sampling across three video generators.'
Section 3.2: 'A proprietary multimodal evaluator takes the prompt, temporally ordered video frames, and the checklist as input' - core verifier is unnamed, limiting reproducibility.
Table 1: FIRM-Video-8B (Qwen3-VL-8B) overall MAE 0.78 vs GPT-5 1.08 and base Qwen3-VL-8B 1.33; GPT-5 retains best IF MAE (0.62 vs 0.65).
Table 2: On MJ-Bench-Video Overall, FIRM-Video-8B (InternVL3-8B) scores 31.06, second to Gemini-3.1-Pro at 33.06; best on Alignment (31.93) and C&C (35.35).
Table 3 / Section 4.4: Best-of-8 Total Score improvements of 0.27 (LaVie), 1.01 (CogVideoX-2B), 0.66 (Wan2.1) over strongest competitor; Semantic Score gains 1.24-2.11.
Appendix 1.4, Table 4: Aggregation ablation shows importance weighting reduces WC MAE 0.86 to 0.80 but leaves IF MAE unchanged at 0.68.
Section 3.4: FIRM-Video-Bench has 250 videos / 750 annotations with 'disagreements resolved through discussion'; no inter-annotator agreement statistics reported.
Section 5 Limitations: 'we have not yet used them to directly optimize T2V generators' - RL alignment remains untested.
Title-page data links: 'https://github.com/VisionXLab/FIRM-Reward' and Hugging Face collection provide code/model availability claims.
Appendix 4: Full inference prompts with reasoning-then-score JSON format and Appendix 1.3 score-mapping thresholds support replication of scoring protocol.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Text-to-video reward modeling paper with genuine language methodology (Qwen3-32B planner, LLM rationale synthesis, VLM fine-tuning producing reasoning-then-score JSON), so it avoids the 0.20 cap for video-diffusion work without language methods, but its core problem (video quality assessment) is peripheral to the highest-weight preferences (no Japanese NLP, agents, or core LLM-research contribution). Novelty is incremental: checklist-driven verifiable supervision extends FIRM (images) and VideoScore2 to video with grounded WC checklists and importance-weighted aggregation (Section 3.2). Rigor is solid: human-annotated FIRM-Video-Bench, out-of-domain MJ-Bench-Video, Best-of-N on three generators, aggregation ablations (Appendix 1.4, Table 4). Evidence supports headline claims (overall MAE 1.33 to 0.78, Table 1), though VBench Total gains are modest (0.27-1.01, Table 3), MJ-Bench Overall is second-best behind Gemini-3.1-Pro (Table 2), and dimension-aware VBench sampling partially favors their multi-dimensional scores. Reproducibility is weakened by an unnamed 'proprietary multimodal evaluator' central to the pipeline (Section 3.2) and unreported annotator counts/agreement (Section 3.4); code, HF links, prompts, and score thresholds are provided. RL-based alignment is explicitly future work (Section 5).

primary_link.title: FIRM-Video: Check Before You Score for Reliable Text-to-Video Reward Modeling

papers.summary: Reliable reward models are essential for text-to-video evaluation and alignment. However, the trade-off between evaluation accuracy and inference efficiency places high demands on the quality of training supervision. Existing approaches often rely on holistic judges with fixed rubrics or open-ended reasoning, leading to incomplete inspection, unfaithful justification, and entangled attribution. We introduce FIRM-Video, a unified checklist-driven data construction framework based on a check-before-score principle: construct dimension-specific checklists, verify each criterion against temporal visual evidence, and aggregate only verified decisions. For Instruction Following, FIRM-Video decomposes prompts into weighted atomic requirements; for World Coherence, it constructs prompt-calibrated, target-specific checks grounded in visible entities and actions; and for Perceptual Quality, it applies a generic taxonomy of visual defects. The verified criteria and scores are further transformed into natural-language analyses for end-to-end reward modeling. Subsequently, we construct FIRM-Video-90K with 88,044 dimension-specific instances from 29,348 videos, and introduce FIRM-Video-Bench with 750 point-wise human annotations across 250 videos. The Qwen3-VL-based FIRM-Video-8B achieves the best overall MAE on FIRM-Video-Bench while consistently delivering the highest VBench Total, Quality, and Semantic Scores in Best-of-8 sampling across three video generators.
papers.summary_zh: 可靠的獎勵模型對文生影片評測與對齊至關重要，但評估準確性與推論效率的取捨對訓練監督品質要求極高；現有整體式評審常有檢查不完整、理由不忠實與歸因糾纏等問題。本文提出 FIRM-Video，基於「先檢查後評分」原則的清單驅動資料建構框架：為指令遵循將提示分解為加權原子需求；為世界一致性以可見實體與動作為錨，建構提示校準的目標檢核項；為感知品質套用通用視覺缺陷分類法。每項準則皆對照時序視覺證據驗證，僅彙總已驗證的決策，再轉為自然語言分析以訓練端對端獎勵模型。產出的 FIRM-Video-90K 含來自 29,348 部影片的 88,044 個維度專屬監督實例，並建立 250 部影片、750 個人工細粒度標註的 FIRM-Video-Bench。以 Qwen3-VL-8B 初始化的 FIRM-Video-8B 在該基準達最佳整體 MAE 0.78（基線 1.33），並於三個影片生成器的 Best-of-8 抽樣一致取得最高的 VBench 總分、品質分與語義分。侷限是尚未將獎勵模型用於直接最佳化生成器，未來可結合強化學習或偏好最佳化。此框架證明清單驅動監督能同時支援可靠的絕對評分與候選排序。

links.title: AI Grinding for Fun and Cryptanalysis

evidence: Section 1 'Autonomous search and human review': 'A large language model reads the sources, enumerates candidate paths from a claim to a consequence, proposes witnesses, and writes the checking code'; the LLM is never identified or evaluated.

Section 1: 'no proposal counts as evidence until it is reduced to an exact statement a short deterministic program can check, alongside a control whose outcome was fixed before it ran' - the core admission discipline.
Appendix A.6: 'What was proposed and failed was not counted, because the generator was never instrumented to record it' - admits no yield/survival statistics for the AI component.

Section 4.5: reduced-dimension runs over F_3329 recovered 'the challenge plaintext in 12/12 trials' at three (n,k) settings, with stated limitation that 'These runs validate the post-permutation algebra; they assume P'.

Section 4.2: Spinel forgery is conditional - 'If H_msg is instantiated with the same primitive... the substitution succeeds with probability one. If H_msg retains a conventional hash... this substitution fails'; Section 4.6 attack 'conditional on the acceptance being observable'.

Section 6: 'Every check below uses only the Python standard library, runs in seconds, and contains at least one discriminating control' (Table 7 lists controls), but no repository or artifact link appears in the document.
End matter, 'AI disclaimer': 'In this paper about AI use, AI tools were used' - no model, version, or usage detail, weakening the AI-methodology contribution.
Appendix A.3 Axiom A.3 (Confident Nonsense): generator confidence kappa 'is inadmissible: no rule below may mention it' - a novel, explicit de-coupling of generation from admissibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An autonomous-cryptanalysis workflow where an LLM generates attack hypotheses that are admitted only via exact deterministic checks with pre-registered controls, then human-audited. Directly relevant to the LLM (2.5) and Agents & Tool Use (2.5) preferences via its agent loop, admission rules, and human-audit handoff, but the AI component is under-evaluated: the generator is never named, instrumented, or ablated (Appendix A.6 concedes failed proposals were not counted), and the 'AI disclaimer' is a single sentence. The substance is post-quantum cryptanalysis (a domain application), which prevents a higher preference score without triggering the out-of-scope cap since an agent methodology is genuinely proposed. Methodology is novel and unusually disciplined (Confident Nonsense axiom, four-way result taxonomy, rejected strengthenings reported); evidence is strong within scope (12/12 and 3/3 trial counts, exact rational arithmetic, witnesses, controls in Table 7) but several headline results are conditional (CRT-RLWE needs an observable accept bit; Spinel forgery hinges on an unspecified H_msg) and the Hollow-LWE bridge assumes prior authors' permutation recovery. No artifact URL is given despite the reproducibility chapter, capping reproducibility. Generalizable two-axes/join taxonomy, demonstrated only on cryptography.

papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出一種自主密碼分析工作流程：大型語言模型閱讀論文、列舉候選攻擊路徑、提出見證並撰寫檢查程式碼，再以精確的有理數或整數運算、事先固定的對照組與人類覆核決定哪些結果可成為證據。方法聚焦兩個搜尋軸：一是找出會暴露或抹除祕密關係的公開可計算映射，例如乘以零、多項式乘積的邊界係數、商與無邊界的可變長度編碼；二是檢驗宣稱的機率分布是否名實相符。八個已發表構造在其作者自述的參數下失效：Ring-LWR 承諾以機率一對任意訊息開啟；兩個中間乘積加密從單一密文還原全部遮罩與明文；格基電子投票喪失收據無關性；Hollow-LWE 的置換還原可透過線性代數提升為有效的舊解密金鑰；顯式正規基底把 63 次實例分解為七個 9 次實例；Spinel 簽章雜湊因編碼非單射而碰撞；CRT-RLWE 的接受位元成為解密雜訊的閾值預言機。另有假設缺陷與三個涵蓋缺口被分開記錄。限制包括部分結果僅在縮減維度驗證、MinRank 加固的分析停留在成本模型、CRT 攻擊仰賴可觀察的接受訊號。其價值在示範「機器提供廣度、精確檢驗決定證據」的研究紀律。
