links.title: TANGO: Token-Aggregated Nonlinear Gating Operators for Natural and Formal Language Modeling

evidence: Section 2.1-2.2: each source token produces a SwiGLU gate aggregated across causally visible positions with a null-gate denominator term n_i*exp(b_a); WANGO uses positive feature map phi(u)=max(ELU(u)+1+eps,eps)/sqrt(d_h) with running sums S_ia and z_ia, window W=64, linear in T for fixed W and dimensions

Section 3 'Parameter matching': all architectures target 44,268,416 nonembedding parameters (within 0.1%); three (init, data-order) seed pairs (17,101), (23,103), (41,107) with identical example order per seed; datasets FineWeb-Edu (temporal split), Mathlib commit cf8e23a62939, all 56 DeepMind Mathematics modules

Table 2: TANGO lowest mean validation NLL on FineWeb-Edu 3.293±0.005, Lean joint 1.719±0.026, DeepMind Mathematics 0.473±0.008, vs Untied Transformer++ 3.318/2.138/0.556; Table 4 replicates the ranking at eight block applications

Table 5 / Section 6.1: on 8,192-token sequences TANGO requires 9.44T MACs vs WANGO 1.90T and Recurrent Transformer++ 1.94T; WANGO beats Recurrent Transformer++ and FLASH (3.465±0.020) among linear-complexity models, but 'Tango performs substantially more arithmetic than Wango' and results are 'not a compute-matched improvement'

Section 6.3 Limitations: 'The four-block experiments cover one parameter scale'; experiments 'are not sufficient to establish scaling laws'; no tokenizer-independent bits per byte, compiler-verified Lean proof completion, exact match, wall-clock speed, or GPU memory reported; no code or checkpoint availability is claimed anywhere in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core language-model architecture paper: replaces self-attention + FFN with a single cross-token SwiGLU-gate aggregation (TANGO, quadratic) and a windowed/feature-map variant with running prefix sums (WANGO, linear). It aligns with the Transformer Architecture and Scaling & Efficiency preferences and is relevant to LLM research broadly, but does not touch the highest-weighted preferences (Japanese LLM/NLP, agents, reasoning methods, RAG, alignment). The construction is a genuinely new combination (gates, not values, are aggregated across tokens; null-gate denominator; ELU+1 feature map with running sums), distinct from GAU, FLASH, GLA, and BASED though built from familiar pieces. Rigor is strong for a small-scale study: ~44.3M nonembedding parameters matched within 0.1%, identical data order per seed, three seeds, six baselines, two depths (4 and 8 blocks), three datasets. However, TANGO's wins are confounded by a ~5x higher analytical MAC count the authors explicitly do not match, the scale is a single ~70M-parameter point, all evidence is teacher-forced NLL (no downstream generation, proof acceptance, or exact match), and no code/checkpoint release is stated. Evidence is internally consistent and honestly scoped, but generalization beyond the tested scale is unknown per the authors' own limitations section.

primary_link.title: TANGO: Token-Aggregated Nonlinear Gating Operators for Natural and Formal Language Modeling

papers.summary: A standard Transformer block separates cross-token interaction in self-attention from a nonlinear feed-forward network applied independently at each position. We introduce the TANGO model (Token-Aggregated Nonlinear Gating Operators), which replaces these two sublayers with one cross-token gated residual update. Each source token produces a SwiGLU gate vector. Query-key similarities determine a weighted average of source gates for each destination, and the resulting gate rescales projected desti
papers.summary_zh: 標準 Transformer 區塊將跨位置交互的自注意力與逐位置前饋網路分開。論文提出 TANGO 區塊，以單一跨 token 的閘控殘差更新取代兩個子層：每個來源位置產生 SwiGLU 閘控向量，目的地依查詢—鍵相似度對所有可見來源閘控做加權平均，再逐元素調變自身投影特徵；WANGO 變體在近期視窗內保留指數相似度，對較舊 token 改用正特徵映射分數，並以遞增前綴和維護統計量，在固定視窗與特徵維度下計算量對序列長度為線性。實驗以約 44.3M 非嵌入參數、相同訓練資料順序與預算比較六種架構：TANGO 在 FineWeb-Edu、Lean 與 DeepMind Mathematics 取得最低驗證 NLL；WANGO 在線性複雜度架構中最佳，並在解析 MAC 數相近下優於 Recurrent Transformer++；八層共享區塊實驗結果方向一致。限制：僅涵蓋單一參數規模且未匹配運算量，無法宣稱縮放定律；只量測驗證 NLL，未評估生成答案正確性、Lean 證明通過率或實測速度與記憶體。其意義在展示跨 token 閘控聚合可作為自注意力加前饋的有效替代，並同時提供二次與線性複雜度兩種實作。
papers.title: TANGO: Token-Aggregated Nonlinear Gating Operators for Natural and Formal Language Modeling
papers.title_zh: TANGO：以 Token 聚合非線性閘控運算子進行自然與形式語言建模

links.title: How Reliable Are NVD CWE Labels? A Large-Scale Semantic Audit with Seclometry

evidence: Section III-C/III-D: two-agent design - Seclometry Builder (web search, webpage reader, source downloader, CodeQL scanner tools) and CWE Matcher with multi-view cluster filtering plus an independent Arbitrator; evidence-refinement loop capped at three iterations.

Section V-A, Table II: on a 100-CVE benchmark CweAgent reaches 85% exact / 92% ambiguity-aware accuracy vs GPT-5.4-mini single-prompt 46%/59%, Claude 4.6 Opus single 74%/83%, and supervised TreeVul 52%/65%, with per-CVE cost/latency reported.
Section V-B, Table III: Arbitrator achieves 90% overall accuracy with per-category F1 89-91% on 100 cases; two-author labels with Cohen's kappa = 0.84.
Section VI-A1, Table IV: across 15,556 CVEs, 49.70% exact match, 25.01% overlap ambiguity, 6.36% defensible alternative, 3.63% evidence-inconsistent, 15.30% classifier error.

Section VI-C1: manual review of all 564 S4 flags confirmed 434 genuine mislabels (kappa = 0.87); open coding yields six patterns, led by consequence-vs-root-cause (23.1%) and sibling sub-type confusion (21.3%).

Section IV and Figures 4-6: fixed prompts, fixed model versions (Claude 4.6 Opus, GPT-5.4-mini, Claude Sonnet 4.6), temperature 0; prompt templates reproduced in the paper and artifact link given in the Conclusion.

Section VII-D (Threats to Validity): corpus restricted to open-source CVEs with fix commits; leakage mitigated via pre-CWE-assignment records, Wayback snapshots, and a 19-CVE post-cutoff benchmark subset.
Section III-C1/III-B: seclometry is a structured eight-field representation built from MITRE CWE catalog (842 Allowed CWEs) rather than trained on NVD labels, addressing the circularity challenge.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent-based measurement study of NVD CWE label quality. Preference relevance is moderate: it strongly hits Agents & Tool Use (two-agent Classifier/Arbitrator workflow with web search, source downloader, CodeQL tools, reflection loop, structured JSON outputs) and Code & Programming (patch/code-grounded evidence), and uses LLMs substantively, but it advances no LLM methodology itself - seclometry is a domain-specific schema and the agent design is a standard builder/matcher/reflection pipeline applied to a security metadata audit. Research quality is solid: the instrument is validated separately (85%/92% Classifier accuracy; 90% Arbitrator accuracy with per-category F1), all 564 flagged cases were manually adjudicated with reported kappa, leakage is mitigated via pre-assignment CVE records and a post-cutoff subset, and threats to validity are candidly discussed (open-source-only corpus, 15.30% classifier-error rate at scale, small 100-CVE benchmark built by filtering rather than independent labeling). Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent. Generalizability beyond open-source CVEs is limited by design; reproducibility is aided by fixed prompts, temperature 0, published prompt templates, and an artifact link. A rigorous applied LLM paper rather than core LLM/NLP methodology research.

primary_link.title: How Reliable Are NVD CWE Labels? A Large-Scale Semantic Audit with Seclometry

papers.summary: CWE labels in the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) are widely treated as ground truth for vulnerability search, scanner evaluation, benchmark construction, learning-based security tools, and vulnerability prioritization. Yet their reliability has not been systematically measured at scale, despite growing concerns about NVD's enrichment backlog and anecdotal reports of inaccurate, ambiguous, or missing labels. This paper presents a large-scale, code-semantics-grounded measurement of CWE labe
papers.summary_zh: NVD 的 CWE 標籤廣泛被當作弱點分類真值，卻缺乏大規模的系統性可靠性測量。論文建構 CweAgent 稽核工具：以 seclometry——涵蓋根因、觸發條件、被違反的安全不變式、影響與鄰近邊界的結構化語意簽章——統一表示 842 個 Allowed CWE 與各 CVE，經多視角聚類篩選與逐候選評分預測證據支持的 CWE，再由獨立仲裁器判斷 NVD 標籤屬精確、重疊模糊、可辯護替代或與證據不一致，避免把受稽核標籤當訓練準則的循環。在 100 個人工策展 CVE 上達 85% top-1 與 92% 模糊感知準確率，仲裁器整體準確率 90%。套用於 2017 至 2026 年 15,556 個開源 CVE：僅 49.70% 完全相符，31.37% 屬可辯護替代或模糊，3.63% 與證據不一致；手動覆核 564 件旗標確認 434 件真實誤標，歸納出六種重複錯誤模式，且 80.5% 的修正跨越弱點家族。品質隨指派 CNA 與弱點類型劇烈變化，但與嚴重度或實際被利用無關。限制：語料限於有修補 commit 的開源 CVE，依賴 LLM 工具有資料外洩與證據不完整風險。其啟示是下游基準與工具不應把 NVD CWE 標籤視為無噪真值，宜以來源與修補證據審慎加權。
papers.title: How Reliable Are NVD CWE Labels? A Large-Scale Semantic Audit with Seclometry
papers.title_zh: NVD 的 CWE 標籤有多可靠？以 Seclometry 進行大規模語意稽核

links.title: NoTB: Oracle-Free Triage of LLM-Generated RTL via Cross-Model Formal Consensus

evidence: Abstract: 'four-family formal consensus achieves 94.7% precision at 27% coverage; three-family consensus achieves 87% precision at 33% coverage' on 78 CVDP RTL-generation tasks.

Section 4.1: setup uses all 78 code-generation tasks (cid003) of the NVIDIA CVDP benchmark, M=4 LLM families (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-OSS-120B, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen 3 Coder), K=5 samples; 8 tasks excluded (5 Yosys elaboration failures, 2 with <4 synthesizable candidates, 1 testbench failure), leaving 70 specifications.

Section 4.2.2: 'simulation-based precision at model count (mc) >= 4 varies from 43% with Claude-generated testbenches to 84% with Gemini- and GPT-generated testbenches, while formal SEC reaches 94.7% (Figure 3)'.

Section 4.3.1, Table 2: mc>=4 accepts 19 specs (18 correct, 1 FP, 95% [0.75,0.99], 27% coverage); mc>=3 accepts 23 (87%, 33%); separation of high- vs low-consensus regimes significant, 'p=4.4e-4 under Fisher's exact test'.
Section 4.3.2, Table 3: leave-one-out ablation shows dropping Qwen yields 100% precision at mc>=3 (29% coverage) and dropping Claude yields 90%, indicating no single family is load-bearing.
Section 4.3.4, Table 4: cost analysis lists 13,133 SEC pairs via JasperGold ('license') and 1,556 judge calls per judge baseline, quantifying the tool-dependency barrier to reproduction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: multi-family LLM code generation (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-OSS-120B, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen 3 Coder) with an evaluation/triage contribution, not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate-to-good: replacing testbench- or judge-based self-consistency with formal Sequential Equivalence Checking consensus is a genuinely new correctness signal for LLM-generated RTL, though at the ML level it is selective prediction over clustered samples with a stronger equivalence oracle. Rigor is solid: oracle-free baselines (LLM-as-a-judge across four judges, simulation-based clustering) are quantified as unstable (Table 1; Section 4.2.2 reports 43%-84% precision swings from testbench choice), the headline result includes Wilson CIs and a Fisher's exact test (p=4.4e-4, Section 4.3.1), plus leave-one-out family (Table 3), K-sweep (Figure 4), and cost ablations (Table 4). Evidence strength is tempered by small scale: 70 evaluable specs after 8 exclusions, headline 94.7% precision rests on 18/19 accepts (CI [0.75,0.99]), single benchmark (CVDP cid003), and coverage capped at 27-33%. Generalizability is limited: SEC-based consensus is hardware-specific and unclear for large designs (inconclusive results reduce coverage), and only one benchmark is tested. Reproducibility is middling: models, prompts constraints, benchmark, and per-call costs are specified, but the pipeline depends on licensed Cadence JasperGold (13,133 pairs, Table 4) and no code/artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: NoTB: Oracle-Free Triage of LLM-Generated RTL via Cross-Model Formal Consensus

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate register-transfer-level (RTL) designs from natural-language specifications. However, assessing functional correctness at early stages remains a fundamental challenge. Existing oracle-free approaches rely either on simulation-based agreement, which depends on LLM-generated testbenches that can fail or vary across models, or on LLM-as-a-judge heuristics, which produce inconsistent predictions. We introduce NoTB, an oracle-free triage f
papers.summary_zh: LLM 常被用來從自然語言規格生成 RTL，但早期難以評估功能正確性；現有免預言機方法仰賴模擬一致或 LLM 評審，前者受生成測試平台品質左右，後者缺乏形式保證且偏誤隨模型變動。NoTB 改以形式化跨模型共識：從四個獨立訓練的 LLM 家族各取樣多個 Verilog 實作，利用 Sequential Equivalence Checking（SEC，以 JasperGold 執行）證明等價並建構等價叢集，以最大叢集涵蓋的模型家族數作為信心訊號，形成可調的精確率—涵蓋率取捨。在 CVDP 的 78 項 RTL 生成任務上，四家族共識於 27% 涵蓋率下達 94.7% 精確率，三家族共識於 33% 涵蓋率下達 87%；對照顯示模擬式共識精確率隨測試平台來源在 43% 至 84% 間波動，LLM 評審也呈現模型依賴偏誤。消融實驗顯示訊號不依賴單一家族，樣本數掃描指出每家族約三個即足。限制：實際僅評估 70 個規格、需要商業 SEC 授權、SEC 呼叫耗時且可能不確定，方法定位為分流而非取代驗證。其貢獻在把多模型一致從有限測試的經驗訊號提升為全輸入空間的形式保證，作為早期 RTL 驗證分流的可靠基礎。
papers.title: NoTB: Oracle-Free Triage of LLM-Generated RTL via Cross-Model Formal Consensus
papers.title_zh: NoTB：透過跨模型形式共識對 LLM 生成的 RTL 進行免預言機分流

links.title: The Plan, Not the Decoder: Diagnosing and Repairing Compositional Failure in Reasoning-Augmented Text-to-Image Generation

evidence: §4.1: box-swap ground-truth manipulation collapses OWLv2 prompt-relation accuracy 0.750→0.477 (p=1e-4) while BLIP-VQA scores it as improvement (0.618→0.681); five-rater human study: detector agrees with human majority on 81% of items vs BLIP-VQA 57%.

Table 1 (§5): intervention ladder on spatial_val n=300 — verify +5.0 (p=.0007), minimal in-place repair +6.0 (p=.021), geometric plan repair +10.7 (p<.0001), clean-box oracle +13.3 (p=.0001); planner-statistics box conditions are non-significant (p=.37/.062).

§7: three-seed replication (control 0.751±0.005; ladder ordering holds per seed) and GoT-R1-7B replication (box swap 0.863→0.433, p<1e-4; repair gains shrink to +1.7–+2.3 n.s. as planner first-try pass rises to 89.3%).
§8: self-audit documents reversal of earlier contrary finding (−4.9→+13.3) attributed to corrupted templates, layout-insensitive VQA scoring, and underpowered unpaired deltas.

§11 Limitations: single model family (GoT-R1 at 1B/7B), 300-prompt validation subsets, OWLv2 open-vocabulary detection quality bounds scoring, planner-mimic stimulus noise at 7B, exploratory null attention probe (r=0.17 max).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A text-to-image generation paper, but with genuine language methodology: it studies generation chain-of-thought plans, ports perturbation-based CoT-faithfulness analysis (Lanham/Turpin lineage) to visual generation, and contributes training-free symbolic plan verification/repair. It is therefore not the 'image diffusion without language methodology' out-of-scope case, though its core object remains image generation, capping preference relevance near 0.5. Research quality is high: metric validation via a box-swap manipulation with built-in ground truth (§4.1), an intervention ladder (verify/repair/replace) with matched controls, paired sign-flip permutation tests, CIs, 3-seed robustness, 7B replication, a 5-rater human study, and an unusually candid §8 documenting reversal of the authors' own contrary earlier result. Limitations: one model family (GoT-R1 1B/7B), 300-prompt validation subsets, detector-score dependence on OWLv2, degenerate 7B planner-mimic cell, and an explicitly null exploratory attention probe; generalization beyond GoT-R1 is acknowledged as untested. Reproducibility is aided by fixed seeds, full procedure specification, and stated release of scripts, evaluator, 12k images, and analysis code.

primary_link.title: The Plan, Not the Decoder: Diagnosing and Repairing Compositional Failure in Reasoning-Augmented Text-to-Image Generation

papers.summary: Reasoning-augmented text-to-image models such as GoT-R1 emit an explicit textual plan - object names, attributes, and bounding boxes - before generating image tokens. When such a model fails a compositional prompt, is the plan wrong, or is the plan right and the decoder unfaithful? Because the plan is machine-readable it can be edited before decoding, which makes the two separable. We first validate the ruler. Swapping the two bounding boxes inside the model's own chain demonstrably flips the ge
papers.summary_zh: 現代文字生圖(T2I)模型常在組合式提示上失敗,例如「貓在狗的左邊」可能畫出相反的空間關係。推理增強模型(如 GoT-R1)會在生成影像前先輸出包含物件、屬性與邊界框的文字計畫,但失敗時究竟是計畫寫錯,還是解碼器未能忠實執行?本文以 GoT-R1-1B 為對象,設計驗證、修復、替換與破壞等控制介入實驗,並採用 OWLv2 開放詞彙偵測器進行幾何評分。作者首先證明常用的 VQA 空間指標對版面幾乎無感:交換鏈中兩個邊界框會翻轉生成版面,使偵測器準確率從 0.75 掉到 0.48,但 VQA 分數反而上升。在可靠量測下,解碼器其實是忠實的執行者:94% 的生成版面符合計畫關係,且外部注入的正確計畫若具乾淨、分離良好的框,可比模型自產計畫再提升 13.3 點,與文字風格及似然無關。瓶頸在於規劃器:其對語意相同的版面因措辭不同而有 98% 對 54% 的規劃準確率差距,並有偏好把先提及物件放在左上的光柵順序偏誤。免訓練對策包括符號驗證加重取樣(+5.0)與最小原地修復(+6.0),僅改寫框幾何的幾何修復更可獲 +10.7 點;但框與文字互相矛盾的計畫會引發物件重複與身分融合。研究限於單一模型家族與 300 題驗證子集。此工作指出修計畫比修解碼器更有效,並釋出評測協定與 12k 影像。
papers.title: The Plan, Not the Decoder: Diagnosing and Repairing Compositional Failure in Reasoning-Augmented Text-to-Image Generation
papers.title_zh: 關鍵在計畫,而非解碼器:診斷與修復推理增強文字生圖的組合性失敗

links.title: LLM-Enhanced Commit Message Generation via Issue Information: An Exploratory Study

evidence: Abstract/Section 6.1 Table 7: issue augmentation improves BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, SBERT-Cos by averages of 23.60%, 20.48%, 25.21%, 30.70%, 8.70% across four LLM configurations.

Section 6.2 Table 8: ISAC_best (GPT-5.5 effort=high) and ISAC_worst (DeepSeek-V4-Flash reasoner) beat reproduced baselines CCT5, NNGen, RACE, CoRec on all five metrics; baselines are all pre-LLM supervised/retrieval methods, with no LLM-based CMG baseline compared despite citations in Section 2.

Section 6.5 Table 11: Diff+Issue+History lowers human scores (e.g., DeepSeek chat Clarity 4.34 vs 4.53 for Diff+Issue; GPT-5.5 none Completeness 3.06 vs 3.50) despite automatic-metric gains in Table 9, showing metric-reference divergence.

Section 3.2.3: four filtering rules including target-leakage control via all-MiniLM-L6-v2 cosine similarity threshold 0.8 reduce 249,830 commits to 47,664 aligned pairs; Section 3.2.4 shows 78.9% Java concentration.

Section 7.3/7.4: human evaluation limited to 50 samples and two evaluators without reported agreement statistics; replication package (GitHub, Ren et al. 2026) includes dataset, prompts, outputs, and evaluation scripts, with API model drift acknowledged as a reproducibility threat.
Section 5.2: experimental dataset of 1,061 pairs drawn from Spark (Scala), Camel (Java), and pooled C++ repositories with sample-size justification, bounding language and ecosystem coverage.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An applied empirical study using LLMs (GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) with prompting and retrieval-augmented context for commit message generation, giving strong alignment to LLM, Code & Programming, and Prompting/RAG preferences, though it contributes no new language-model methodology. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself notes ExGroFi (Wang et al. 2023, Section 2/Table 1) already built a commit-issue dataset and used issue context for supervised CMG, so the delta is a new multi-language dataset (ApacheCM-Issue, 47,664 pairs, Section 3) plus systematic ablations of history and structured summaries. Rigor is solid on dataset filtering (R1-R4, Section 3.2.3) and multi-configuration design, but weakened by absent significance testing, no inter-rater agreement for the 2-evaluator/50-sample human study (Section 7.3), and baselines limited to reproduced pre-LLM methods while recent LLM-based CMG work cited in Section 2 (e.g., Li et al. 2024, CoRaCMG) is not compared. Evidence from Tables 7-10 is consistent and transparent, but reference-overlap metrics are weak proxies and human evaluation partially contradicts automatic gains for history augmentation (Table 11). Generalizability is constrained to Apache, Java/Scala-dominated projects, acknowledged in Section 7.2. A public replication package with fixed samples, prompts, and outputs (Data Availability, Section 7.4) supports reproducibility, with API drift noted.

primary_link.title: LLM-Enhanced Commit Message Generation via Issue Information: An Exploratory Study

papers.summary: Commit messages help developers understand code changes, support collaboration, and improve long-term maintenance. However, the use of issue information alone as the external context for LLM-based CMG has not been systematically studied. We propose an ISsue-Augmented framework for Commit message generation (ISAC) by combining code diffs with issue information as LLM input. To support the evaluation, we construct ApacheCM-Issue, a commit-issue aligned dataset built upon ApacheCM by linking commit
papers.summary_zh: 提交訊息(commit message)幫助開發者理解程式碼變更與後續維護,但研究顯示約 44% 的提交訊息缺乏「改了什麼」或「為何而改」的資訊。既有 LLM 提交訊息生成(CMG)研究多聚焦於程式碼差異、歷史提交或儲存庫內部脈絡,較少系統性檢視 issue 資訊本身的作用。本文提出 ISAC 框架,將程式碼差異與 issue 標題及內容一同作為 LLM 輸入,並構建 ApacheCM-Issue 資料集:基於 ApacheCM,透過 GitHub 與 Apache Jira 連結提交與 issue,經四道過濾規則(含防目標洩漏的相似度控制)後得到 49 個 Apache 儲存庫、47,664 筆對齊樣本。實驗在 1,061 筆跨 Scala、Java、C++ 的樣本上,比較四種輸入組態與 GPT-5.5、DeepSeek-V4-Flash 等模型。結果顯示加入 issue 資訊在所有模型與五項自動指標上一致提升,BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR、CIDEr、SBERT-Cos 平均分別提升 23.60%、20.48%、25.21%、30.70%、8.70%;再加入同專案相似歷史提交可進一步提升(如 BLEU +29.49%),但以結構化 issue 摘要取代原文則五項指標皆下降。人類評估顯示 issue 資訊提升清晰度與完整性而不損正確性。限制包括提交-issue 對齊品質、issue 資訊量參差、樣本集中於 Apache 專案,以及人類評估僅 50 則樣本。此研究證明外部任務層級脈絡對 CMG 的價值。
papers.title: LLM-Enhanced Commit Message Generation via Issue Information: An Exploratory Study
papers.title_zh: 透過 Issue 資訊強化 LLM 提交訊息生成:一項探索性研究

links.title: DynaContext: Self-Improving Dynamic Contextualization of Optimized Prompts for Heterogeneous Parameter Extraction

evidence: Abstract: 'average accuracy increases from 86.6% for the base prompt to 96.9% for standalone SkillOpt and 98.6% for the best DynaContext configuration' and heterogeneous F1 rises from 51.8% (control) to 71.0% with both factors, a 17.3-point gain over the deployed static pipeline.

Section 5.3 / Table 3: two-factor ablation over 850 gold facts reports demonstrations +7.47 F1 [6.42, 8.51], optimized core +15.14 [10.66, 19.61], joint +19.22 [14.18, 24.27], 'positive in all eight deployments (Wilcoxon signed-rank, p=0.0039)', with sub-additive interaction (demos worth 4.09 on top of the core).

Section 6 (Limitations): 'Our benchmarks are small: 142 single-category records and 133 heterogeneous records... drawn from one industrial corpus'; ceramic capacitors and chip resistors supply 74% of gold facts; 'the underlying offer records cannot be released because of confidentiality constraints'; WDC-PAVE evaluation 'left for future work'.

Section 5.1 (Models and comparability): paired design over eight deployments (GPT-3.5 Turbo through GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Pro) with 'no human intervenes in a measured run'; demonstration memory built from a disjoint set so 'no evaluation record can be retrieved as its own demonstration'.

Section 5.3: 'Holding the model fixed, DynaContext costs more than the Static-10 reference in every deployment... 1.48 times on average, in exchange for a mean gain of 17.32 F1 points'; Table 4 shows small-model configurations (GPT-5.4 mini at $0.203/run) beat the largest model on F1 and cost.

Section 4.4: validation-gated self-improvement—only accepted human decisions update memory (M_{t+1} equation), the GEPA-optimized judge is a triage gate that 'cannot add or alter parameter values'; Section 6 concedes 'improvement of the memory across successive review rounds is not evaluated'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology paper (offline prompt/skill optimization composed dynamically per instance, demonstration retrieval, agentic routing, LLM-judge gating) and therefore not a capped pure-domain application, though it is instantiated on one proprietary electronics-extraction task. Novelty is moderate: DynaContext is a competent synthesis of known pieces (GEPA/SkillOpt cores, RAG-style demonstration retrieval, deterministic route graph, human-verified memory) rather than new techniques, with the UPE formalization (schema-conditional, provenance, abstention) as the freshest element. Rigor is above average for a system paper: paired design across eight deployments, two-factor ablation with confidence intervals and Wilcoxon testing, cluster bootstrap, and cost/runtime accounting; however, both benchmarks are tiny (133/142 records), single-corpus, unbalanced (74% of gold facts from two families), GEPA is excluded from the main ablation, and the self-improvement loop's longitudinal benefit is not evaluated. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitatively detailed but entirely self-contained, with the headline 17.32 F1 gain measured against a weak static-prompt reference. Generalizability is limited by one industrial corpus and no public benchmark (WDC-PAVE deferred). Reproducibility is poor: data explicitly withheld, commercial APIs and cached external responses, no code release claim.

primary_link.title: DynaContext: Self-Improving Dynamic Contextualization of Optimized Prompts for Heterogeneous Parameter Extraction

papers.summary: Automated prompt and skill optimization typically produces a single static instruction that is reused across inference instances until the next optimization cycle. However, this approach cannot adapt when the required context, constraints, and evidence vary from one instance to another. For instance, parameter extraction from electronic component descriptions breaks this assumption: resistors, capacitors, transistors, and connectors require different fields, unit constraints, and demonstrations,
papers.summary_zh: 自動化提示與技能最佳化通常產出單一靜態指令,並在下次最佳化循環前重複使用,但當輸入所需的結構、約束與證據隨個案而異時便會失效。電子元件參數抽取即為典型:電阻、電容、電晶體與連接器需要不同欄位、單位約束與範例,且每筆輸入的證據狀態不同。本文提出 DynaContext,結合以 GEPA 或 SkillOpt 離線學習的抽取核心,與推論時的動態情境化及驗證把關的自我改進。系統以確定性圖控制器將每筆資料路由至內部、外部或後備證據路徑,並由最佳化核心、結構、證據、未解欄位與已驗證示範組成個案專屬提示;確定性驗證與 LLM 評審把關每個輸出,不確定個案送人工審查,僅有人工確認的修正進入示範記憶。實驗包含 133 筆跨 13 類別、850 個黃金參數事實的異質基準,以及 142 筆單類別陶瓷電容基準,涵蓋八種 LLM。單類別平均準確率從未最佳化基礎提示的 86.6% 提升至 SkillOpt 的 96.9%,最佳 DynaContext 組態達 98.6%;異質任務上,欄位級 F1 從控制組 51.8% 提升至動態示範 59.2%、最佳化核心 66.9%,兩者合併達 71.0%,較部署中的靜態提示管線平均高 17.3 點,且小模型配上合適結構與示範能以極低成本逼近大模型表現。限制為基準規模小、類別分布不均且資料因保密無法公開。此方法凸顯推論時動態組裝脈絡相對靜態提示的價值。
papers.title: DynaContext: Self-Improving Dynamic Contextualization of Optimized Prompts for Heterogeneous Parameter Extraction
papers.title_zh: DynaContext:針對異質參數抽取的最佳化提示自我改進動態情境化

links.title: Learning to Look Again: Loss-Gap Supervision for Free-form Crop Routing in Vision-Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'On InternVL2.5-8B, GapSight raises the six-benchmark average from 52.25 to 64.29, above CropVLM (57.16), ViCrop (55.84), and ZoomRefine (54.43).'

Method > Loss-Gap Supervision: crop utility defined as 'reduction in answer negative log-likelihood' for generated answers and 'correct-option margin' improvement for multiple choice, with labels mined per backbone because 'crop utility depends on the target model's visual encoder, tokenizer, decoder, prompt format, and answer parser.'

Table 1 caption: 'Per-benchmark entries report mean scores over three seeds; TextVQA, DocVQA, ChartQA, and InfographicVQA use 1,000-example evaluation subsets, VStarBench uses 191 examples, and MME-Lite uses 1,919 examples'; text also states benchmark subsets are 'disjoint from mining, router training, and threshold selection.'

Table 3 (Supervision-signal ablation): loss-gap labels reach 71.57 four-benchmark InternVL average vs CLIP relevance 66.88 and random labels 64.00, isolating the supervision signal with backbone, router, candidate bank, and schedule fixed.

'Useful Crops Are Model-Specific' / Figure 3: 'Off-diagonal retention averages 0.44 across all benchmark-transfer pairs,' supporting per-backbone label mining but limiting plug-and-play generalization.
Table 4: 107 wrong-to-right vs 27 right-to-wrong transitions (net +80) on four InternVL2.5-8B VQA benchmarks; Table 5 shows task-adaptive action rates (76.5% InfographicVQA vs 25.6% MME-Lite).

Training and Inference: objective L = lambda_g L_gate + lambda_u L_utility + lambda_b L_box, but numeric lambda values, candidate bank size K, router parameterization/size, and optimizer settings are not specified, and no code or artifact release is mentioned anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A vision-language model method (GapSight) that mines 'loss-gap' supervision (answer-NLL reduction for free-form VQA, option-margin gain for multiple choice) from a target VLM's own behavior and distills it into a one-shot free-form crop router. Topic relevance is moderate: it squarely matches Multimodal AI/VQA and visual-token efficiency interests and uses LLM-backbone likelihood signals, but it is not core LLM reasoning, agents, alignment, or Japanese NLP work, and it is not pure CV (language-model answer behavior defines the supervision). Research quality is above average: three backbones, six benchmarks over three seeds with held-out subsets, external crop/zoom baselines (ZoomRefine, ViCrop, CropVLM), a supervision ablation against random and CLIP-relevance labels (Table 3), a cross-backbone crop-transfer matrix (0.44 off-diagonal retention), and a 107-vs-27 repair/regression transition analysis. Concerns: the magnitude of gains over prior trained-crop baselines (e.g., InternVL DocVQA 78.11 vs CropVLM 66.52) is large and uncorroborated; no tiled/high-res or always-crop cost-matched control beyond external baselines; hyperparameters (lambda weights, candidate bank size K, router architecture size) and optimization details are unspecified; no code or data release is claimed, hurting reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Learning to Look Again: Loss-Gap Supervision for Free-form Crop Routing in Vision-Language Models

papers.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) fail many detail-centric questions for a concrete reason: the answer is visible in the image, yet lost after the image is compressed into a low-resolution global view. Allocating more visual tokens to every query improves some OCR and document cases, but it spends computation indiscriminately and can disturb tasks that rely on global context. We propose GapSight, a framework for learning visual re-reading: a VLM first takes a global glance, then selectively returns
papers.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型(VLM)常在細節導向問題上失敗:答案明明在影像中,卻在低解析度全域視圖壓縮後遺失。對每個查詢一律增加視覺 token 雖有助 OCR 與文件任務,卻不加區分地消耗運算,且可能干擾依賴全域脈絡的任務。本文提出 GapSight,教 VLM「視覺重讀」:先全域概覽,再於需要局部證據時回到自由形式區域。監督訊號來自目標模型自身的失敗反應:離線比較僅全域視圖與候選裁切增強視圖下的答案損失(生成式)或選項差距(選擇題),能改善答案的裁切成為模型專屬的重讀標籤。輕量的自由形式裁切路由器將這些標籤蒸餾為一次性推論策略,從全域狀態預測是否重讀、預期效用與連續裁切框。在 LLaVA-1.5-7B、InternVL2.5-8B 與 Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct 上,涵蓋 TextVQA、DocVQA、ChartQA、InfographicVQA、VStarBench 與 MME-RealWorld-Lite 六項基準,GapSight 全面超越不縮放基線:InternVL2.5-8B 六基準平均從 52.25 升至 64.29,優於 CropVLM(57.16)、ViCrop(55.84)與 ZoomRefine(54.43),且平均視覺 token 僅 391,低於外部裁切基線;機制分析顯示 107 個錯誤被修復、僅 27 個退化,閘門會依任務調整重讀率,而有效裁切具模型專屬性(跨模型保留率僅 0.44)。限制包括評測子集規模與骨幹數量有限。此研究示範以模型自身損失差距作為監督,是教導 VLM 何時何地再看一次的實用路徑。
papers.title: Learning to Look Again: Loss-Gap Supervision for Free-form Crop Routing in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 學會再看一次:視覺語言模型中自由形式裁切路由的損失差距監督

links.title: W-RAG: Source-Aware Retrieval for Enterprise Document Generation from Heterogeneous Knowledge Bases

evidence: Section 5.2/Table 1: W-RAG beats Vanilla RAG and OG-RAG on Requirement Satisfaction and Context Relevancy across 16 domain-document settings, with claimed relative gains of 58.1%/39.1% over OG-RAG.

Section 5.1: all pipelines use the same GPT-4.1 backbone via Azure AI Search; Claude Sonnet 4.6 serves as LLM-as-judge with manual verification at 91% (Requirement Satisfaction) and 86% (Context Relevancy) agreement.

Section 4: benchmark has 100 requirement documents across 4 document types and 4 domains, with 4 KBs of ~500 publicly sourced documents each; Section 7 admits it is a 'relatively small, synthetic enterprise-style dataset'.
Section 7 (Limitations): authors concede limited baselines ('We do not include heavily tuned retrieval strategies') and unvalidated generality beyond enterprise document generation.

Section 3.3 and A.2: source weights use fixed hand-tuned coefficients (0.7/0.1/0.2) and rule-based match scores (1.0/0.7/0.3); λ=0.5 chosen on a held-out dev set; 16 ontologies semi-automatically built and expert-refined.

A.5.1: controlled weight-override study using permutations of (40,35,20,5) shows realized KB attribution tracks prescribed mixtures; fidelity reported via JSD-based score (0.60-0.74 range across domains).

A.6: deployment numbers (12-18 hours saved/week, 3x faster turnaround) explicitly attributed to a prior retrieval-assisted workflow, not to W-RAG itself; no code or dataset release URL appears anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic RAG paper: source-aware weighted retrieval over heterogeneous knowledge bases for enterprise document generation with LLMs (GPT-4.1 generator, Claude judge), directly matching the RAG & Knowledge and LLM preferences. The problem framing (evidence composition vs. chunk-level global ranking) is sensible and the new enterprise drafting benchmark fills a stated gap, but the method is a heuristic pipeline (rule-based match scores 1.0/0.7/0.3, fixed 0.7/0.1/0.2 source-weight coefficients, λ=0.5 tuned on dev) that is incremental over OG-RAG-style ontology-guided retrieval. Rigor is moderate: only two baselines (Vanilla RAG, OG-RAG), no significance testing or variance, ~100 requirement docs spread over 16 domain-document cells (~6 per cell), hand-tuned hyperparameters, and Table 1 contains apparent anomalies (OG-RAG Finance M&A Requirement Satisfaction of 5, W-RAG Academic Finance Context Relevancy of 7) inconsistent with the averages reported in the fine-grained analysis. Evidence is credible but self-benchmarked; the weight-override study and 91%/86% judge-human agreement strengthen it, and the authors honestly disclaim that the proposal-drafting productivity case study is not a W-RAG evaluation. Generalizability is limited by 16 manually curated ontologies and unvalidated transfer beyond enterprise settings (Section 7). No code or dataset release is stated, though prompts and hyperparameters are documented in appendices.

primary_link.title: W-RAG: Source-Aware Retrieval for Enterprise Document Generation from Heterogeneous Knowledge Bases

papers.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables large language models to incorporate external knowledge during generation, improving factual grounding and domain adaptability. However, existing RAG pipelines assume that evidence retrieved from multiple repositories can be ranked globally using a single similarity function. While suitable for open-domain retrieval, this assumption breaks down in enterprise document generation, where heterogeneous knowledge bases (such as policies, regulations, techn
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）雖能提升大型語言模型的事實依據與領域適應性，但現有管線假設多個知識庫擷取的證據可用單一相似度函數全域排序；在企業文件產生情境下，此假設常使脈絡被少數來源壟斷，導致草稿涵蓋不完整。本文提出 W-RAG，一個來源感知的檢索框架，分三階段運作：先以本體引導的主題抽取進行候選段落檢索，結合語意相似度與本體對齊評分；接著在每個知識庫內局部排序，並依主題重疊度、文件可用性先驗與類別加權估計各知識庫的來源權重；最後將權重轉為 token 預算，建構來源平衡的單一脈絡視窗。作者並建立涵蓋政策、產品上市、併購盡職調查與學程提案四類文件、橫跨四個產業領域的新資料集。實驗顯示，相較 OG-RAG，W-RAG 使需求滿足度提升 58.1%、脈絡相關性提升 39.1%；相較 Vanilla RAG 提升更顯著；權重覆寫實驗亦證實生成內容會隨來源組成改變。限制包括資料集規模小且偏合成、評估指標具主觀性、基線有限。此研究指出企業文件產生的關鍵不在段落排序品質，而在文件層級的證據組成控制。

links.title: LLM Agents Perform Controlled Experiments Using Simulation Models

evidence: Sec. IV-A: four system variants evaluated, 'all agent-based variants powered by GPT-4o', including No simulation and LLM-only ablations
Table I: Full System achieves 13.7 fuzzy words/1k, LUCI 0.13, Correct 4.1, Helpful 4.2, Sim P/R 94%/64%, Sim Conf 76%
Sec. IV-B: test set consists of 'five task scenarios in pharmaceutical crystallization process design'
Sec. V-B2: correctness and helpfulness rated 1-5 by 'Two senior domain specialists'; LLM-as-a-Judge explicitly rejected
Sec. IV-C: 'The simulation model used in this work is a proprietary industrial asset' (first-principles + semi-empirical crystallization model)
Sec. V-E: No Requirement ablation raises recall to 69% but lowers precision to 65%, with declined correctness/usefulness scores
Sec. VI: discussion claims generalizable 'approximation fidelity' principle but no cross-domain experiments are reported
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM agent work: a six-agent pipeline (GPT-4o) that uses scientific simulation as an experimental substrate for hypothesize-intervene-observe reasoning (Sec. III), fitting Agents & Tool Use, LLM, and Reasoning preferences; it is a domain-anchored application but with genuine language/agent methodology. Novelty is moderate: the framing of simulation as a controlled-experiment environment is a sensible step beyond tool-execution systems (Sec. II), but the architecture is a conventional planner-operator-executor-interpreter pipeline akin to prior multi-agent work the authors cite. Rigor and evidence are limited by a very small evaluation: only five crystallization tasks, 17 simulated results analyzed for the full system (Sec. IV-C/V-C), correctness/helpfulness rated by just two specialists with no inter-rater agreement or significance testing (Sec. V-B2), and specificity measured only via linguistic fuzziness/LUCI proxies rather than ground truth. Ablations (no-simulation, no-requirement, LLM-only) are well-designed and the Table I numbers (e.g., LUCI 0.13 vs 0.33/0.36; Sim Conf 76%) support the claims within-setting. Generalizability is asserted (Sec. VI 'approximation fidelity') but demonstrated on one proprietary simulation and one LLM. Reproducibility is poor: the simulation model is a proprietary industrial asset (Sec. IV-C) and no code or full prompts are released.

primary_link.title: LLM Agents Perform Controlled Experiments Using Simulation Models

They require understanding how a system responds to intervention, which in practice depends on controlled experimentation. In this work, we propose a multi-agent framework that enables LLM agents to conduct controlled experiments with scientific simulation models for pharmaceutical process design. Given a
papers.summary_zh: 科學與工程任務常需理解系統如何回應介入，而非僅產出看似合理的文字，但現有 LLM 系統多把模擬當作被動工具，缺乏結構化的對照實驗推理。本文提出一個多代理框架，讓 LLM 代理與高保真製藥結晶製程模擬模型互動並執行受控實驗：需求分析代理解析任務並產出結構化需求；規劃代理擬定抽象計畫；操作代理將計畫具體化並生成模擬呼叫程式碼；執行代理以規則式元件可靠執行；解讀代理透過具視覺能力的 LLM 解讀模擬圖表；報告代理彙整最終建議。系統遵循假設、介入、觀察、分析的科學探究流程進行參數最佳化，並以有向圖視覺化推理軌跡以利稽核。在五個結晶任務上，完整系統的模糊詞頻為每千字 13.7、LUCI 不確定性 0.13，模擬呼叫精確率 94%、假設驗證率 76%，專家評分正確性 4.1、實用性 4.2；移除模擬後 LUCI 升至 0.33，純 LLM 為 0.36，顯示模擬整合是精確推論的關鍵。限制包括僅驗證於專有結晶模擬與單一領域、任務數少。此框架示範 LLM 與科學模擬互補耦合可產生可驗證、可執行的工程決策支持。

links.title: HIRA: A Human-in-the-Loop Retrieval-Augmented Cascade for Document Classification in Regulated Industries

evidence: Abstract: HIRA 'processes the full 30,233-document production stream while requesting human correction for only 1,945 documents (6.4%), improving Macro-F1 from 0.6218 to 0.8548' with a locally hosted DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B verifier
Section 6.2/Table 2: 'HIRA reaches Macro-F1 0.9423... +17.4 points above the DeepSeek zero-shot baseline (0.7683), at a verifier call rate of approximately 40%'
Section 6.3/Table 3: EDRM ablation raises Tier-1-only Macro-F1 from 0.8857 (kNN+Naive HITL) to 0.9135 (+2.78 points), gains concentrated in medium classes (0.854 to 0.907)
Section 6.3/Table 4: at N=518 HIRA reaches 0.9423 versus DiT-618 at 0.9193 at equal annotation budget, and equals the Oracle-2086 row (0.9423)
Section 5.3 Variance and seed protocol: three-run check on Financial-80 yields 0.8523/0.8535/0.8586 (mean 0.8548) but 'all main results use a single fixed seed'
Section 5.1: 'Under the data-sharing agreement we report only aggregate metrics... per-class F1 tables and category names cannot be released', limiting independent verification of the primary corpus
Section 6.4: 'small open-weight LLMs collapse numeric confidence to the visible gate value (0.950); replacing it with an ordinal enum5 enum restores a usable spread'
Section 8 Limitations: 'We do not include a fully supervised LayoutLMv3 baseline on Financial-80 because collecting a sufficiently labelled training set is not feasible'
Section 6.5: verifier 'served by vLLM on a single A100... No document, retrieval snippet, or prompt leaves the deployment environment'; no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: Applied LLM-systems paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: a locally hosted DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B verifier (LLM/local LLM/DeepSeek), retrieval-augmented classification (RAG/dense retrieval/embeddings), guided_ structured output, vLLM serving, and ~60% LLM-call reduction (efficiency/inference). It is not a pure domain application since RAG+LLM verifier methodology is the core contribution, but the task is document classification and half the evidence base is a private trade-finance corpus, capping relevance below core-methodology work. Novelty is moderate: cascade routing (FrugalGPT/CALM), kNN-Prompting, and Class-RAG precede it; the EDRM dual-signal memory (margin-weighted exemplars + Dirichlet confusion graph feeding distinguishing terms into verifier prompts) is the main incremental contribution. Rigor is solid for a systems paper: single-retriever/RRF/naive-HITL/zero-shot/DiT-equal-budget baselines, EDRM ablation, four-way configuration ablation, frozen-state protocol, and an honest three-run variance check, though single fixed seeds and no significance testing persist. Evidence is internally consistent (17.4pp and +23.3pp deltas, ablation numbers, and split arithmetic all check out) but unverifiable on the private corpus (per-class results withheld), and the oracle-match at exactly 0.9423 is not statistically supported. Generalizability is plausible (V3 config transferred to Financial-80 without recalibration) but shown on only two document-classification corpora. Reproducibility is limited: no code or prompt artifacts released, primary dataset private; only public Tobacco-3482 subset and open-weight models are replicable.

primary_link.title: HIRA: A Human-in-the-Loop Retrieval-Augmented Cascade for Document Classification in Regulated Industries

papers.summary: Document classification in regulated industries is constrained by data residency, limited cold-start labels, scarce review capacity, and costly model-governance procedures. We present HIRA, a training-free, on-premises retrieval-augmented cascade for document classification in regulated deployments that combines BM25 over OCR text, dense text embeddings, and image-level representations through validation-calibrated weighted reciprocal-rank fusion. Confident documents are classified directly by r
papers.summary_zh: 在金融等受規範產業，文件分類受資料落地、冷啟動標註稀缺、審核人力有限與模型治理成本所限，無法使用雲端 LLM API，也難以頻繁重訓。本文提出 HIRA，一個免訓練、地端部署的檢索增強級聯分類系統。第一層融合 BM25、MiniLM 與 SigLIP2 三種檢索訊號，以驗證集校準的加權倒數排序融合（RRF）評分，信心充足者直接分類；不確定或易混淆文件送交本地部署的 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 驗證器，其接收 OCR 文字、檢索範例、標籤描述與混淆區分詞；仍不確定者進入人工審核佇列。每次人工修正以邊際加權範例存入檢索索引，並更新 Dirichlet 平滑的混淆圖，全程不改動模型權重。在 80 類、30,233 份文件的私有貿易金融語料上，HIRA 僅請求 6.4% 人工修正，Macro-F1 從 0.6218 提升至 0.8548；在修正版 Tobacco-3482 上達 0.9423，較零樣本 LLM 高 17.4 個百分點，驗證器呼叫率僅約 40%，且標註 24.8% 資料即達全標註上限水準。限制包括私有資料僅能揭露彙總指標、缺少全監督基線。此系統為受規範環境提供免重訓、可稽核且節省標註的務實方案。

Section 4.5, Table 3: gap/overlap accuracy 86.38% (501/580) vs Claude Sonnet 4.6 direct-reading 87.76%, ChatGPT-5.3 72.93%, Gemini-3 65.17%; ground-truth SPARQL queries were rewritten into the induced ontology's vocabulary via ChatGPT-5.5.

Section 4.4 and Figure 8: 300 CQ-answer pairs generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6 and adjudicated by Qwen3-30B-Instruct judge against queries grounded in the system's own ABox vocabulary; 91% overall accuracy — a circularity risk not ablated.
Section 4.1: extended 100-contract corpus is synthetic, generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini-3, and ChatGPT-5.3 from 10 seed contracts; diversity assessed only via UMAP projection (Figure 6).
Section 2 and References: closest baselines (direct and multi-agent, Talukder et al. 2026a) are from the same author group; OLLM and LLMs4OL are discussed but never empirically compared.

Section 4 (Evaluation intro) and Conclusion: pipeline is claimed domain-agnostic but evaluated only on life insurance; cross-domain transfer explicitly deferred to future work; no per-stage ablation isolating the contribution of closed-vocabulary prompting or graph signals.

Section 1 and Section 3.2 (Stage 7): code/resources at github.com/brains-group/GrOIL with README; Stage 7 assembly is deterministic, but Stages 3-6 and ABox mining rely on proprietary LLM API calls (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), limiting full reproducibility.

Section 3.1: UDH formalism and document-to-graph conversion adopted wholesale from Talukder et al. (2026b); Stage 3 uses standard all-mpnet-base-v2 embeddings with agglomerative clustering, following established practice.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric ontology induction paper squarely within the LLM + knowledge-graph/RAG preference space: LLMs are used as bounded mediators with closed-vocabulary prompting inside a seven-stage graph-grounded pipeline, with provenance annotations and hallucination mitigation as explicit design goals. Relevance is solid but it is a single-domain (life insurance) engineering contribution rather than core language-model methodology. Novelty is moderate: UDH graphs are adopted from prior work (Talukder et al.), closed-vocabulary LLM population is extended from Norouzi et al., and the pipeline is largely a careful synthesis of known components; the main new artifacts are the end-to-end TBox+ABox provenance chain and a 100-contract synthetic dataset. Rigor is mixed: evaluations are broad (CQ coverage, keyphrase coverage, gap/overlap, growth curves) and failures are honestly reported (Equivita RAG), but there are no stage ablations, no external ontology-learning baselines (OLLM, LLMs4OL discussed but not compared), and both primary baselines come from the same group. Evidence strength is capped by evaluation circularity: CQs are generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6 and judged by Qwen3-30B against SPARQL queries written in the system's own induced vocabulary (Section 4.4), and benchmark queries for the gap/overlap test were rewritten via ChatGPT-5.5 (Section 4.5); the 100-contract corpus is itself LLM-generated synthetic data. Generalizability is explicitly unvalidated beyond insurance (Section 4: transfer 'leaving empirical validation to future work'). Reproducibility benefits from a public GitHub repo and deterministic final assembly, but intermediate stages depend on proprietary, non-versioned-by-default LLM APIs, so the 'deterministic reproducibility' claim is only partial. Overall a competent, above-midpoint LLM-application paper with real quantitative support but limited external validity and self-referential evaluation.

primary_link.title: GrOIL: Graph-Grounded Domain Ontology Induction with Constrained LLM Mediation

papers.summary: Constructing formal ontologies from domain documents requires simultaneously enforcing corpus grounding, vocabulary consistency, axiom-level expressivity, and end-to-end provenance, a combination no existing automatic system delivers. We present a seven-stage graph-grounded pipeline that converts domain documents into a complete, auditable Web Ontology Language (OWL) Terminological Box (TBox) without any unconstrained generation step. Documents are first encoded as Unified Discourse-Hypergraphs
papers.summary_zh: 從領域文件自動建構正式本體，須同時滿足語料依據、詞彙一致性、公理表達力與端對端可追溯性，但現有系統難以兼顧。本文提出 GrOIL，一個七階段、以圖為基礎的本體歸納管線：文件先轉為統一論述超圖（UDH），擷取實體參與關係與論述依賴；後續階段將圖證據轉換為類別階層、具型別的物件與資料屬性及限制公理。LLM 僅被允許執行窄範圍、以圖為依據的仲介任務，如叢集命名、領域與值域判定、類別擺放，並以封閉詞彙提示在生成時強制輸出合法術語；每個輸出術語皆附完整決策鏈溯源，並配有 ABox 個體填充流程以支援 SPARQL 功能評估。在人壽保險領域，本管線於能力問題（CQ）覆蓋率上超越直接生成與多代理基線（0.85 對 0.63 與 0.62；0.77 對 0.40 與 0.44），關鍵詞覆蓋率達 86–89%，與手工建構的參考本體相當；在缺口與重疊分析上達 86.38%，接近最強 LLM 直接推論（87.76%）。本體成長曲線顯示詞彙於規模擴大後趨於飽和。限制包括僅在保險領域驗證，跨組織本體對齊與本體評估仍是開放問題。此研究展示 LLM 作為受限的語意裁決角色，可產生可稽核、可重現的領域本體。
papers.title: GrOIL: Graph-Grounded Domain Ontology Induction with Constrained LLM Mediation
papers.title_zh: GrOIL：以圖為基礎之領域本體歸納與受限 LLM 仲介

links.title: BanglaVeilGuard: Cross-Script Safety Benchmarking and Lightweight Guardrails for Bangla Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: guarded runs reduce attack success under deterministic response scoring from 93.8-100.0% to 6.3% for Claude Opus 4.8, BanglaLLama, and TituLLM; TigerLLM-1B with BanglaVeilGuard achieves 78.2% accuracy with 8.8% ASR

Section 3.2: benchmark of 2,366 rows (1,664/348/354 train/dev/test) harmonized from XSafety, MultiJail, Multilingual-Vuln-LLMs, and BIDWESH, with rule-based transliteration, noun-only substitution, and spelling-noise variant generation
Section 3.4: balanced multinomial logistic model over char 3-6-gram and word 1-2-gram TF-IDF features with thresholds tau_u=0.43 and tau_q=0.45 selected on the 348-row development split
Section 4.3, Table 6: BanglaVeilGuard attains 88.5% unsafe recall vs 55.2% (Qwen3Guard-Gen-4B) and 41.7% (NVIDIA Nemotron-SG-8B), at a 20.0% safe false-positive rate and 68.8% conservative rate

Section 4.5: guarded Claude, BanglaLLama, and TituLLM each reach 73.3% over-refusal on dialectal prompts; Section 5 acknowledges Claude responses frequently hit the 128-token limit, possibly inflating automatic ASR
Section 5: four of six language forms are controlled rule-based transformations of shared standard-Bangla seeds; per-form Wilson intervals are wide; no human safety annotation yet performed

Reproducibility gap: no explicit code or benchmark release statement found anywhere in the document; Sections 3.5-3.6 describe deterministic scoring rules and validation checks but no availability claim
llm_evaluation.rationale: Genuinely in-scope LLM safety research: a Bangla-first jailbreak/prompt-injection benchmark plus a lightweight pre-generation prompt gate evaluated on four LLM families. It matches the LLMs, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences, though not the highest-weighted agents/reasoning/Japanese-LLM clusters. Novelty is moderate: the six-form cross-script framing is a useful angle, but the benchmark largely harmonizes existing resources (XSafety, MultiJail, Multilingual-Vuln-LLMs, BIDWESH) with rule-based variants, and the guard is a TF-IDF logistic classifier behind established guard-model ideas (PolyGuard, CultureGuard). Rigor is mixed: held-out split, dev-tuned thresholds, two prompt-guard baselines, and Wilson CIs are present, but the entire evaluation rests on deterministic phrase-based refusal scoring with no human validation, generation budgets differ across model families, and identical 48.4%/100% numbers for BanglaLLama and TituLLM in both modes are unexplained. The authors honestly flag the Claude 128-token truncation confound and the high 39.3-44.4% over-refusal cost. No public code/data release is stated, limiting reproducibility despite detailed method specification.

primary_link.title: BanglaVeilGuard: Cross-Script Safety Benchmarking and Lightweight Guardrails for Bangla Large Language Models

papers.summary: Bangla large language model (LLM) safety is difficult to evaluate with English-centric or standard-script benchmarks because Bangla users routinely write across scripts, spellings, code-mixed forms, and regional registers. This paper presents BanglaVeilGuard, a compact Bangla-first safety benchmark and lightweight prompt guard for six language forms: standard Bangla, Romanized Bangla, Banglish, code-mixed Bangla--English, noisy Bangla, and dialectal Bangla. The benchmark contains 2,366 quality-f
papers.summary_zh: 孟加拉語使用者日常混用多種書寫形式，包括標準孟加拉文、羅馬拼音、Banglish、孟英夾碼、錯字變體與方言，但現有安全評估多為英文中心，難以反映此類表面變化，導致有害請求可能繞過過濾，而無害的方言或口語請求又可能被過度拒絕。本文提出 BanglaVeilGuard，一個涵蓋六種語言形式的孟加拉語優先安全基準（2,366 筆提示與 354 筆保留測試集），搭配輕量提示防護閘門：先對原始提示做非破壞性多視圖正規化（Unicode、羅馬化提示、夾碼與雜訊視圖），再以字元與詞彙 TF-IDF 特徵訓練的提示風險分類器，於生成前依門檻決定拒絕、複核或放行，無須修改目標模型權重。實驗顯示，加上防護後 Claude Opus 4.8、BanglaLLama 與 TituLLM 的攻擊成功率從 93.8–100.0% 降至 6.3%，TigerLLM-1B 達 78.2% 準確率與 8.8% ASR，88.5% 的不安全召回率明顯高於 Qwen3Guard-Gen-4B 與 Nemotron-SG-8B 等基線。主要代價是方言與雜訊良性提示的過度拒絕（方言最高 73.3%），且四種形式為規則生成、各形式樣本偏小。此研究凸顯低資源語言的安全評估必須考量表面形式變異，對多語 LLM 部署具參考價值。
papers.title: BanglaVeilGuard: Cross-Script Safety Benchmarking and Lightweight Guardrails for Bangla Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: BanglaVeilGuard：孟加拉語大型語言模型的跨書寫系統安全基準與輕量防護欄

links.title: SSDi8: Accurate and Efficient 8-bit Quantization for State Space Duality

evidence: Abstract: claims FP16-comparable accuracy with up to 1.4x speedup in W4A8/W8A8 and code at https://github.com/cau-hai-lab/SSDi8
Table 1 (Sec 1): quantizing SSD layers per-tensor drops 2.7B accuracy from 63.8% to 58.4%, motivating architecture-specific design
Table 2 (Sec 5.1): SSDi8 8B W8A8 avg 70.2% vs Quamba2 69.8% and FP16 70.7%; 2.7B W4A8 62.6% vs Quamba2 62.1%
Table 3 (Sec 5.1): WikiText2 PPL 8B W4A8 7.62 vs Quamba2 7.94, FP16 7.25
Sec 5.2/Fig. 4: 1.47x speedup over FP16 and 1.38x over Quamba2 on 2.7B (B=32, L=2048); Table 4 shows consistent Orin NX 16G gains across L=256-2048
Table 5 (Sec 5.3): reformulation enables 1.32x latency with PPL degradation below 0.1; Table 6: mean correction lifts LAMBADA 67.2%->67.4% at ~1-2% overhead
Table 7 (Sec 5.4): Nemotron-H-8B-Reasoning hybrid avg acc 73.0% vs FP16 73.1%, SSD latency 19.834ms -> 9.156ms
Table 13 (Appendix H): FP16 PPL rises to 113.407 at 6k tokens while SSDi8 stays 8.943-9.36 across 2k-14k, a notable but unexplained stability claim
Appendix A: Proposition 1 proves MSE(x_scaled) <= MSE(x) under uniform-noise and sparsity assumptions with stated mildness discussion
Appendix D: calibration uses 512 Pile samples, GPTQ for 4-bit weights, Hadamard fusion, gamma migration, correction factor 0.15
Minor inconsistency: Table 2 lists 2.7B W4A8 avg 62.6% while Table 8 lists 62.7%
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope efficiency paper: post-training INT8 quantization of Mamba-2's SSD internals for language models, matching 'Scaling & Efficiency' (quantization, latency, throughput), 'Transformer Architecture' (Mamba/SSM), and 'Inference & Serving' preferences, though it lacks the highest-weight topics (LLM methodology, agents, reasoning, Japanese NLP). Novelty is genuine but incremental: it extends Quamba2 by quantizing internal SSD computations via a persistent INT8 path, sparse-aware reformulation, and per-channel mean correction; the Appendix A proof is a straightforward uniform-noise MSE argument. Rigor is solid: three model scales (1.3B/2.7B/8B), FP16/Quamba/Quamba2/HAD baselines, six zero-shot tasks, WikiText2/Pile perplexity, component ablations (Tables 5-6, 10-11), calibration sensitivity (Tables 14-15), and edge (Orin NX) plus hybrid (Nemotron-H-8B) validation. Evidence is detailed, but accuracy gains over Quamba2 are modest (~0.5-1.2 avg points), there are minor inconsistencies (Table 2 reports 2.7B W4A8 avg 62.6% vs Table 8's 62.7%; abstract's 1.4x vs text's 1.47x), no variance/error bars, and the striking long-context FP16 PPL blowup in Table 13 is reported but not investigated. Method is tightly tailored to SSD structure, limiting generalizability beyond chunked SSM/hybrid models, though Table 7 demonstrates transfer to a Mamba-Transformer hybrid. Code release and detailed hyperparameters (512 Pile calibration samples, GPTQ + Hadamard, correction factor 0.15, k=7 bit-shift gating) support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: SSDi8: Accurate and Efficient 8-bit Quantization for State Space Duality

papers.summary: Recent advances in sequence modeling have highlighted Mamba as a state space architecture offering efficient long-range dependency modeling and providing a viable alternative to Transformers. Building upon this, Mamba-2 introduces the Structured State Space Duality (SSD), which integrates recurrent and attention modes to achieve efficiency and scalability. However, this architectural expansion substantially increases memory and latency overhead, underscoring the need for efficient compression st
papers.summary_zh: Mamba-2 的 Structured State Space Duality（SSD）結合遞迴與注意力模式，雖提升擴充性，卻加重記憶體與延遲負擔。直接套用為 Transformer 設計的量化方法（如 Hadamard 旋轉或 GPTQ）於 SSD 層會造成嚴重精度損失，原因包括頭維度與每頭維度統計分佈迥異、跨模組反覆呼叫的維度變動激活，以及大量與矩陣乘法交錯的逐元素乘法。本文提出 SSDi8，首個為 SSD 設計、維持完整 INT8 路徑的後訓練量化框架：透過稀疏感知重構，把 LUT_state 的縮放從 B 移到 X，使逐元素乘法脫離浮點路徑；沿群組軸 G 提前量化 B、C 並跨模組重複使用；將遞迴狀態以 INT32 直接轉為 INT8 儲存，搭配位移運算完成 Decay 的定點量化；另引入基於逐通道誤差均值的校正項，於輸出投影層施作以補償累積誤差。在 Mamba-2 1.3B、2.7B、8B 上，SSDi8 的零樣本準確率與 WikiText2 困惑度皆優於 Quamba2 並逼近 FP16，SSD 延遲相較 FP16 最高加速 1.47 倍，ChunkScan 與 StatePassing 分別達 1.77 倍與 2.25 倍，且於 Orin NX 邊緣裝置與長上下文（2k–14k）場景維持穩定。部分模組仍需 FP16，W4A4 因硬體因素未納入。此方法讓 Mamba-2 在資源受限環境下的部署更具可行性。
papers.title: SSDi8: Accurate and Efficient 8-bit Quantization for State Space Duality
papers.title_zh: SSDi8：為 State Space Duality 提供精準且高效的 8 位元量化

links.title: GenomeHarness: Harnessing Al Agents for Reliable Adaptation of Genome Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 52 model-task settings, GenomeHarness improves mean test MCC in 47 settings, including 24 of 26 DNABERT2 settings and 23 of 26 NTv2-100M-Multi settings.'

Section 2.5: 'Recipe freezing marks the boundary between search and final evaluation... both the root recipe and the GenomeHarness-selected recipe are trained under the same final protocol with random seeds {42,43,44}'; Section 2.4 Eq.(1): 'The test set is never used to compute search rewards.'

Section 2.2: 'A compact operational summary is provided in Supplementary Note S1, and a no-agent grid search ablation is provided in Supplementary Note S2' - the key control's results are not present in the main text.
Section 3.1: 'We used Codex powered by GPT-5.5 as the agent, with the intelligence setting configured to Extra High'; fixed 1 hour launch budget per task on four NVIDIA L20 GPUs.

Section 3.3: 'On average, GenomeHarness completed 43 trials for DNABERT2 on the NT Benchmark, 57 trials for DNABERT2 on Genomic Benchmarks, 36 trials for NTv2-100M-Multi on the NT Benchmark, and 54 trials...'; during search 'all trials use search seed 42' (Section 2.3).

Table 3 / Section 3.2: largest gain on human_ocr_ensembl where DNABERT2 root is '0.2504 ± 0.2313' vs GenomeHarness '0.5343 ± 0.0093' (Δ=0.2839), indicating recovery from unstable root recipes rather than uniform gains.
Data and code availability: 'The datasets and codebase used in this work can be accessed at https://github.com/ai4nucleome/GenomeHarness.'

Discussion, limitations paragraph: 'this study focuses on sequence classification tasks using two pretrained backbones, so broader validation is needed on longer-sequence tasks, variant effect prediction, regression objectives, and multimodal genomic settings.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic-LLM system (Codex/GPT-5.5 agent proposing recipe edits, harness enforcing protocol locking and test isolation, MCTS controller with progressive widening and reservation penalty) for fine-tuning recipe search on genome language models. The methodology centrally matches the high-weight Agents & Tool Use and Training & Optimization preferences, but the target models and benchmarks are biology foundation models, diluting topic relevance. Rigor is moderately good: 52 model-task settings across two backbones and two benchmark families, validation-only selection with test access only after freezing (Sec. 2.5), final evaluation with three seeds {42,43,44}; the reported 47/52 improvements are internally consistent with Tables 2-3 (24/26 DNABERT2, 23/26 NTv2). Key weaknesses: the decisive no-agent/grid-search control is deferred to Supplementary Note S2 with no results shown, search uses only seed 42 with ~36-57 trials per task creating selection-on-validation risk (validation-test alignment also relegated to supplementary), no statistical significance tests, and the largest gains occur precisely where root recipes are unstable (e.g., human_ocr_ensembl 0.2504->0.5343), leaving open whether budget-matched random search would achieve similar recovery. Novelty is incremental relative to cited AlphaEvolve/AutoHarness/VCHarness and prior agent-based AutoML; the specific MCTS-over-recipe-lineages design with asynchronous reservation is a reasonable but not groundbreaking combination. Code and public benchmarks are released, aiding reproducibility, though the proprietary GPT-5.5 agent with a fixed 'Extra High' setting limits exact replication. Authors honestly scope limitations to two classification-only backbones.

primary_link.title: GenomeHarness: Harnessing Al Agents for Reliable Adaptation of Genome Language Models

papers.summary: Pretrained genome language models provide reusable representations for DNA sequence analysis, but turning them into reliable downstream predictors remains non-trivial. Their practical performance depends strongly on fine-tuning recipes, and default recipes reported in prior studies may be suboptimal for new tasks or model backbones, making weak downstream results difficult to interpret. These requirements place a substantial operational burden on many intended users, whose expertise is often cen
papers.summary_zh: 預訓練基因體語言模型（如 DNABERT2、Nucleotide Transformer）為 DNA 序列分析提供可重用表徵，但其下游表現高度依賴 fine-tuning 配方；文獻預設配方對新任務或新骨幹往往不夠最佳化，微調還涉及資料準備、環境建置、算力管理與失敗診斷等操作負擔，令以生物問題為主的學者難以可靠應用。本文提出 GenomeHarness，一套代理式調適框架：AI 代理（以 GPT-5.5 驅動的 Codex）提出並修復可執行的配方編輯；harness 負責協議鎖定、資源管理、試驗記錄與測試集隔離，於凍結前嚴禁存取測試資料；蒙地卡羅樹搜尋（MCTS）控制器則在配方譜系間分配搜尋預算，每任務限定一小時啟動窗口，最終以三個隨機種子完成評估。在 NT Benchmark 與 Genomic Benchmarks 共 52 個模型—任務設定中，GenomeHarness 於 47 個設定改善平均測試 MCC，DNABERT2 平均 MCC 於 NT 基準從 0.6087 升至 0.6489，Genomic Benchmarks 從 0.6606 升至 0.7391；增益在根配方不穩定或錯配的任務最顯著，如 human_ocr_ensembl 由 0.2504±0.2313 提升至 0.5343±0.0093。限制包括搜尋受配方軸與算力預算約束，且僅驗證序列分類任務。此工作顯示微弱的下游結果未必代表模型能力不足，並為生物學者降低調適門檻。
papers.title: GenomeHarness: Harnessing Al Agents for Reliable Adaptation of Genome Language Models
papers.title_zh: GenomeHarness：運用 AI 代理可靠調適基因體語言模型

links.title: Beyond Success and Failure: Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents

evidence: Abstract: proposes LACL-GUI, 'a contrastive RLVR framework that incorporates trajectory-level quality signals', claiming +2.8% over GRPO and +2.7% over REAL on 8B backbone.
Table 1: LACL-GUI-8B achieves 50.0% overall on OSWorld vs. Qwen3-VL-8B-REAL 47.3% and Qwen3-VL-8B-GRPO 47.2%; LACL-GUI-4B 44.5% vs. REAL 43.0%, GRPO 42.2%.
Sec 4.2.1 / Table 2: incremental ablation from prompt baseline 42.7% to 47.2% via architecture components (GRPO), with LACL-GUI objective adding +2.8% to reach 50.0%.

Sec 4.2.2 / Tables 4-5: mechanism evidence - average successful trajectory length 9.13 (REAL) to 8.19 (LACL-GUI, -10.3%) and failed 29.87 to 26.72 (-10.5%) on tasks with identical outcomes, though VLC (+115%) and VS Code (+51.7% failed) are exceptions.

Sec 4 Implementation: 'We report the best checkpoint selected according to evaluation performance across training iterations'; single run, no variance or significance reporting; 8 H100 GPUs, lambda=1.0, epsilon=0.03, Theta=0.85.
Appendix A.2.1: evaluation uses 222 of 369 OSWorld tasks, excluding Chrome and Multi-app tasks due to environment instability, limiting comparability to standard OSWorld numbers.
Sec 3.3.3 / Fig. 3: divergence estimation uses SSIM against the shortest successful reference with threshold Theta; sensitivity over 0.80-0.90 yields 49.5/50.0/49.9% overall.

Sec 5 Conclusion: only OSWorld evaluated; 'Future work will explore more adaptive trajectory quality estimation strategies and extend to broader interactive environments'; no code or data release mentioned anywhere.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically focused paper on RL-based training of GUI (computer-use) agents, squarely within the 'Agents & Tool Use' and 'Reinforcement Learning' preferences; it builds a contrastive RLVR objective (on top of REAL) with length-aware positive perturbations and SSIM-based divergence-aware negative perturbations, plus a simple but correct first-order invariance theorem. The contribution is incremental over REAL/CLIPO/ConSPO contrastive RLVR and existing length/credit-assignment work, but the zero-mean logit modulation with theoretical justification is a genuine twist. Rigor is moderate: matched GRPO/REAL baselines, component ablation (Table 2), threshold sensitivity (Fig. 3), and trajectory-length analyses (Tables 4-5) that directly probe the mechanism are strengths; however, results are single-benchmark (a 222-task OSWorld subset excluding Chrome/Multi-app tasks), gains are small (~2.7-2.8 pts, ~6 tasks out of 222) with best-checkpoint selection and no seed variance or significance testing, and SSIM stepwise alignment against a shortest-success reference is a potentially brittle heuristic. Evidence is plausible but not statistically strong. Generalizability is limited to OSWorld with Qwen3-VL backbones; broader environments are explicitly future work. Reproducibility is mixed: hyperparameters and task subset are documented, but no code release and training relies on Baidu's proprietary RLE environment.

primary_link.title: Beyond Success and Failure: Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents

radar.summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents powered by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for automating tasks across diverse digital environments, where reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant training paradigm. However, widely used methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) suffer from reward-gradient misalignment, leading to inefficient and unstable optimization. Recent work addresses this issue by reformulating RL with verifiable rewards (
radar.summary_zh: 以 Multimodal LLM 驅動的 GUI 代理普遍採用強化學習訓練，但 GRPO 存在獎勵與梯度錯配問題；近期將 RLVR 重構為對比或分類目標的方法（如 REAL）雖提升穩定性，卻僅依賴結果層級監督，無法區分同一結果類別內的軌跡品質差異。本文提出 LACL-GUI，一個納入軌跡層級品質訊號的對比式 RLVR 框架：對成功軌跡施加長度感知的 logit 擾動，偏好簡潔執行；對失敗軌跡則引入分歧長度概念，以 SSIM 相似度與參考成功軌跡逐步比對，統計偏離後的錯誤步數，越早分歧的失敗受越強抑制，接近成功的失敗則保留為具資訊性的負樣本。擾動採零均值設計，理論證明一階上與 REAL 目標不變，僅重塑組內梯度分配。系統採解耦非同步架構，配合成功軌跡緩衝區與軌跡過濾。在 OSWorld 222 個任務子集上，以 Qwen3-VL-Thinking 4B/8B 為骨幹，LACL-GUI-8B 整體成功率達 50.0%，較 GRPO 與 REAL 分別提升 2.8 與 2.7 個百分點，成功軌跡平均長度較 REAL 縮短 10.3%。限制為長度縮減在部分應用域不均勻，且評估排除了 Chrome 與多應用任務。此研究顯示軌跡層級的細緻監督能在維持 RLVR 穩定性的同時，進一步提升 GUI 代理表現。

links.title: Width-Independent Compressibility of Deep Neural Networks

evidence: Abstract: 'We prove a uniform compressibility theorem for deep multilayer perceptrons with analytic activations... The reachable compressed width is strikingly independent of the original width, but is O((log(1/eps))^{d_in})'
Section 1 (Assumption 1 discussion): 'This assumption does not hold for ReLU. Extending the construction to ReLU would require a separate approximation argument and is left for future work.'

Section 6 Discussion: 'Our construction (and associated numerical results) serves as a proof of existence and is not necessarily practical as-is. In particular, it is compute- and memory-expensive to evaluate the high-order derivative features.'

Section 5 Numerics: deep compression instantiated on a randomly initialized [2,1024,1024,1024,1024,2] network with d_in=d_out=2; every hidden layer compressed from 1024 to 66 neurons at k=10, errors at float32 noise floor

Appendix G / Table 1: 'Assumption 4 is violated for all trials (especially at layer 2, R/rho is at least 3)'; per-seed task-preserving widths 21-66 on a trained [2,512,512,512,1] sigmoid MLP on a toy 2D target
Section 6, item 2: LLM relevance is speculative only ('There has been a tendency to train LLMs with low precision...'); no LLM or transformer experiments anywhere in the paper
Appendix B.3: 'The maximum-volume search is combinatorial and infeasible even for modest D and d_l... practical implementations can instead use polynomial-time rank-revealing column selection.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A careful pure-theory paper proving a uniform, width-independent compression theorem for deep MLPs with analytic activations via input-derivative matching, composed layer-wise in backward order. Topic fit to the stated preferences is modest: the core subject is generic neural-network compression theory, matching only the lower-weight Scaling & Efficiency preference (compression, pruning, quantization, distillation); LLMs appear only as motivation (Section 1/3 cite GPTQ, SliceGPT, ShortGPT), and there are no language-model or transformer experiments or methods. The mathematical contribution is genuinely novel relative to its tensor-moment predecessor (Section 3), with an explicit algorithm and non-vacuity analysis (Appendix D). Rigor is high: assumptions are explicit, proofs are provided, limitations are candidly stated (ReLU excluded per Assumption 1 discussion; forward order lacks guarantees per Appendix C.1; algorithm is compute/memory-expensive per Section 6). Evidence strength is limited: numerics are only on random MLPs and a toy 2D regression task, with sample-based sup-norm estimates and no baseline comparisons, though the trained-network experiments honestly disclose that Assumption 4 is violated for every seed (Appendix G, Table 1). Generalizability to modern practice is constrained by the analytic-activation requirement and the binomial(d_in+k, d_in) width cap, which the paper itself notes becomes 10^3-10^6 for image-like intrinsic dimensions (Section 6). Reproducibility is moderate: Algorithm 1, full protocol, seeds, and per-seed diagnostics are given, but no code release is stated and the maximum-volume selection step is combinatorially infeasible (Section B.3).

primary_link.title: Width-Independent Compressibility of Deep Neural Networks

radar.summary: It has long been known that well-trained neural networks can be compressed very strongly without affecting their performance, an important phenomenon that remains poorly understood. We prove a uniform compressibility theorem for deep multilayer perceptrons with analytic activations. For a deep, wide fixed teacher network, there exists a narrow (same depth) network that approximately represents the same function as the original. The reachable compressed width is strikingly independent of the orig
radar.summary_zh: 本文針對深層多層感知器（MLP）建立統一壓縮定理：對於使用解析型激活函數（如 sigmoid、tanh、GELU）的已訓練網路，可建構深度相同但寬度極窄的網路，在有界輸入域上以一致的 sup-norm 誤差近似原函數，壓縮後寬度為 O((log(1/ε))^d_in)，僅取決於誤差預算 ε 與有效輸入維度，與原始寬度無關。核心技術為新穎的「導數匹配」：在原點匹配所有 k 階以內的輸入導數，利用 Cauchy 不等式將 Taylor 展開尾項誤差控制在幾何衰減率 (R/ρ₀)^(k+1)；再透過秩縮減與權重重算，保留至多 D_k 個神經元。作者證明單層壓縮定理與逐層反向壓縮的深層定理，並以 sigmoid 與 GELU 網路實驗驗證幾何誤差衰減，甚至在理論半徑條件不滿足的訓練後網路上仍觀察到實用的寬度縮減。限制方面，理論僅適用於解析型激活函數（不含 ReLU）、假設固定教師網路，且高階導數特徵的計算與記憶體成本高昂，方法偏向存在性證明而非即用工具。此結果暗示網路的有效複雜度主要取決於資料維度而非寬度，為實務壓縮提供函數層級的理論憑證，對彩票假說與大型模型的訓練後壓縮具啟示意義。
radar.title: Width-Independent Compressibility of Deep Neural Networks
radar.title_zh: 深度神經網路的寬度無關可壓縮性

links.title: From Association to Causation: Improving Retrieval Precision of Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Causal Relations and an Attention Mechanism

evidence: Abstract & Section 3.4: proposes training-free re-scoring rule s_c(d)=cos(E(q), v_B(d)) over residual keyword set B, with negligible complexity overhead and no extra LLM calls at query time

Section 3.2, Remark 1: authors explicitly state the causal graph use is 'structural and motivational rather than inferential' and the score 'is not an identified causal estimand', limiting the strength of the causal claim
Section 4.2 (Table 1): single-query case study on a proprietary 471-document enterprise KB; target guideline promoted from rank 6 to top-3 under the re-ranker

Section 4.4 (Table 2): controlled synthetic 8-theme diagnostic corpus; mean target rank improves 2.88→1.25 with semantic absorption while a trained cross-encoder (BGE-reranker-v2-m3) yields 2.63; no statistical significance testing reported

Section 4.5 (Table 3): negative result on SciFact/NFCorpus/ArguAna — nDCG@10 0.157/0.136/0.213 vs. baseline 0.642/0.317/0.398; cross-encoder strongest on all three; fallback variant indistinguishable (empty-B fraction ≤0.4%)
Section 4.6 (Table 4): corpus-level regime gating via 30 labeled probes and 2,000-draw bootstrap achieves ≥95% correct-disable reliability on BEIR and 100% correct-enable on the diagnostic corpus
Section 4.3: reproduction testbed (Qwen3-4B generator/translator + BGE-M3 embeddings) with code and experiment scripts claimed publicly available at github.com/Silk-Road/causal-rag-rerank
Section 5: limitations include regime dependence, dependence on keyword extractor quality, and incomplete ablation of interpolation weights and threshold τ
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope RAG-for-LLM methodology paper: it proposes a training-free terminal-retrieval re-ranker derived from a collider/causal-graph analysis (Reichenbach common cause) of the retrieval process, matching the RAG&Knowledge, LLM, and causal-reasoning preferences, though it is not about LLM reasoning or prompting methodology per se. The core mechanism reduces to removing query-similar (semantically absorbed) keywords from a candidate and scoring the residual keyword centroid against the query; the causal framing is acknowledged by the authors themselves as 'structural and motivational rather than inferential' and 'not an identified causal estimand' (Remark 1), which caps novelty at a useful reframing rather than a new capability. Rigor is creditable: honest negative results, ablations (exact vs. semantic absorption, hybrid, empty-B fallback), a failed per-query gating attempt reported, and a bootstrap-evaluated corpus-level gate. However, positive evidence is thin: one single-query case study on a proprietary 471-document KB (Section 4.2, Table 1) and an 8-theme synthetic diagnostic corpus (mean target rank 2.88→1.25, Table 2), with no end-task generation-quality evaluation and no significance testing; on three BEIR benchmarks the method degrades sharply below the similarity baseline (nDCG@10 0.157/0.136/0.213 vs. 0.642/0.317/0.398, Table 3), so applicability is explicitly narrow (keyword-stuffing regime only), bounding generalizability. Reproducibility is moderate: hyperparameters (τ=0.6, top-15/top-10 TF-IDF terms, 4096/512 chunking) and a fully local Qwen3-4B/BGE-M3 testbed are specified, and code availability is claimed (Section 4.3, github.com/Silk-Road/causal-rag-rerank), but the link is unverifiable and the proprietary KB cannot be released.

primary_link.title: From Association to Causation: Improving Retrieval Precision of Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Causal Relations and an Attention Mechanism

radar.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM generation on retrieved documents, but the standard terminal retrieval stage--dense-vector similarity, optionally followed by reranking--often returns documents that share keywords with the query without containing the needed information, a failure mode that grows with the knowledge base. We trace it to a conceptual gap: similarity captures only associational relations, whereas the documents that matter are linked to the query causally. We model t
radar.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）的終端檢索通常以向量相似度排序，隨知識庫擴張，只含查詢關鍵字卻未含答案的「關鍵字堆疊」文件容易被檢出。本文以 Reichenbach 共同因原則對檢索過程本身建立因果圖：查詢與文件共享的關鍵字集 A 是共同因，文件的剩餘關鍵字集 B 連結到理想輸出；檢索到的文件是碰撞節點（A→d←B），因此檢索本身即開啟查詢與 B 的關聯路徑，據此提出免訓練的重排序規則：以查詢向量與 B 加權質心向量的餘弦相似度評分，並以語義吸收把近義關鍵字併入 A。在真實 471 份企業知識庫中，方法將真正相關的跨境資料評估指南從第 6 名提升到前 3 名；在受控診斷語料上，目標文件平均排名由 2.88 進步至 1.25，而訓練過的 cross-encoder reranker 幾乎無效（2.63）。但在 SciFact、NFCorpus、ArguAna 三個 BEIR 基準上，本方法低於相似度基準，劃出適用邊界：它守護的是關鍵字堆疊情境，並非通用排名改進。作者另提出語料層級校準閘門，以少量標註探針查詢以至少 95% 可靠度決定是否啟用。限制包括依賴關鍵字擷取器品質，且因果圖屬結構性啟發論證而非因果效應估計。
radar.title: From Association to Causation: Improving Retrieval Precision of Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Causal Relations and an Attention Mechanism
radar.title_zh: 從關聯到因果：以因果關係與注意力機制提升 RAG 檢索精確度

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope empirical study of LLM generation behavior (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek-V3, Phi-4) under a 2x2 prompt x response language design, touching high-weight LLM and prompting preferences but not the top subareas (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLM). Strengths: mixed-effects model with question random intercepts (Section 5.2), token/char/log robustness checks, chunk-averaged LaBSE check, per-model heterogeneity reporting, and unusually honest confound disclosure (tokenizer fertility, truncation, prompt-cue asymmetry). Weaknesses: the headline 52% 'translation compression' effect is acknowledged to be contaminated by token-cap truncation and tokenizer fertility (Appendix D: 110 truncated responses, 69% in Norwegian-output cells), the 2x2 is confounded because only cross-lingual conditions carry explicit language cues (Appendix B), one generation per cell, and mixed question provenance (Tulu/Copilot/manual) is untested. Single English-Norwegian language pair with 68 questions limits generalization. Data/code/template availability supports reproduction. A modest but methodologically careful analysis with partially confounded headline claims.

primary_link.title: Investigating the Influence of Prompt and Response Languages on LLM Content Generation

radar.summary: This study examines how prompt and response language influence the behavior of large language models. Using five models, we evaluated answers to 68 non translation questions across four language conditions: English to English, English to Norwegian, Norwegian to Norwegian, and Norwegian to English. After removing refused items, the dataset contains 1348 responses. We measure length differences with Cohen d, semantic fidelity with LabSE cosine similarity, and cross lingual keyword overlap with bot
radar.summary_zh: 本文探討提示與回應語言如何影響大型語言模型（LLM）的生成行為。研究以 DeepSeek V3、GPT-4o、Phi-4、Claude 3.5 Haiku 與 Gemini 2.5 Pro 五個模型，對 68 道涵蓋倫理、文化、健康與社會的非翻譯問題，在英→英、英→挪威語、挪→挪、挪→英四種條件下測試，得到 1,348 則回應，以 Cohen's d、LaBSE 餘弦相似度、資訊密度與原始／軟性 Jaccard 分析。主要發現：英文提示改用挪威語回應的壓縮在字數上達 52%（d≈1.32），但以 token 計僅 25%，顯示部分壓縮源自挪威語在英文中心分詞器上的較高 fertility；固定回應語言時，挪威語提示使回應平均縮短 37%–41%，混合效應模型的提示×回應交互作用極為顯著（z≈25.6），效應符號在不同組合間甚至反轉。各模型效果高度異質（d 從 0.78 到 4.42）；語義相似度維持約 0.83，原始 Jaccard 僅 0.02 而軟性 Jaccard 達 0.53，證實模型以概念改寫而非直譯。限制包括 token 上限造成截斷偏差、單一語言對，以及資訊密度近乎是長度的反指標。語言選擇並非中性參數，對多語提示工程具實務意涵。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-for-code application paper: prompt-engineered zero/one-shot repair of Unity/XR performance bugs using five off-the-shelf LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-3.5, Code Llama, DeepSeek-Coder, StarChat-beta), matched to Code & Programming and Prompting preferences, but the core contribution is a domain-specific dataset (104 bugs, 23 XR repos) and customized static analyzers rather than new LLM methodology. Evaluation is multi-pronged (static analysis, CodeBLEU vs author-written references, small manual inspection, Wilcoxon tests, bootstrap CIs, prompt-component ablation, data-leakage check on 9 post-cutoff bugs), yet the headline superiority over Self-Repair rests on fix rate while the correctness metric (CodeBLEU 0.664 vs 0.667) is explicitly not statistically significant, and manual validation covers only 8 bug types with one case each. Generalizability is limited to Unity/C# and 10 bug types, acknowledged by the authors. Code availability on GitHub supports reproducibility, though API-model nondeterminism and partially author-graded metrics temper this.

primary_link.title: XRFix: Exploring Performance Bug Repair of Extended Reality Applications with Large Language Models

radar.summary: As an emerging technology, Extended Reality provides end-users with an immersive experience of interacting with virtual and physical environments. Unlike traditional software, the execution of XR applications involves more computationally complex operations, such as 3D scene rendering, real-time animation, and process simulations. Inefficient coding practices during the software development of XR applications may cause various performance bugs, degrading user experience and even causing motion s
radar.summary_zh: 延伸實境（XR）應用涉及 3D 渲染與即時動畫等高計算負載，低效程式碼易造成效能問題，但長期缺乏資料集、偵測與修復工具。本文提出 XRFix，一個基於大型語言模型的自動程式修復（APR）框架：先從 23 個開源 Unity XR 專案蒐集 104 個真實錯誤，歸納十種 XR 錯誤類型（如 Update 中實例化與銷毀物件、剛體設定錯置等）；再針對 C# 腳本與 asset 檔案客製化 CodeQL 與 UnityLint 兩套靜態分析工具，新增偵測規則達 90.4% 精確率；最後設計單行、函式與類別三種層級的提示模板，評估五種 LLM 的零樣本／單樣本修復能力。結果顯示 GPT-4o 搭配提示 c 達 67.3% 修復率，比次佳方法高 7.7 個百分點，也大幅優於 AlphaRepair、微調 CodeT5 與 Self-Repair；消融研究顯示「錯誤說明」元件貢獻最大，更換註解風格反而降低效能。限制包括僅涵蓋 Unity 與十種錯誤類型、部分錯誤可能涉及資料洩漏（作者以截斷日期後的九個錯誤佐證結論仍成立），且未處理視覺與屬性類問題。此研究為 XR 軟體品質與 LLM 輔助程式修補開啟新方向。
