links.title: Do Large Language Models Perform Well on Comprehending Poetic Logic in Modern Chinese Poetry?

evidence: Abstract: 'we propose Peony, the first benchmark specifically designed for evaluating the poetic logic of modern Chinese poetry... We evaluate these models under both non-thinking and thinking configurations.'

Section 3.1: 'Peony contains 800 modern Chinese poems in total' built from AIGenPoetry, 'released in November 2025, after the reported knowledge cutoff dates of all evaluated models' to mitigate memorization.

Section 3.2 / Appendix A: 'we use DeepSeek-V4-Pro to generate initial mask positions and distractor candidates... Professional poets subsequently review all candidates and substantially revise or replace the vast majority'; authors note in Section 6.1 that DeepSeek models 'do not consistently outperform' others on the tasks it helped annotate.
Table 2: Gemini 3 Pro (thinking) averages 74.01 accuracy vs 46.98 for GPT-5.1 (non-thinking); thinking configs generally outperform non-thinking counterparts.
Table 3: Perfect Rate lags accuracy sharply, e.g., DeepSeek-V4-Pro IMF accuracy 72.93 vs PR 59.95; highest SNI PR is only 30.77 (Gemini 3 Pro).
Appendix F (Table 15): expert mean 51.44 vs non-expert 41.28 on a 40-poem sample, below the best model's 74.01; the paper does not reconcile this with its claim of revealing LLM 'limitations'.
Appendix C (Table 11): STO option-order permutation ablation shows stable scores (GPT-5.1: 39.08/39.45/39.68), supporting low positional bias.

Limitations: benchmark covers '800 works by six contemporary poets', does not evaluate cultural interpretation or aesthetic judgment, and findings 'should not be generalized to genres such as classical Chinese poetry, haiku, or Arabic poetry'.

Abstract/Conclusion: 'Our data and code will be available' is a promise only; evaluation prompts are fully given in Appendix B (Tables 6-9) with 'developer-recommended default parameters' for commercial models.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation benchmark (Peony) for 'poetic logic' in modern Chinese poetry, with four multiple-choice tasks (STO, LIO, IMF, SNI) across line/stanza/imagery levels. It squarely targets LLM comprehension and thinking-vs-non-thinking reasoning behavior, plus benchmark construction, giving solid but not top-tier preference relevance: it lacks the highest-weighted preference areas (Japanese LLM/NLP, agents, code, RAG, safety) and is a niche literary-domain benchmark rather than a general language-methodology advance. Novelty is moderate: it is plausibly the first benchmark formalizing poetic logic for modern Chinese poetry (Table 12 contrasts it with classical-poetry and detection benchmarks), though benchmark papers are incremental and prior work (Wang et al. 2026 on ChatGPT and modern Chinese poetry) exists. Rigor is respectable: balanced answer positions (Table 10), an option-permutation ablation (Table 11), contamination mitigation via post-cutoff poems (Section 3.1), three-run averaged results, expert-revised LLM-assisted annotation (Section 3.2), and a human baseline (Appendix F). However, no significance testing is reported, and a serious validity tension is left unexplained: the best model (Gemini 3 Pro, 74.01) far exceeds the expert mean (51.44), which undercuts the paper's framing that results 'reveal the limitations of current LLMs'. Evidence strength is moderate: extensive quantitative tables (Tables 2, 3, 15) and case studies (Appendix G) support the accuracy-vs-Perfect-Rate gap and thinking-mode gains, but small human samples (9 readers, 40 poems), absent confidence intervals, and unsupported claims like 'validate the effectiveness and necessity of Peony' weaken it. Generalizability is explicitly limited by design (six poets, one genre; Limitations section disclaims extension to classical or other poetry). Reproducibility is middling: full curation and evaluation prompts are provided, but data/code availability is only promised ('will be available') and evaluation relies on commercial APIs with only 'developer-recommended default parameters'.

primary_link.title: Do Large Language Models Perform Well on Comprehending Poetic Logic in Modern Chinese Poetry?

radar.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved significant progress across a wide range of natural language processing (NLP) tasks, yet their ability to understand literary texts, particularly modern Chinese poetry, remains largely unexplored. The unique literary characteristics of modern Chinese poetry necessitate a distinct form of reasoning for effective comprehension. Unlike conventional texts that convey clear information, the unique "poetic logic" of modern Chinese poetry requires a holistic r
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）對現代中文詩的理解仍缺乏系統性評估。現代詩依賴隱含聯想、意象與情感推進，需要超越表面語義的「詩性邏輯」整體推理。本文提出首個針對現代中文詩詩性邏輯的基準 Peony，收錄六位當代詩人 800 首作品，選用較新語料以降低記憶與檢索洩漏，並將詩性邏輯操作化為三個層級四項任務：詩節排序（STO）、詩行排序（LIO）、意象填空（IMF）與句子推斷（SNI），題目與干擾選項皆經專業詩人審訂與重寫。研究在非思考與思考兩種設定下評估多個主流模型。結果顯示所有模型皆有明顯侷限：思考模式的 Gemini 3 Pro 最佳（平均 74.01），非思考模式以 Kimi-K2.5 最強（59.89）；SNI 最難，最佳模型的 Perfect Rate 也僅 30.77；IMF 準確率較高但 Perfect Rate 遠低於準確率，顯示模型能處理單一意象，卻難協調詩內多重意象與跨句的邏輯連貫；錯誤多源於依賴字面意義、無法跟隨情感推進與文化指涉。限制包括樣本僅 800 首六位詩人、未涵蓋文化詮釋與開放式隱喻分析，且結論不宜類推至古典詩等其他文類。此基準為 LLM 文學理解開啟新研究面向。
radar.title: Do Large Language Models Perform Well on Comprehending Poetic Logic in Modern Chinese Poetry?
radar.title_zh: 大型語言模型能否理解現代中文詩的詩性邏輯？

links.title: PUMA: A Polish Benchmark for Culturally Grounded Multimodal Understanding

evidence: §1 Contributions: PUMA is 900 hand-crafted tasks; claimed first Polish-language benchmark jointly evaluating image, audio, and document understanding, combining culturally grounded and practical tasks (ASR, OCR, structured extraction).

§3.2 Grading: deterministic binary 'strict score' plus auxiliary 'soft score' with seven verification rule types (Include/Exclude/Regex/Order for QA; WAcc, TEDS-based OCR, JSON-schema comparison for other tasks).

Table 1: Gemini-3.1-Pro highest mean strict score 79.7 across 900 tasks; Table 2: ElevenLabs-Scribe-V2 best ASR strict score 81, Whisper-Large-V3 (63) beats newer Qwen3-ASR (24) and Cohere-Transcribe (46); Table 3: Claude-Fable-5 best OCR strict score 90 vs best specialized model Chandra-OCR-2 at 45.

Appendix F: manual audit of 600 QA responses per run (Gemini-3.1-Pro, Gemini-3-Flash, MiMo-V2.5, GPT-5.5+GPT-Audio) found rule-related false negatives in 3-6 of 600 questions (~0.5-1.0%), supporting the reliability of rule-based scoring.

Appendix E: sound & music QA hardest (best model 56%); multi-speaker recordings drop ASR from 72.2% to 47.1% while Speech QA is unaffected; all six analyzed models score lower on scans/photographs than born-digital documents.

Ethical considerations (Benchmark usage and data release): 'only a subset of the dataset will be publicly released. The full benchmark will remain private,' which limits independent verification despite the open-source evaluation app (github.com/OPI-AILab/puma-app) and public HuggingFace space.

Limitations: annotator group homogeneous in age/experience, no quantitative inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's kappa/Krippendorff's alpha deemed inapplicable), rule-based evaluation restricts open-ended tasks; ASR/OCR normalization relies on an external LLM (Gemini 3 Flash) described in Appendix A.1/A.2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A carefully executed Polish multimodal benchmark (900 hand-crafted tasks across images, audio, documents) evaluating frontier and open-weight LLMs/VLMs with deterministic rule-based scoring. It matches the evaluator's LLM-evaluation, multimodal-AI, and benchmark/evaluation preferences (Tables 1-3, Appendix G cover 50+ models), but it is not a Japanese-LLM, reasoning, or agent contribution, and it is an evaluation artifact rather than a language-methodology advance, capping preference relevance. Research quality is solid: annotation guidelines and review phase (Appendix H: 28 tasks replaced, 57 revised), manual error audit showing only 0.5-1.0% rule-induced false negatives (Appendix F), and detailed ablations over audio quality, speaker count, and document type (Appendix E). Novelty is incremental since the culturally grounded multimodal benchmark template is established (CVQA, K-Viscuit, BLEnD-Vis cited in §2) and Polish text benchmarks (PLCC) already exist; the main new element is joint image+audio+document coverage with ASR/OCR/structured-extraction comparisons. Reproducibility is limited because only a subset of the dataset is public while the full benchmark remains private (Ethical considerations), though the evaluation app and prompts are open-sourced and well documented (§3.2, Appendix A).

primary_link.title: PUMA: A Polish Benchmark for Culturally Grounded Multimodal Understanding

radar.summary: Large language models are increasingly moving beyond text processing, adding support for other modalities such as images and audio. While text understanding and generation have been extensively studied, multimodal data processing capabilities, particularly in the context of cultures and languages other than English, have not yet been evaluated comprehensively. In this paper, we propose PUMA (Polish Unified Multimodal Assessment), a novel benchmark of 900 hand-crafted tasks designed to probe the
radar.summary_zh: 多模態大型模型在英語以外文化脈絡的能力評估仍不完整。本文提出 PUMA，首個針對波蘭語言與文化、整合影像、音訊與文件三種模態的 900 項手工設計任務基準，涵蓋九個類別：歷史文化、當代生活、地理環境、語音辨識（ASR）、語音問答、聲音與音樂問答、光學字元辨識（OCR）、文件問答與結構化擷取，採確定性規則驗證，無需外部評審，兼具可重現性與低成本。作者評估多個商用與開放權重模型及 50 多個視覺語言模型。頂尖商業模型明顯領先：Gemini-3.1-Pro 平均約 80% 最佳，GPT 家族受安全拒答影響表現；開源模型中 Gemma 4 與 Qwen3.5 在文件類別有可觀表現，但整體落後。最難的是聲音與音樂問答（最高僅 56%），顯示非語音音訊理解仍是缺口；ASR 上 2023 年的 Whisper-Large-V3 在波蘭語竟優於較新的開源模型；OCR 專用模型在嚴格指標下大幅落後大型模型。限制包括不含影片模態、規則式評估較適合封閉式任務，以及資料僅部分公開以避免洩漏。此基準凸顯在地化與文化根基評估對多模態 AI 進展的必要性。
radar.title: PUMA: A Polish Benchmark for Culturally Grounded Multimodal Understanding
radar.title_zh: PUMA：以波蘭文化為根基的多模態理解基準

links.title: Convergence in Science, Divergence in Religion: Calibrated Framing Differences Across Wikipedia's Language Editions

evidence: Abstract: 'the largest language-pair mean distance is 3.6 times the smallest' and 'Code, data, and per-language-pair calibration baselines are released' (GitHub link in Section 1)

Section 4.3: permutation test 'recompute[s] the calibration baseline b(i,j) inside every permutation' to avoid construction bias, plus-one Monte Carlo correction and Holm adjustment across four domain tests

Section 6.1 Table 4: religion effect falls from +0.0341 (Holm p=.007) under LaBSE to +0.0098 (Holm p=.369) under MPNet and +0.0043 (Holm p=.764) under CMLM, while science/tech remains below baseline under all three encoders; concept-rank Spearman rho=0.754 (MPNet) and 0.789 (CMLM) vs LaBSE
Section 6.3: Wikipedia and FLORES-200 parallel-text floors share structure at Spearman rho=0.79-0.82 (n=190, p<10^-41), though levels differ (0.215 vs 0.062)
Section 6.2: audit of 889 articles finds 13.3% bot/translation-flagged (Swahili 41.5%); excluding flagged articles shifts religion mean only from +0.034 to +0.032

Section 5.4 and Appendix Table 6: sacrifice and censorship stay in top-10 in 99.0% and 99.3% of 5,000 language-node bootstrap draws; pilgrimage (45.5%) and scripture (37.7%) are far less stable, so tiers rather than exact ranks are interpreted

Section 7 Limitations: 'we do not validate the metric against human ratings of semantic difference'; only lead sections analyzed; zh result reflects a transnational editor community, not a PRC-based perspective
llm_evaluation.rationale: A careful computational-sociolinguistics study of cross-lingual Wikipedia framing using multilingual sentence encoders (LaBSE, MPNet, CMLM), motivated by language-conditioned LLM behavior but containing no LLM, agent, or reasoning methodology; topical fit rests mainly on NLP (1.5) and embedding (1.8) preferences against heavily LLM-weighted ones. The calibrated per-language-pair baseline distance is a genuine, well-motivated methodological contribution for uncalibrated cross-lingual embedding comparisons. Rigor and evidence are strong: permutation tests that recompute the baseline inside each draw, three bootstrap designs, Mantel tests with Holm correction, three-encoder replication, bot/translation audit, leave-one-out calibration composition, and FLORES parallel-text validation, with unusually honest negative results (religion's significance is LaBSE-specific; 2D geometry is a poor fit and treated as diagnostic only). Main evidence gaps: no human validation of the metric, lead sections only, purposive concept selection, and the headline positive religion effect not replicating significantly. Code, data, baselines, and full concept inventory are released, supporting good reproducibility. High research quality partially offset by moderate preference alignment yields 0.60.

primary_link.title: Convergence in Science, Divergence in Religion: Calibrated Framing Differences Across Wikipedia's Language Editions

radar.summary: When Wikipedia's language editions describe the same concept, how differently do they frame it? Prior work measures coverage gaps between editions; we measure framing distance for matched concepts. We analyze 2,799 valid articles from 3,000 possible concept-language observations, spanning 150 Wikidata-anchored concepts, 20 language editions, 4 domains, and a calibration set. Raw embedding distances reflect both content differences and how well the encoder aligns each language pair. Even among ca
radar.summary_zh: 當維基百科不同語言版本描述同一概念時，框架差異有多大？既有研究多衡量覆蓋缺口，本文改為衡量「框架距離」：分析 150 個 Wikidata 錨定概念、20 個語言版本、四個領域（宗教、政治、科學科技、流行文化）加上校準集，共 2,799 篇有效文章。方法關鍵是「校準距離」：以化學元素、數字、顏色等文化負載極低的校準概念估計每個語言對的嵌入距離基線，再從原始距離扣除。此調整極為必要——校準基線跨語言對相差可達 3.6 倍且帶語系訊號，未校準會把編碼器對齊差異誤認為文化差異。結果顯示：LaBSE 下宗教類平均校準距離顯著高於基線（+0.034），科學科技類顯著低於基線；政治分歧集中於審查、難民等敏感概念，民主與人權則高度一致。以 MPNet 與 CMLM 複製時，領域與概念排序可重現（Spearman ρ=0.75–0.79），但宗教效應僅在 LaBSE 下顯著，屬編碼器相依；排除機器人與翻譯產生的文章影響甚微。限制包括未以人工評分驗證、僅分析導言、Swahili 覆蓋率低等。此方法有助判斷多語言模型的語言條件化行為究竟源自資料或模型本身。
radar.title: Convergence in Science, Divergence in Religion: Calibrated Framing Differences Across Wikipedia's Language Editions
radar.title_zh: 科學趨同、宗教分歧：維基百科各語言版本的校準框架差異

links.title: PatchGate: Narrowing the Verbalization Gap with Intrinsic Object Inventories in Frozen Vision-Language Models

evidence: Abstract: claims Cover 49.4→56.0 (+13.4%) and CHAIR 7.5→6.6 (−12.0%) on AMBER 'without external detectors or fine-tuning and with one extra forward pass'.
Sec. 4.2: honestly states 'Hal and Cog are not uniformly improved, so PatchGate does not dominate every AMBER diagnostic'; Table 2 shows Hal worsening 31.4→34.3.
Sec. 4.4 / Table 4: VEX evidence ranks hallucinations and omissions with AUROC 0.883/0.890 vs random 0.5, supporting the core mismatch claim.
Sec. 4.4 / Table 5: internal VEX beats GroundingDINO and RAM++ inventories (Cover 56.0 vs 51.3/50.9) with only +0.3 GB VRAM.
Table 7 (Sec. 4.4): consistent Cover/CHAIR gains across LLaVA-v1.5-7B/13B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InstructBLIP-7B.
Appendix 0.D Table L: continuous PCS outperforms thresholded RAM++ tags for omission diagnosis (AUROC 0.890 vs 0.616).

Appendix 0.A.3 Table B: full hyperparameters (layer range, α_esi=8, γ_ede=0.5, λ_QA=0.7), hardware/software versions; Appendix 0.A.2 states 'full implementation code and configuration files are provided in a separately submitted code archive'.
Appendix 0.E: acknowledged limitations — object-token-only evidence, single-token vocabulary, no attribute/relation/counting handling, and possible loss of descriptive detail.
Table C (Appendix 0.B): on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, PatchGate Precision drops 8.2 points (92.9→84.7) despite Recall gains, showing metric trade-offs.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A training-free VLM decoding framework (PatchGate) for object hallucination and omission in image captioning. Topic fit is moderate: it matches the Multimodal AI and Interpretability preferences (logit-lens readout of LM decoder patch states, probing internal evidence, decoding intervention on a frozen LLM backbone) and partially the RAG/knowledge 'hallucination/grounding' keywords, but it does not engage the highest-weight interests (LLM methodology per se, Japanese LLM/NLP, reasoning, agents); it is not pure CV since the method operates on language-model internals, so no out-of-scope cap applies. Research quality is solid: novelty is incremental but real — a signed 'evidence-verbalization gap' enabling two-sided (inclusion+exclusion) logit calibration built from prior techniques (logit lens, TTD largest-gap cutoff, MARINE-style guidance). Rigor is strong with component ablations (Table 6), hyperparameter sweeps (Table E/F), layer/aggregation ablations (Tables I/J), external-tagger comparisons (Tables 5/K/L), and four backbones (Table 7). Evidence is credible but imperfect: headline gains (Cover 49.4→56.0, CHAIR 7.5→6.6, Table 2; POPE Acc 82.0→89.8, Table 3) are supported by diagnostics (AUROC 0.883/0.890, Table 4), yet Hal worsens 31.4→34.3 and Qwen2.5-VL Precision drops 8.2 (Tables 2/C), results are single deterministic runs without significance testing, and some baseline results (e.g., Devils-in-Mid) look atypically degraded. Reproducibility is good: full hyperparameters (Table B), algorithms A/B, hardware/software versions, and a submitted code archive. Limitations (object-level only, single-token vocabulary) are candidly stated in Appendix 0.E.

primary_link.title: PatchGate: Narrowing the Verbalization Gap with Intrinsic Object Inventories in Frozen Vision-Language Models

radar.summary: Reliable image captioning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires captions to be both precise and complete, avoiding unsupported object mentions while covering visible objects. Existing training-free methods primarily address the former requirement, suppressing unsupported object words by intervening on model-predicted mentions during generation. Because they operate only on objects the model is already likely to mention, visible objects omitted from the output remain difficult to recover. We
radar.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLM）的圖像描述需同時精確與完整：既不虛構影像中不存在的物件（物件幻覺），也不遺漏可見物件（物件遺漏）。既有免訓練方法多在生成時抑制可能被提及的虛構物件，難以找回被略過的可見物件，或需依賴外部偵測器。本文提出 PatchGate，一個免訓練、免外部模組的兩階段框架：第一階段 VEX 在生成前僅以圖像做一次前向傳播，利用 logit lens 從 LM 解碼器後段層讀取 patch 層級詞彙證據，以 patch-confidence score（PCS）評分候選物件，並以自適應最大間距閾值建構與提示無關的物件清單；第二階段 VIED 依此清單校準解碼 logits——證據支持包含（ESI）提升有視覺證據卻未被言及的物件，證據不足排除（EDE）壓制視覺證據薄弱卻 logits 偏高的物件詞。在 LLaVA-v1.5-7B 上，AMBER 可見物件覆蓋率由 49.4 提升至 56.0（+13.4%），CHAIR 由 7.5 降至 6.6（−12.0%），POPE 精確率與召回率同步提升，增益在多個骨幹一致，僅增加約 0.38 秒與 0.3GB 記憶體。限制在於依賴內部物件清單品質，且僅處理物件層級、未及屬性與關係幻覺。此研究證明凍結 VLM 自身的內部證據可作為可靠的接地訊號。
radar.title: PatchGate: Narrowing the Verbalization Gap with Intrinsic Object Inventories in Frozen Vision-Language Models
radar.title_zh: PatchGate：以凍結視覺語言模型的內在物件清單縮小言語化落差

links.title: LëtzCross: A Cross-Lingual Page-Level Benchmark for Multimodal Retrieval over Luxembourgish Documents

evidence: Abstract: benchmark of 'Luxembourgish PDF documents, with document pages indexed as images and queries provided in English, French, German, and Luxembourgish'; page-image retrievers 'perform better across query languages in this system-level comparison'
Table 1 (Section 3): 579 QA pairs over 908 pages; 530 auto-generated text-focused vs 49 manual visually grounded

Section 3.3: automatic QA generated with GPT-5-mini and validated by Gemini-2.5-Flash/GPT-5-mini; '90.28% of the QA pairs were judged semantically equivalent... and 71.50% contained the exact literal gold answer'

Table 2 (Section 6.1): colqwen2.5-v0.2 avg nDCG@10 78.83 vs best text-only jina-embeddings-v4 75.76; authors note 'we interpret this as a practical system-level comparison rather than a controlled modality ablation'
Table 5 (Section 6.2): text+visual fine-tuning gains over text-only adaptation range 0.21 to 2.53 nDCG@10, all positive across settings

Table 6 (Section 6.3): EN+FR+DE multilingual FT averages 79.93 (-1.03 vs FT(FR)); EN+FR+DE+LB reaches 80.94 vs FT(FR) 80.96, with authors cautioning differences are 'comparable overall performance rather than a clear advantage'

Limitations: benchmark is 'relatively small', visually grounded subset limited, translated queries 'may introduce translation artifacts', findings 'specific to Luxembourgish and should be validated on other low-resource languages'

Section 5: training details 'temperature τ=0.02 and LoRA adapters (r=32, alpha=32, dropout=0.1)', '3 epochs with a learning rate of 5×10−5', 'effective batch size of 64 on 4 NVIDIA L40S GPUs', seeds 42/43/44; Section 1: 'We release LëtzCross and all experimental code and resources through our GitHub repository'
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope multimodal retrieval/RAG benchmark paper: cross-lingual page-level retrieval over Luxembourgish PDFs comparing OCR-based text embedders vs ColPali-style page-image retrievers, plus fine-tuning transfer studies. Preference relevance is moderate: strong alignment with RAG/retrieval, multimodal AI, benchmark/evaluation, datasets, and fine-tuning axes, but no core LLM-methodology, reasoning, agent, safety, or Japanese-NLP contribution; LLMs (GPT-5-mini, Gemini) are used only as data-generation/translation tools. Novelty is incremental: ColPali/ViDoRe-style page-image retrieval and multilingual CLIR exist; the contribution is a new low-resource-language benchmark and fine-tuning analysis. Rigor is above average for a benchmark paper (3 seeds with mean±std, 9 retrievers, visual-component ablation, efficiency measurements, explicitly framed as a system-level comparison, honest handling of the confounded multilingual-data-quantity issue), but weakened by a small benchmark (579 queries/908 pages, only 49 visually grounded QA), LLM-generated ground truth validated partly by the same model family (GPT-5-mini generates and judges semantic equivalence, Section 3.3), translated rather than independently authored queries, and no significance testing. Evidence quantitatively supports the scoped claims (Table 2: colqwen2.5-v0.2 avg 78.83 vs best text-only 75.76; Table 6: EN+FR+DE multilingual FT drops 1.03 avg, adding LB recovers to 80.94 vs FT(FR) 80.96), though differences within noise are appropriately flagged. Generalizability is explicitly limited to Luxembourgish per the Limitations section. Reproducibility is good: GitHub release of benchmark, code, and prompts, with detailed training configs (Section 5: LoRA r=32, lr 5e-5, 3 epochs, batch 64 on 4xL40S, seeds 42-44).

primary_link.title: LëtzCross: A Cross-Lingual Page-Level Benchmark for Multimodal Retrieval over Luxembourgish Documents

radar.summary: Recent page-image retrievers such as ColPali have improved retrieval over visually rich documents, yet little is known about how they behave in cross-lingual, low-resource settings. We introduce LëtzCross, a benchmark for cross-lingual page-level retrieval over Luxembourgish PDF documents, with document pages indexed as images and queries provided in English, French, German, and Luxembourgish. The benchmark combines text-focused QA pairs with visually grounded QA pairs, covering both textual and
radar.summary_zh: 本文處理跨語言、低資源情境下視覺豐富文件的檢索問題：頁面影像檢索器（如 ColPali）在這類情境的表現長期缺乏評估，而盧森堡語的 NLP 資源仍相當有限。作者建立 LëtzCross 基準，將 PDF 頁面以影像形式索引，查詢涵蓋英文、法文、德文與盧森堡語四種語言，並結合自動生成的文字型問答對與人工撰寫、以圖表等視覺元素為依據的問答對，共 579 個問答對、908 個頁面。實驗比較以 OCR 為基礎的純文字檢索器與 late-interaction 頁面影像檢索器，結果顯示 colqwen2.5-v0.2 與 colnomic-embed-multimodal-3b 在所有查詢語言皆優於文字基準；微調能跨查詢語言轉移，法文微調在盧森堡語查詢上平均表現最佳，多語言微調納入盧森堡語則帶來最強結果。限制包括基準規模較小、視覺子集僅 49 題、屬系統層級而非受控消融比較，且非英文查詢皆由英文翻譯而來，可能帶入翻譯偏差。此研究為低資源語言的頁面層級 RAG 檢索提供首個基準，凸顯影像檢索器在跨語言場景的實用潛力。

Section VI (Dataset validity): curated educational datasets may contain label noise and Common Core/calculus items 'heavily represented online' may inflate accuracy, possibly differently per model
Section II: paper concedes TokenPowerBench and ConsumerBench 'measure resource costs in greater depth than we do', positioning its contribution as a narrower controlled combination
llm_evaluation.rationale: Topically well-aligned LLM evaluation work: benchmarks three sub-5B open-weight LLMs (Gemma3:4b, Phi3:3.8b, Qwen3:4b) on mathematical reasoning with local inference and energy-efficiency metrics, hitting the LLM, reasoning, evaluation/benchmark, and inference/serving preferences. However, it is a preliminary, small-scale benchmarking exercise with limited methodological novelty (the paper itself concedes TokenPowerBench and ConsumerBench measure resource costs more deeply). Statistical practice is sound (McNemar+Holm, Wilson CIs, Cohen's h, matched question sets, failure-mode separation), but major confounds remain: a single shared prompt template possibly disadvantaging Phi3 (0.025 accuracy on Grade 8 with an acknowledged uninvestigated prompt-format alternative), Qwen3 tested only in /no_think mode, one prompt/sampling configuration, non-standard curated datasets with contamination risk, and unspecified repeated runs. Evidence is internally documented with tables and CIs but key artifacts (per-question measurements, model digests, hardware/software identifiers) were not retained. Reproducibility is poor: code and datasets are explicitly not releasable. Generalizability is honestly scoped to one workstation, one domain, one framework.

primary_link.title: More Accurate or More Efficient? Evaluating Locally Deployed Compact Open-Weight Language Models for Mathematical Reasoning

radar.summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed on local hardware for privacy, cost, and accessibility reasons. Yet many evaluations emphasize accuracy while fewer quantify local runtime and energy, characterize failure modes, or apply paired statistical comparisons under controlled conditions. This paper presents a controlled, documented procedure for evaluating locally hosted LLMs on mathematical reasoning. It combines fixed inference settings, hierarchical answer extraction and verification,
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益部署於本地硬體以兼顧隱私、成本與可及性，但多數評估偏重能力與準確率，少有量化本地執行時間與能耗、刻畫失敗模式，或在受控條件下進行配對統計比較。作者提出一套受控、可文件化的評估流程，結合固定推論設定、階層式答案抽取與驗證、明確的失敗模式分類（錯誤答案、抽取失敗、硬性失敗）與逐題資源量測，並以 McNemar 檢定（Holm 校正）、Wilson 信賴區間與 Cohen's h 報告準確率差異。研究在單一工作站以 Ollama 執行三個 5B 參數以下的開放權重模型（Gemma3:4b、Phi3:3.8b、Qwen3:4b），涵蓋八年級數學、微積分 I 與進階機率統計。結果顯示沒有單一模型全面勝出：Qwen3:4b 在兩個資料集準確率最高，Gemma3:4b 領先微積分；但 Gemma3:4b 每瓦時正確答案數約為 Qwen3:4b 的三倍，後者每題生成 token 數與 GPU 能耗高出三到四倍。Phi3:3.8b 準確率遠低於另兩者，極低的抽取失敗率顯示是答案錯誤而非解析失敗，但作者保留提示格式影響的警告。限制包括屬初步研究、僅單一硬體配置、評估產物未公開，以及 Qwen3:4b 關閉思考模式。此研究說明選擇本地模型不能只看準確率，還需權衡能耗與效率。

radar.title_zh: 更準確還是更省電？本地部署小型開放權重語言模型之數學推理評估

IV), fabricated-looking references ('Anonymous (2023) Gemini: openai's multimodal language model, arXiv:2306.12345', refs [1]-[3]), text/table mismatches (Sec. VIII cites Table IV for T=0.9 results that appear in Table V; Table III described as including Mistral-7B but omits it), and an internally contradictory statement that higher Non-Feasible 'coincides with a substantially higher rate of feasible answers' (Sec. IX, 80.33% Non-Feasible). Threats to validity (Sec. primary_link.title: On Predicting Vulnerability Severity Using In-Context Learning: An Industrial Case Study

radar.summary: Modern software systems require earlier and more scalable vulnerability severity assessment to reduce exposure to high-impact security flaws. Security analysts typically assign CVSS scores, but this manual triage does not scale with the growth of disclosed vulnerabilities and often depends on cloud LLM services that raise confidentiality concerns. This paper presents an industrial case study on predicting CVSS v3.1 scores directly from vulnerable C/C++ snippets using in-context learning with loc
radar.summary_zh: 漏洞的 CVSS 嚴重程度評分通常由安全分析師人工完成，難以隨揭露漏洞數量擴展，而使用雲端 LLM 又有機密性與合規疑慮。本文以產業案例研究探討：能否透過情境學習搭配可本地部署的開源 LLM，直接從易受攻擊的 C/C++ 程式碼片段迴歸預測 CVSS v3.1 分數。作者先比較專有資料與公開 Big-Vul 資料集，顯示兩者 CVSS 分布在 4–8 分區間重疊、與 Kenna 調整分數的相關性相似，支持以 Big-Vul 作為產業資料的代理建構提示測試台。接著系統性變化情境配置（C1–C3）、序列長度、溫度與 shot 數，評估 CodeLlama2-7B、CodeLlama2-13B、Mistral-7B、gpt-oss，並以 GPT4o-mini 作為雲端參考，指標包括 MSE、不可行輸出率與超出範圍比例。結果顯示中型開源程式碼模型表現最佳，尤其 CodeLlama2-7B 在三 shot 搭配限制輸出格式的 C3 提示時，MSE 約為 7 且幾乎無不可行輸出，逼近雲端模型表現；GPT4o-mini 在 C3 下更準但需雲端部署。限制包括 Big-Vul 函數級標籤可能含雜訊、訓練資料汙染風險、僅涵蓋 C/C++ 與彙總分數。此研究為重視隱私的產業嚴重程度分流提供實用的本地方案。
radar.title: On Predicting Vulnerability Severity Using In-Context Learning: An Industrial Case Study
radar.title_zh: 以情境學習預測漏洞嚴重程度：一項產業案例研究

links.title: Variance Driven Exploration: A Provable and Efficient Methodology for Pure Exploration in Highly Stochastic Environments

evidence: Section 5.1 / Table 2: VarDE–BAI achieves lowest error probability in all four BAI benchmarks (e.g., 12.87% vs best baseline 15.64% UGapE2 in BAI.1) averaged over 20,000 independent runs.

Appendix F.1.1 / Table 3: component ablation shows full VarDE at 1.84% error at 2000 pulls vs Weight-Only 5.07% and Var-Only 13.09%; Table 4 shows sensitivity to temperature tau exceeds variance floor.

Appendix A.1–A.7 and B–D: complete proofs including min-pulls guarantee (Lemma A.1/B.2) yielding Theorem 4.5 exp(-cT) BAI error bound; Section 4.3.3 concedes the RL guarantee is asymptotic, not fixed-budget.
Appendix F.1.2 / Tables 5–7: first-order variance surrogate underestimates full LSE variance by up to 88.7% at tau=0.05 but tightens for moderate tau, quantifying the acknowledged approximation gap.
Section 6 Limitations: first-order approximation, unstable early variance estimates, trajectory coupling and bootstrapping violate the independence assumption, and no finite-sample BPI bound.
Section 5 Common protocol / Appendix F: code available at https://github.com/luongkhang04/VarDE; hyperparameters, seeds 0–9, run counts (10–20,000), and evaluation protocols fully specified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solid classical RL/bandit theory paper on variance-aware pure exploration (BAI, MCTS, best-policy identification). It matches only the mid-weight Reinforcement Learning preference (exploration/exploitation, Q-learning, MCTS); no LLM, Japanese NLP, reasoning, agents, safety, or other high-weight preference content, so topic relevance is modest. Quality is genuinely good: a unified decision-variance minimization principle with influence-weighted allocation is a fresh framing, full proofs are supplied (min-pulls guarantee, exponential BAI/MCTS error bounds, asymptotic Q-learning convergence), the BAI evaluation uses 20,000 runs with recent strong baselines (Continuous Rejects, MF-BPI/O-BPI), and includes component ablations, sensitivity grids, and a quantified first-order approximation study. Rigor has minor gaps: adaptive-sampling conditioning in Theorem 4.5 is unstated and one Hoeffding display is miswritten; the variance decomposition assumes independent components, which the paper itself concedes is violated under trajectory coupling (Section 6). MCTS and BPI results are figure-only claims on small synthetic/tabular domains; no deep RL or function approximation. Reproducibility is strong: public code link, full pseudo-code, tuned hyperparameters, seeds, and run counts. Score reflects good research quality dampened by narrow preference alignment.

primary_link.title: Variance Driven Exploration: A Provable and Efficient Methodology for Pure Exploration in Highly Stochastic Environments

radar.summary: We propose Variance Driven Exploration (VarDE), a principled approach for pure exploration in highly stochastic environments, where the exploration process is dominated by stochastic variance. VarDE is built on a fundamental principle: sampling effort should be allocated to minimize the uncertainty of the final decision. We formalize the uncertainty of the final decision through a smooth decision function and derive allocation rules that explicitly capture how stochastic noise in individual comp
radar.summary_zh: 純探索問題要求在資料收集過程不計回報，只求最終決策可靠，例如選出最佳臂、最佳根節點動作或最佳策略。既有方法多以樂觀界線（信心上界、淘汰規則、熵正則化）分配樣本，但主要調控各元件的局部估計誤差，未顯式量化不確定性如何傳播到最終決策，在高隨機、異質變異數環境中容易把雜訊誤當證據。作者提出 VarDE，核心原則是將抽樣努力分配給最能降低最終決策不確定性之處：把最終決策視為局部經驗估計的平滑決策函數，以一階敏感度取得影響權重，結合經驗變異數導出貪婪規則，選擇使決策變異數下降最大的元件。此方法論統一應用於三個場景：最佳臂識別（以 LogSumExp 平滑近似 max）、蒙地卡羅樹搜尋與最佳策略識別的 Q-learning（以 TD 目標變異數捕捉隨機性）。理論上證明決策變異數以 O(1/t) 衰減、BAI 與 MCTS 的誤認機率呈指數衰減、Q-learning 以機率 1 收斂至最佳策略。實驗顯示 VarDE 一致優於 UCBE、UGapE、Successive Halving、UCT、MENTS/TENTS 及模型基礎與無模型 BPI 基準，且在高隨機環境增益最大。限制為一階近似在學習初期可能不穩、RL 保證屬漸進性質。此研究確立以決策層級不確定性最小化為核心的統一探索框架。
radar.title: Variance Driven Exploration: A Provable and Efficient Methodology for Pure Exploration in Highly Stochastic Environments
radar.title_zh: 變異數驅動探索：高隨機環境中可證明且高效的純探索方法

links.title: Counterfactual Quotient Models: Learning What Actions Change, Not What the World Does

evidence: Abstract: CQM treats action-conditioned futures as equivalent when differing only by a component shared across actions and claims decision sufficiency, identifiability, common-mode invariance, and regret properties.

Section 3.5 and Algorithm 1 (CQM-B): paired-rollout objective using common random numbers with centering applied as the final layer so the quotient constraint holds for every parameter value; Section 3.6 admits CQM-H (density-ratio via outcome-conditioned classifier) is not evaluated.

Section 4.4: matched architectures (two width-128 layers, 16-dim action embedding, 8-dim bottleneck), AdamW lr 3e-4, batch 256, 4,000 updates, seeds 7-11, 20,000 training / 4,000 test states, baselines described as 'controlled proxies' not exact reproductions.

Section 4.6 Tables 1-3: CQM-B accuracy 0.9998/0.9553/0.6411/0.3134 vs world model 0.2521/0.2598/0.2693/0.2989 (Cartpole/Reacher/Cheetah/Walker); Walker effect NMSE 1.0453 with overlapping CIs, explicitly treated as a negative or stress-test result.

Section 4.3 Remark 2: evaluation measures best first action for unseen linear rewards under a uniform continuation policy and 'should not be read as evidence that the learned model solves the standard DM Control objective'.

Section 4.1 (eqs. 18-19): four DM Control state-based domains augmented with a 64-dim autonomous process mixed via a fixed random orthogonal matrix; Section 6 Limitations: requires resettable simulator with synchronized branches, only five seeds, finite action prototypes, no pixel/real-robot/native-return evaluation, no code availability stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A pure model-based reinforcement learning / representation-learning paper with no language-model methodology, so it only matches the mid-weight Reinforcement Learning preference (successor representations, world models, value equivalence) and not the high-weight LLM/language preferences. Research quality is solid: the quotient-of-successor-measures formulation with a canonical centered signed representative is a genuinely novel learning target, the theory (duality, identification, common-mode cancellation, rank bound, 2W-delta regret bound) is carefully stated with honest caveats, and the experimental protocol is fair (matched architectures ~79-82k params, held-out reward queries, 5 seeds with 95% CIs, a frankly reported negative Walker result). Evidence is bounded by synthetic augmentation of state-based DM Control, short H=12 horizon, finite action prototypes, linear-reward-only queries, and proxy baselines; applicability is narrow because training requires resettable simulators with synchronized branches, and the density-ratio alternative (CQM-H) is proposed but never evaluated. No code release is claimed. Competent and novel within RL, but low topical fit to the curator's core program.

primary_link.title: Counterfactual Quotient Models: Learning What Actions Change, Not What the World Does

radar.summary: Reinforcement-learning models commonly predict complete future states, observations, or feature occupancies, even though action selection depends only on differences between the consequences of candidate actions. As a result, these models may devote substantial statistical and representational capacity to high-dimensional phenomena that evolve independently of the agent's current choice. We introduce the Counterfactual Quotient Model, which treats action-conditioned futures as equivalent when th
radar.summary_zh: 強化學習的世界模型通常預測完整的未來狀態、觀測或特徵，但動作選擇其實只取決於候選動作後果之間的差異，導致大量統計與表示容量耗費在與當前動作無關的現象上（如光照、天氣、背景運動）。作者提出反事實商模型（CQM），把僅差一個跨動作共同成分的動作條件化未來視為決策等價：其標準化中心化表示移除共同成分，同時保留被建模獎勵族可表達的所有成對動作比較，理論上建立效應—價值對偶、可識別性、共同模式不變性、低秩界與決策後悔保證。實作上，模型從同步反事實 rollout 直接學習動作相關效應，以共同隨機數使共享隨機雜訊在函數近似之前逐樣本抵消，並採低秩架構使輸出在建構上滿足商約束。實驗在四個 DM Control 環境加入 64 維自主干擾動態：CQM 在 Cartpole 幾乎完美、Reacher 達 95.5% 保留動作準確率，遠勝同等大小的絕對世界模型與 successor features；雖無獎勵監督，仍與獎勵感知基準相當；但 Walker 顯示固定秩八瓶頸在接觸豐富動態下的容量限制。其他限制包括需要可重置並同步分支的模擬器、有限動作原型、僅用狀態觀測與五個種子。此研究說明智慧體只需建模動作改變了什麼，即可支撐選擇。
radar.title: Counterfactual Quotient Models: Learning What Actions Change, Not What the World Does

links.title: Calibrate What You SHIP: Post-Selection Risk Control for Verifier-Guided Text-to-Image Generation

evidence: Abstract: pooled-candidate threshold yields released risk 0.310 whereas SHIP reduces it to 0.162 on GenEval2 with FLUX at N=16; fixed-grid certificate has no target crossing across 200 cached-stream splits.
§2: 'We therefore do not claim policy-level calibration or its confidence bounds as new' — contribution framed as T2I-specific estimand analysis and evidence, with BOKBO cited as closest prior.

§3.4: Hoeffding bound with Bonferroni δ/|T| over a prespecified grid; 'The confidence construction is not our methodological claim'; adaptive-policy operating points treated as descriptive due to M|T| rollout cost.
§4.1 Protocol: 400/400 calibration/test prompts, α=0.30, δ=0.10; main-table rows use pointwise Hoeffding bounds that 'do not inherit Proposition 2'.
§4.2: pooled threshold risks 0.310/0.361/0.328 across sequential/Flash-BoN/rewriting; one-candidate-per-prompt sensitivity gives 0.196 vs policy calibration 0.162 (Table 5).
Supp Table 12: fixed-grid SHIP (201 thresholds) mean risk 0.148, 0/200 crossings, vs pointwise 0.226 with 2/200 crossings.
Supp Tables 18-19: human audit atomic loss 0.112→0.076, any-failure 0.380→0.280; annotation reliability Cohen's κ=0.460, PABAK 0.760, Gwet's AC1=0.865.
Supp Table 16 and §4.4: cross-backbone transfer holds risk below budget but SDXL coverage falls to 0.113 and SD3 requires recalibration at risk 0.303.
Supp Table 13: baseline reproduction fidelity for ProbeSelect/Flash-BoN/RAISE/ADE-CoT with relative gaps −4.9% to +6.8%.

Supp §J / Table 22: subgroup risk 0.398 for 9-10-atom prompts at 0.05 coverage; paper concedes average-only control and VLM-defined loss limits ('human audit corroborative rather than a human-risk certificate').
llm_evaluation.rationale: A statistically careful T2I reliability paper, not a core LLM/NLP/agent work. Preference relevance is moderate: the deployment domain is image diffusion (low-weight, exclusion-adjacent), but the pipeline is built on language methodology (Qwen2.5-VL/Qwen3-VL/InternVL3 judges define risk via next-token probabilities on atomic yes/no questions, plus prompt rewriting), so the 0.20 out-of-scope cap for diffusion-without-language-methodology does not strictly apply; strongest matches are Multimodal AI, Red-Teaming/Evaluation (VLM-as-judge), and inference-time scaling. Novelty is honest and incremental: the paper explicitly disclaims the statistical tool (§3.4: 'The confidence construction is not our methodological claim') and prior policy-level calibration (§2, BOKBO/SAFER/TRON), contributing a T2I-specific estimand analysis (prompt-reweighting vs within-prompt decomposition, Prop 1) and a simple limiting lower bound (Prop 3). Rigor and evidence are the paper's strengths: transparent split of pointwise Hoeffding operating points (headline 0.310 vs 0.162, which 'do not inherit Proposition 2', §4.1) from the fixed-grid certificate (0/200 crossings, mean risk 0.148, Supp Table 12), calibration-unit sensitivity (Table 5), independent-stream replication (Table 6), judge swap (Table 11), cross-backbone results including failures (SDXL coverage 0.113, SD3 recalibration at 0.303, Table 16), baseline reproduction fidelity (Table 13), and a human audit (0.112→0.076 atomic loss) with only moderate Cohen's κ=0.460. Generalizability is limited in demonstrated scope to image generation/editing; valid certification for threshold-dependent adaptive search is left open, and risk is average-only. No code release is stated despite a detailed protocol.

primary_link.title: Calibrate What You SHIP: Post-Selection Risk Control for Verifier-Guided Text-to-Image Generation

This creates a candidate-to-policy calibration mismatch: search changes both which prompts receive an output and which candidate is released, so candidate-level risk control need not imply control of released-output risk. We formalize this estimand shift through prompt reweighting and within-prompt selectio
radar.summary_zh: 驗證器引導的文生圖系統越來越多以測試期搜尋在多個候選中選取、精煉或停止，但釋出門檻常以個別影像校準，形成「候選到政策校準錯位」：搜尋同時改變哪些提示會獲得輸出（提示重新加權）與釋出哪張影像（提示內選擇），因此候選層級風險控制未必保證已釋出輸出的風險受控。作者提出 SHIP，在保留提示上執行或重播完整部署政策，以獨立的目標裁判模型評估實際釋出影像，選出風險上界符合預算的最寬鬆門檻；對預先指定門檻網格的可重播政策，同步信心控制提供有限樣本有效性。實驗涵蓋固定、循序與自適應推論程序（Flash-BoN 錦標賽、RAISE 精煉、提示改寫、ProbeSelect 軌跡選擇、ADE-CoT 影像編輯）：在 GenEval2 搭配 FLUX、N=16 時，合併候選門檻的釋出風險為 0.310，SHIP 降至 0.162；跨 200 個快取串流切分，固定網格憑證無目標超越；人類審核亦確認改善。機制分解顯示提示重新加權是主要錯位來源。限制包括門檻相依的自適應搜尋僅能描述性評估、需忠實重播、控制平均而非子群組風險。此研究主張可靠度應以完整部署政策誘導的輸出分布校準。

links.title: Closed-loop AI achieves certifiable engineering design

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): framework 'orchestrates large language models(LLM) with deterministic engineering backends in a closed loop', establishing the agent-framework core of the contribution.

Methods, 'The AI Engineer orchestrator' (Pages 15-16): schema-validated tool invocation, feedback tuples, and the replanning rule (Eq. 1) with a three-tier failure taxonomy; however, the specific LLM model/version and prompting details are never named in the text.

Results, 'An Automated Reviewer...' (Page 8): reviewer-vs-regulatory validation on 11 reference projects reports Spearman rho=0.717, MAD 3.9 points, 89% high agreement - a small-n calibration supporting the termination gate.

Results (Page 5): AI design achieves 255.5 vs 278 t·MW⁻¹ steel intensity and ¥18,197 vs ¥19,800 kW⁻¹ unit capex (both -8.1%) vs the TuQiang baseline, with unity check <1.0 and fatigue within 25-year life at DFF 3.0.

Pages 9-10, 'External validation via formal third-party Approval in Principle': single highest-scoring candidate (S=91) passed CCS AIP after three clarification rounds - strong external evidence, but for only one artifact.

Discussion, 'Limitations and future directions' (Pages 13-14): fabrication constraints are 'prompt-approximated', LLM stochasticity introduces epistemic variance, and only one branch advanced to AIP; also no wave-basin or typhoon-survivability validation.

Data and code availability (Pages 20-21): GitHub repo for the orchestration platform is claimed, but the flagship run bundles 'will be deposited in Zenodo with a DOI upon publication' (not yet available) and Zwind 2.5 is third-party proprietary.
Statistics and reproducibility (Page 20): 'All flagship metrics are from single deterministic solver runs' with no multi-seed characterization of the stochastic LLM loop.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-based agent-framework paper (orchestrator + schema-validated tool calling + failure-driven replanning) applied to a single physical-engineering demonstration: a 20 MW floating offshore wind foundation that passed CCS Approval in Principle. It is not a pure domain application because the closed-loop 'verification-closed' agent architecture, termination gates, and two-stage internal-reviewer/external-AIP validation cascade are genuine agentic-methodology contributions (Agents & Tool Use, LLM preferences). However, relevance is tempered: the entire empirical evaluation is one artifact; the LLM is used as an underspecified orchestration layer (model identity, prompts, and replanning policy ablations absent), and the deterministic engineering stack (BESO, PSO, CalculiX, Zwind) does most of the work. Novelty of the verification-closed framing and regulatory calibration is real but adjacent to existing autonomous-discovery agents. Rigor is mixed: honest limitations, deterministic solvers, and quantitative limit-state checks, but the reviewer-vs-regulator validation uses only 11 reference projects (Spearman 0.717 is moderate), baseline comparison is a single human design, no ablations on the agent policy, and 'thousands of candidates' claims lack run-level statistics. Evidence strength rests on the external AIP pass (strong for n=1) plus a small-n calibration study. Generalizability is asserted via three enabling conditions but never tested outside FOWT design. Reproducibility is weak: the proprietary Zwind 2.5 solver, unspecified LLM, Zenodo deposit only promised 'upon publication', and acknowledged LLM sampling variance.
topics: LLM tool use and closed-loop planning

primary_link.title: Closed-loop AI achieves certifiable engineering design

radar.summary: Agentic AI has automated parts of scientific discovery, including paper generation, expert-level coding, therapeutic proposal, and autonomous experimentation. Complex physical engineering design remains a gap, because candidates must satisfy simultaneous constraints in fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and structural stability. We introduce The AI Engineer, an agentic framework that couples large language models (LLMs) to deterministic engineering backends in a closed loop: natural-language requi
radar.summary_zh: 從風機到離岸浮式平台，物理工程設計必須同時滿足流體力學、固體力學與結構穩定性等多重約束，長期仰賴專家反覆試錯。作者提出 The AI Engineer：一個代理式框架，將 LLM 與確定性工程後端整合於閉環——自然語言需求轉為設計域幾何與網格，以 BESO 拓撲最佳化耦合 CalculiX 求解器，再以 PSO 尺寸最佳化耦合 Zwind 在真實離岸氣動—水動—伺服彈性載荷下細化構件，遇網格異常或極限狀態違反時自主重規劃。為避免逐候選認證的高昂成本，系統以自動審查員作為內部終止閘門，基於 11 個真實浮式風電專案校準的片段線性函數，在容量、鋼材強度、單位成本、可施工性與疲勞壽命五個維度評分，複合分數達 85 分（A 級）且無子維度低於 60 才終止探索。此門檻經外部金標驗證：最高分候選送交中國船級社（CCS）完整審查並通過原則性認可（AIP），審查員與監管評分的 Spearman 相關為 0.717。產出設計優於人工最佳化的「TuQiang」基準，鋼材消耗與單位資本成本皆降低 8.1%，並滿足所有極限狀態準則。限制包括細部設計與製造約束未涵蓋、無法自主安排水池試驗、LLM 隨機性需以多種子與凍結工具架構控制。此研究確立可認證工程設計的端對端自動化為可行典範。

links.title: Ask or Answer: A Decision Framework for Multi-Turn Health Misinformation Intervention

evidence: Table 1 (Section 5): RO-PnR utility 0.71-0.73 vs strongest baseline SFT 0.69-0.72 across three datasets and three 8B models; RO-PnR turns 3.46-3.80 vs 5.00 for always-probe Fixed-Q.
Table 4 (Section 6): reward-horizon ablation drops utility 0.71 to 0.60; probe cost c=0 yields 5.83 turns and quality 0.51; c=0.03-0.05 recover 0.69-0.71.

Section 7, Tables 8-11: simulator persona accuracy 3.87/5 and consistency 4.64/5; LLM-judge vs human consensus Scott's pi=0.55, MAE=0.23, Pearson 0.57, Spearman 0.72; pairwise preference 79.70% RO-PnR vs 20.30% Fixed-Q with only six users and one baseline.

Section 2.2: paper states it builds on decision-theoretic probing (refs 7, 28), multi-turn-aware rewards (ref 55), and curiosity reward for latent user state (ref 52), combining forward-looking reward with an explicit interaction cost.
Limitations section: authors concede reliance on simulated users, unoptimized probe content, and coarse fixed per-turn cost modeling.

Appendix C: CounterHealth derived from 4,968 Reddit posts to 769 misinformation posts via RoBERTa classifier (F1=0.76) plus GPT-5-mini filtering, Cohen's kappa >= 0.67 on a 100-post validation sample.
Section 4.5 and Table 5: LoRA SFT (r=16, alpha=32) then offline GRPO (beta_KL=0.05, lr 5e-6) with seed 42 on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B, Gemma-4-E4B-it; no code or data release is mentioned.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In scope: core methodology is LLM-centric (8B LLMs fine-tuned with SFT+GRPO on turn-level probe/respond decisions, cost-aware forward-looking reward, LLM-simulated heterogeneous users, LLM-judged metrics), matching high-weight preferences for agents, RLHF/alignment, and dialogue NLP; it is not a pure domain application, though the health-misinformation framing dilutes topic fit. Novelty is modest and self-acknowledged as a combination of existing decision-theoretic probing, multi-turn-aware rewards, and latent-user-state modeling, instantiated with domain-grounded health-literacy/belief-commitment states. Rigor is above average (3 datasets, 3 base models, 5 baselines, reward-horizon and cost ablations, human validation of simulator, judge, and preference), but the headline utility advantage over the strongest SFT baseline is only 0.01-0.02 with no variance, seeds, or significance testing, and all interaction is simulator-only with quality metrics judged by models whose rubrics mirror the training reward. Evidence strongly supports the turn-reduction claim (~3.5 vs 5.0 turns) but only weakly supports 'highest utility'. Generalizability is limited by a domain-specific latent state space and health-only training/evaluation. Reproducibility is decent (hyperparameters, full prompts, dataset construction) but no code/data release is stated and the pipeline depends on GPT-4o-mini/GPT-5-mini/Mistral APIs.

primary_link.title: Ask or Answer: A Decision Framework for Multi-Turn Health Misinformation Intervention

radar.summary: Correcting health misinformation in dialogue requires more than producing a factual rebuttal: users differ in what they know, what they believe, and what they need to hear, so an effective intervention often depends on first asking the right clarifying question. Yet existing methods either respond immediately or probe indiscriminately, treating clarification as either unnecessary or always beneficial. We propose Reward-Optimized Probe-and-Respond (RO-PnR), a framework that learns when asking is
radar.summary_zh: 對話式糾正健康錯誤資訊不能只靠產出事實反駁：使用者的知識、信念與需求各異，有效介入往往取決於先問對澄清問題。然而既有方法不是立即回答，就是一律追問，把澄清視為不必要或永遠有益。作者提出 Reward-Optimized Probe-and-Respond（RO-PnR），學習「何時提問值得其成本」：在每一輪以輪級獎勵權衡追問的預期收益與互動成本，決定繼續澄清或直接給出最終糾正。為捕捉使用者異質性對提問價值的影響，模擬使用者以健康素養與信念承諾兩個潛在維度刻劃（各三級、共九種組合），且這些狀態對政策隱藏。訓練上先以最佳軌跡做監督式微調暖機，再以 GRPO 在輪級決策對上依群組相對優勢更新政策。實驗涵蓋三個健康錯誤資訊資料集與三個基礎模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma），RO-PnR 取得最高成本調整效用，且比一律追問基準少約 30% 輪數，增益在低素養與強信念使用者上最大，正是提問決策最關鍵的族群；人類驗證亦支持模擬器可靠性與評分一致性。消融顯示前瞻式長程獎勵與追問成本皆不可或缺。限制包括依賴模擬使用者、未最佳化提問內容、成本模型較粗略。此研究將健康錯誤資訊糾正重塑為奠基於使用者動態的序列決策問題。

links.title: Guidance for Prior Change via Density Ratio Estimation

evidence: Abstract: proposes 'an unbiased test-time guidance framework that leverages Density Ratio Estimation (DRE)' claiming it 'matches or outperforms PriorGuide on C2ST and MMD in most tasks'; no language-model or agent content anywhere in the paper.
Section 4.1.1 (Figure 2): OOD C2ST of ~0.58 on Gaussian Linear 6D and ~0.54 on OUP versus ~0.69 and ~0.65 for PriorGuide, described as 'the largest margins in the OOD regime'.

Table 2 (Appendix H) and Appendix I.2: on Turin, PriorGuide attains C2ST 0.53 (ID) / 0.53 (OOD) vs NRE 0.57 / 0.71; authors attribute the loss to DRE degradation at combined dimension d_theta+d_x=105, with observation compression deferred to future work (Section 5 Discussion).

Appendix G.1: for OUP and Turin, 'we use a score-based NPE model trained on one million simulations as a surrogate ground-truth posterior', so evaluation on two of five tasks is against an approximate reference.

Appendix G.3 and G.4: full training details given (Simformer with 6 transformer layers, 4-layer/256-hidden MLP ratio model, AdamW batch 4096 lr 3e-4 for 10k iterations, T=25-step sampler); Abstract provides code at github.com/a-chenchen/dre-based-prior-guidance and Appendices G.5/J.5 name the GPU hardware, supporting reproducibility.

Appendix I (Table 4): introduces an ESS/N diagnostic of prior-ratio weights to predict when guidance carries signal (Two Moons 0.990 explaining its failure case), adding methodological rigor beyond headline metrics.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid statistical-ML methodology paper on test-time prior adaptation for diffusion-based simulation-based inference via density ratio estimation, but it sits outside the curated preference space: no LLM, language-model, agent, reasoning, or Japanese NLP content; only weak keyword overlaps (diffusion model, Simformer transformer, scientific simulation/astrophysics use cases), so preference relevance is low though it is not one of the explicitly excluded domains (not image/video diffusion or a pure domain application). Research quality is competent: a clean importance-weighting identity (Prop. 1) enables simulation-free DRE training of the guidance term, a general variational framework (Thm. 1) covers NRE/KLIEP, and the evaluation is broad (5 benchmarks, ID+OOD, 4 metrics, Wilcoxon tests, oracle reference, failure-case analysis with an ESS diagnostic). Results are mixed rather than dominant: clear OOD gains on Gaussian Linear 6D and OUP, but PriorGuide wins on Turin and marginally on Two Moons, and OUP/Turin ground truth relies on a surrogate NPE rather than exact posteriors. Novelty is incremental over PriorGuide (replacing Gaussian-kernel/GMM bias with DRE). Reproducibility is strong (code URL, exhaustive hyperparameters, hardware, prior specs).

primary_link.title: Guidance for Prior Change via Density Ratio Estimation

radar.summary: Simulation-Based Inference (SBI) serves as a vital framework for parameter inference in scientific fields where simulators involve intractable likelihoods, yet while amortized generative models offer rapid posterior estimation, they are often restricted by the specific priors used during training, thereby limiting their flexibility as prior knowledge evolves. To address this prior dependency, PriorGuide was introduced as an inference-time guidance method, but due to its intractable formulation,
radar.summary_zh: 模擬式推論(SBI)中的 amortized 生成模型能在訓練後快速估計後驗,但其結果隱含固定於訓練時的先驗;當科學先驗知識演變時,模型便產生偏差,重新模擬與重訓的成本又極高。既有測試時引導方法 PriorGuide 因公式不可解析,須以高斯混合模型擬合先驗比值,並以高斯近似反向轉移核,兩者皆引入系統性偏差。本文提出以密度比估計(DRE)直接學習引導項的無偏測試時引導框架:藉由重要性加權恆等式,訓練僅需重用基礎模型原有資料,無須額外呼叫模擬器;框架對比率估計器不可知,文中以 NRE 與 KLIEP 兩種目標實例化並推廣為一般化變分形式,擴散過程的高斯雜訊亦自然穩定比率估計,即使訓練與目標先驗支撐重疊有限仍具穩健性。在 Two Moons、SLCP、Gaussian Linear 6D、OUP 與 Turin 五項基準上,以 C2ST、MMD、W2 與 RMSE 評估,本方法於多數任務追平或超越 PriorGuide 與加權分數匹配(WSM),OOD 情境優勢最大;後驗預測實驗亦顯示 PriorGuide 有系統性偏差,本方法則表現穩定。應用於 TESS 系外行星光變曲線資料的序列式貝葉斯更新時,後驗隨觀測穩定收斂至參考值,PriorGuide 則逐漸失穩。限制在於比率估計於高維度(如 Turin 任務達 105 維)效能下降,且當先驗比值在後驗支撐上近乎平坦時引導訊號有限。此工作使科學流程得以在不重訓基礎模型的情況下彈性更新先驗,兼具效率與實用價值。

links.title: Bi-EZP: LLM-Guided Bilevel Program Evolution for Ensemble Zero-Cost Proxy Discovery

evidence: Abstract: proposes 'a bilevel framework that separates the two decisions' with an LLM generating aggregation programs and CMA-ES optimizing continuous parameters.
Section IV-B: GLM-4.7-Flash used, population size 20, 20 generations, CMA-ES capped at 1,500 evaluations per candidate, seed 1, temperature 1.0, no LLM seed.
Table I: Bi-EZP reaches 0.809/0.791/0.775 on NATS-Bench-TSS vs ECP 0.782/0.771/0.740.

Section IV-C1/IV-D1: authors state the comparison 'does not establish that the gain arises from program representation, operator choice, or expression size'; 'w/o LLM' variant scores 0.784 vs 0.809 on TSS CIFAR-10.
Tables III-IV (Section IV-C3): frozen transfer off-diagonal means 0.775 (cross-dataset) and 0.515 (NDS) vs diagonal 0.792 and 0.557, showing measurable source-target degradation.
Section IV-D4: LLM-sensitivity check covers only two backbones (GLM-4.7-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Flash), explicitly not establishing invariance.
Section IV-C4: reported 0.06 GPU-days covers only downstream DARTS search and 'do[es] not include the one-time offline Bi-EZP proxy-discovery cost'.
Section III-I: 'it does not penalize program complexity explicitly' and the search space 'depends on the language model, prompt, decoding behavior, and validator'.
Abstract/Section III-C: source code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Bi-EZP-318D; AST-based validation gate with correction attempts and fallback program described.
llm_evaluation.rationale: The core contribution is automated zero-cost proxy discovery for NAS (vision AutoML), an adjacent domain; the LLM is used instrumentally as an upper-level program generator (EoH-style), not as an object of study, so relevance to the LLM/NLP/agent preference profile is moderate rather than central. The bilevel decoupling of LLM structural search from CMA-ES parameter calibration is a sensible incremental advance over ECP (fixed aggregation family + PSO) and EZNAS (GP), with a proper code-validation gate. Experiments are broad (NATS-Bench TSS/SSS, NDS, DARTS, CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet) with ablations for bilevel removal, LLM removal, three alternative lower-level optimizers, population/generation sweeps, and two LLM backbones; however, results are single-seed (seed 1, Section IV-B) with no variance or significance testing, gains over the closest baseline are modest (0.782 to 0.809 Kendall tau, Table I), and the authors themselves concede the comparison 'does not establish that the gain arises from program representation' (IV-C1, IV-D1). Transfer matrices (Tables III-IV) honestly show degradation under freezing. Reproducibility is comparatively good: anonymous code link, LLM identifier, temperature, endpoint, budgets, and splits are reported, though no LLM-side seed and temperature 1.0 limit determinism.

primary_link.title: Bi-EZP: LLM-Guided Bilevel Program Evolution for Ensemble Zero-Cost Proxy Discovery

radar.summary: Zero-cost proxies enable neural architecture search (NAS) to rank candidate networks from statistics computed at initialization, avoiding repeated training. However, different proxies capture different properties and often produce inconsistent rankings across search spaces. Ensemble proxies can combine complementary signals, but automated discovery must optimize both discrete aggregation structures and their continuous coefficients, making structural quality difficult to separate from parameter
radar.summary_zh: 神經架構搜尋(NAS)的成本瓶頸在於候選架構評估;零成本代理可由初始化階段的少量前向或反向傳遞統計量排序架構,但單一代理在不同搜尋空間常產生不一致的排名。整合多個代理可結合互補訊號,惟自動化探索需同時決定離散的聚合結構與連續係數,兩者耦合使結構品質難以與參數校準區分。本文提出 Bi-EZP,以雙層最佳化解耦兩類決策:上層由大型語言模型(LLM)生成可執行的聚合程式,並附各程式專屬的參數邊界;下層以 CMA-ES 於內部訓練集為每個固定結構校準連續參數,校準後的程式在不相交的驗證集上以 Kendall 等級相關評估,經錦標賽選擇與精英保留進行演化。輸入基底固定為 NASWOT、MeCo、Sweet-SNIP 與 SZiCo 四種互補代理,涵蓋激活、特徵、參數顯著性與梯度一致性視角。實驗於 NATS-Bench(TSS/SSS)、NDS 五個架構家族與 DARTS 空間進行,Kendall τ 全面超越先前最強基線 ECP,如 TSS CIFAR-10 由 0.782 升至 0.809;凍結代理於跨資料集與跨搜尋空間遷移時多數仍保有排名保真度。下游 DARTS 搜尋於 CIFAR-10 達 2.47% 測試錯誤率、ImageNet 達 24.7% Top-1 錯誤率,搜尋成本僅 0.06–0.07 GPU-days(不含一次性離線探索成本)。消融顯示雙層解耦與 LLM 提案機制皆屬關鍵,CMA-ES 亦優於 GA、DE 與 PSO。限制包括離線探索的 token 成本、代理品質受限於預選基底指標,以及搜尋空間依賴提示與驗證器設計,且未對程式複雜度施以懲罰。

links.title: Ludi${}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$: An Agentic System for Socially Intelligent Robots

evidence: Table 1 (Section 3.4): Qwen3.5-9B fine-tuned 20/28 vs 11/28 vanilla, 4B fine-tuned 17/28 vs 10/28 vanilla, GPT-5.6 with GEPA-optimized prompt 26/28; LoRA used, judge-overturned counts reported per cell.

Section 3.2: corpus of 14,432 fully synthetic trajectories, tool-call correctness 'guaranteed by construction' via state machine, teacher LLM writes language, two-stage LLM judge quality gate with up to two revision attempts.

Section 3.4: Core28 has 28 scenarios in AI2-THOR/ProcTHOR with gold tool-call trajectories and deterministic gates; LLM judge may only overturn failures on language-semantic utterance gates, not tool use or final state.
Section 3.2: 9B 'achieved higher benchmark success than the 4B model, but we deployed the smaller model because its lower inference latency provided a better tradeoff.'

Section 4: sherpa-onnx STT transcribed a 10-second utterance in 94.7 ms average, 99.2 ms P95, 'no transcription errors on the test clips'; authors note these are processing times, not end-to-end latency.

Section 6: Isaac Sim calibration (mask IoU ~0.92, fingertip error <=13 mm) but 'simulated performance did not always preserve policy rankings on the physical robot,' so simulation used only as a screening tool.
Section 8: authors state the integration 'can introduce context loss, latency, brittle handoffs, and fragmented behavior' and that the system 'does not learn a unified representation.'
Whole document: no statement of code, dataset, benchmark, or model weight release; Sections 3.3-3.4 note scenarios are hash-fixed for internal reproducibility only.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An embodied agentic system whose core is a fine-tuned Qwen3.5 VLM doing tool calling (say/navigate/reachability/vla/wait), matching high-weight preferences for Agents & Tool Use, LLM fine-tuning, multimodal reasoning, and LLM-judge evaluation; it is not 'pure robotics' because language methodology (SFT on 14,432 synthetic tool-call traces, GEPA prompt-optimization baseline, LLM judge) is central. However, the contribution is a system/demo paper: the agentic VLM-selects-tools pattern is well established (SayCan, Hi Robot, Gemini Robotics ER 2, VLAs-as-Tools, acknowledged in Section 7), the headline evaluation is only 28 simulation scenarios (Core28) with no repeats or variance, real-robot results are a single qualitative demonstration with no end-to-end success metrics, and the deployed 4B model is chosen over the better-scoring 9B for latency, leaving the best result undeployed. No code, data, weights, or scenario release is mentioned, so reproducibility is weak. Limitations (brittle handoffs, fragmented behavior, simulation rankings not preserving physical rankings) are candidly stated.

A robot must recognize ambiguity, maintain context across turns, communicate its intentions, and revise ongoing behavior as the user's intent changes. We present $\scriptstyle\mathsf{Ludi}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$, an agentic system for socially intelligent robots that integrates interactive speech, multimodal reasoning, memory, naviga
radar.summary_zh: 機器人基礎模型在感知與控制上進展迅速,但自然的人機協作需要更多:機器人必須辨識語意模糊、跨輪次維持上下文、傳達意圖,並在使用者意圖改變時修正進行中的行為。本文提出 Ludi 0.1,一個整合互動語音、多模態推理、記憶、導航與學習型操作的代理式機器人系統,運行於 Unitree G1 人形機器人。其決策核心為經 fine-tuning 的 Qwen3.5 視覺語言模型(VLM),訓練資料為 14,432 條完全合成的多輪互動軌跡,涵蓋模糊請求、任務中途更正、打斷與多步驟任務,工具呼叫正確性由狀態機保證,並經規則檢查與兩階段 LLM 評審把關。harness 管理模型呼叫、工具執行與共享互動紀錄,支援非阻塞式上下文壓縮、視覺預填充與非同步語音;操作由微調自 GR00T N1.7 的 VLA 政策執行,導航結合 KISS-ICP 定位、關鍵點地圖與連續規劃器。評估採封閉迴圈模擬基準 Interaction Core28(28 個 AI2-THOR 情境):微調後 9B 模型完成 20/28,約為未微調版兩倍,接近 GPT-5.6 加最佳化提示的 26/28;實機亦展示語音更正下即時改送 Pepsi 的能力,剩餘失敗多集中於交付端的空間定位。限制在於互動層整合屬工程性質而非學得,可能引入上下文流失、延遲與脆弱交接。作者將持續改進此架構,並利用其多模態互動軌跡發展更深整合的機器人與人類基礎模型 Ludi 1.0。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An industrial LLM-agent technical report squarely within preferred topics (agents/tool use, agentic RL, distillation, prompting, serving). Core methodological idea—Harness-State Augmentation placing harness variation (skills, tools, prompts, hooks) into the training distribution to prevent surface-form overfitting—is a sensible, moderately novel framing that mostly composes known techniques (teacher-rejection SFT, on-policy distillation, GRPO/GDPO/GSPO). Rigor is above average for a tech report: stage-wise ablations (Table 4), judge calibration against 482 human labels (Appendix B.4), paired bootstrap (Table 14), a 100-request human blind test with binomial test, and a ~1.98M-UV online A/B test. Evidence is strong but self-referential: headline quality scores come from the authors' own LLM-judge panel with ~82-90% human agreement, two of four sets are synthetic/LLM-generated, and the IFEval gain over base (+2.03, CI [-1.11,+5.18], P_boot=0.1134) is honestly reported as not significant; A/B significance is reproduced from the platform without test details. Generalizability is claimed via a general formulation but all evaluation is Taobao live-commerce; the method plausibly transfers to any evolvable-harness agent. Reproducibility is low: no code/data release, proprietary live-room data, internal simulator and harness inventory, unreleased future-model checkpoints. Not a pure domain application since the training methodology is the contribution.

primary_link.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report

top5.summary: AI-powered digital avatar streamers must answer product questions, engage viewers, and execute marketing strategies in real time, demanding low latency, frequent strategy updates, and accurate yet effective responses. Evolvable Harnesses, whose Skills, Hooks, prompts, and tools can be updated independently of model weights, enable rapid iteration but expose a trade-off: large models adapt zero-shot yet are too slow, whereas compact models meet latency targets but overfit to fixed Harness configurations. We propose Harness-Aware Training (HAT), which trains compact models to adapt to changing Harnesses. Its key component, Harness-State Augmentation (HSA), applies task-preserving transformations to Skill identifiers and content, tool schemas, prompt structures, and Hook functions. Training proceeds in three stages: HSA-SFT learns reasoning and tool use from strong-model trajectories across diverse environments; General On-Policy Distillation restores generalization lost during SFT; and HSA-RL improves robustness to changing Harnesses through reinforcement learning in augmented environments. Across four evaluation sets, HAT achieves 94.8 on Live-Stream QA (base: 80.3; strongest general LLM: 93.0) and 94.6 on Harness-Variant QA (base: 75.4). Unlike Fixed-Harness SFT, which lowers IFEval by 7.7 points from the base model, HAT avoids this regression and reaches 83.5. On one NVIDIA H20 GPU, the optimized system delivers P50 and P95 latencies of 3.4 s and 8.1 s. Deployed in Taobao Live's digital-avatar service, it also yields positive online A/B test results for GMV and item-page views.
top5.summary_zh: 此報告探討淘寶直播數位虛擬主播代理的訓練難題:即時電商要求超低延遲、策略頻繁更新,回覆又須準確。團隊採用可演化的 Harness 架構,將 Skills、Hooks、系統提示與工具註冊表同凍結的模型權重解耦,業務行為免重訓即可調整;但僅以單一組態做 SFT,輕量模型會對技能與工具名稱、提示模板產生表面形式過擬合,IFEval 掉了7.7分。作者提出 Harness-Aware Training(HAT),以 Harness-State Augmentation(HSA)對技能識別與內容、工具定義、系統提示及 Hook 施加保留語意的擾動,並採三階段訓練:HSA-SFT 由教師模型在多樣 Harness 環境產生軌跡;General OPD 以基礎模型做 on-policy 蒸餾,恢復通用指令遵循;HSA-RL 在模擬直播環境以 GRPO 與 GDPO 做強化學習。訓練後的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 Live-Stream QA 達94.8分、Harness-Variant QA 達94.6分,IFEval 保住83.5分而未退化;單張 NVIDIA H20 開啟 MTP 後 P50 延遲3.4秒、P95約8.1秒,請求全數於15秒內完成;線上 A/B 測試確認收貨 GMV 較 ReAct 提升4.33%、商品頁瀏覽提升0.91%。限制為評測集與模擬器多源自自有業務資料且依賴內部評審,MTP 加速僅限低併發,訓練動態屬單次運行診斷。本研究示範讓輕量模型理解當前 Harness 而非背誦固定版本,兼顧延遲、適應性與通用能力,對快速迭代的生產級代理系統深具參考價值。

links.title: VIG: Visual Information Gain as a Reward Signal for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression

evidence: Abstract: 'Across six main multimodal reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3-VL-Thinking model sizes (2B/4B/8B)... VIG consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off' and code link https://github.com/chaser682/vig
Section 4.2: 'On Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, VIG attains AvgACC = 64.92% and AvgEff = 52.42, surpassing the strongest compression baseline ThinkPrune by +2.37% in accuracy and +39.4% in efficiency'
Section 4.3 / Table 4: 'Removing the VIG term from the reward reduces the method to plain GRPO, which collapses AvgEff from 52.42 to 36.44 (-30%) and lowers AvgACC by 2.04 points'
Section 4.1: 'All numbers we report are from a single deterministic (greedy, temperature 0) decoding pass per checkpoint' with paired-bootstrap CIs reported where margins matter (Appendix F)
Section 4.2: 2B block caveat: 'the margin over the strongest baseline is only +0.55 points and is not significant under a unified step-400 protocol... 53% of 2B generations hit the 4,096-token limit'

Appendix F.2 / Table 6: deletion probe shows 'deleting the lowest-VIG sentences is the most damaging condition' on VIG-trained chains (80.92 to 72.36 at 50%), the opposite of a token-importance reading
Limitations: 'VIG measures visual dependence, which is neither visual correctness nor counterfactual necessity... we regard cross-architecture generality as unresolved'
Appendix G / Table 7: VIG training overhead 1.17x vs plain GRPO (37.2 vs 31.8 s/it); break-even after roughly 48K inference requests
Appendix E: full training configuration (G=8, KL 0.04, lr 1e-6, DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, 500 steps) and baseline implementations on identical data/protocol
Appendix D: training mixture of 2,948 samples from MMStar, MathVista, LogicVista; evaluation set sizes for all seven benchmarks

Section 4.2 / Table 3: non-math transfer on RealWorldQA and OCRBench claims only 'VIG preserves accuracy at a substantially lower token cost', with gaps among strong methods acknowledged as within noise
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal CoT-compression paper squarely inside scope: it trains Qwen3-VL reasoning models with GRPO using a per-token conditional-mutual-information reward (visual information gain) computed from two forward passes (with/without image), reframing compression as visual-density maximization rather than length budgeting. Strong match to high-weight preferences (Reasoning/CoT, LLMs, RL, efficiency, multimodal). Novelty is solid: per-token information-theoretic reward for CoT compression is a fresh angle versus textual length penalties (L1, ThinkPrune, TALE) and trajectory-level VPPO, though it builds on established GRPO and information-bottleneck ideas. Rigor is unusually careful: five baselines, three model sizes, six-plus-one benchmarks, reward/masked-image/weight ablations, a confidence-only control arm, text-solvable vs vision-required stratification, paired-bootstrap CIs, and an honest deletion probe (Appendix F.2/Table 6) whose counterintuitive asymmetry the authors interpret rather than hide. Evidence is strong for the core claim (+2.37% ACC, +39.4% efficiency over ThinkPrune at 8B; ablation removes 30% of efficiency gain), and the authors appropriately hedge the 2B block (runaway-length confound, non-significant +0.55), non-math accuracy (within noise), and the mismatched VPPO checkpoint. Deductions: single greedy decoding pass for headline tables, checkpoint-step asymmetry (400 vs 500) across methods, one model family with cross-architecture generality explicitly unresolved, and reward requiring model-specific vision-token separation. Reproducibility is good: code link, Algorithm 1, full hyperparameters, training-data details, licenses, and a cost/break-even analysis (1.17x overhead, ~48K request payback). Minor metadata sloppiness (mismatched author emails) noted but not decisive.

primary_link.title: VIG: Visual Information Gain as a Reward Signal for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression

top5.summary: Multimodal large reasoning models often rely on long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces in which a substantial fraction of tokens, such as repeated visual descriptions, self-reflection, and other visually-disengaged filler, inflate inference cost without contributing to the answer. Existing CoT compression methods optimize output length but never measure whether a reasoning token is actually grounded in the image. We propose \textbf{VIG} (Visual Information Gain), an information-theoretic GRPO reward
top5.summary_zh: 多模態大型推理模型常產生冗長的思維鏈（CoT），其中大量詞元——如重複的視覺描述、自我反思以及其他與影像無關的填充語句——推高推論成本卻無助於答案。現有 CoT 壓縮方法僅最佳化輸出長度，從未衡量推理詞元是否真正依賴影像。本文提出 VIG（視覺資訊增益），一種資訊理論的 GRPO 獎勵：以影像降低詞元預測不確定性的程度為每個推理詞元評分。VIG 透過同一策略的兩次前向傳播（含影像與移除視覺詞元）線上計算熵差，無需參考鏈、外部標註或輔助獎勵模型，可直接嵌入 GRPO。在三種 Qwen3-VL-Thinking 模型（2B/4B/8B）與六個多模態推理基準上，VIG 一致改善準確率與效率的權衡：於 8B 模型達到平均準確率 64.92% 與效率 52.42，較最強壓縮基線 ThinkPrune 提升 +2.37% 準確率與 +39.4% 效率，並在 R1-Onevision-Bench 總體排名第一。消融實驗顯示鏈長縮短是提升視覺資訊密度的副產品。限制包括：訓練需額外的純文字前向傳播（約 17% 開銷）、依賴視覺與文字詞元的乾淨切分，且 VIG 衡量的是視覺依賴而非正確性——自信的幻覺讀取也可能得高分；跨架構泛化性亦尚未解決。核心主張是：高效的多模態推理源自提升視覺資訊密度，而非施加長度預算。

Section 3: coupling coefficient C=||RW||_F/(||R||_F||W||_F) generalizes Elhage et al. (2021) composition scores to all 18 connection classes; Prop. 5 (Appendix A.4) gives exact chance level E[C^2]=1/d.

Section 4 / Table 10: freezing the 30-head induction community destroys 93.8% of GPT-2's induction gain vs 2.5% random-control median; five behavioral induction heads alone account for only 60.8%; replication in Table 9 reaches 97.1% vs 1.0% control at Pythia-2.8B.

Section 5 / Table 3: RW-PCA 2D subspace deletion destroys 82-96% of induction gain across six models; Pythia-6.9B: 89.5% (ours) vs 84.5% (activation PCA) vs 36.5% (outlier dims); Pythia-160m: 95.8% vs 42.0%/35.4%; principal cosines show the directions are distinct from baselines.

Section 6 limitations: map shows potential connectivity from weights only, not input-dependent routing; validated against a single capability (in-context copying); experiments limited to sub-10B-parameter models; nodes are heads/neurons, not learned features.
Appendix C.2/D.3: GPT-Neo excluded from deletion because random 2D deletions already destroy 60-98% of its induction gain; Pythia-6.9B absent from Table 9 due to ~55 GB RAM vs 45 GB available.

Reproducibility statement: full pipeline released at github.com/richardzhewang/communication-map with fixed seeds, public TransformerLens checkpoints, fixed Pile samples, single NVIDIA RTX 5090; all numbers regenerate from released code and map tables.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Mechanistic interpretability of transformer language models, squarely in scope (not a listed out-of-scope area). It directly matches high-weight preferences: LLMs (weight 2.5; GPT-2/Neo/Pythia language models), Interpretability & Explainability (weight 1.8; circuits, attention heads, residual stream), Transformer Architecture (weight 1.2; W_QK/W_OV, attention), plus moderate matches to Prompting/ICL (in-context copying/induction gain) and Scaling. Novelty is high: first claimed whole-transformer communication map over all 18 connection classes including neurons (Section 1, 3), a generalized coupling coefficient with closed-form rotation-null moments, and a new RW-PCA method yielding an induction-critical 2D subspace distinct from activation-PCA and outlier-dimension baselines (Section 5, Table 3). Rigor is strong: proofs (Appendix A.3-A.4), Monte Carlo verification of closed-form nulls, FDR control with stratum-fitted empirical nulls (Section 4, C.1), matched random ablation controls, replication across six models (Table 9), and honest caveats (GPT-Neo excluded because random deletions destroy 60-98%, Appendix D.3; Pythia-6.9B ablation absent due to RAM, C.2). Evidence is quantitative and controlled (93.8% induction-gain destruction vs 2.5% control median, GPT-2, Table 10; 89.5% vs 84.5%/36.5% baselines at 6.9B, Table 3), though validated on a single capability and limited to sub-10B models (Section 6 limitations). Reproducibility is excellent: released code/maps with fixed seeds, public checkpoints, documented compute (Reproducibility statement).

primary_link.title: The Communication Map of a Transformer

top5.summary: The components of a transformer communicate by writing to and reading from a shared residual stream, and mechanistic interpretability has mapped these connections by hand, one circuit at a time. We present the communication map, which charts every potential communication channel in a language model from weights alone, generalizing the composition score of Elhage et al. (2021) into a single coupling coefficient covering all 18 connection classes, from entire attention head circuits to single neur
top5.summary_zh: Transformer 的各元件（attention heads 與 MLP 神經元）共用殘差流（residual stream）交換資訊，但過去機制可解釋性研究多為逐一手工追蹤單一電路，缺乏整個模型層級的通訊全景。本文提出「通訊地圖」，僅從權重即可描繪所有潛在通訊通道：作者將 Elhage 等人的 composition score 推廣為通用的耦合係數，覆蓋 18 類連線（head 間 K/Q/V-composition、head 與神經元、介面矩陣等），並以 Haar 旋轉的理論虛無分配、分層經驗虛無分配與 FDR 控制判定顯著連線。透過跡的循環性質與內 Gram 矩陣分解，繪製 GPT-2 全圖僅需 15 秒，Pythia-6.9B 的 1.3×10¹¹ 條候選通道也只要 11 分鐘（單張消費級 GPU）。普查發現 70–89% 的 head 對顯著偏離隨機水準，不是超耦合就是主動迴避；神經元之間也存在遠超機率的直接連線。應用一：最強的 head 間耦合在不依賴行為線索下重現 induction 電路，並形成縱貫多層的社群，消融含五個 induction heads 的社群摧毀 GPT-2 93.8% 的 in-context 複製能力（Pythia-2.8B 達 97.1%）。應用二：reader–writer PCA（RW-PCA）從權重幾何找出二維 induction 關鍵子空間，刪除它在六個模型上摧毀 82–96% 的 induction 能力，效果優於 activation PCA 與 outlier dimensions 基線，且選出的方向與二者不同。限制方面：地圖僅反映權重的潛在連通性，無法呈現依輸入而變的實際訊號路由；驗證聚焦單一能力（in-context copying）；實驗限於百億參數以下模型；節點為 heads 與神經元而非稀疏自編碼器學得的特徵。整體而言，此工作首次建立全模型通訊地圖，並釋出地圖、統計工具與介入套件，為電路發現、子空間介入與可解釋性研究提供高效且可重現的基礎。
